title: IAM Operations - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Manager in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber Operate team, you will help clients manage identity and access management (IAM) operations across enterprise platforms, customer applications, and third-party tools. You will lead day-to-day delivery of user identity and access lifecycle activities, helping maintain a secure, compliant, and efficient access environment. You will work with client and cross-functional teams to strengthen access governance, operational controls, and service delivery while supporting the development of team members.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Lead day-to-day user access administration across applications, platforms, and systems, including provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, access modifications, and joiner, mover, leaver activities.
* Validate access requests for completeness, approvals, and policy alignment; maintain user accounts, group memberships, roles, and entitlements in accordance with approved workflows and service-level targets.
* Oversee the logging, triage, categorization, prioritization, tracking, and closure of incidents, service requests, and access-related tasks using IT service management (ITSM) and ticketing tools.
* Apply standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, knowledge articles, and control requirements; maintain operational documentation, trackers, status updates, and audit evidence for access reviews and recertification activities.
* Troubleshoot routine access issues, coordinate with application owners, infrastructure, security, and service delivery teams, and escalate complex issues to senior team members or tool administrators within defined thresholds.
* Investigate recurring access issues, entitlement mismatches, control gaps, and workflow exceptions; participate in root-cause discussions and recommend process improvements to strengthen a secure, audit-ready access administration environment.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance.

Cyber Operate team focuses on efficiently running operations by enabling automation, reducing manual effort and adhering to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) based on the standards set by clients.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**
**Shift Timings: 24/7 rotational shifts; on-call support based on project assignment**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  
Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
  
  

* 10 - 15 years of experience in information technology, service operations, information security support and operational governance with ITIL v4 Service Management Framework.
* 6+ years of experience in access administration, user account management, or IAM operations support.
* Basic hands-on experience with any IAM tool or platform, such as SailPoint, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, or similar solutions, used for provisioning, deprovisioning, access provisioning, access management, access management or access governance.
* Experience performing manual access administration tasks using documented procedures and approval workflows.
* Working knowledge of user provisioning, deprovisioning, account maintenance, entitlement updates, and access review support.
* Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Remedy, or equivalent for managing incidents, service requests, escalations, and operational tracking.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of identity and access management concepts, including joiner-mover-leaver processes, role-based access, least-privilege principles, and access recertification.
* Ability to review requests, follow process controls, and accurately execute operational tasks.
* Experience in maintaining documentation, operational logs, and status reporting.
* Good communication and coordination skills for working with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate with appropriate context.

Preferred:
  
  
Good to have skills/ Project experience/ Certifications:
  
  

* Exposure to IAM, IGA, or access management tools.
* Familiarity with access request workflows, approval matrices, and security governance processes.
* Understanding of audit, compliance, and policy requirements related to access administration.
* Ability to follow client information security policies and handle sensitive access tasks with accuracy.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and process discipline.
* Ability to identify issues early, troubleshoot at a basic level, and escalate appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic reporting and tracking skills using standard operational tools.
* Exposure to incident/problem management concepts and recurring issue resolution.

Education:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Senior Supplier Operations Manager
description:
**Are you Senior Supplier Operations Manager looking for an innovative role?**
**Do you enjoy being part of a team that works with a diverse range of technology?**
**About our Team: -**
Platform Ops is a fast growing team within Data Ops with a key focus on the managing the services and data that are part of the new research data platform that is organized following the principles of the data mesh.
  
  
The supplier operations management team is responsible for managing the services the data products that fuel products like Scival, Scopus, Reaxys and many other commercial offering.
  
  
The supplier operations management team is responsible for managing both internal and external partners that supply data into the data platform. Key role is performance management, agreeing goals, monitoring performance, resolving incident and leading continuous improvement initiatives. The team maintains a knowledge base on our services, documenting SLAs, Workflow description, instructions.
  
  
**About the Role: -**
As Data Ops is set-up as a separate team to support our platform transition, an exciting role will be opened that sits at the heart of our new data use cases.
  
  
One initial key Operational efficiency goal will be to develop a full end to end view, underpinned by reporting and supported by clear visualizations of all our data asset processes, to a granularity that helps to support automation and transparency in our processes, as multiple teams and capabilities are dependent on this data to maintain a high speed of content onboarding. This work takes place as part of the ongoing (digital) transformation of our back-office and will support automation in our content sourcing and customer support. The data developed will support e-mail automation, proactive alerting and outlier management, escalation workflows, and providing tracking data to support our customers in meeting their needs. Work takes place in an agile framework and the data development manager will act both as analyst but will also be asked to act as product owner for a data squad that collaborates to improve our assets and processes. The expectation is that this role actively contributes to the way Data Ops will structure the continuous improvement and data development function.
  
  
Next to operational efficiency, the data development role will be supporting RDP in (cross-) domain initiatives as operations lead to foster collaboration, guide delivery and ensure Operational expertise is applied where needed and prioritized. Work will be done in multi-disciplinary squads to ensure that data is onboarded and processed according to agreed metrics. A rounded understanding of the strategic goals of RDP and the individual domains will ensure value added contributions and continuous, iterative improvement toward those goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
-
  
  
**Supplier Performance Management**

* Independently manage and monitor operational performance of assigned suppliers across data workflows (e.g., data ingestion, enrichment, validation, transformation, reporting and quality control).
* Track SLA adherence, turnaround times, quality scores, defect rates, and productivity metrics.
* Lead monthly performance review meetings with suppliers and present insights to internal stakeholders.
* Identify performance gaps and drive corrective and preventive action plans.
* Proactively escalate risks impacting service continuity, data accuracy, or timelines.
* Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned suppliers.

**Data Analytics & Reporting**

* Design and maintain Power BI dashboards to track supplier KPIs and operational health.
* Analyze large operational datasets to identify trends, inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Conduct structured root cause analysis for recurring data quality or delivery issues.
* Prepare and publish structured monthly supplier performance reports with clear executive summaries and actionable insights.
* Support demand forecasting and supplier capacity planning through data-driven analysis.

**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Ensure supplier adherence to contractual obligations, data governance standards, and security policies.
* Monitor compliance with data privacy and information security requirements.
* Maintain structured governance cadence, documentation, and audit readiness.
* Support performance documentation required for commercial reviews and renewals.

**Project & Product Alignment**

* Support supplier onboarding, transitions, and scope changes.
* Manage defined operational improvement initiatives (automation, standardization, workflow optimization).
* Collaborate closely with internal domain functional teams to understand evolving requirements and ensure supplier outputs align with business and customer expectations.
* Translate business and product requirements into measurable supplier performance metrics.
* Track milestones, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications using structured project management approaches.

**Continuous Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes within supplier workflows.
* Partner with internal teams to implement system or workflow enhancements.
* Drive productivity improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives.
* Promote a data-driven and customer-focused culture of operational excellence.

**Requirements:**
-
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 5–6 years of experience in operations, data operations, or shared services environment.
* Experience managing external vendors or global suppliers in a matrixed organization preferred.
* Strong exposure to data lifecycle management, data processing environments, or analytics-driven operations.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Operations, Analytics, or Business Management (preferred but not mandatory).
* Experience collaborating with Product and Technology teams is a plus.

**Technical & Analytical Skills**
**Data & Reporting**

* Advanced Excel (Power Query, complex formulas, Pivot Tables)
* Power BI (dashboard development, DAX, data modeling, automated reporting)
* Tableau reporting and dashboard development (good to have)
* Strong data analysis and interpretation capability
* Experience working with large datasets and operational metrics
* Root cause analysis methodologies (5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.)

**Project Management**

* Experience leading cross-functional operational initiatives
* Understanding of Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies
* Risk, issue, and dependency management
* Experience with MS Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools
* Process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart)

**Systems & Platforms**

* Workflow management platforms
* SharePoint or similar collaboration tools

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to present complex data insights in a clear, structured, and compelling manner
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability
* Product-oriented thinking with strong awareness of customer impact
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills
* Governance-oriented mindset with high attention to detail
* Ability to operate effectively in a global, fast-paced environment
* Proactive and results-driven approach

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification
* Lean / Six Sigma
* Power BI or Data Analytics certification

**Work in a way that works for you: -**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
  
  
**Working for you: -**
**Benefits**
At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy
* Generous long-service awards
* New Baby gift
* Subsidized food provided (applies to India- Chennai)
* Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India-Chennai)

**About Us:**
-
  
  
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals’ advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s
  
  
**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
Restaurant Operations Manager – Chennai

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Restaurant Operations Manager to oversee and optimize all aspects of restaurant operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in hospitality management, team leadership, revenue growth, cost control, and operational excellence. This role requires a hands-on leader who can drive business performance while maintaining exceptional guest experiences and consistent operational standards.

Experience Required

* Minimum 5–6 years of experience in restaurant or hospitality operations.
* Proven experience in managing restaurant profitability, team performance, and guest satisfaction.
* Experience in multi-unit operations is an added advantage.

Key ResponsibilitiesOperations Management

* Oversee daily restaurant operations to ensure smooth and efficient functioning.
* Implement and maintain operational SOPs, service standards, and quality controls.
* Ensure consistency in food quality, service delivery, hygiene, and customer experience.
* Monitor operational performance and identify areas for improvement.

Revenue Growth & Business Performance

* Develop and execute strategies to increase sales and revenue.
* Drive guest engagement, repeat business, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor key business metrics and take corrective actions to achieve targets.
* Support local marketing initiatives and promotional activities.

Cost Control & Inventory Management

* Control food costs, labor costs, and operational expenses.
* Implement measures to reduce wastage and improve profitability.
* Monitor inventory levels and ensure proper stock management.
* Conduct regular audits and variance analysis.

Team Leadership & Training

* Lead, motivate, and develop restaurant teams to achieve operational excellence.
* Manage recruitment, onboarding, training, and retention of employees.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and coaching sessions.
* Build a strong culture of accountability, teamwork, and customer service.

Reporting & Analysis

* Prepare and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Track sales, labor costs, food costs, inventory, wastage, and profitability.
* Utilize Microsoft Excel and reporting tools to support business decisions.
* Present performance insights and action plans to management.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

* Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, food safety, and hygiene standards.
* Maintain all statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular operational audits and corrective action reviews.

Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent operational planning and execution capabilities.
* Proven ability to increase revenue and improve profitability.
* Strong understanding of cost control and inventory management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Based in Chennai or willing to relocate.
* Hands-on operational leader with strong business acumen.
* Passionate about hospitality, service excellence, and team development.
* Demonstrated success in driving operational efficiency, reducing wastage, and building high-performing teams.

Key Success Indicators

* Revenue growth and profitability improvement.
* Reduction in food and operational wastage.
* Strong SOP compliance and operational consistency.
* High guest satisfaction scores.
* Effective team retention, training, and development.
* Accurate and timely operational reporting.

title: Manager Operations Home Automation
description:
Manager – Operations (Home Automation)

**Company:**
Homebots Automation Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Job Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Work Mode:**
On-site

Job Summary

Homebots Automation is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Manager to manage end-to-end execution and operations of residential and commercial Home Automation projects.

The candidate will be responsible for project planning, technical coordination, installation, commissioning, team management, vendor coordination, quality control, and customer handover.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in Home Automation, Smart Home Solutions, Electrical Systems, ELV, or Building Automation projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end execution of Home Automation projects from planning to commissioning.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, consultants, clients, and project teams.
* Plan project schedules, manpower, materials, and site requirements.
* Supervise installation and commissioning of smart home automation systems.
* Manage technical teams, site engineers, technicians, and subcontractors.
* Coordinate automation system integration, programming, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ensure timely project completion within approved budgets and quality standards.
* Manage procurement, inventory, material planning, and vendor coordination.
* Conduct regular site inspections and ensure proper installation standards.
* Handle customer coordination, project updates, and final handover.
* Manage after-sales support, maintenance, and service requests.
* Develop operational SOPs, project reports, and MIS documentation.
* Monitor team productivity, project profitability, and operational efficiency.

Technical Knowledge Required

* Home Automation and Smart Home Systems.
* Smart Lighting and Lighting Control Systems.
* Curtain and Blind Automation.
* HVAC and AC Control Integration.
* Smart Switches, Sensors, Keypads, and Controllers.
* Wi-Fi, Networking, and Structured Cabling.
* CCTV, Access Control, and Security Systems.
* Audio-Video and Home Theatre Integration.
* KNX, DALI, Zigbee, Z-Wave, or other automation protocols.
* Smart Home App and Voice Assistant Integration.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, ECE, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in Home Automation, ELV, Electrical Projects, or Building Automation.
* Proven experience in handling multiple projects and technical teams.
* Strong understanding of electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and system integration.
* Experience in project planning, execution, installation, and commissioning.
* Excellent team management, vendor coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and customer-handling abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, project tracking, and reporting.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates from the following industries are encouraged to apply:

* Home Automation / Smart Home Solutions
* Building Automation Systems (BMS)
* ELV and Integrated Security Systems
* Electrical Contracting and Infrastructure
* Lighting Automation and Control Systems
* Audio-Video and Smart Building Solutions

Key Performance Indicators

* On-time project execution and commissioning.
* Installation quality and project delivery standards.
* Effective manpower and resource utilization.
* Project cost control and profitability.
* Customer satisfaction and service response.
* Team productivity and operational efficiency.

Why Join Homebots Automation?

* Opportunity to work on innovative Smart Home and Home Automation projects.
* Exposure to integrated smart home technologies.
* Leadership role with direct responsibility for project and operations management.
* Opportunity to grow with a technology-focused organization.

**Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated resume.**

title: Team Manager
description:
**Job Description**
At
**Maersk**
, we are a global leader in integrated logistics, pioneering the industry for over a century. Our commitment to innovation and transformation continuously redefines the boundaries of what’s possible—setting new benchmarks for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.
  
  
We believe in the power of
**diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning**
, and strive to ensure our people reflect the customers we proudly serve. With a workforce of over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade.
  
  
**Purpose of the role:**
SCM Planning & Visibility represents the 'brain' of the E2E Operation layer, and covers roles that do planning, assembling, monitoring, etc, to ensure seamless order execution across all means of transport: air, landside and ocean. Includes Maersk managed (Example: 4PL) as well as operated business (Example: 3PL & 2PL). Responsible for long-term supply chain strategies and networks that address capacity issues and production location decisions. Monitors key sales and performance indicators and coordinates work to increase effectiveness of supply chain offerings.
  
  
**You will be Responsible for:**
**Managing**
the SPC team’s day-to-day operations and ensuring timely task completion.
  
  

* Issuing pricing quotes for complex dimension and OOG (Out of Gauge) cargo.
* Handling customer booking creation and amendment requests.
* Enhancing customer experience through efficient and accurate service delivery.
* Improving visibility and performance tracking of OOG quoting activities.
* Leading and developing team members through coaching and mentoring.
* Managing employee lifecycle activities, including performance reviews and career development.
* Setting priorities and coordinating resources to achieve operational goals.
* Implementing business plans, policies, and operational practices.
* Applying industry knowledge, practical methods, and established processes to support business objectives.
* Evaluating available solutions and selecting appropriate actions within the area of expertise.
* Supporting stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration.
* Driving process improvements to increase efficiency and service quality.
* Monitoring team performance and ensuring adherence to established standards and guidelines.

**Qualifications**
Good communication skills.
  
  
**What We Offer:**

* Impact: Be part of a team that directly contributes to global operations.
* Opportunity: Unlock professional and personal growth through diverse career pathways.
* Innovation: Work with a team that embraces technology and continuous improvement.
* Global Exposure: Collaborate across geographies and cultures.
* Work-Life Balance: Flexible working arrangements to support your well-being

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
  
  
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Transportation Manager
description:
**Job Description – Transport Manager**

Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology | Chennai

**Department:**
Administration / Transport

**Designation:**
Transport Manager

**Reporting To:**
General Manager – HR & Administration / Head – Administration / The Management

**Location:**
Chennai

**Experience:**
8 –20 Years

**Qualification:**
Any Bachelor's Degree (Preference for candidates with experience in Transport / Fleet Management / Logistics / Automobile Administration).

**Company Description:**

Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology ( An Autonomous Institution) is one of the best engineering colleges in Chennai and is part of Rajalakshmi Institutions, which has been synonymous with providing excellence in higher education to students for many years. Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology was established in 2008. RIT is accredited with highest grade of A++ by NAAC. RIT is affiliated with Anna University Chennai. It is one of the AICTE-approved colleges in Chennai New Delhi, and also offers NBA-approved courses.

**Job Purpose**

To manage and oversee the entire transportation operations of the institution, ensuring the safe, efficient, timely and cost-effective transportation of students, teaching staff, non-teaching staff and other authorized personnel. The Transport Manager will be responsible for fleet management, vehicle maintenance, driver supervision, statutory compliance, route planning and transport-related administration.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Transport Operations Management**

* Manage day-to-day transportation operations across institutional campuses.
* Ensure the availability and proper deployment of buses, vans and other institutional vehicles.
* Prepare and monitor vehicle schedules, routes, timings and trip allocations.
* Ensure timely pick-up and drop-off of students and staff.
* Coordinate transportation requirements for academic events, examinations, functions and special programmes.
* Monitor vehicle movement and operational efficiency.

**B. Fleet Management & Vehicle Maintenance**

* Maintain a complete database of institutional vehicles.
* Monitor vehicle fitness, servicing, repairs and preventive maintenance schedules.
* Ensure vehicles are roadworthy, clean and properly maintained.
* Coordinate with authorized service centres, workshops and vendors.
* Monitor fuel consumption, mileage, maintenance expenses and vehicle operating costs.
* Ensure proper maintenance of vehicle logbooks and trip sheets.

**C. Driver & Staff Management**

* Recruit, supervise and manage drivers, helpers and transport support staff.
* Verify driving licences, experience, identity and other relevant documents.
* Monitor driver attendance, punctuality, discipline and performance.
* Conduct regular driver briefings and safety awareness sessions.
* Ensure drivers follow institutional policies and traffic regulations.
* Maintain driver duty rosters and leave arrangements.

**D. Safety & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure all vehicles possess valid:
* Registration Certificate (RC).
* Fitness Certificate (FC).
* Insurance.
* Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate.
* Applicable permits and tax documents.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Motor Vehicles Act provisions and school/college transport safety requirements.
* Implement vehicle safety procedures and emergency response protocols.
* Coordinate accident reporting, insurance claims and incident investigations.
* Ensure availability of first-aid kits, fire extinguishers and other prescribed safety equipment.

**E. GPS & Transport Monitoring**

* Monitor GPS-enabled vehicles and vehicle tracking systems.
* Track vehicle movement, route deviations and delays.
* Implement systems for transport complaints and feedback.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly transport performance reports.
* Coordinate with security, HR, administration and academic departments.

**F. Financial & Vendor Management**

* Prepare and monitor the annual transport budget.
* Control fuel, maintenance, repair and operational expenses.
* Verify fuel bills, vehicle repair bills and vendor invoices.
* Negotiate with transport contractors and service providers.
* Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs without compromising safety.

**G. Student & Staff Coordination**

* Address student, parent and employee transportation-related grievances.
* Coordinate with department heads, hostel wardens and administration.
* Ensure appropriate transport arrangements during emergencies.
* Maintain proper communication regarding route changes and schedule modifications.

**Key Result Areas (KRA), KPA & KPI**

**KRA Key Performance Indicators (KPI)**

Transport Operations - 100% adherence to approved schedules

Vehicle Availability - Minimum 98% operational availability

Vehicle Maintenance - 100% preventive maintenance compliance

Statutory Compliance - 100% validity of mandatory vehicle documents

Driver Management - 100% licence and document verification

Safety Management - Zero preventable safety incidents

Fuel Management - Monthly fuel consumption and mileage monitoring

Cost Control - Adherence to approved transport budget

Complaint Management - Resolution of complaints within 24–48 hours

Reporting - Timely submission of monthly transport reports

**Educational Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Diploma / certification in Transport Management, Logistics or Automobile Engineering will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 8 – 20 years of relevant experience in transport and fleet management.
* Experience managing institutional, corporate, hospital or large-scale transportation operations is preferred.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong fleet and transport operations management skills.
* Knowledge of vehicle maintenance and statutory compliance.
* Excellent coordination and vendor management skills.
* Strong administrative and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and transport/GPS management applications.
* Ability to manage drivers and transport personnel effectively.
* Strong decision-making and emergency management capabilities.

**Documents & Reports to be Maintained**

1. Vehicle Master Register.
2. Driver and Helper Master Register.
3. Vehicle Fitness and Insurance Register.
4. Vehicle Maintenance Register.
5. Fuel Consumption and Mileage Register.
6. Daily Vehicle Movement Register.
7. Route and Trip Allocation Register.
8. Driver Attendance and Duty Roster.
9. Accident and Incident Register.
10. Monthly Transport Expenses Report.
11. Vehicle Compliance and Renewal Tracker.
12. Transport Complaints and Resolution Register.

**Candidate Profile – Preferred**

Candidates from the following sectors will be preferred:

* Educational Institutions (Schools, Colleges and Universities).
* Corporate Transport Operations.
* Hospital and Healthcare Transportation.
* Fleet Management Companies.
* Logistics and Transportation Services.

**Important:**
Candidates must have practical experience in handling multiple vehicles, drivers, route planning, vehicle maintenance and statutory compliance.

**Candidates with only office administration experience without hands-on transport operations experience are not preferred.**

**Overall Job Expectation**

The Transport Manager is expected to independently manage the institution's entire transport operations, ensure uninterrupted transportation services, maintain vehicle safety and compliance, optimize operational costs and provide regular reports to the HR & Administration Department and the Management.

**Compensation**

Salary will be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and institutional norms.

**Apply to**

Interested candidates send your resume to:
**gmhr.admin@ritchennai.edu.in**

**Whatsapp your resume to: +91 8056194696**

description:

Lead and manage end-to-end sales order execution, ensuring orders are executed in accordance with contractual obligations, business objectives, and customer requirements. Drive revenue realization, billing performance, contribution margin, quality, and on-time delivery through effective execution strategies, cross-functional coordination, process standardization, and continuous improvement. Lead team performance and ensure achievement of agreed business KPIs.

* Review and finalize large, complex, and high-value orders, ensuring commercial, operational, contractual, and financial requirements are appropriately addressed.
* Review orders involving Letters of Credit (LCs), Bank Guarantees (BGs), and other complex payment terms in collaboration with Finance, Legal, Procurement, and Logistics.
* Coordinate with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure compliant order execution, including orders involving embargoed or restricted countries.
* Develop and maintain revenue forecasts, billing plans, and order execution schedules to support business planning and financial commitments.
* Monitor order execution progress, revenue realization, billing milestones, backlog, delivery commitments, and key performance indicators; initiate corrective actions to address deviations.
* Establish effective communication with customers and internal stakeholders to manage expectations, address escalations, and maintain strong business relationships.
* Implement order execution strategies, standard operating procedures, governance mechanisms, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, quality, and productivity.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Order Execution team; identify competency gaps, support succession planning, and establish clear performance objectives and accountability.
* Ensure effective order processing, milestone tracking, risk identification, and timely delivery through proactive monitoring and escalation.
* Review order intake by order typology and product category to ensure appropriate classification, accurate order booking, and alignment with revenue recognition and reporting requirements.
* Identify risks related to delivery, quality, contractual obligations, payment terms, and resource availability; establish mitigation plans to minimize business and customer impact.

* Partner with Sales and regional financial teams to review order intake, contribution margins, revenue forecasts, billing plans, and significant financial deviations.

* Maintain regular communication with customers regarding order status, delivery schedules, billing milestones, and potential execution risks.

* Drive customer satisfaction through reliable execution, transparent communication, and timely resolution of issues.

Bachelor’s Engineering degree from a reputed university. Mechanical specialization would be preferred.

* Proven ability to manage customer expectations, resolve escalations, and maintain strong business relationships.
* Ability to anticipate execution risks, resolve bottlenecks, and manage payment delays, material shortages, and delivery challenges.

title: NOC Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**About the role:**
The Major Incident Manager & NOC Shift Lead is responsible for owning and managing Major Incidents (P1/P2) and ensuring effective NOC operations during the assigned shift. This role acts as the central command point during critical incidents, ensuring rapid coordination, communication, escalation, and resolution across all infrastructure towers. Additionally, the role ensures NOC operational discipline, monitoring effectiveness, and shift-level service delivery ownership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Major Incident Management (Primary Responsibility)
* Take full ownership of Major Incidents (P1/P2) during the assigned shift.
* Lead and anchor incident bridge calls with technical teams, stakeholders, and vendors.
* Ensure timely escalation to appropriate technical teams, leadership, and stakeholders.
* Drive incident resolution by coordinating across infrastructure towers (Compute, Network, Storage, Cloud, Security, etc.).
* Provide timely and clear incident communication, updates, and status reports.
* Ensure proper incident tracking, documentation, and closure.
* Coordinate post-incident reviews and ensure RCA follow-ups.
* NOC Operations Shift Ownership
* Own and manage NOC operations during the assigned shift.
* Ensure continuous monitoring of infrastructure, systems, and services.
* Ensure alerts, incidents, and service requests are handled within defined SLAs.
* Ensure proper shift handover and operational continuity.
* Monitor NOC team performance and ensure adherence to operational processes.
* Ensure all incidents are properly logged, categorized, escalated, and tracked.
* Escalation & Stakeholder Coordination
* Act as primary escalation point during the shift for infrastructure and service issues.
* Coordinate with Tower Leads, Technical Teams, Service Delivery Managers, and Vendors.
* Ensure stakeholders and customer teams receive timely and accurate updates.
* Escalate critical risks and operational issues to leadership when required.
* Service Reliability & Operational Governance
* Ensure adherence to Incident Management, Major Incident Management, and Escalation processes.
* Ensure compliance with SLAs, OLAs, and operational procedures.
* Identify operational risks and proactively mitigate service impact.
* Ensure operational discipline and adherence to defined SOPs and runbooks.
* Shift Leadership & Operational Coordination
* Provide leadership and direction to NOC engineers during the shift.
* Ensure proper resource coordination and workload distribution.
* Ensure smooth shift transition and proper handover to next shift.
* Ensure operational stability and service continuity.
* Reporting & Documentation
* Maintain Major Incident logs, trackers, and reports.
* Provide shift summary reports highlighting incidents, escalations, and key operational updates.
* Ensure proper documentation of incidents, actions taken, and resolution details.
* Support incident trend analysis and service improvement initiatives.

**Experience**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6–10 years of experience in Infrastructure Operations, NOC Operations, or Managed Services.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience handling Major Incident Management.
* Experience working in 24×7 enterprise production environments.

**Technical Skills**
  
  

* Strong understanding of infrastructure domains:

+ Windows / Linux Servers
+ Networking
+ Cloud Platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP preferred)
+ Monitoring tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, SolarWinds, etc.)
+ ITSM tools (ServiceNow preferred)

**Communication & Leadership Skills**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong escalation management and coordination capability.
* Ability to lead incident bridges and manage critical situations.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure in critical situations.
* Strong leadership and coordination skills.
* Proactive and service-oriented approach.

**Work Requirements**

* Mandatory Work from Office
* 24×7 rotational shift model
* Immediate availability during critical incidents
* Ability to manage high-severity operational situations

title: Technical Lead
description:
Leads the day-to-day annotation operation at Valeo Chennai. This person is Valeo's single point of contact for the team, owns allocation, tracking and reporting, and drives the team from the pilot baseline towards Valeo's scaled throughput objective without loss of quality.
  
  
Work location
  
  
Onsite at Valeo's Chennai premises.
  
  
Working pattern
  
  
5 days per week, Valeo site calendar and hours
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key responsibilities**

* Allocate and priorities daily work in line with Valeo's batches, by engineer capacity and scene type.
* Track productivity, throughput and quality against agreed targets: scenes per engineer per day, accepted scenes per week, first-pass acceptance, rework rate and turnaround.
* Act as first point of contact for Valeo's Project Manager and Annotation / Data Lead. Raise guideline clarifications and route tool issues, with their time impact, to Valeo's tool owner.
* Publish the daily status and weekly performance report and maintain the productivity and quality dashboard.
* Lead onboarding, training, calibration on gold scenes, guideline adherence and coaching of the team.

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
HARTING stands for strong connections – across the globe. As one of the leading international suppliers of industrial connectivity, we are connecting customers to their digital future. And as an employer? We connect around 6,000 people at our headquarter in Espelkamp and at locations worldwide. Here you’ll find great colleagues, as well as ever new opportunities and innovations revolving around IoT and artificial intelligence. In everything we do, we remain true to our roots: as a regionally connected family business that always stays firmly grounded in spite of our stellar high-tech. Here’s to your unique future with us: Yours!
  
  
**Position: Maintenance Manager**
Hierarchy Level: Lead
  
  
Functional Family: Operations
  
  
Sub Function: Maintenance and Services
  
  
Job Location: Chennai
  
  
**Job Description**
Leads the maintenance function to ensure high equipment reliability, availability, safety and lifecycle performance
  
  
across production machinery. Leads preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance, drives TPM and
  
  
continuous improvement, manages maintenance resources and spares, and partners with Production,
  
  
Engineering, Quality, EHS and other stakeholders to minimise downtime and support stable manufacturing
  
  
operations.
  
  
Key Stakeholders / Coordination
  
  

* Internal: Production, Industrial Engineering, Quality, EHS, Procurement and Engineering
* External: Equipment suppliers, service vendors and contractors

Job Responsibilities
  
  
**In Alignment With The Maintenance Function, The Incumbent Will**

* Develop and execute preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance strategies to maximise equipment

uptime and improve OEE.
  
  

* Own maintenance planning, shutdown schedules, checklists, standard operating procedures and compliance

documentation.
  
  

* Drive TPM, autonomous maintenance, reliability improvement and continuous improvement across

manufacturing.
  
  

* Analyse recurring breakdowns using structured root-cause analysis and ensure sustainable corrective and

preventive actions.
  
  

* Monitor and improve maintenance KPIs – MTBF, MTTR, equipment availability, breakdown trends,

maintenance cost and schedule compliance.
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop maintenance engineers and technicians; define skill requirements, training plans,

work allocation and performance expectations.
  
  

* Establish critical-spares strategy, optimise spare-parts inventory and coordinate with Procurement and

suppliers to ensure availability while controlling cost.
  
  

* Provide maintenance input for new equipment selection, installation, commissioning, acceptance, validation

and handover to operations.
  
  

* Collaborate with Production, Industrial Engineering, Quality, EHS and other functions to resolve equipment

issues and support production priorities.
  
  

* Ensure adherence to safety, environmental, statutory and company requirements, including safe work

practices and contractor controls.
  
  

* Drive automation, energy efficiency, utility optimisation, maintenance digitalisation and cost-reduction projects

with measurable impact.
  
  

* Manage maintenance budgets, service contracts, external vendors and equipment lifecycle plans.
* Support audits and management reviews with accurate maintenance records, risk assessments, action

tracking and improvement plans.
  
  

* Support Environmental Management System (EMS) goals – drive energy and utility optimisation (compressedair

leak arrest, efficient motors, idle-time shutdown), ensure used oil, coolant, batteries and e-waste are
  
  
disposed only through authorised channels, and ensure contractors follow EMS requirements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics or related engineering; postgraduate qualification in

management or engineering is advantageous.
  
  

* 12–15 years of maintenance experience in manufacturing, including leading maintenance teams and functions.

Technical Expertise / Skill Sets
  
  

* Facility Maintenance, Production equipment maintenance, troubleshooting and reliability engineering.
* Preventive / predictive maintenance and process optimisation.
* TPM and autonomous maintenance.
* People leadership – coaching technical teams, setting priorities, safety and reliability culture.
* ERP / CMMS maintenance and spare-parts management; SAP advantageous.

Benefits: Staff insurance coverage (APAC)

description:
**About Supply Chain Resources Group (SCRG)**

Supply Chain Resources Group (SCRG) is the execution partner for the world's most innovative hardware companies. We help everyone from the biggest tech companies to the most promising start-ups design, implement, and manage their product manufacturing supply chain. SCRG provides manufacturing and supply chain advisory services, vendor management services, and highly skilled technical resources in the world’s major manufacturing centers. From prototypes and early-stage New Product Introduction (NPI) to full high volume mass production, our teams bring speed, clarity, and control to complex global supply chains.

**Position Overview**

* Reports to the VP of Asia Operations and is responsible for leading and growing SCRG's India operations, including people management, recruiting, customer operations, business development, budget oversight, and financial governance.
* This is a hands-on leadership role requiring a strong manufacturing background and the ability to understand both the technical and business needs of our customers. The Director will actively support recruiting, including technically interviewing candidates for engineering and manufacturing-related positions, while building and developing a high-performing local team.
* The Director is also expected to identify growth opportunities, strengthen customer relationships, and drive the use of technology, data, AI, and automation to improve how we operate.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Operations Leadership & Compliance**

* Lead overall India operations across locations and functions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, regulatory, tax, labor, and employment requirements.
* Maintain and continuously improve local policies, procedures, controls, and operating practices.
* Drive improvements in productivity, efficiency, quality, and scalability.
* Manage key external service providers, facilities, vendors, and administrative requirements.
* Proactively identify and manage operational risks.

**2. Talent Acquisition & People Leadership**

* Lead recruiting for customer-facing and internal positions in India.
* Conduct technical interviews and assessments for engineering, manufacturing, operations, and other relevant positions, or assign the appropriate technical expert when needed.
* Apply practical manufacturing and technical knowledge to assess candidate capabilities against customer requirements.
* Build, develop, and retain a high-performing team.

title: Senior Warehouse Handler
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
The Warehouse Supervisor oversees assembly support, warehouse operations, inventory management, shipping, receiving, logistics coordination, and delivery planning activities. You will ensure the efficient flow of materials from receipt through storage, production support, and final customer delivery. You will maintain inventory accuracy, supporting production requirements, planning weekly and monthly deliveries, and ensuring compliance with company safety, quality, and operational standards. You will report to the
**Assembly & Warehouse Manager**
and work onsite at our facility.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
**Warehouse Operations**

* Manage daily warehouse activities, including receiving, storage, material handling, and distribution.
* Ensure efficient material flow within the warehouse and production areas.
* Maintain proper warehouse organisation, housekeeping, and storage practices.
* Monitor warehouse performance and implement continuous improvement programs.

**Inventory Management**

* Maintain accurate inventory records and stock integrity.
* Conduct and manage cycle counts and annual physical inventories.
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment activities.
* Ensure stock rotation, identification, traceability, and storage compliance.
* Analyse inventory variances and implement corrective actions.

**Assembly & Production Support**

* Ensure issuance of materials to production and assembly lines.
* Coordinate preparation of kitting packages and production material requirements.
* Support production schedules by maintaining material availability.
* Monitor material usage and return of excess materials.
* Work with production teams to prevent material shortages and downtime.

**Ship & Logistics Operations**

* Oversee packing, labelling, staging, and dispatch of customer shipments.
* Ensure shipments comply with customer requirements and company standards.
* Prepare and maintain shipping documentation and records.
* Coordinate transportation activities with logistics providers and carriers.
* Monitor shipment status and resolve delivery issues.

**Delivery Planning & Coordination**

* Maintain weekly and monthly delivery plans based on customer demand, production schedules, and inventory availability.
* Coordinate with Sales, Production Planning, Procurement, and Logistics teams to meet delivery commitments.
* Track delivery schedules and identify risks to on-time delivery performance.
* Improve shipment planning to improve transportation efficiency and reduce logistics costs.
* Communicate delivery schedules and priorities to relevant partners.
* Create reports on shipment status, delivery performance, and capacity planning.

**Team Leadership**

* Oversee warehouse and assembly support personnel.
* Allocate resources to meet operational requirements.
* Train employees on warehouse processes, safety practices, and standard operating procedures.
* Conduct performance monitoring and support employee development.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all company safety, quality, and environmental policies.
* Promote safe work practices and proper use of PPE.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and address identified risks.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Support audits and corrective action projects.

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in warehouse operations, inventory management, logistics, manufacturing, or assembly support environments.
* Experience leading teams in a warehouse, logistics, or production support setting.
* Knowledge of inventory control, material management, shipping, receiving, and warehouse operations.
* Proficiency with ERP, WMS, or inventory management systems.
* Planning and scheduling.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Manufacturing, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience supporting assembly or manufacturing operations.
* Experience in production logistics, material planning, and delivery scheduling.
* Knowledge of warehouse performance metrics, inventory reconciliation, and continuous improvement practices.
* Experience coordinating with external transportation providers and logistics partners.
* Forklift operation certification.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, 5S, or Kaizen methodologies.

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

title: Associate Manager - Conduct & Control
description:
**Job Summary**

* The purpose of RP is to assist Country Process Owners (CPOs) and Global Process Owner (GPOs) to effectively manage operational risk within the first line of defence. The members must ensure that the sampling tests are conducted in accordance with Risk Management Framework, Group Operational Risk Policies and Procedures.
* To ensure error free work with no operating losses
* Emphasis to Identify, assess, monitor, escalate and report operational risks from respective business scope to both business line managers and Unit Head in a timely manner.
* Ensure Individual Productivity targets are met / surpassed

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Emphasis to Identify, assess, monitor, escalate and report operational risks from respective business scope to both business line managers and Unit Head in a timely manner.
* Quality Assurance: To make sure the quality assurance of operational risk controls across all processes in the corresponding business area.

**Business**

* Competency and Effectiveness: To be fully competent in control measure skills and methodology in conducting sample testing, quality checking, and monitoring; to be effective in identifying control process gaps, timely escalation of identified issues or risks, and any effective actions to mitigate within the accepted timeframe.

**Processes**

* Support CPOs and GPOs in managing First Line operational risk in accordance with the Risk Management Framework and applicable Group policies and procedures.
* Ensure effective Material Control Testing (DT and OT) to minimize operational errors and losses.
* Support First Line risk ownership through independent Material Control DT and OT, providing clear insights on control effectiveness, gaps, and required remediation to provide feedback to the Business head/Unit Head/GPOs/RFOs and control functions in timely manner.
* Investigation, logging and monitoring of Ops Risk issues, events including development and implementation of action plans.
* Accurate Updating of Control Sheets / master sheets and all working templates.
* Ensure share drive /share point policies are adhered.
* Ensure timely escalation to Senior Management of any exception noticed related to work and environment.
* Ensure proper training (OJT) is given to team members whenever required.
* Meet or exceed productivity targets while ensuring quality Material Control Testing.
* Ensure timely remediation of Material Control Testing exceptions, with preventive actions to avoid recurrence.
* To actively participate in BCP/DR and any other UAT / UVT.
* Perform independent reviews of Risk/Loss items if required.
* Provide Group with any common trends of issues identified and add value by identifying any gaps.
* Assist in the identification of the business / regulatory risks and the implementation of appropriate controls to mitigate those risks if applicable.

**People and Talent**

* Ensure backup staff is identified and trained.

**Risk Management**

* Compliance with all relevant Group Policies & Procedures.
* Compliance with all relevant Group Money Laundering Prevention Policy.
* Compliance with Group Operational Risk procedures.

**Governance**

* Monitoring and escalation: To be responsible for monitoring all processes in the corresponding area and escalate any issues and risks to the Line Manager / Unit Head on timely manner.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment]
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Representatives in Group and In-country Risk and Control team, Business Functions & Relationship Managers

**Other Responsibilities**

* Ensure that Productivity MIS is updated accurately and immediately after the completion of respective process.
* Actively participate in automation initiatives including A3.
* Ensure that knowledge on Systems and procedures is updated by keeping track of periodical circulars and other instructions issued
* Participate in test on knowledge and procedures, departmental quizzes, and Group / Companywide CSR Initiatives/Trainings including role certification and internal training programmes like leadership trainings.
* Ensure proper maintenance of the workstation and the environment of the workplace.
* Ensure adherence of Clean Desk Policy.
* Ensure timely completion of all E Learning Courses.

**Skills And Experience**

* Product Knowledge/ Domain Knowledge
* Process Management
* Time / Resource Management
* Precision / Accuracy
* Customer Centricity
* Problem Resolution / Handling
* Communication
* Stakeholder Management

**Qualifications**

* Preferably Commerce Graduate / Postgraduate.
* Experience in operational risk management or engineering processes and possess in-depth knowledge and problem-solving skills to function well in an Operations Risk Role.
* Ability to work in a matrix organisation, leveraging resources across the organisation to complete deliverables
* Basic Understanding of Banking and Credit Administration / Credit Process / Documentation Knowledge with experience ranging from 5-15 years
* Advanced Product & process knowledge (knowledge in terms of customers, products and transactions)
* Core Risk awareness
* Banking operations experience (Credit Risk, Documentation, Client Service, CDD, payments, trade, markets or other) and service-oriented attitude.
* Good Oral & Written communication.
* Full understanding on Bank’s RMF, ORMF and skills in managing operational risk.
* Sound judgement and courage to perform a risk and control role and maintain effective working relationship in the first line of defence

* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Production Manager:**

Company: Zlaata India

Department: Production

Industry: Fashion

Job Location: Chennai, India

Reports To: Head of Brand / Brand Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Production Manager to oversee the end-to-end garment production process and ensure that products are manufactured according to approved quality standards, production plans, specifications, cost targets, and delivery timelines. The role will be responsible for planning and monitoring production activities, coordinating with internal teams and external vendors, managing production capacity and manpower, resolving production challenges, and ensuring the timely availability of finished garments for the retail business. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of garment manufacturing, production planning, apparel construction, quality control, vendor management, and team management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Production Planning & Management**

● Plan and manage daily, weekly, and monthly garment production requirements based on business and delivery requirements.

● Prepare production schedules and ensure timely execution of production plans.

● Monitor production progress against planned quantities and timelines.

● Allocate production activities based on capacity, manpower, machinery, and vendor availability.

● Ensure production targets are achieved without compromising quality.

● Identify production bottlenecks and take timely corrective action.

● Ensure smooth flow of garments from sampling to bulk production and final dispatch.

**2. Garment Production & Process Monitoring**

● Oversee the complete garment manufacturing process, including:

○ Fabric receipt and inspection

○ Cutting

○ Stitching

○ Embroidery/printing, where applicable

○ Finishing

○ Pressing

○ Quality inspection

○ Packing

○ Dispatch

● Monitor production at each stage to ensure adherence to approved specifications.

● Ensure production is carried out according to approved samples, size charts, tech packs, and production requirements.

● Monitor production efficiency and identify opportunities to improve processes.

● Ensure proper coordination between different production stages to avoid delays.

**3. Production Target & Delivery Management**

● Take ownership of production targets and delivery commitments.

● Track daily production output against planned quantities.

● Identify delays at an early stage and develop recovery plans.

● Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure production deadlines are met.

● Maintain production timelines for new collections, repeat orders, seasonal products, and retail requirements.

● Escalate critical production delays to management with a clear action plan.

**4. Manpower & Team Management**

● Manage and supervise production teams, supervisors, operators, workers, and support staff.

● Allocate manpower according to production requirements and workload.

● Monitor employee productivity and production efficiency.

● Identify manpower shortages and coordinate for timely deployment of additional resources.

● Conduct regular reviews with production supervisors and team members.

● Train and guide team members on production processes, productivity, safety, and quality expectations.

● Build a performance-driven and accountable production team.

**5. Production Quality Coordination**

● Work closely with the QA/QC team to ensure production meets approved quality standards.

● Ensure quality issues identified during production are addressed immediately.

● Coordinate with QA/QC teams on inline, midline, and final inspections.

● Monitor recurring production defects and take preventive measures.

● Ensure rework and rejection levels are minimized.

● Implement corrective actions related to production processes.

● Ensure production teams follow approved quality standards and specifications.

**6. Fabric, Trims & Material Coordination**

● Coordinate with Stores, Sourcing, Merchandising, and Procurement teams regarding the availability of fabrics, trims, labels, accessories, and other production materials.

● Ensure required materials are available before production starts.

● Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.

● Identify material shortages or quality issues that may affect production timelines.

● Coordinate with relevant teams to resolve material-related production delays.

● Ensure proper handling and storage of production materials.

**7. Vendor & Supplier Management**

● Manage and coordinate with external garment manufacturers and production vendors.

● Allocate production orders based on vendor capacity, capability, quality, and delivery performance.

● Communicate production specifications, quantities, quality expectations, and delivery timelines to vendors.

● Monitor vendor production progress regularly.

● Conduct vendor performance reviews based on quality, delivery, capacity, productivity, and responsiveness.

● Identify underperforming vendors and implement improvement plans.

team, where technology powers business impact and innovation drives everything we do. title: Supply Chain Development Manager
description:
**Description**
Supply Chain Development Manager (APAC)
  
  
Department: Supply Chain Management
  
  
Reports To: VP-Supply Chain
  
  
Location: Remote (India) with Regional Travel
  
  
Industry: Power & Distribution Transformers, Electrical Equipment, Energy Infrastructure
  
  
**Company Description**
Sanmina Corporation is a global manufacturing & services company that supports diversified
  
  
Customers with innovative products and manufacturing services. More details can be found at
  
  
https://www.sanmina.com/
  
  
Business Unit Description
  
  
The Power & Energy business is currently based out of a Greenfield facility in Houston, US.
  
  
It’s geared up to provide a unique solution in a distribution transformer space designed &
  
  
Engineered in technical collaboration with Sanmina’s Technology Partner from Europe.
  
  
The opportunity is for a seasoned supplier quality professional with a robust track record of
  
  
success and a strong technical foundation in developing & managing regional supply base
  
  
to cater to the facilities & customers that are based globally.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Regional Supplier Quality Manager (SQM) – Mechanicals & Electro mechanicals is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuous execution of the supplier quality management strategy across regional supply chains for transformer manufacturing. This role ensures that all mechanical components (e.g., tanks, radiators, insulation materials, structural steel) and electromechanical assemblies (e.g., tap changers, bushings, control cabinets, sensors, cooling systems etc.) meet rigorous reliability, safety, and regulatory standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Supplier Qualification & Auditing
* Supplier Quality Management System Audit: Lead comprehensive supplier quality audits (VDA 6.3, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 as applicable) for prospective and active suppliers across the region.
* Component Qualification: Manage the approval process for new mechanical and electromechanical components using APQP and PPAP methodologies (or equivalent industry frameworks).
* Technical Capability Assessment: Evaluate supplier manufacturing processes, welding quality (e.g., ISO 3834 / AWS D1.1), non-destructive testing (NDT), surface treatment/coatings (C5-I/M ISO 12944 environments), and electromechanical integration.
* Supplier Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement
* KPI Tracking: Monitor, report, and drive improvement on key supplier metrics: Supplier Parts per Million (PPM), On-Time In-Spec (OTIS), First Pass Yield (FPY), and Non-Conformance Report (NCR) closure rates.
* Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: Lead formal non-conformance investigations using 8D, 5-Why, and Fishbone methodologies. Ensure root causes are identified and permanent corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) are verified.
* Supplier Development: Drive continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma) with strategic suppliers to improve yield, reduce lead times, and mitigate quality risks.
* Engineering & Technical Alignment
* Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Interface between Global Sourcing, Site Procurement, Engineering, and Suppliers to review engineering drawings, GD&T, material specifications, and tolerance stack-ups.
* Special Process Validation: Oversee validation of critical mechanical and electromechanical processes, including structural welding, hermetic seal integrity, galvanizing/painting, transformer tank pressure testing etc.
* Inspection & Test Plans (ITP): Define and approve critical-to-quality (CTQ) parameters, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and source inspection plans at supplier facilities.
* Regional Sourcing Strategy & Quality Governance
* Risk Management: Maintain regional supplier quality risk matrices, identifying critical component failure modes (FMEA) and establishing risk mitigation strategies.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Global Sourcing Managers, Plant Manufacturing Engineering, and Plant Quality teams to align supplier strategies with overall production schedules and cost targets.
* Standardization: Harmonize supplier quality standards, audit tools, and incoming quality control (IQC) procedures across regional manufacturing plants.

**Qualifications & Skills**
Educational & Technical Requirements
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or related engineering field.
* Experience: 15+ years of Quality Assurance experience in heavy manufacturing, power transmission & distribution, transformers, or industrial equipment sectors.
* Subject Matter Expertise:
* Deep technical understanding of transformer mechanical components (tank fabrication, conservator systems, radiator/cooling assemblies) and electromechanical units (on-load/off-circuit tap changers, high-voltage bushings, control panels, monitoring instruments).
* Strong knowledge of international standards: IEC 60076, IEEE C57, NACE, ISO 9001, ISO 3834, AWS D1.1, ISO 12944.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Quality Auditor / Manager (ASQ CQA, CQE, or CQM)
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* VDA 6.3 Process Auditor certification
* NDT Level II (VT/PT/MT/UT) or International Welding Engineer (IWE) / CWI is a strong plus
* Coating Inspection NACE Level 2 or Higher

Core Competencies & Soft Skills
  
  

* Problem Solving: Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in 8D, FMEA, SPC, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Auditing & Compliance: Proven ability to audit complex industrial supply chains and enforce rigorous quality standards.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills to manage regional cross-cultural supplier relationships and internal executive communication.
* Travel Willingness: Ability to travel up to 40%–50% regionally for supplier visits, audits, and source inspections.

title: Head of Sourcing
description:
Job Description: General Manager – Sourcing (Leather & Accessories)

Location: Chennai/South India (Export Manufacturing Hub)

Reporting To: Chief Operating Officer / Director – Operations

**Role Overview**

The General Manager – Sourcing will lead end-to-end strategic procurement and raw material sourcing for leather goods, footwear, and accessory manufacturing. This leader will oversee vendor development, cost benchmarking, capacity planning, and supply resilience, with a core technical focus on cow and sheep/lamb leather, tanneries, trims, and hardware to support export buyers and private-label programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Strategic Sourcing & Material Procurement

● Direct end-to-end sourcing of wet-blue, crust, and finished leather (specializing in cow, calf, sheep, and lamb hides/skins), along with textiles, hardware, and trims.

● Lead supplier negotiations on pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities (MOQs), and delivery schedules to ensure target gross margins.

● Formulate seasonal raw material roadmaps aligned with buyer technical packs, styling guidelines, and Bill of Materials (BOM).

2. Tannery & Vendor Management

● Identify, audit, and onboard tanneries and material vendors domestically and internationally.

● Monitor tannery production schedules to secure on-time delivery of crust and finished hides while minimizing lead times.

● Drive vendor performance evaluation based on OTIF (On-Time In-Full), defect rates, yield consistency, and compliance standards (such as LWG certification).

3. Technical Quality & Yield Optimization

● Work closely with Product Development, Pattern Making, and Production teams to establish cutting yields, grade selection, and substance/thickness specifications for cow and sheep leathers.

● Ensure all raw materials comply with international restricted substances lists (RSL/REACH), color fastness, tensile strength, and environmental standards.

● Address quality defects, grain variations, and finishing discrepancies directly with tanneries prior to factory dispatch.

4. Cost Engineering & Budget Control

● Implement standard costing sheets, benchmarking mechanisms, and cost-reduction initiatives to offset raw material price fluctuations.

● Optimize inventory carrying costs by aligning material procurement cycles with master production schedules (MPS).

● Monitor market price trends of hides and skins across key global trading regions to inform forward-purchasing strategies.

**Qualifications & Candidate Profile**

● Education: Degree in Leather Technology, Footwear/Apparel Production, or Sourcing from institutions such as CLRI, FDDI, NIFT, or equivalent.

● Experience: 15–20 years of progressive experience in material sourcing, procurement, or product-level technical sourcing within leather goods, footwear, or leather garment export manufacturing.

● Technical Expertise:

○ Deep domain mastery of sheep and cow leather tanning processes, grading, yield economics, and finishing techniques.

○ Working knowledge of LWG (Leather Working Group) compliance, REACH, and global brand sustainability audits.

● Leadership & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record in high-value contract negotiations, vendor development, and cross-functional leadership across Merchandising, Production, and Finance.
