title: Deputy General Manager Process and Proposal
description:
The incumbent will lead the Process Engineering and Proposal functions for water and wastewater treatment projects across industrial and municipal sectors. This role is responsible for developing technically sound, commercially competitive, and innovative treatment solutions while overseeing engineering excellence, estimation, proposal development, and bid management activities.

The position requires a strategic techno-commercial leader who can drive business growth through successful proposal submissions, accurate cost estimation, optimized process designs, and effective client engagement. The role will work closely with Business Development, Commercial, Procurement, Project Execution, and Operations teams to ensure successful conversion of opportunities into profitable projects.

**Responsibilities**

**Process Engineering Leadership**

* Lead process engineering activities for water and wastewater treatment projects, including WTP, STP, ETP, RO, UF/MF, MBR, MBBR, and ZLD systems.
* Establish engineering standards, design methodologies, best practices, and quality systems across the organization.
* Review and approve key process engineering deliverables, including:
* Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs)
* Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs)
* Hydraulic calculations
* Process calculations and mass balances
* Equipment specifications
* Process design reports
* Provide technical leadership on process optimization, energy efficiency, sustainability initiatives, and innovative treatment technologies.
* Lead HAZOP, HAZID, process safety reviews, and technical risk assessments.
* Support project teams during detailed engineering, commissioning, startup, and performance testing activities.
* Troubleshoot complex process challenges and provide guidance on operational improvements and plant optimization

**Proposal Management & Bid Leadership**

* Lead the preparation and submission of technical and commercial proposals for water and wastewater treatment projects.
* Review RFQs, RFPs, tenders, bid documents, and technical specifications to define proposal strategy and execution plans.
* Develop optimized treatment solutions that balance technical performance, commercial competitiveness, project risks, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate proposal activities across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial, and business development teams.
* Lead bid review meetings, proposal evaluations, and executive approval processes.
* Develop win strategies that enhance proposal competitiveness and maximize probability of award.
* Ensure proposal compliance with client requirements, technical specifications, contractual obligations, and company standards.
* Support bid clarification meetings, contract negotiations, and technical discussions with clients and consultants.
* Establish and maintain proposal management procedures, templates, databases, and best practices.

**Estimation and cost Engineering**

* Lead project estimation activities for EPC, Design-Build, and technology-based water treatment projects.
* Develop accurate CAPEX and OPEX estimates based on project requirements and design concepts.
* Review equipment sizing, material take-offs, and engineering quantities to support cost estimation activities.
* Evaluate vendor quotations, subcontractor pricing, and budgetary proposals to establish competitive project costs.

**Prepare:**

* Budgetary estimates
* Detailed cost estimates
* Techno-commercial evaluations
* Life-cycle cost analyses
* Value engineering studies
* Identify project risks, assumptions, exclusions, and contingencies during bid development.
* Establish estimation standards, cost databases, benchmarking tools, and pricing methodologies.
* Monitor estimate accuracy against project execution costs and continuously improve estimating processes.
* Drive margin optimization while maintaining technical integrity and client satisfaction.

**Business Development and Client Engagement**

* Partner with Business Development and Commercial teams to pursue new business opportunities and strategic growth initiatives.
* Participate in client meetings, technical presentations, proposal defenses, and bid clarification sessions.
* Develop conceptual treatment solutions and preliminary process designs during project pursuit stages.
* Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, technology partners, EPC contractors, and industry stakeholders.
* Identify emerging market opportunities, industry trends, and new technologies that support business expansion.
* Support strategic planning and growth initiatives within targeted market segments.

**Team Leadership and Organizational Development**

* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of process engineers, proposal engineers, and estimation professionals.
* Establish resource plans to ensure effective support for both project execution and proposal development.
* Mentor, coach, and develop team members to build organizational capability and succession plans.
* Drive a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Set performance objectives and monitor team effectiveness against business and operational goals.

**Quality, Compliance and Continuous improvement**

* Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, client specifications, and company policies.
* Promote safety, quality, sustainability, and operational excellence across all engineering and proposal activities.
* Drive standardization of engineering processes, estimation methodologies, and proposal development tools.
* Implement lessons learned programs and continuous improvement initiatives to improve efficiency and competitiveness.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical, Environmental, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. Masters Degree is preferred.

* Strong knowledge of:Water Treatment Plants (WTP),Sewage Treatment Plants (STP),Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP).Reverse Osmosis (RO),Ultrafiltration/Microfiltration (UF/MF),Membrane Bioreactors (MBR),Moving Bed Biofilm Reactors (MBBR),Sequential Batch Reactors (SBR),Activated Sludge Process (ASP),Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD)

title: Head - IQAC - GO/JC/4831/2026
description:
**Job Details**
**Job Title:**
Head – Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
  
  
**Job Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  
  
**Work Model:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Job Level:**
Head / Senior Leadership
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Candidate Expectations**
**Total Experience:**
15+ years preferred.
  
  
**Relevant Experience:**
Significant experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, academic administration, quality frameworks, and institutional ranking processes within higher education.
  
  
**Candidate Location:**
Chennai preferred; candidates willing to relocate may be considered.
  
  
**Mandatory Skills**
Leadership of IQAC or institutional quality assurance functions.
  
  
NAAC accreditation processes, assessment, and documentation.
  
  
Institutional ranking frameworks and data management.
  
  
Academic and administrative quality audits.
  
  
Outcome-based education, academic quality metrics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Preparation of institutional reports, evidence repositories, and performance dashboards.
  
  
Stakeholder coordination and team leadership.
  
  
**Preferred Industry:**
Universities, higher education institutions, medical colleges, engineering institutions, and multidisciplinary educational institutions.
  
  
**Leadership Expectations:**
Ability to lead institution-wide quality initiatives, coordinate accreditation and ranking activities, and establish robust quality assurance and governance mechanisms.
  
  
**Education & Certification**
**Mandatory:**
Ph.D. or postgraduate qualification in a relevant discipline, as appropriate to the institution's requirements.
  
  
**Preferred:**
Ph.D. with substantial experience in higher education administration, academic quality assurance, or institutional governance.
  
  
**Good to Have:**
Training or certifications related to NAAC accreditation, NBA accreditation, quality management systems, academic auditing, outcome-based education, or institutional assessment frameworks.
  
  
**Additional Preference:**
Experience in multidisciplinary institutions covering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education.
  
  
**Detailed Job Description**
**Role Overview**
The Head of IQAC will be responsible for establishing, leading, and strengthening the institution's internal quality assurance framework. The role will oversee institutional quality processes, accreditation readiness, NAAC-related data and documentation, institutional ranking submissions, academic and administrative audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
The position will work closely with senior management, academic leaders, department heads, faculty, and administrative teams to ensure institutional performance is measured, documented, evaluated, and improved in line with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Institutional Quality Assurance & Governance**
Develop and implement institution-wide quality assurance policies, frameworks, procedures, and annual quality plans.
  
  
Lead the functioning of the Internal Quality Assurance Cell and establish mechanisms for continuous academic and administrative improvement.
  
  
Define quality indicators, monitoring systems, review mechanisms, and accountability structures across departments.
  
  
Ensure quality initiatives are aligned with institutional objectives and applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  
  
**NAAC Accreditation & Assessment**
Lead institutional preparedness for NAAC accreditation, assessment, and applicable quality assurance processes.
  
  
Coordinate the collection, verification, consolidation, and presentation of data and supporting evidence required for accreditation.
  
  
Oversee preparation and review of relevant institutional submissions, including the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR), Self-Study Report (SSR), and other applicable documentation.
  
  
Track accreditation criteria, performance indicators, evidence gaps, and improvement requirements.
  
  
Coordinate with academic and administrative departments to ensure accurate, consistent, and timely submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines.
  
  
**Institutional Rankings & Performance Data**
Lead institutional ranking-related data collection, validation, analysis, and submission activities for relevant national and other applicable ranking frameworks.
  
  
Coordinate with departments to compile verified information relating to academics, research, faculty, student outcomes, infrastructure, outreach, and institutional performance.
  
  
Establish centralised data repositories and evidence-tracking mechanisms to improve data accuracy, consistency, and auditability.
  
  
Analyse ranking performance, identify gaps, and recommend initiatives to strengthen institutional outcomes.
  
  
Monitor ranking criteria, submission timelines, and applicable framework updates.
  
  
**Academic Quality & Continuous Improvement**
Monitor academic quality indicators, teaching-learning processes, curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and student outcomes.
  
  
Promote outcome-based education, programme outcome mapping, feedback mechanisms, and academic quality enhancement initiatives, where applicable.
  
  
Facilitate internal academic audits, administrative audits, and periodic departmental reviews.
  
  
Identify performance gaps and coordinate corrective and preventive action plans.
  
  
Encourage evidence-based decision-making and a culture of continuous quality improvement.
  
  
**Data Management, Documentation & Reporting**
Establish standardised processes for data collection, validation, documentation, and record maintenance.
  
  
Develop dashboards and institutional reports to track quality indicators, accreditation readiness, ranking performance, and improvement initiatives.
  
  
Ensure the availability of reliable supporting evidence for audits, assessments, accreditation reviews, and ranking submissions.
  
  
Implement document control, version management, and evidence verification practices.
  
  
Present periodic quality performance reports and improvement recommendations to institutional leadership.
  
  
**Stakeholder Coordination & Capacity Building**
Work closely with senior management, academic leadership, faculty, department coordinators, and administrative teams on quality-related initiatives.
  
  
Establish departmental quality coordinators and define clear responsibilities for data submission, verification, and compliance.
  
  
Conduct awareness sessions and capacity-building programmes on accreditation criteria, documentation standards, quality metrics, and institutional ranking requirements.
  
  
Facilitate internal quality review meetings and monitor the closure of agreed action items.
  
  
Build institution-wide ownership of quality assurance and accreditation readiness.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Audits**
Monitor applicable quality assurance and accreditation requirements relevant to the institution and its academic programmes.
  
  
Coordinate internal reviews to assess compliance with prescribed academic, administrative, and documentation standards.
  
  
Ensure timely identification, escalation, and closure of quality-related gaps.
  
  
Maintain readiness for external assessments, inspections, audits, and accreditation visits.
  
  
Coordinate with relevant institutional departments to ensure consistency between submitted data, supporting evidence, and official records.
  
  
**Strategic Planning & Institutional Improvement**
Translate accreditation and ranking findings into measurable institutional improvement plans.
  
  
Benchmark institutional performance against relevant peer institutions and applicable quality frameworks.
  
  
Recommend process improvements, governance mechanisms, and digital tools to strengthen quality management.
  
  
Track implementation of improvement initiatives and report progress to institutional leadership.
  
  
Contribute to long-term institutional planning through quality analytics and performance insights.
  
  
**Key Skills**
**Mandatory Skills**
IQAC leadership and institutional quality assurance.
  
  
NAAC accreditation and related documentation.
  
  
Institutional rankings and performance data management.
  
  
Academic and administrative quality audits.
  
  
Data validation, evidence management, and institutional reporting.
  
  
Quality indicators, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Stakeholder coordination and institutional governance.
  
  
Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Exposure to NBA accreditation and other applicable programme-level accreditation frameworks.
  
  
Experience in multidisciplinary universities offering Medical/Healthcare and Engineering programmes.
  
  
Knowledge of outcome-based education, programme outcome assessment, and academic quality frameworks.
  
  
Experience with institutional dashboards, data analytics, and digital documentation systems.
  
  
Exposure to national ranking frameworks, benchmarking, and institutional performance improvement.
  
  
Research, academic administration, and university-level governance experience.
  
  
**Other Specific Remarks**
Candidates should have substantial experience in institutional quality assurance, accreditation, and ranking-related activities, rather than general academic administration alone.
  
  
Demonstrated ownership of NAAC-related data, documentation, assessment readiness, and institutional quality processes is preferred.
  
  
Strong expertise in data accuracy, evidence validation, reporting, and coordination across academic and administrative departments is essential.
  
  
Candidates should be capable of leading institution-wide quality initiatives and presenting performance insights to senior leadership.
  
  
Experience in a university or large multidisciplinary higher education institution will be an advantage.
  
  
Candidates with exposure to both Medical/Healthcare and Engineering education are preferred.
  
  
The role requires a detail-oriented, process-driven leader with strong analytical, documentation, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities.

Measurable business value delivered through improved reporting quality, insights and finance support. What We OfferYou bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. title: Manager - Management Consulting
description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a motivated and talented professional with a strong understanding of Discoms, power markets, procurement, policy and regulatory developments, energy transition and strategic advisory. The candidate should possess sufficient technical understanding to assess emerging energy-sector solutions, while ensuring high-quality deliverables, regulatory compliance and timely, responsive support to client requirements.

**Detailed expectations from the role:**

* Discom Power Planning and Optimization Advise State Discoms on power procurement planning, resource adequacy, power shortage/surplus assessment and optimization of power purchase costs, including evaluation of short-, medium- and long-term procurement options.
* Data Analytics, Energy Modelling and Decision Support Undertake power-sector data analysis, energy modelling and scenario assessment to support procurement strategy, project evaluation, market assessment and management decision-making, including development of analytical dashboards and management presentations.
* Renewable Energy Strategy and Energy Transition Advisory Support clients in developing renewable energy strategies and transition roadmaps, including assessment of procurement options, renewable power sourcing, open access/captive solutions, storage and emerging RE procurement mechanisms.
* Policy, Regulatory and Market Analysis Analyze policy, regulatory and market developments affecting renewable energy, power procurement and electricity markets, and assess their implications for clients’ projects, business strategies and investment decisions.
* Capacity Building and Stakeholder Engagement Design and support delivery of training, workshops and capacity-building programmes on renewable energy, power markets, procurement, clean-energy transition and related sector developments; engage with utilities, government agencies, developers and other stakeholders.
* Project Implementation and PMC Support Support implementation and monitoring of renewable energy projects, including coordination with project stakeholders, review of key deliverables, tracking of project progress, and identification and escalation of technical, commercial and regulatory issues.

**Required skill set**

* Experience in power-sector consulting, advisory or project management, preferably with exposure to Discoms, power markets, renewable energy or energy transition.
* Understanding of power-sector business, market and commercial aspects, including power procurement, power markets, resource planning and related decision-making processes.
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to develop reports, presentations, analytical assessments and client-facing deliverables.

title: Technical Head – Sampling & Development
description:
**About Evolv**

Evolv Clothing is a Chennai-based apparel manufacturing powerhouse with over 50 years of deep expertise in precision garment manufacturing for leading European and American brands. Recognized for quality, consistency, and product excellence, Evolv specializes in value-added apparel manufacturing, blending craftsmanship with innovation and technology.

With advanced manufacturing capabilities, strong global partnerships, and a commitment to sustainable and compliant production, Evolv is strengthening its position as a preferred apparel manufacturing partner for UK, European, and global fashion brands.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a senior Technical Head to lead the Sampling and Development function. The role requires strong technical expertise and a thorough understanding of the products we manufacture, along with the leadership to deliver sampling and development programs that meet customer expectations, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

The Technical Head will own technical evaluation, product feasibility, and sampling execution end to end. Working closely with customers and internal teams, the role resolves technical challenges, makes sure product requirements are clearly understood before sampling begins, and builds the technical capability of the garment technician team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Review & Product Feasibility**

·  Analyse customer tech packs, sketches, specifications, measurement charts, construction details, and workmanship requirements to fully understand each product.

·  Assess product feasibility against garment construction, fabric and trim behaviour, wash-finish requirements, and technical risks.

·  Identify technical gaps early and recommend practical construction or process solutions before sampling begins.

·  Provide technical inputs for costing, including construction methods, SMV, and fabric consumption.

·  Translate customer requests into technical garment development solutions, ensuring design feasibility and product functionality.

·  Coordinate closely with design teams on fabric selection, trim compatibility, garment detailing, and construction techniques.

·  Understand the characteristics of different fabric categories and determine suitable trims, construction techniques, and finishing methods for each garment.

·  Evaluate fabric suitability and identify appropriate garment construction approaches based on design requirements and end-use.

·  Explore and develop new avenues in garment development across design, technical, and construction aspects, considering fabric characteristics, trim selection, and garment feasibility.

**Sampling & Development Delivery**

·  Lead the sample room and development team so that all samples are completed and submitted within agreed timelines.

·  Plan sample room capacity, workload, and priorities across customers and seasons.

·  Conduct fit sessions, review fit comments, and drive pattern and construction corrections.

·  Review and sign off every sample against customer specifications and quality standards before submission.

·  Track sample status, approvals, comments, and revisions, and reduce the number of sample rounds per style.

·  Drive seasonal garment development in collaboration with design teams, aligning product concepts with collection requirements.

·  Lead sampling and technical development activities to translate garment concepts into production-ready samples.

·  Prepare and develop garment lines for seasonal collections in coordination with the Technical Head, Sampling, and Development teams.

**Customer Liaison & Technical Ownership**

·  Act as the senior technical point of contact for customers on construction, specifications, feasibility, and development concerns.

·  Translate customer feedback into clear, actionable instructions for internal teams.

·  Take full ownership of technical issues and coordinate merchandising, pattern, sampling, production, and quality teams to resolve them within customer timelines.

·  Escalate risks to sample quality or delivery proactively and ensure closure with all stakeholders

**Sampling-to-Production Handover**

·  Lead pre-production (PP) meetings and ensure complete technical handover from sampling to bulk production.

·  Be present on the production floor to support the line on technical issues during bulk, so that issues solved in sampling do not recur in production.

**Team Leadership & Capability Development**

·  Guide, coach, and train garment technicians to upgrade their technical skills and problem-solving capability.

·  Identify skill gaps across the technical and sampling teams and run structured, hands-on training.

·  Set technical standards and SOPs for sampling, tech pack interpretation, and measurement checks.

·  Set KRAs for the team, review performance, and build accountability for quality and timelines.

**Key Performance Indicators**

·  On-time sample submission rate

·  Right-first-time sample approval rate and average sample rounds per style

·  Technical issues carried from sampling into bulk production

·  Measurable skill improvement across the garment technician team

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Experience**

·  10-15 years in garment technical, sampling, or product development roles within export apparel manufacturing for UK, European, or US brands.

·  Must have led a technical or sampling team including garment technicians

·  Hands-on experience with product categories Women’s, Kid’s and Men’s Woven Wears, including tech packs, fit sessions, and sample development.

·  Proven experience handling customer technical discussions and feasibility issues directly.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

·  Expert knowledge of garment construction, specifications, measurements, workmanship, and fabric and trim behaviour.

·  Strong understanding of patterns, fit, sewing operations, washes/finishes, and testing requirements.

·  Ability to evaluate SMV, construction methods, and consumption for costing inputs.

·  Strong troubleshooting and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple development programs at once.

·  Confident customer communication and stakeholder management at a senior level.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

·  A hands-on technical leader capable of leading and developing the technical team while confidently handling customer discussions and resolving technical challenges.

·  Takes ownership of technical issues and drives them to resolution.

·  Develops people and raises the technical standard of the whole team.

**Education**

A degree in Garment Technology, Fashion Technology, Textile Technology, or Apparel Manufacturing from NIFT or an equivalent recognized institution is required. A postgraduate (PG) qualification in a relevant field will be an added advantage.

**What Evolv Offers**

·  Leadership of a key function at an established manufacturer with over 50+ years of expertise.

·  Direct exposure to leading UK, European, and global fashion brands.

·  The opportunity to shape and strengthen sampling standards, processes, and team capabilities while driving technical development, improving garment construction, fit, quality, and product execution.

**Apply Now**

Interested candidates can share their profiles at: careers@evolvclothing.com

description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. The Associate Director of AI Science is a highly strategic, business-facing leadership role dedicated to driving commercial value across our Home and Mobility verticals. Sitting at the intersection of advanced machine learning and business strategy, this role focuses on leveraging propensity modeling and dynamic microsegmentation to unlock new revenue streams, optimize the customer lifecycle, and elevate customer lifetime value.
  
  
You will act as the crucial bridge between our technical AI Science teams and the Home and Mobility business units, ensuring that complex AI and data science capabilities are translated into adopted, scalable solutions that deliver measurable ROI and continuous business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Business Strategy & Commercial Value Creation**

* Monetize AI Capabilities: Lead the strategic application of advanced propensity models (e.g., likelihood-to-buy, churn prediction, next-best-action, cross-sell/up-sell) to drive tangible growth and retention in the Home and Mobility sectors.
* Define Microsegmentation Strategy: Guide the development of highly granular, behavioral microsegments to personalize marketing efforts, optimize pricing strategies, and tailor product offerings in real-time.
* ROI Accountability: Establish frameworks to measure the commercial impact of deployed AI models. Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) that demonstrate direct value creation, revenue lift, and cost optimization.
* Lifecycle Optimization: Embed AI-driven insights into critical touchpoints along the customer lifecycle, ensuring predictive interventions are timed perfectly with high-impact trigger events.

**Stakeholder Management & AI Adoption**

* Executive Liaison: Serve as the primary strategic advisor and translator between the AI Science function and Home/Mobility business leaders (Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Experience).
* Drive Business Adoption: Champion the operationalization of AI models. Overcome organizational silos and resistance by demonstrating clear business value, securing buy-in, and embedding AI tools directly into end-user workflows.
* Storytelling with Data: Translate highly technical machine learning concepts, model performance metrics, and statistical outputs into clear, compelling narratives and strategic recommendations for senior executive leadership.
* Needs Translation: Proactively identify business pain points within Home and Mobility and translate these into actionable data science projects, defining clear modeling requirements for the technical teams.

**Technical Oversight & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Model Lifecycle Strategy: Oversee the business strategy for models deployed in high-impact areas, ensuring continuous optimization, accuracy, and relevance to shifting market dynamics.
* Pipeline Integration: Partner closely with Data Engineering, MLOps, and IT teams to ensure models are seamlessly deployed into production environments and marketing automation platforms.
* Team Mentorship: Provide strategic direction and business-context mentorship to data scientists and AI engineers, ensuring their technical execution remains tightly aligned with corporate objectives.

**Core Competencies & Qualifications**
**Experience & Education**

* Education: Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field (an MBA with a strong quantitative focus is highly preferred).
* Industry Experience: 8+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or AI strategy, with a minimum of 3 years in a leadership, product management, or business-facing role.
* Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the telecommunications, broadband, or consumer technology industries, specifically within Home (e.g., fiber, smart home, IoT) and Mobility (e.g., 5G, wireless services) verticals.

**Technical & Business Skills**

* AI/ML Fluency: Strong foundational understanding of machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, and LLM architecture. Must be highly conversant in how techniques utilizing frameworks like PyTorch and scikit-learn are applied to business problems, even if not writing production code daily.
* Advanced Propensity & Segmentation: Proven track record of designing, evaluating, and strategically deploying end-to-end propensity models and clustering techniques for large-scale customer bases.
* Data Stack Familiarity: Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), production MLOps tools, and large-scale data extraction processes.
* Exceptional Communication: Elite presentation skills with the ability to distill complex analytical findings into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like in Year One
  
  

* Successfully integrated at least three major propensity or microsegmentation models into the Home and Mobility go-to-market workflows.
* Established a regular cadence of AI performance reporting that clearly demonstrates incremental revenue lift or churn reduction to the executive team.
* Achieved a high adoption rate of AI-driven recommendations among business stakeholders, shifting the organizational culture toward proactive, model-driven decision-making.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40

title: Delivery Manager I
description:
**Role Description**
The Project Manager II will oversee day-to-day technology operations and production support for a mid-sized Health Plan, ensuring seamless delivery of services across core healthcare administration systems, including enrolment, claims, adjudication, and payments.
  
  
This role requires strong leadership, project management, service delivery, and stakeholder management capabilities. The individual will work closely with health plan clients, third-party vendors, and onshore/offshore teams to ensure operational stability, timely issue resolution, continuous improvement, and high customer satisfaction.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Project & Service Delivery Management
* Manage end-to-end technology delivery and production support operations, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs and operational commitments.
* Oversee day-to-day production support activities for healthcare administration platforms and associated applications.
* Plan, prioritize, and coordinate operational activities, enhancements, maintenance, and release schedules.
* Ensure timely delivery of project milestones, tasks, and customer commitments.
* Drive service delivery excellence through continuous process improvements and operational efficiencies.
* Production Support & Incident Management
* Ensure production stability and application performance across the Health Plan ecosystem.
* Lead incident management, problem management, root cause analysis (RCA), and resolution activities.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and change activities using service management tools such as ServiceNow and JIRA.
* Coordinate with network, middleware, infrastructure, hardware, operating system, database, and application support teams to resolve technical issues.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely communication and resolution.
* Provide on-call support and coordinate critical production activities during after-hours and weekends, as required.
* Client & Stakeholder Management
* Act as a primary point of contact for customer interactions, operational reviews, and service delivery discussions.
* Lead customer calls, prioritize business requirements, and drive issue resolution.
* Collaborate with onshore teams, offshore delivery teams, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client executives, business leaders, and technology partners.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and ensure transparent communication on project progress, risks, dependencies, and escalations.
* Governance, Reporting & Compliance
* Prepare and deliver SLA reports, operational dashboards, and management status reports within defined timelines.
* Establish and maintain governance frameworks, including RACI matrices, RAID logs, and Steering Committee reviews.
* Monitor service performance, identify operational risks, and implement mitigation plans.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
* Manage vendor performance, SOWs, SLAs, and Change Requests.
* Resource & Team Management
* Manage project staffing, resource allocation, and delivery capacity.
* Mentor, coach, and develop team members to strengthen technical capabilities and operational accountability.
* Drive team collaboration, performance management, and effective coordination across distributed teams.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and customer-centric service delivery.
* Process Improvement & Transformation
* Identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and service improvement.
* Establish standardized processes to improve consistency, quality, and service delivery.
* Drive change management, release management, and successful client rollouts.
* Apply ITIL best practices, SDLC, and Agile methodologies to enhance operational effectiveness.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of relevant experience in IT, Healthcare IT, technology operations, or service delivery management.
* Strong experience in project management, production support, and service delivery operations.
* Proven experience managing customer-facing technology support teams in complex IT environments.
* Experience managing healthcare payer systems, preferably HealthEdge HealthRules suite.
* Strong understanding of core healthcare administration processes, including enrolment, claims processing, adjudication, and payments.
* Hands-on experience with service management tools such as ServiceNow and JIRA.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL practices, incident management, problem management, change management, and release management.
* Experience managing SLAs, operational metrics, service reports, SOWs, and Change Requests.
* Proven experience in vendor management and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent planning, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and management presentations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with customers, senior management, and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, drive accountability, and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

Educational Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 12+ years of relevant professional experience in IT or Healthcare Management.

What We Look For
  
  

* Strong customer focus and commitment to service excellence.
* Ability to lead teams and manage complex operational challenges.
* Proactive approach to risk identification, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to build collaborative partnerships across technology, business, and operations teams.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, operational stability, and customer satisfaction.

Agile, Change Management, Claims Management, Healthcare Systems, ITIL, Incident Management, Issue Analysis, Jira, Payment Processing, Production Support, Project Management

title: Manager, Business Operations
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
The Core Platforms Technology team is looking for a talented, self-driven, and analytically minded Business Operations professional. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Business Operations Analyst will partner with engineering leaders and cross-functional teams to improve operating discipline, generate actionable insights, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
  
This role combines business operations, data analysis, workforce and capacity planning, portfolio governance, communications, and program execution.
  
  
Meet Our Team
  
  
The Business Operations team supports the Core Platforms Technology leadership team and helps the organization operate effectively at scale. We partner closely with Engineering, Product, Finance, People, Strategy, and other Business Operations teams to translate business priorities into measurable plans and coordinated execution.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Lead functional projects and programs to optimize operational processes.
* Identify issues and recommend best practices for process improvements.
* Partner with various departments to understand business trends.
* Drive business or process improvements within the function.
* Provide oversight and support for planning and management of financial, budget, and headcount targets.
* Act as a point of contact or liaison between business leadership, staff, and other key partners.
* Promote transparent reporting and foster a culture of data-driven decision-making by defining key metrics and evaluating progress.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities**
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Prepare, analyze, and interpret organizational and operational data, including workforce census, OKRs, KPIs, capacity, investment plans, roadmaps, delivery health, and other leadership reporting.
* Translate data into actionable insights, clearly identifying trends, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for leadership consideration.
* Create dashboards, executive presentations, and decision-support materials that communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistent operating metrics.
* Support annual and quarterly planning processes, including workforce planning, capacity planning, resource allocation, and scenario modelling for employees and contingent workers.
* Support portfolio and operating reviews by tracking priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and follow-through.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring operational processes and reporting.
* Use company-approved AI and automation tools to accelerate analysis, generate initial insights, synthesize information, and improve the efficiency of reporting and communications.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, bias, and business context, while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and responsible-AI requirements.
* Help develop and maintain operating playbooks, training materials, communications, templates, and best practices for the organization.
* Develop leadership messaging for internal communications, organizational updates, operating reviews, and executive presentations.
* Support employee engagement and organizational effectiveness initiatives in partnership with People Business Partners and business leaders.
* Lead or contribute to cross-functional initiatives and special projects, from problem definition and analysis through implementation and measurement of outcomes.

**What You Need To Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in business operations, strategic planning, analytics, program management, technical project management, or a related discipline, preferably within a technology or engineering organization.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into insights, recommendations, and executive-level narratives.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of data-analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or equivalent platforms.
* Practical experience using generative AI or AI-enabled productivity tools for research, data synthesis, reporting, communications, workflow improvement, or decision support.
* Understanding of responsible AI use, including data confidentiality, output validation, bias awareness, and appropriate human oversight.
* Ability to identify repeatable processes that can be simplified or automated using AI, workflow tools, or low-code solutions.
* Strong execution orientation, with demonstrated ownership from problem definition through delivery and follow-through.
* Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives and technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly in an environment characterized by change and ambiguity.
* Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed organization.
* Ability to establish credibility, build trusted relationships, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Sound judgment and the ability to balance business partnership with constructive challenge and timely escalation of risks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting platform engineering, infrastructure, cloud, developer productivity, enterprise technology, or another complex technical organization.
* Experience with portfolio management, technology investment planning, engineering capacity planning, or organizational health metrics.
* Familiarity with automation or low-code tools such as Power Automate, Copilot, or similar platforms.
* Experience designing executive dashboards, conducting scenario analysis, or developing business cases.

title: Tender Lead Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**
The Tender Lead Engineer Leads the preparation of high-quality, detailed, and comprehensive technical and commercial proposals for the Utility and Industry segments, with a primary focus on High-Voltage AC Substations. Ensures that gross margin and cash flow targets are aligned with Linjemontage business objectives for this segment and collaborates with cross-functional teams to maximize competitiveness while maintaining profitability and delivering an optimal offer price. You will be an integral part of our skilled, multidisciplinary teams in Sweden and Norway.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The role will be responsible for tender preparation for turnkey High-Voltage AC Substations for Utility and Industry projects from the early pursuit phase until final negotiation, contract signature and handover to the execution team. During preparation, the successful candidate will lead an interdisciplinary tender team to professionally prepare the technical and commercial offer.
  
  
The position of Tendering Manager will have a variety of responsibilities including, but not limited to:
  
  

* Together with the International front-end sales organization, you will identify projects in the early stage, understand customer requirements and follow-up regularly and promptly with customers during the acquisition phase
* Together with the sales organization, you follow the sales strategy for the individual tenders by selecting the winning solution, both commercially and technically
* Assume the lead for assigned tenders, incorporating the help of interdisciplinary supporting teams consisting of engineering, project management, legal, commercial and supply chain management
* Prepare and ensure on-time and complete technical and commercial tender submittal to the customer and lead the technical and commercial negotiations with customers
* Responsible for the integration of supplier offers, risk evaluation and completeness of tender in multi-national setups
* Oversee the validation of terms and conditions in each offer
* Hand over successful sales projects to the project execution and engineering departments
* Collaborate with supply chain management to coordinate subcontractor and supplier offers. Support SCM in negotiations with vendors to get the best technical and commercial offers
* Provide in a timely manner all necessary information to support the Linjemontage risk and approval process in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering discipline
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in sales and tendering of power systems, with a focus on substations.
* Proven track record of working with utility and industrial customers, as well as international EPC contractors and project developers.
* Solid technical knowledge of AIS and GIS high-voltage (HV) and medium-voltage (MV) equipment and systems.
* Experience collaborating with Nordic utilities or EPC companies will be considered a strong advantage.

**Personal attributes**

* Leadership on Integrity
* Proactive and self-motivated with the ability to work with cross-functional and cross-border teams as well as to cope with a flexible-load environment
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Willingness to travel for site assessments and project meetings.
* Structured and solution oriented.
* International travel is required.

**What We Offer**

* A key role in exciting, future-oriented projects within the energy sector
* Autonomy in your work and decision-making responsibilities
* Opportunities for continuous professional growth and development
* A strong, collaborative, and supportive team culture
* Long-term career prospects within a growing and forward-thinking organization

**Recruitment process**
We do not accept applications by email. We will review all applications and make an initial selection. Selected candidates will be invited to a first interview by phone. Final candidates will then be invited to an in-person interview at our office in Chennai.
  
  
**Office location**
COWRKS Rmz Millenia Business Park, 600096 Chennai Tamil Nadu, India
  
  
**About Linjemontage**
***Linjemontage is a Swedish pure-play EPC provider within power infrastructure, enabling the modernisation and expansion of the Nordic electricity grid. The company provides turnkey solutions within substations and transmission and distribution networks, with capabilities across the entire project value chain and specialist high-voltage expertise up to 400 kV. The company currently has approximately 400 employees. Operations are primarily conducted in Sweden and Norway, complemented by a business branch in Croatia and an operation centre in India. Linjemontage was founded in Grästorp in 1993 and the company’s shares have been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2026. For more information, visit***
***www.linjemontage.se***

description:
\*AGM Projects – Multi Storey Building (Civil) | Saligramam, Chennai\*
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior and experienced AGM Projects to lead end-to-end execution of Multi Storey Residential Buildings – Apartments / Villas. The candidate will be responsible for complete project delivery from mobilisation to handover, ensuring timeline, quality, safety, cost and client satisfaction.
  
  

* Experience:\* 15-20 Years
* Salary:\* Rs. 1,00,000 - 1,20,000 per month
* Qualification:\* B.E. / B.Tech Civil Engineering (Mandatory)
* Preferred:\* PMP / Primavera / Construction Management
* Joining:\* Immediate Joiners Preferred

**Detailed Responsibilities**
\*1. Project Planning & Execution\*
  
  
Plan, monitor and control project schedules, construction sequence, manpower, machinery and material planning for multi storey buildings. Ensure execution as per approved drawings, structural designs, specifications, BOQ and project timelines. Identify delays in advance and take corrective action. Coordinate with Project Head for strategic planning and approvals.
  
  
\*2. Site Management & Coordination\*
  
  
Oversee multiple multi storey project sites at Saligramam and nearby locations. Conduct daily / weekly site reviews for progress, productivity, quality and safety. Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, QA/QC, Safety, Purchase and Stores teams. Ensure site discipline, SOP compliance and smooth day-to-day operations.
  
  
\*3. Technical Coordination\*
  
  
Coordinate with Architects, Structural Consultants, MEP Consultants, Liaison and other stakeholders for drawing clarifications, approvals and design coordination. Review GFC drawings, resolve site technical issues, and ensure execution without rework. Provide technical guidance to site team for complex structural works like raft, basement, podium, tower structure, finishing works.
  
  
\*4. Cost, Budget & Billing Control\*
  
  
Monitor project budget, cost consumption, material wastage and variations. Review BOQ, RA bills, subcontractor bills, variation claims and certifications in coordination with QS and Finance. Control project cash flow, forecast requirements and implement cost optimization measures.
  
  
\*5. Quality & Safety\*
  
  
Ensure strict adherence to quality standards for structure, waterproofing, finishes and MEP integration. Coordinate with QA/QC team for checklists, material testing, cube tests, mock-ups and NCR closure. Ensure 100% safety compliance, toolbox talks, PPE usage, scaffolding / tower crane safety and statutory requirements.
  
  
\*6. Procurement & Vendor Management\*
  
  
Coordinate with Purchase for timely procurement of cement, steel, RMC, blocks, finishing materials and services. Plan material requirements as per schedule to avoid site stoppage. Monitor contractor / subcontractor performance, workmanship, manpower deployment and compliance with agreements.
  
  
\*7. Team Leadership\*
  
  
Lead, mentor and manage Project Managers, Site Engineers, Supervisors and support staff. Define KRAs, review performance, conduct review meetings and build a result-oriented team. Ensure effective communication and adherence to hierarchy.
  
  
\*8. Reporting & Handover\*
  
  
Prepare weekly / monthly MIS, progress reports, delay analysis, risk register and present to Management. Highlight risks, resource gaps and action plans. Ensure snag rectification, final inspections, statutory approvals, customer handover and complete project closure documentation.
  
  
**Skills Required**
Strong knowledge of multi storey building construction, structural execution, finishing works, drawings, BOQ, specifications, MS Project, Primavera, MS Office, ERP. Excellent leadership, planning, coordination, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
15-20 years in Civil Construction with minimum 3-5 years in senior leadership role, with proven track record of completing multi storey apartments / villas on time.
  
  
Work Location: Saligramam, Chennai.
  
  
Immediate joiners are preferred.
  
  
For more details contact us at 9176033506/9791033506.

title: Purchase Manager
description:
Job Opening – Senior Manager – Purchase (Pharma & Surgical)
  
  
**Company:**
Curtis Drug Point Private Limited (Kauvery Hospital Group)
  
  
**Position:**
Senior Manager – Purchase
  
  
**Department:**
Purchase & Procurement
  
  
**Experience:**
12–15 Years (Minimum 5 Years in a Managerial Role)
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Pharm / M.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com; MBA in Materials Management / Supply Chain preferred
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Manager – Purchase to lead pharmaceutical and surgical product procurement operations across Curtis Drug Point Private Limited. The candidate will be responsible for strategic sourcing, vendor management, rate contract negotiations, centralized purchasing, inventory optimization, cost reduction, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in pharmaceutical procurement, hospital pharmacy purchasing, or pharmaceutical distribution, with strong negotiation, vendor management, and leadership capabilities.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Procurement Strategy & Planning
* Develop and implement procurement strategies based on demand forecasts, consumption trends, and sales requirements.
* Lead centralized purchasing and purchase order management across all Curtis Drug Point units.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential medicines, surgical products, and fast-moving items.
* Coordinate with the Kauvery Hospital Central Purchase Team for rate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms.
* Standardize purchase policies, approval processes, reorder levels, and procurement procedures.
* Vendor Management & Negotiation
* Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, CFAs, and stockists.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, margins, discounts, schemes, credit terms, and rate contracts.
* Ensure procurement under approved rate contracts and consistent pricing across all units.
* Monitor vendor performance based on product quality, delivery timelines, pricing, and service levels.
* Negotiate returns, credit notes, and adjustments for expired, damaged, and non-moving stock.
* Inventory Optimization & Cost Control
* Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent stockouts and overstocking.
* Implement cost-saving initiatives through strategic sourcing, vendor consolidation, and alternate sourcing.
* Minimize near-expiry, expired, damaged, and non-moving inventory.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor claims, purchase returns, and credit note adjustments.
* Optimize procurement costs while maintaining product availability and quality.
* Regulatory Compliance & Procurement Controls
* Ensure compliance with applicable drug licensing requirements, the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, and GST regulations.
* Verify vendor licences, product registrations, and statutory documentation.
* Maintain accurate procurement records and ensure adherence to purchase SOPs and approval policies.
* Support internal and external audits by providing procurement-related documentation.
* Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination
* Lead and manage purchase teams across Curtis Drug Point units.
* Allocate vendor and product category responsibilities and monitor team performance.
* Train team members on procurement systems, vendor negotiations, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with Pharmacy, Sales, Warehouse, and Finance teams for purchase planning, stock availability, and vendor payments.
* MIS Reporting & Performance Monitoring
* Prepare and present procurement MIS reports covering purchase spend, cost savings, vendor performance, and inventory status.
* Monitor procurement KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
* Utilize ERP/SAP systems for purchase order management, procurement tracking, and reporting.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in pharmaceutical and surgical product procurement.
* Experience in centralized purchasing, strategic sourcing, and rate contract management.
* Excellent vendor negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical pricing, margins, GST, and procurement compliance.
* Strong inventory planning, demand forecasting, and cost optimization skills.
* Proficiency in ERP/SAP, procurement MIS, and MS Excel.
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Candidate Requirements
  
  

* Education: B.Pharm / M.Pharm or Graduate in Science / Commerce; MBA in Materials Management / Supply Chain preferred.
* Experience: 12–15 years in pharmaceutical purchase or supply chain management, including at least 5 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in hospital pharmacy procurement, pharmacy chain purchasing, or pharmaceutical distribution preferred.
* Proven experience in vendor negotiations, rate contract management, centralized procurement, and cost-saving initiatives.
* Experience managing procurement teams and coordinating purchasing across multiple units will be an advantage.

**Key Skills:**
Pharma Purchase, Pharmaceutical Procurement, Surgical Purchase, Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management, Rate Contract Negotiation, Centralized Procurement, Purchase Order Management, Inventory Planning, Cost Optimization, Pharma Distribution, Hospital Pharmacy Purchase, ERP, SAP, Supply Chain Management.

Role Overview

The Head of Coffee will be responsible for developing, building and managing Geetham's entire coffee vertical, covering bean sourcing, procurement, roasting, blending, product development, quality control and operational execution across our outlets.

The ideal candidate should possess deep technical knowledge of coffee, hands-on experience in roasting and sourcing, and a strong understanding of traditional South Indian filter coffee as well as contemporary speciality coffee.

This is a leadership role that requires both technical expertise and the ability to build a scalable coffee business within a growing restaurant chain.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Coffee Sourcing & Procurement**

* Identify and establish relationships with coffee growers, estates, plantations, cooperatives and green coffee suppliers across India.
* Source premium Arabica, Robusta and other suitable coffee varieties from different coffee-growing regions.
* Develop a strong understanding of coffee origins, varietals, processing methods, altitude, grading and flavour profiles.
* Evaluate green coffee beans based on quality, consistency, pricing and availability.
* Establish long-term sourcing partnerships to ensure consistent quality and a reliable supply chain.
* Explore opportunities for direct sourcing from coffee estates.

**2. Coffee Roasting & Blending**

* Lead the end-to-end roasting process, including roast profiling, batch management and quality evaluation.
* Develop customised roast profiles for different coffee applications.
* Create proprietary coffee blends exclusively for Geetham.
* Develop signature blends for traditional South Indian filter coffee.
* Experiment with Arabica-Robusta ratios, roast levels and different bean origins to achieve distinct flavour profiles.
* Establish roasting standards, protocols and consistency benchmarks.
* Work towards developing an in-house roasting capability for the brand.

**3. South Indian Filter Coffee Development**

* Possess an in-depth understanding of traditional South Indian filter coffee preparation.
* Develop signature filter coffee blends with the right balance of aroma, body, strength and flavour.
* Standardise coffee-to-chicory ratios and evaluate different blending combinations.
* Experiment with different coffee origins, roast profiles and grind sizes.
* Optimise decoction extraction, brewing time, water temperature and coffee-to-water ratios.
* Standardise the preparation of filter coffee across all Geetham outlets.
* Develop a consistent and distinctive Geetham filter coffee experience.

**4. Speciality Coffee & Product Innovation**

* Develop a speciality coffee portfolio that complements Geetham's traditional South Indian identity.
* Experiment with single-origin coffees, speciality blends and different processing methods.
* Explore brewing methods such as pour-over, French press, AeroPress, espresso and other relevant techniques.
* Develop signature coffee beverages and innovative hot and cold coffee offerings.
* Conduct regular coffee tastings, cupping sessions and product trials.
* Stay updated with global coffee trends, emerging brewing techniques and new product innovations.

**5. Quality Control & Standardisation**

* Establish quality benchmarks for green beans, roasted beans, blends and finished beverages.
* Implement cupping and sensory evaluation protocols.
* Monitor consistency in aroma, acidity, body, flavour and extraction.
* Establish standard operating procedures for grinding, brewing, storage and handling.
* Conduct regular quality audits across outlets.
* Ensure consistency of coffee quality irrespective of outlet location or volume.

**6. Operations & Supply Chain Management**

* Build a centralised coffee procurement, roasting and distribution system.
* Plan coffee inventory, production schedules and supply requirements across outlets.
* Establish systems for bean storage, freshness management and shelf-life monitoring.
* Work closely with the procurement, operations and finance teams.
* Manage coffee costs, wastage, yields and gross margins.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency without compromising quality.

**7. Team Building & Training**

* Build and lead a dedicated coffee team.
* Train chefs, beverage staff, supervisors and outlet teams in coffee preparation.
* Develop training modules and standard operating procedures.
* Establish coffee preparation standards and competency assessments.
* Build a culture of coffee appreciation, product knowledge and quality consciousness.

Desired Qualifications & Experience

* 7–12 years of relevant experience in the coffee industry, preferably with hands-on experience in roasting, sourcing and product development.
* Proven experience in green coffee procurement and relationships with coffee estates or suppliers.
* Strong practical knowledge of coffee roasting, roast profiling and blend development.
* Experience in developing commercial coffee blends and proprietary coffee products.
* In-depth knowledge of traditional South Indian filter coffee and its preparation techniques.
* Understanding of speciality coffee, coffee origins, processing methods and sensory evaluation.
* Experience with coffee cupping and quality assessment.
* Familiarity with commercial roasting equipment, grinders, brewing equipment and extraction techniques.
* Experience in managing teams, production operations and quality standards.

Certifications such as SCA Coffee Skills, Q Grader or equivalent coffee education will be an added advantage, but practical expertise and demonstrable results will carry greater weight.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

1. Development of Geetham's signature filter coffee blend.
2. Development of proprietary speciality coffee blends.
3. Consistency of coffee quality across all outlets.
4. Improvement in coffee procurement costs and gross margins.
5. Successful establishment of a centralised roasting and supply system.
6. Reduction in coffee wastage and quality variations.
7. Successful launch of new coffee products and beverages.
8. Training and capability development of outlet teams.
9. Customer satisfaction and coffee product performance.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about coffee and understands it beyond the beverage itself.

Someone who can identify the right beans, understand their origins, roast them to perfection, create unique blends and translate that expertise into a consistent, high-quality coffee experience at scale.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable working with coffee estates, operating a roaster, developing a new filter coffee blend, conducting a cupping session and implementing processes across multiple restaurant outlets.

**The larger vision is to build a distinctive Geetham coffee identity — one that respects the heritage of South Indian filter coffee while embracing the possibilities of speciality coffee.**

title: Lead SAP FICO Consultant
description:
The consultant will combine deep hands-on AR and SAP FI expertise with functional team leadership, partnering with finance stakeholders, solution architects, technical teams, and cross-functional workstreams to deliver scalable solutions, govern quality, mentor consultants, and drive successful project outcomes.
  
  
Business Process Analysis and Solution Design
  
  

* Engage with finance and business stakeholders to understand Accounts Receivable, customer accounting, collections, cash application, credit, dispute, dunning, and period-end requirements.
* Plan and facilitate requirement-gathering workshops; document current-state and target-state processes, business rules, pain points, controls, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform fit-to-standard and gap analysis, recommend process improvements, and define practical SAP FI solutions aligned with business objectives and accounting controls.
* Translate approved requirements into process designs, configuration documents, functional specifications, and traceability artifacts.

SAP FI Configuration and Accounts Receivable Expertise
  
  

* Design and configure SAP FI capabilities with Accounts Receivable as the primary focus, including customer master and Business Partner settings, account groups, number ranges, posting controls, payment terms, dunning, incoming payments, clearing, residual and partial payments, reason codes, correspondence, and account determination.
* Provide senior-level expertise across complex AR scenarios including lockbox, electronic bank statement integration, cash application, refunds, credit memos, down payments, customer statements, intercompany receivables, write-offs, dispute handling, collections, and month-end reconciliation.
* Configure and support General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, taxes, currencies, document splitting, validations, substitutions, and financial closing where required for an integrated FI solution.
* Map finance processes to SAP S/4HANA functionality using standard capabilities wherever appropriate, including Universal Journal, Business Partner, SAP Fiori applications, and modern reporting.
* Collaborate with SD, MM, CO, Treasury, banking, tax, and integration teams to ensure coherent end-to-end process integration, especially order-to-cash postings and customer account settlement.
* Work with developers and integration teams to define functional requirements for enhancements, forms, reports, workflows, interfaces, conversions, APIs, IDocs, and extensions.
* Support finance master-data design and migration activities for Business Partner/customer, G/L accounts, open items, balances, credit data, payment methods, and relevant reference data.

Testing, Deployment, and Support
  
  

* Prepare test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results; execute and support unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing.
* Validate AR postings, clearing, aging, reconciliation, dunning, cash application, customer statements, tax, and financial reporting outcomes.
* Analyze defects, identify root causes, coordinate fixes, and validate that solutions meet functional, accounting, control, and business requirements.
* Support cutover planning, open-item migration, reconciliation, deployment readiness, go-live, stabilization, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Troubleshoot production issues, assess financial and business impact, and coordinate timely resolution with technical and cross-functional teams.

Project Delivery and Collaboration
  
  

* Act as the functional liaison between finance teams, product owners, project managers, developers, testers, architects, and other SAP workstreams.
* Contribute to project planning, estimates, status reporting, risk and issue management, and delivery of small to medium-sized initiatives.
* Maintain accurate functional documentation, configuration rationale, test evidence, reconciliation evidence, support knowledge, and handover materials.
* Serve as an SAP FI and Accounts Receivable subject-matter expert and provide guidance, peer support, and mentoring to junior team members.
* Work independently while contributing effectively within Agile, hybrid, or structured project delivery models.

Team Leadership and Delivery Management
  
  

* Lead and mentor SAP FI consultants, analysts, and junior team members across implementation, rollout, enhancement, and application-support engagements.
* Own functional workstream planning, estimation, task allocation, prioritization, progress tracking, and coordination of delivery dependencies.
* Provide functional leadership during workshops, solution design, configuration reviews, testing cycles, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
* Review functional specifications, configuration documents, test scenarios, reconciliation outputs, defect resolutions, and deployment deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, and traceability.
* Act as the functional escalation point for complex AR and SAP FI issues, critical business requirements, and cross-workstream design decisions.
* Drive knowledge sharing, reusable assets, process standardization, continuous improvement, onboarding, coaching, and capability development.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* 8+ years of SAP consulting experience with advanced hands-on expertise in SAP FI, including SAP S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, enhancements, transformation programs, and application support.
* Demonstrated experience designing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting end-to-end Accounts Receivable processes as the primary functional competency.
* At least two full-cycle SAP implementation engagements covering requirements, design, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
* Strong functional knowledge of customer accounting, incoming payments, clearing, dunning, cash application, account statements, credit and collections touchpoints, reconciliation, and period-end close.
* Broad working knowledge of General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, tax, and integration with SD, MM, CO, and Treasury.
* Experience preparing business process documents, functional specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, training materials, and user-facing guidance.
* Strong analytical, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert business needs into clear, controlled, and supportable functional solutions.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, stakeholder-management capability, and confidence facilitating workshops.
* Demonstrated experience leading an SAP FI functional workstream or team, including planning, estimates, task coordination, quality reviews, mentoring, and stakeholder communication.
* Experience coordinating onshore and offshore team members across multiple functional and technical workstreams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Formal SAP training or certification in SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA transformation, upgrade, rollout, migration, or Central Finance programs.
* Exposure to SAP Fiori finance applications, SAP Cash Application, FSCM Credit Management, Collections Management, and Dispute Management.
* Experience with banking interfaces, lockbox, electronic bank statements, payment formats, data migration, and custom enhancement delivery relevant to AR.
* Understanding of SAP Activate, Agile/Scrum delivery, solution governance, global delivery models, effort estimation, roadmap definition, presales, or proposal activities.
