title: Demand Planning & SIOP Leader
description:
***The Demand Planning & SIOP Leader***
(Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) at FLSmidth is responsible for leading the global demand planning and integrated business planning process to optimize forecast accuracy, production alignment, and customer delivery performance. This role ensures cross-functional synchronization among Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to deliver reliable demand visibility, effective capacity planning, and operational execution across the mining capital equipment business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership**

* Develop and lead FLSmidth’s global SIOP framework to ensure a disciplined, transparent, and data-driven planning process that aligns commercial and operational priorities.
* Partner with Sales, Product Line, and Operations leaders to establish a unified demand plan that supports business growth and customer satisfaction.
* Drive collaboration across functional areas to balance demand, supply, and inventory in line with strategic objectives.
* Provide executive leadership with accurate demand visibility and capacity alignment to support growth and customer delivery.
* Champion process standardization and system integration for global SIOP implementation.
* Support executive decision-making by providing scenario planning, risk assessments, and business insights.

**Demand Planning & Forecasting**

* Lead the development of a comprehensive demand planning process that integrates sales forecasts, customer insights, and market trends for capital equipment and spare parts.
* Incorporate sales input, market intelligence, and customer project visibility into forecast accuracy improvements.
* Implement forecasting tools and analytics that enable data transparency and predictability across global regions.
* Measure and improve forecast accuracy (FA%) and forecast bias through ongoing performance review.
* Continuously refine forecasting techniques to account for project-based variability and global market conditions.

**SIOP Process Ownership**

* Own and facilitate the monthly global SIOP cycle, driving consensus among commercial, operational, and financial stakeholders.
* Lead executive-level SIOP meetings, presenting key metrics, risks, and mitigation actions.
* Integrate supply chain capacity planning, production scheduling, and resource planning into the demand plan.
* Drive alignment between the SIOP plan and the company’s budget, long-term planning, and financial forecasts.
* Monitor and communicate key performance indicators, risks, and recovery plans.
* Partner with Finance to align operational plans with financial budgets and forecasts.

**Operational Excellence & Systems**

* Lead the deployment of digital planning tools, dashboards, and analytics to enhance forecast visibility and execution accuracy.
* Leverage ERP and advanced planning systems (APS) to provide end-to-end visibility and performance tracking.
* Ensure process compliance, data integrity, and KPI governance across business units.
* Implement predictive planning capabilities and digital dashboards for decision-making.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build and lead a high-performing global Demand Planning and SIOP team.
* Develop organizational capability in data analysis, scenario modeling, and collaborative planning.
* Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and cross-functional teamwork.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field (MBA or advanced degree preferred).
* 10+ years of experience in demand planning, SIOP, or supply chain management within capital equipment or heavy industrial manufacturing, ideally in a project-based environment.
* Proven experience implementing and managing SIOP or IBP processes across complex, project-based environments.
* Strong understanding of global manufacturing, order-to-delivery, and supply chain planning dynamics for engineered-to-order (ETO) products.
* Proficiency in ERP and advanced planning/forecasting tools (Kinaxis, O9, or equivalent).
* Lean Six Sigma certification or APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP, or CLTD) preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and strategic planning skills.
* Strong business acumen with a focus on operational and financial alignment.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills across global and cross-functional teams.
* Experience driving organizational change and continuous improvement.
* Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Forecast Accuracy and Bias (%).
* On-Time Delivery (OTD) and Customer Service Level.
* Inventory Turns and Working Capital Efficiency.
* SIOP Process Adherence and Maturity Index.
* Alignment between Operational and Financial Plans.

title: TC-CS-Cyber Architecture- OT and Engineering-infrastructure and Cloud Security- Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**IT Network & Infrastructure Security – Senior Manager**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and scale the Zero Trust Security Portfolio across EY GDS. This role will be responsible for leading complex client programs, building high-performing teams, and driving innovation across Infrastructure Security capabilities.
  
  
The Senior Manager will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, helping organizations transition from traditional security to Zero Trust Security. The role requires deep experience in cybersecurity architecture, network security, and zero trust security in cyber.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise & cloud environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in zero-trust and micro-segmentation solutions including Zscaler, Guardicore and Illumio.
* Define logical patterns & develop use cases for zero trust capabilities across Network, Identity & Access Management, Device, Application and other security domains
* Work in multiple domains of security technologies viz Network segmentation, Application gateways, security automation, Firewalls, VPN, SDN, SD-WAN, IAM solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Good exposure in requirement understanding, security frameworks, technical documentation, designing HLDs and LLDs.
* Well-versed in encrypting all end-to-end communication regardless of the location, authorizing access to resources on a per-session basis, enforcing the temporary and dynamic nature of authentication and authorization.
* Monitoring all assets to be in the most secure state possible and maintaining visibility into the security of the entire network and business's resources.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of zero trust market needs/challenges and assist in the planning, design and development of go-to-market solutions.
* Understand SaaS based technologies and identity-based micro-segmentation for cloud workloads and their implications for the enterprise.
* Document or enhance documentation on zero-trust architecture requirements.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s Zero Trust, Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience across Network & Infrastructure security domain, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Expertise in Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (NIST 800-207, NIST 800-53, ZT DoD, CISA ZTMM).
* Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of zero trust architecture and solutioning of zero trust security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for zero trust security including governance and operating models.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, plant leadership, OT operations teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Director, Analytical Technology
description:
Job Title: Associate Director, Analytical Technology
  
  
GCL : E
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to harness pioneering analytics and AI to speed medicines to patients while strengthening product quality and reliability? This role puts you at the center of shaping future analytical capabilities across biologics and ADCs—simplifying operations, elevating scientific decision-making, and enabling confident, faster technology transfers. You will act as a catalyst for innovation, turning emerging technologies and AI-enabled tools into practical solutions that improve readiness for manufacturing and strengthen control strategies across the product lifecycle.
  
  
You will lead the assessment and adoption of new analytical methods, Process Analytical Technology (PAT), and AI-enabled solutions that underpin Operations 2030 ambitions. Could you connect real-world manufacturing challenges with imaginative, compliant solutions that deliver measurable value—for example, enabling Real-Time Release Testing where justified or deploying AI tools that streamline analytical knowledge management?
  
  

* Accountabilities:

Analytical Innovation and Emerging Technologies: Lead evaluation and implementation of next-generation analytical technologies, rapid methods, and novel potency approaches to streamline control strategies while safeguarding product quality and patient safety.
  
  
Lifecycle and Technology Transfer Enablement: Assess applicability of emerging methodologies for technology transfer, commercialization, lifecycle management, comparability assessments, and post-approval changes to reduce timelines and variability.
  
  
Process Analytical Technology (PAT): Identify and implement at-line, online, inline, and rapid analytical technologies to improve process understanding and control; develop enhanced control strategies and evaluate opportunities for Real-Time Release Testing.
  
  
AI-Enabled Solutions: Build and deploy AI-assisted tools for knowledge retrieval, technical authoring, risk assessment, and decision support; establish scalable capabilities in partnership with Digital teams to drive consistency and productivity.
  
  
Operations 2030 Transformation: Lead simplification and standardization initiatives that reduce complexity and accelerate technology transfer; define metrics that demonstrate value delivered by innovation, PAT, and AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
Product Stewardship and Lifecycle Support: Provide technical leadership for analytical readiness assessments, risk assessments, comparability strategies, control strategy optimization, and long-term capability planning across the portfolio.
  
  
Change Leadership and Collaboration: Benchmark industry practices and regulatory trends, develop business cases for innovation, and drive adoption through cross-functional partnerships spanning Product Stewardship, Manufacturing Sciences, Technical Transfer, Operations, and Development.
  
  

* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Advanced degree (PhD, MS, or equivalent) in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific subject area.
* Significant experience supporting biologics, proteins, vaccines, or ADC products.
* Deep understanding of analytical lifecycle management, technology transfer, validation, control strategies, and commercial manufacturing support.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive organizational change.
* Experience supporting commercialization and lifecycle management activities.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Experience with Process Analytical Technology (PAT).
* Experience evaluating and implementing innovative analytical technologies.
* Understanding of Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT) and advanced control strategies.
* Experience utilizing AI-enabled solutions in scientific or technical environments.
* Knowledge of emerging analytical and biopharmaceutical industry trends.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  

* Why AstraZeneca:

Here, your expertise has tangible impact—translating a complex, science-led pipeline into reliable supply for larger patient populations. You will collaborate with diverse experts, leverage advanced digital and automation capabilities, and contribute to ambitious goals such as decarbonizing operations and evolving toward Smart Factory practices. We value curiosity and ownership alongside kindness, giving you the space to lead, learn, and experiment while building a long-term global career with exposure to multifaceted challenges and real opportunities to shape how medicines are made.

description:
**Company Description**
Orange Retail Finance India Private Limited is a non-banking finance company, incorporated in 2000 and registered with the Reserve Bank of India. The company focuses on serving salaried, self-employed, and informal segment customers from middle and lower-middle income groups in semi-urban and rural markets. With a mission to reach unbanked regions, Orange Retail Finance aims to provide accessible, transparent, and tailored financial products that improve the lives of households at the base of the pyramid. The organization is particularly committed to financing essential needs such as two-wheeler transport, addressing infrastructure gaps and supporting mobility in underserved areas. Its vision is to become the preferred neighborhood financier for every household in semi-urban and rural India through customer-centric, hassle-free lending solutions.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Chennai Area for business leaders in Gold Loan and SME/wholesale lending. The role involves leading and scaling the Gold Loan and SME lending portfolios, including designing products, setting policies, and driving growth strategies aligned with the company’s mission and risk appetite. Daily responsibilities include overseeing branch and field operations, guiding credit underwriting, monitoring portfolio quality, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal standards. The business leader will collaborate with senior management to define business plans, manage budgets, and achieve profitability and asset-quality targets. Additional tasks include developing partnerships in target markets, mentoring teams, implementing process improvements, and using data-driven insights to strengthen customer engagement and operational efficiency.

* Excellent leadership, people management, and mentoring skills, with the ability to build and motivate high-performing teams.

* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities for working with senior leadership, partners, and customers.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, economics, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification (MBA or equivalent) is an advantage.
* Prior experience in retail lending for underserved segments in semi-urban or rural markets is highly preferred.
* Commitment to ethical, transparent practices and customer-centric financial solutions

title: Associate Director  - RPO (Manufacturing/ Auto)
description:
Associate Director – Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) - Manufacturing /Auto

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Function:**
Recruitment Delivery / RPO

**Experience:**
12–18 years

**Education:**
MBA / B.Tech preferred

We are looking for a dynamic and business-oriented Associate Director – RPO to lead large-scale recruitment delivery across the Chennai region.

The role will be responsible for managing recruitment operations for multiple strategic customers, delivering
**2,000+ hires annually**
, and leading a large recruitment organization comprising 30–40 team members, including recruitment managers and delivery leaders.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in manufacturing and automotive recruitment, strong operational and financial acumen, exceptional client relationship management capabilities, and a proven track record of delivering recruitment excellence at scale.

This is a strategic leadership role that requires the ability to balance customer expectations, recruitment delivery, operational efficiency, profitability, and people leadership.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Regional Recruitment Delivery & Operations**

* Lead end-to-end RPO delivery across multiple customers in the Chennai region.
* Own the recruitment delivery portfolio with an annual hiring volume of 2,000+ positions.
* Ensure consistent delivery against client SLAs, hiring targets, quality benchmarks, and agreed timelines.
* Develop scalable recruitment delivery models aligned with customer requirements and business growth.
* Manage recruitment across manufacturing, automotive, engineering, plant operations, and other relevant functions.
* Drive continuous improvement in recruitment processes, productivity, and operational efficiency.

**2. Client & CXO Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including CHROs, business heads, plant heads, talent acquisition leaders, and other CXO-level stakeholders.
* Act as the primary escalation point for strategic customers and complex recruitment delivery challenges.
* Understand customer business priorities, workforce requirements, and talent acquisition strategies.
* Drive customer satisfaction, retention, and account growth through superior delivery and proactive engagement.
* Conduct periodic business reviews and present recruitment performance, insights, and improvement plans to senior stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for expanding the RPO scope and strengthening strategic partnerships.

**3. Team Leadership & Organizational Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a recruitment organization of 30–40 team members, including recruitment managers, team leaders, and recruiters.
* Establish a strong performance-driven culture focused on accountability, ownership, collaboration, and customer-centricity.
* Manage recruitment managers through structured performance reviews, delivery governance, and operational reviews.
* Build leadership capability within the team and develop a strong second line of leadership.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, productivity, and capability development.
* Ensure effective workforce planning and deployment across customers and recruitment projects.

**4. Recruitment Metrics, Analytics & Process Excellence**

* Establish and monitor robust recruitment dashboards and performance metrics.
* Drive data-led decision-making across the recruitment delivery organization.
* Monitor and improve key recruitment metrics, including:
* Time to Fill / Time to Hire
* SLA adherence and fulfillment rate
* Recruitment conversion ratios
* Source effectiveness and sourcing productivity
* Recruiter productivity and hiring manager satisfaction
* Offer-to-Joining ratio and candidate dropouts
* Cost per Hire
* Aging of open positions and requisition pipeline
* Quality of Hire and client satisfaction
* Identify recruitment bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Drive technology adoption, automation, and process optimization to improve delivery efficiency.

**5. Business Financials & P&L Management**

* Demonstrate strong understanding of RPO business financials and commercial models.
* Manage account-level and regional delivery economics, including revenue, cost, margins, and profitability.
* Monitor recruitment delivery costs, resource utilization, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Drive revenue realization, profitability, and EBITDA improvement through effective delivery management.
* Partner with finance and business leadership on budgeting, forecasting, revenue planning, and financial reviews.
* Ensure recruitment delivery commitments are aligned with contractual obligations and commercial viability.

**6. Manufacturing & Automotive Talent Expertise**

* Bring strong domain knowledge and hands-on experience in manufacturing and automotive recruitment.
* Understand talent requirements across automotive OEMs, auto component manufacturers, engineering, manufacturing plants, and industrial organizations.
* Demonstrate familiarity with hiring across plant operations, production, quality, maintenance, supply chain, engineering, and leadership roles.
* Understand the unique recruitment challenges of manufacturing organizations, including niche talent availability, location-specific hiring, and large-scale workforce requirements.
* Leverage industry networks and talent intelligence to improve recruitment outcomes.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 12–18 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or RPO delivery, preferably in a leadership role.
* Proven experience in managing large-scale RPO or recruitment delivery operations.
* Experience managing an annual recruitment volume of 2,000+ hires or a comparable high-volume recruitment portfolio.
* Strong experience in manufacturing and automotive recruitment is essential.
* Prior experience managing multiple customers and large recruitment delivery portfolios.
* Demonstrated experience leading recruitment managers and teams of 30–40 members.
* Strong understanding of recruitment metrics, analytics, productivity, and delivery governance.
* Good understanding of business financials, revenue models, cost management, and profitability.
* Exceptional CXO-level stakeholder management and client relationship skills.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and problem-solving abilities.
* MBA or B.Tech qualification preferred.
* Knowledge of Tamil will be an added advantage, particularly for regional stakeholder engagement and manufacturing talent ecosystems in Chennai.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and business orientation
* Customer-centricity and relationship management
* Data-driven decision-making
* Strong execution and operational discipline
* Financial and commercial acumen
* People leadership and talent development
* Change management and continuous improvement
* Ownership, accountability, and results orientation

title: Head of Product
description:
About Wualt

Wualt is building a connected safety wearable for women: a smart ring and mobile app that let someone signal for help discreetly and keep the people they trust informed. Designed and built in India, the product brings together hardware, firmware, software and applied ML. Pilots are live, and we are working towards a national launch in 2027.

We are hiring a Head of Product to lead the product end to end and turn what we learn from pilots into a reliable experience people can trust.

The role

This is our most senior product role, reporting to the founders. You will own the product vision, priorities and roadmap across the ring, dock, firmware, app, backend and ML, bringing the work of engineering, data, design and quality together around a shared plan.

You will stay close to users and the technical details, give teams clear ownership, and resolve difficult trade-offs and blockers. You will lead and grow the product function, working closely with the founders and functional leads to align delivery plans, resources and launch decisions.

Brand and growth own marketing, positioning and campaigns. You will partner with them on launch readiness, ensuring the product experience and the promises we make about it stay aligned.

What you will own

Product strategy and priorities. Set a clear direction and an achievable roadmap from pilots through launch and beyond. Make explicit choices about what to build, what to defer and why.

User learning and pilots. Lead the pilot programme, understand how women use the product in practice, and turn feedback and evidence into product decisions. Test the full experience, from setup and everyday use to signalling for help.

Delivery across teams. Coordinate hardware, firmware, app, backend and ML milestones. Surface dependencies early, agree owners and acceptance criteria, and help teams resolve blockers.

Reliability and launch readiness. Define readiness criteria with engineering and quality. Own the integrated delivery plan, making risks and trade-offs between timing, scope and quality clear before launch decisions.

Safety, privacy and trust. Keep claims grounded in what the product can reliably detect and notify. Work with the relevant specialists on privacy, data protection and applicable requirements, and make limitations clear in the experience.

Product measures and improvement. Define and track measures such as alert reliability, notification latency, activation and retention, alongside user feedback. Use them to guide improvements through launch and beyond.

People and leadership. Build the product function, develop people, and establish a clear way to make decisions and review progress. Create accountability while giving teams the ownership to deliver.

What you will bring

Experience leading products from development to launch and improving them in production, with clear examples of your decisions and their outcomes.

The ability to set product direction and lead delivery across disciplines, balancing user needs, technical constraints and business priorities.

Enough technical depth to discuss hardware, firmware, mobile software, backend systems and applied ML with specialists, ask good questions and make informed trade-offs.

Experience leading teams through ambiguity, setting clear priorities and resolving dependencies without becoming the bottleneck.

Sound judgement about reliability, privacy and user trust, and a willingness to challenge a date or a claim when the evidence does not support it.

A collaborative approach to working with founders, engineering, design and brand, and the ability to explain decisions clearly.

Experience bringing a physical or connected product to market is strongly preferred, particularly a wearable, consumer-electronics product or hardware-plus-app system. Familiarity with hardware timelines, firmware releases, certification and manufacturing constraints will be valuable.

Additional experience we value

Wearables, safety, health or products combining hardware and services. Consumer products you helped launch and scale, including direct-to-consumer businesses. Working with applied-ML teams on a shipped product. Building a product function in an early-stage company.

Your first six to twelve months

Establish a shared assessment of the product, pilot findings and launch risks, with clear priorities and owners. Build and lead an integrated roadmap towards the 2027 national launch, with agreed readiness criteria and visible dependencies. Translate pilot learning into improvements across the ring, app and alert experience, and validate those improvements with users. Put product measures and regular decision reviews in place so teams can see progress and address risks early. Align product readiness with brand and growth so launch communications accurately reflect the experience we can deliver.

What we offer

Company-wide product ownership, direct access to the founders, and a team already working across hardware, software and ML. The role offers a competitive salary and meaningful equity, with the opportunity to grow into Chief Product Officer as the company and the scope of the role expand. This is a full-time, on-site role in Chennai, working closely with the team building the product.

How to apply

Email your resume or LinkedIn profile to sunil@armortrixtech.com, with a short note about a product you helped bring to market, what you personally owned and why Wualt interests you.

description:
Job Title: Production Manager – Sheet Metal Stamping & Automated Press Lines
  
Location: Chennai, India (Kakkalur – Tiruvallur)

Job Purpose:
  
We are seeking an experienced Production Manager to spearhead our sheet metal stamping division. • Tooling & SMED Implementation: Work tightly with the Tool Room team to coordinate tool trials, minimize die-changeover times (Single-Minute Exchange of Die), and optimize die life cycles.
  
• Quality & Audits: Maintain strict compliance and lead root-cause analysis (RCA) to eliminate stamping defects
  
• Shop-floor Leadership: Direct workforce of supervisors and operators, enforcing lean principles (5S, Kaizen, TPM) and maintaining an accident-free safety environment.

• B.E. / B.Tech Mechanical or Production.

Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. **Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

Required:
  
  

* 9-15 years of experience in cybersecurity, including 5+ years in vulnerability management and 2+ years in team leadership or program management
* Experience managing enterprise vulnerability management programs across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
* Experience designing and governing agentic artificial intelligence systems for security use cases, including multi-agent orchestration and tool-use application programming interfaces
* Experience with vulnerability management platforms such as RiskSense, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, Armis VIPR or Centrix, Tenable, Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Prisma Cloud, and cloud-native scanning tools
* Experience with vulnerability risk frameworks including Common Vulnerability Scoring System version 3 or version 4, Exploit Prediction Scoring System, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, threat-informed prioritization, and business-risk contextualization

* Experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning applied to cybersecurity, including vulnerability prediction models or artificial intelligence-assisted threat intelligence correlation
* CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Tenable Certified Security Professional, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Specialty, or equivalent certification
* Experience with attack surface management platforms and integrating external exposure data into vulnerability management prioritization workflows
* Published thought leadership, conference presentations, or contributions to vulnerability management or artificial intelligence in security communities
* Master of Business Administration or postgraduate degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or a related discipline

#Cyber\_Cyber Operate

title: Sr. Team Lead - Reservoir Engineering
description:
**What’s The Role**
The Sr Team Lead – Reservoir Engineering is a leadership role in the Reservoir Engineering Function of TAS (Technical Asset Support) responsible for building, coaching and sustaining a high performing team that can support various assets for RE activities, especially around Shell Reserves and Resource Reporting applications and workflows, with Resource One (Rs1) being the Group Ledger for reporting hydrocarbon resource volumes and the single integrated system for recording, managing & reporting Shell Petroleum Resources, forecast and HCM data capturing OP (Operating Plan) and ARPR (Annual Review of Petroleum Resources).
  
  
This role includes the responsibility of coordinating the Rs1 Workflow Consultancy (WfC) activities to support the Shell assets across the globe. As a coordinator, there will be opportunities to cooperate with and gain insight into a wide range of corporate functions and groups such as Resource Assurance and Reporting (RAR), Hydrocarbon Performance (HCP), Finance, Planning and Economics. It also gives opportunities to engage with Resource Volume Managers (RVM), Country Resource Focal Points (CRFP), as well as Reservoir Engineers across Shell.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing (Duties And Responsibilities)**
The responsibilities of this role include:
  
  

* Working closely with Assets / Reservoir Engineers to understand the current challenges in using the Rs1 application and providing improvement suggestions.
* Support the E2E workflow in assessing and reporting volumetrics. Participate and support OP/ARPR cycles with necessary data and insights.
* Ability to perform quality checks and connect with relevant stakeholders for verification / rectification.
* You will work alongside the Rs1 Product Owner and Rs1 Scrum team as part of the global natural Rs1 team and in close collaboration with the business, RAR, HCP, Finance, RE/PG Discipline and Economics Function. This team supports the assets and the interfaces between Rs1 & other applications and supports overall product lifecycle management and ensures continued alignment with the overall product vision, creating more user value and, in turn, driving greater commercial value for Shell.

Rs1 Workflow Consultancy (WfC) Coordinator: Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead WfC workload planning, prioritization, coordination, and delivery execution across the TAS team.
* Manage asset and interface ownership, ensuring complex asset scopes are assigned appropriately.
* Govern key Rs1 WfC processes, including user support, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, guidance packs, continuous improvement, KPI management, SharePoint administration, workflow governance.
* Facilitate WfC team engagement through regular huddles and operational forums.
* Represent the WfC community with the Rs1 Product Team, supporting UAT decisions, asset onboarding, interface governance, and enhancement requests.
* Drive After-Action-Reviews for OP and ARPR cycles, consolidating feedback and identifying improvement opportunities.
* Contribute to governance forums and stakeholder reviews to enhance Rs1 performance and delivery outcomes.
* Serve as the focal point for operational excellence, ensuring compliance with agreed workflows, governance standards, and delivery expectations.

TAS Team Leadership Accountabilities:
  
  

* Deliver HSSE and code of conduct performance of the team & team tasks.
* Deliver performance requirements (quality, timeliness, productivity etc.) for scopes migrated to team.
* Close value and efficiency Gap to Potential (GtP) for the migrated activities.
* Maintain organizational capability to deliver team scope and maintain operational continuity. Interface Management etc.).
* HR Manage team.

TAS Team Leadership Responsibilities:
  
  

* Hire and onboard staff; develop and assure competency and autonomy for task delivery.
* Integrate team members into Asset/Project natural teams and cadences.
* Maintain plans for migrated tasks aligned with Asset/Project plans.
* Conduct regular progress reviews and ensure delivery as planned
* Define and implement recovery plans when plans/ targets are missed.
* Implement structured programs to assure team deliverables.
* Develop and execute operational continuity plans for team scope.
* Approve competency assessments and learning/development plans.
* Identify and track improvement opportunities in migrated tasks.
* Support terms of reference preparation, conduct operational cadence, communication, and reporting per TAS migration framework.

You will work closely with the Sr. Process Specialist-Reservoir Engineering to:
  
  

* Develop plans for TAS RE resourcing, timeline, budget, risk and change management
* Assess the demand and actively work on talent attraction / recruitment and staff retention

**What You Bring**

* Energetic and seasoned Reservoir Engineer with 8+ years of experience in the oil and gas industry. University degree in Petroleum Engineering or a relevant discipline.
* Technically strong in Reservoir Engineering with good all-round knowledge of other Petroleum Engineering disciplines.
* Solid understanding of key business processes including Reserves & Resources Reporting, Business Planning, Hydrocarbon Maturation Strategy, Estimation, and Production Forecasting.
* Experience in developing business cases and demonstrating the value of new functionality is an advantage.
* Affinity for IT, digitalisation, and automation. Business Analysis experience in an Agile software development environment is an advantage.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across global virtual teams, influence stakeholders, and build trusted relationships across functions and cultures.
* Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while ensuring objectives are met.
* Strong aptitude for Continuous Improvement and a learner mindset.
* Demonstrated leadership capability, including experience working in multidisciplinary teams, coaching and mentoring colleagues, and thinking beyond disciplinary boundaries.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to rapidly identify and focus on key issues.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from HireVue - please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.**

title: Head of Operations
description:
Head of Operations – Indian Snack House (ISH)

**Location:**
Chennai

**Department:**
Supply Chain & Operations

**Role:**
Head of Operations

About Indian Snack House

Indian Snack House is a fast-growing Indian sweets and snacks brand on a mission to bring authentic regional flavours to consumers across India. With a growing presence across D2C, Swiggy, Zomato, and Quick Commerce platforms, we are building a scalable, technology-driven supply chain to support our next phase of growth.

We are looking for a
**high-ownership, execution-driven Head of Operations**
who can lead our end-to-end supply chain operations, build strong teams, establish robust processes, and drive operational efficiency at scale.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Inventory Control & Tracking**

* Own end-to-end inventory visibility across warehouses, channels, and locations.
* Implement strong inventory tracking, reconciliation, FIFO/FEFO, and stock accuracy processes.
* Minimize inventory losses, expiry, stockouts, and working capital blockage.
* Build data-driven inventory planning and replenishment systems.

**2. First-Mile Operations & Cost Optimization**

* Manage vendor-to-warehouse logistics, pickup planning, and inbound movement.
* Optimize first-mile logistics costs through route planning, vendor consolidation, and transporter negotiations.
* Ensure timely inward movement, GRN completion, and inventory availability.

**3. Warehouse Management**

* Lead warehouse operations, including inbound, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, and stock audits.
* Drive warehouse productivity, manpower efficiency, space utilization, and cost per order.
* Establish scalable SOPs, operational dashboards, and accountability systems.
* Ensure warehouse hygiene, product handling standards, and process compliance.

**4. D2C & Quick Commerce Fulfilment**

* Own end-to-end order fulfilment across D2C, Quick Commerce, and Swiggy/Zomato channels.
* Ensure high order fulfilment rates, dispatch accuracy, and adherence to platform SLAs.
* Drive availability, PO fulfilment, and timely replenishment across Quick Commerce dark stores and distribution centres.
* Build systems to manage seasonal demand spikes and high-volume festive operations.

**5. Mid-Mile & Delivery Operations**

* Manage warehouse-to-distribution-centre, store, and fulfilment-location movements.
* Optimize transportation costs, delivery timelines, vehicle utilization, and route efficiency.
* Establish strong logistics partner relationships, tracking mechanisms, and escalation processes.
* Reduce delivery failures, delays, damages, and operational leakages.

**6. Team Leadership & Process Excellence**

* Lead, mentor, and develop teams across inventory, warehousing, logistics, and fulfilment.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and measurable performance.
* Implement technology, automation, and data-driven decision-making to improve efficiency.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and proactively build scalable solutions.

Ideal Candidate

* 7–12+ years of experience in supply chain, warehouse, logistics, or operations management, preferably in FMCG, D2C, Quick Commerce, or consumer brands.
* Proven experience managing multi-location operations and high-volume order fulfilment.
* Strong understanding of inventory management, warehouse operations, logistics cost structures, and distribution networks.
* Excellent analytical capabilities with proficiency in Excel, ERP/WMS systems, and operational dashboards.
* Ability to build processes, manage large teams, and solve complex operational challenges.
* **Strong bias for action, attention to detail, cost consciousness, and end-to-end ownership.**
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with ambitious growth targets.

What We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who simply manages daily operations.
**We want a leader who can build an operations engine that scales 5–10X without proportionately increasing costs or complexity.**

* Someone who can combine strong on-ground execution, analytical thinking, team leadership, and process discipline to make operations a competitive advantage for Indian Snack House.

title: RC FS - BTI INS - Retirement Domain SME-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: Retirement Manager Position**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Working as part of the Consulting team, you will take part in engagements related to a wide range of topics. Some examples of domains in which you will support our clients include the following:
  
  

* Defined Benefits Operations (E.g. - Benefits calculations, Benefits Review), Benefits Calculation for Retirement, Termination, Disability, Death, Divorce.
* ERISA Compliance - US Retirement Plan Testing (ADP & ACP Testing, Corrective Distribution) & Reporting experience.
* Deep understanding of in-plan guaranteed income products such as annuities embedded within defined contribution plans (e.g., target date funds with income guarantees).
* Experience in designing or evaluating protected retirement solutions through insurance-wrapped investment vehicles.
* Exposure to recordkeeping platform enhancements to support in-plan income features, including income projection tools, guarantee tracking, and participant-level income illustrations.
* Money in and Loans -Must have experience in handling money in & Loan related activities, i.e. Check processing, contribution, loan initiation, Loan repayments, re-amortization etc.
* Disbursements: Distributions/Disbursements such as Hardship withdrawals, QDRO, RMD, In-service distributions, loans or experience in processing 401K contribution, loan repayments etc.
* Understanding of business rules of Payout, Qualified/Non-Qualified Plans, Roth Conversion, Roth IRA, Fiduciaries, Defined contribution, Defined Benefits/Pension
* Exposure to Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation (PBGC) study and Public Pensions
* Understanding of plan administration, group and account setup, eligibility
* Understanding of Vesting rules and Investment management
* Knowledge of middle office and back-office processing (retirement account origination, servicing, funds payout, reconciliation of funds, etc.)
* Experience supporting or leading PMO functions for large-scale retirement transformation programs, including project planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and stakeholder reporting

Proven ability to coordinate across business, technology, and vendor teams, ensuring alignment with project timelines, scope, and quality standards in retirement platform implementations or upgrades
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Consulting Skills –**

* Experience in creating business process map for future state architecture, creating WBS for overall conversion strategy, requirement refinement process in multi-vendor engagement.
* Worked on multiple Business transformation and modernization programs.
* Conducted multiple Due-Diligence and Assessment projects as part of Transformation roadmaps to evaluate current state maturity, gaps in functionalities and COTs solution features.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Managing service delivery within the agreed service level across multiple blended processes
* Implement operational governance framework quality review mechanism, communication strategy.

**Technology Skills –**

* Proficient in technology solution architecture, with a focus on designing innovative and effective solutions.
* Experienced in data migration projects, ensuring seamless transfer of data between systems while maintaining data integrity and security.
* Skilled in data analytics, utilizing various tools and techniques to extract insights and drive informed decision-making.
* Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices, ensuring data quality and compliance.
* Collaborative team player, able to work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to define requirements and implement effective solutions.

Industry certifications (ASPPA/LOMA/ RPF) will be added advantage.
  
  
Experience on these solutions is preferrable.
  
  
ALIS
  
  
OMNI
  
  
Relius
  
  
NeoSpin
  
  
Vitech
  
  
TRAC
  
  
We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Vice President, WRB GRU
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business**

* (WRB GRU) Wealth Solutions and Retail Banking Global Reconciliation function across markets, products and account types
* COE (Centre of excellence) for WRB Reconciliations that enables optimal end to end delivery of financial controls leveraging on global TLM system, core TP system with specialist accounting talent
* UK SOX / ACGR implementation for WRB – ie., Controls review, remediation and governance, in collaboration with Group Financial Controls team and External Consultants
* Aspire Project for WRB – Ie., Transitioning General Ledger from PSGL to SAP S4 HANA for WRB systems

**Strategy**

* Drive the reconciliation strategy for the (WRB) Wealth Solutions and Retail Banking Global Reconciliation function across markets, products and account types
* Deliver the overall strategy for the global processes, controls and technology solutions within the function
* Drive the alignment of GRU services with the relevant operational and technology change deliverables including leveraging innovative solutions to increase quality of services
* As a control stakeholder to the underlying operations, act in a directing and influencing capacity with the stakeholders regarding the recon strategy to secure ongoing support for the business process and technology changes required to deliver high standard of reconciliation controls
* Continuously appraise internal and industry strategies and approaches to ensure best practices and innovative solutions are being utilized
* Support Product, Operations and other Value centres on a day-to-day basis in areas of process changes, improvements and new product launches
* Play an active role in developing the business requirements on system enhances and follows through till delivery of requirements.
* Lead re-engineering initiatives along with other value centres like Operations, Service and Distribution for identification of cost-saves, process improvement opportunities & customer service enhancement.

**Processes**

* Manage account reconciliation activities covering;
* Internal/ GL account (suspense and sundry) reconciliations,
* Trade/Stock and Position reconciliations,
* Credit Card, ATM, retail branch banking reconciliations
* Perform error free reconciliation as per procedures (DOI) / Reconciliation Policy using reports from various transaction processing and recon applications.
* Handle customer queries and correspondence (both internal and external) and maintain effective working relationships with all departments, country and internal stakeholders including technology teams.
* Ensure effective follow ups and escalations, both internal and external, in resolving outstanding reconciliation items, process and system issues, as per agreed SLA / reconciliation matrix, DOIs. Ability to differentiate escalations to various senior levels depending on the nature and impact of an issue/open reconciliation break with clear articulation of the requirement and attention from them is a must.
* Actively look for opportunities to standardize processes / automate / eliminate nonvalue added activities and implement them for process improvements.
* Liaise extensively with a wide set of senior stakeholders, get required support to resolve long outstanding reconciliation open items and get buy-in to implement process / system changes
* Continuously improve team productivity to the standards prescribed
* Consistent review on process cycle times and ensure effective and efficient service delivery.
* Work to reduce System Downtime in collaboration with technology teams
* Create sufficient back-ups for each process to eliminate key staff risk at any point of time.
* Lead inward migration of newer activities and ensure relevant documentations are completed within the timelines
* Manage budgeting for the unit and have detailed knowledge of the unit financials - effectively control spends and deliver on cost targets
* Ensure high engagement levels in the teams with minimal attrition.
* Provide training to teams and ensure they have thorough understanding of the underlying product, recon process and its impact before handling a new process
* Implement robust training and development plan for each staff keeping succession planning for various roles into consideration.
* Understand the end-to-end impact of any new change/enhancement initiative, train teams and ensure the change is incorporated in a seamless way with no service impact
* Closely hand hold teams and train them to perform thorough User Acceptance Tests (UAT) in consultation with tech teams and co-ordinate with them to ensure timely completion of testing and comprehensively highlight all issues
* Perform end-to-end analysis of reconciliation processes and controls and propose solutions for addressing gaps, from a reconciliation perspective.
* Perform root-cause analysis of reconciliation errors and issues with clearly articulated mitigation plans.
* Follow up on risks with both internal teams and external stakeholders for timely closure without becoming overdue and promptly update actions to risk teams ahead of target timelines
* Liaise extensively with the product and technology teams to understand the product nuances and associated regulations to recommend required reconciliation controls and processes

**People and Talent**

* SDAF approvals and Amendments for TLM Account Opening and Closure basis Country Ops approvals and confirmation.
* Ability to lead the team effectively through remote working
* Guide the team on Recon and Recon COE

**Governance**

* WRB GRU risk reporting related governance at country / regional and Group RC levels
* Periodic review of hubbed and non-hubbed WRB reconciliations for adherence to GPI (including exception management ie., dispensations from adherence to GPI)
* Continuous recon and accounting process review to assure that the controls are fit for purpose and act as mitigation against internal frauds

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* GPO WRB SnT / COO, Client Servicing & Transacting, WRB
* COO, Wealth Soln, Affluent Bnkg & Enablement
* Global Head, WM Investment Operations
* Global Head – R2R GSF Finance
* Global Head – WRB Internal Fraud
* Financial Transaction processing team leads (WRB – COB, SnT, Branches and business in particular)
* Finance operation leads
* Technology data Lead (Aspire)
* Workstream team members across TP systems (eBBS, RLS, CCMS, Card400, Marcis and other CPBB TP systems)
* Workstream team members across Programme (Data, Tools, Core Finance, Local Regulatory, Treasury) – (Aspire and SOX)
* Product Controllers and Business CFO’s
* Treasury leads
* Information Technology (Recon tool ‘TLM – Transaction Lifecycle Management‘ change management as WRB business owner and continuous improvement)

**Skills And Experience**

* Financial Accounting
* Financial Reconciliations
* Sarbanes and Oxley Act (UK SOX)

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant or Equivalent

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Vice President, India Trade Centralized Operations, Fulfilment and Servicing Lead, Global Credit Operations
description:
**Job Description:**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Job Description:**
Global Credit Operations plays a critical role in delivering Trade Finance solutions across Asia Pacific, supporting clients through a network of operations teams, fulfilment centers, and strategic service partners. As business volumes, regulatory expectations, and client demands continue to evolve, Operations is at the forefront of driving service excellence, risk management, and scalable growth.
  
  
The successful candidate will be accountable for the end-to-end delivery of trade operations, servicing and fulfilment for India, balancing exceptional client service, operational excellence, regulatory compliance and business growth support.
  
  
Additional exposure includes representing India in regional and global operational excellence forums, partnering with Corporate Banking and Treasury Services leaders, and shaping the Operational and client focus strategy to support business growth and service excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee end-to-end centralized Trade Finance operations, Fulfilment, and Service delivery across India branches, ensuring a consistent and high-quality client experience.
* Enhance operational processes, fulfilment and servicing procedures, impart training, and facilitate standardization programs to improve quality, efficiency, and consistency.
* Align with regional strategy, execute operating models and capacity planning to support business growth, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and scalable delivery
* Partner with senior leaders across operations, business, and risk to address client needs, enable new business initiatives, and advance strategic priorities
* Maintain a robust risk, control, and governance framework; act as the senior escalation point for significant operational, regulatory, client, and control matters; and ensure timely, sustainable remediation
* Drive organizational effectiveness through talent development, succession planning, workforce strategy, employee engagement, and leadership development

**Managerial Responsibilities:**
This position may also have responsibilities for managing associates. At Bank of America, all managers at this level demonstrate the following responsibilities, in addition to those specific to the role, listed above.
  
  

* Opportunity & Inclusion Champion: Models an inclusive environment for employees and clients, aligned to company Great Place to Work goals.
* Manager of Process & Data: Demonstrates deep process knowledge, operational excellence and innovation through a focus on simplicity, data based decision making and continuous improvement.
* Enterprise Advocate & Communicator: Communicates enterprise decisions, purpose, and results, and connects to team strategy, priorities and contributions.
* Risk Manager: Ensures proper risk discipline, controls and culture are in place to identify, escalate and debate issues.
* People Manager & Coach: Provides inspection, coaching and feedback to motivate, differentiate and improve performance.
* Financial Steward: Actively manages expenses and budgets in alignment with objectives, making sound financial decisions.
* Enterprise Talent Leader: Assesses talent and builds bench strength for roles across the organization.
* Driver of Business Outcomes: Delivers results by effectively prioritizing, inspecting and appropriately delegating team work.

**Desired Skills:**

* This role requires a senior operations leader with deep Trade Finance expertise, strong risk discipline, and proven experience leading Pan India teams in a complex banking environment.

+ More than 20 years of banking operations experience, including substantial leadership experience in Trade Finance Operations
+ Experience in leading operations, Onboarding, Implementation, and Servicing of corporate clients and Financial Institutions
+ Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience
+ Demonstrated success in leading large, geographically dispersed teams across multiple branches
+ Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to partner across the front office, operations, technology, risk, and control functions to deliver seamless client service
+ Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences and present consolidated information clearly and concisely at all levels of management
+ Strong understanding of operational risk management, audit, regulatory compliance, and control frameworks
+ Proven ability to manage workforce planning, organizational capacity, reporting, and forecasting
+ Experience leading transformation initiatives that optimize processing, service models, client experience

title: Client Service Manager - Phoenix
description:

**Key Responsibilities**

He/she must ensure compliance with these policies and procedures on an ongoing basis. Any suspicious transaction must immediately be reported to the supervising officer.

* Facilitate a smooth working relationship of Front Office teams with support functions.
* Business Controls: To comply with all applicable money laundering prevention procedures and highlight suspicious activities/behaviour of clients and staff e.g., account irregularities and alert TL of the suspicious transactions on a timely basis.

* Provide concise and relevant information flow and execute all client transactional and administrative needs accurately and on a timely basis (information flow and client requests might include but not be limited to exchange rate requests, referral letters).

Assist TL/RMs in preparing Business Credit Application, financial review documentation and other customer correspondence as and when required. Support TL/RMs in attending to and follow-up on customer service issues with clients and internal departments, and in all cases report and escalate customer complaints to management in accordance with established procedures. Failure to report and escalate complaints will result in disciplinary action.
* Handle and ensure clients’ documents and reporting comply with internal process standards.
* Ensure full awareness of and adherence to the policy and procedures e.g. credit policy and operation procedures.

**People & Talent**

* Develop professional skills of oneself, including training, license registrations, and deepening of “knowledge spikes” on specific topics by the CSM Team Leaders.

**Risk Management**

* Responsibility for identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks that may be posed by activities conducted by the RMs. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the Local Client Services Team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles. Fair Outcomes for Clients, Effective Financial Markets, Financial Crime Compliance, The Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Relationship Managers and Team Leaders
* Client Onboarding Managers

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed here for good and the Group’s brand and values.
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.i

**Skills And Experience**

* Diligent & Punctual
* Knowledgeable about the role

description:
