We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Sanctions Review team performs sanctions screening in the FircoSoft system for payment entities, settlements, and trade transactions across Asia, EMEA, and the US at the enterprise level.
  
  
Payments created manually through GBS, FPS, or STP, along with trade transactions, are routed through FircoSoft and RLSU filtering channels for sanctions review.
  
  
**Job Description\***
The Sanctions Review team reviews all transactions in coordination with GES and completes assessments in the FircoSoft application. The team also investigates requests from the Global Economic Sanctions team for additional transaction information.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Review the Global Economic Sanctions hits on Fircosoft for Asia Branches (Except India), EMEA Branches (Except Greece) and US
* Investigate the transactions coming in to the queue for additional information required by GES (Global
* Economic Sanctions)
* Monitor the group mailbox
* Investigate the transactions which are rejected for any possible OFAC Sanctions reasons
* Be a subject matter expert and train the new joiners in the team
* Review the Global Economic Sanctions hits on Fircosoft for printed checks (DPS files)
* Escalate the close hits / potential hits to GES or Local Compliance
* Process the transactions from the OFAC queues within the currency cut offs
* Review and Monitor Sanctions Queues across profiles
* Review and Monitor all currency cut offs across branches
* Report any escalations immediately and ensure timely resolution
* Prepare/Review EOD reports across branches and ensure appropriate monitoring of the same
* Prepare monthly process dashboards as per schedule
* Report, monitor and escalate any cut off miss / OTD error and ensure timely resolution & control
* In case of any error on releasing the transaction, take all measures to inform GES proactively
* In case of any error on releasing the transaction, seek help from the branch / Operation teams to recall the funds such that the funds do not reach the beneficiary / beneficiary bank
* Identify and address knowledge gaps in the process across profiles
* Assist and adhere to any audit schedules applicable
* Comply with the CTQ (Critical to Quality)
* Must be fully conversant with Windows based IT systems, eg, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Access

**Requirements\***

* Education\* - Graduate (B.Com)
* Certifications If Any
* Experience Range\* 5-8 years of experience
* Mandatory skills\* Experience in Sanctions Review process, Strong Payments knowledge (Swift) and good communication skills.
* Desired skills\* Strong ability to conduct detailed research, with preferred exposure to the FircoSoft application

**Work Timings\***

* Staggered Night Shifts - 5:30 PM to 5:30 AM (Any 9 Hours shift on rotation basis).

**Job Location\* -**
Chennai

title: Product Implementation Manager
description:
**What’s The Role**
The Product Implementation Manager (PIM) within the Capability Hub acts as the operational backbone of the Global Product Management organization, serving as a central hub for portfolio governance, compliance, implementation, and strategic portfolio support. The role supports the execution of Global Product Management priorities across lubricant portfolios, including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, and Greases, depending on business requirements and job grade.
  
  
The position focuses on data-driven portfolio management, knowledge management, compliance coordination, analytics, and digital enablement to ensure consistency, scalability, and governance across regions while driving execution against defined KPIs and SLAs. By coordinating cross-functional, cross-regional, and system-related activities, Product Implementation Managers enable Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs to focus on portfolio strategy, innovation, customer engagement, and long-term business growth.
  
  
In addition, PIMs provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to regional FPIMs and RAPMs, ensuring effective integration between global strategy and regional execution. At more senior levels, the role also provides guidance and support to the wider PIM community, drives capability development, and contributes to portfolio optimization, digital transformation, and strategic planning initiatives across the Global Product Management organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Portfolio Management & Product Lifecycle Support**

* Manage the deployment, maintenance, and governance of regional and global product portfolios across business systems, including full GPC data ownership.
* Support and maintain Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes, ensuring portfolio data accuracy, integrity, and governance compliance.
* Provide implementation support for product launches, portfolio changes, and withdrawal of obsolete products.
* Support a range of lubricant portfolios including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, Greases, and other assigned portfolios based on business priorities.

**Data Governance, Analytics & Portfolio Optimization**

* Ensure accurate and consistent portfolio data management across multiple systems and regions.
* Develop, maintain, and analyse KPI and SLA dashboards to support portfolio performance monitoring and decision-making.
* Drive analytics and insights to support formulation cost optimization, portfolio rationalization, and business performance improvement.
* Provide structured analysis and recommendations to support regional and global portfolio planning activities.

**Strategic Portfolio Support**

* Support Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs in developing and executing 5+ year portfolio strategies and roadmap plans.
* Provide implementation, risk, feasibility, and execution perspectives to support strategic portfolio decisions.
* Contribute to portfolio optimization initiatives through data-driven insights and business recommendations.

**Compliance, Quality & Governance**

* Coordinate and maintain compliance documentation, including SDS, product registrations, certifications, approvals, waivers, and governance records.
* Manage and maintain digital PPAP records and quality-related portfolio documentation.
* Ensure adherence to internal governance, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain central repositories for formulations, approvals, compliance records, and portfolio documentation.

**PPAP, Licensing & Project Support**

* Support and/or coordinate PPAP activities for automotive-related products, including readiness assessments, documentation, quality assurance requirements, and implementation activities.
* Own or support product licensing activities, including documentation management, approvals, renewals, and implementation support.
* Provide support for Joint Venture (JV), portfolio implementation, and special project activities where applicable.
* Coordinate with manufacturing sites, quality teams, FPIMs, RAPMs, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and compliance.

**Digital Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as a key user, trainer, and subject matter resource for portfolio management and digital tools.
* Collaborate with digital and system development teams to identify and implement tool enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across portfolio management processes, systems, governance practices, and workflows.
* Support capability-building and digital adoption initiatives across regional and global teams.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Execution Support**

* Provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to FPIMs, RAPMs, and regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities involving Product Management, Technology, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, and Procurement teams.
* Support additive transitions, supplier escalations, and portfolio-related implementation activities in collaboration with GAAMs and other stakeholders.
* Organize governance forums, stakeholder reviews, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities to drive alignment and best-practice adoption.

**Leadership & Capability Building (Senior PIM Levels)**

* Act as a senior PIM for complex or high-value portfolios, providing guidance, coaching, and support to less experienced PIMs.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on portfolio transformation, governance excellence, and digital enablement.
* Support long-term capability development across the PIM community.
* Influence portfolio management, governance, and implementation decisions through thought leadership, analytics, and subject matter expertise.
* Champion best practices and drive consistency across regions, functions, and portfolio teams.

**What You Bring**

* A background in physical or chemical product testing, product development, or a formal qualification in technical sciences, engineering, chemistry, mathematics, or a related discipline would be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of lubricant product specifications, formulations, manufacturing processes, and product quality requirements.
* Familiarity with blending operations, supply chain processes, and product lifecycle management concepts.
* Understanding of analytical test methods, quality procedures, and Quality Assurance standards and processes.
* Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data handling, reporting, data governance, and performance analysis.
* Ability to handle, collate, manipulate, and interpret large volumes of data accurately and with strong attention to detail.
* Experience in developing insights and recommendations through data analysis to support operational and portfolio decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global, regional, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, technical teams, and business partners.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset with experience in process optimization, workflow improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly learn new concepts, analyze situations, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience with digital systems and tools, including Microsoft Office applications and data visualization/reporting platforms.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed global environment.
* High level of accuracy, ownership, and attention to detail when managing product, portfolio, and compliance-related data.
* English language proficiency at a minimum C1 level.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from HireVue - please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.**

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Title: Operations Manager (Chennai)**

**Location: Chennai (In-Office)**

**Compensation: 10 to 12 LPA**

**Additional Incentive Plan: Incentive Pay+ Benefits+ Equity**

**About Silq**

At Silq, we’re building the largest sustainable global shipping network with a 40% gross margin, leveraging people, data, and technology. Our technology simplifies shipping by allowing customers to create custom workflows and is enhanced by real-time factory information from our team. This combination minimizes exceptions, improves shipment consolidation, and helps customers save on shipping costs from day one. As Silq grows, we’re focused on building durable systems and teams that can scale without sacrificing execution or margin.

As a
**Operations Manager**
at Silq, your core priority will be to manage the establishment and administration of a defined set of professional/operational services, programs, and initiatives of key significance to the business.

Primary responsibilities are focused on one or more broadly defined core functional areas, such as freight processes, origin operations team building, establishing relationships with origin partners, negotiating rates & contracts and monitoring performance against operational goals & developing reports/audit processes to analyze effectiveness.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manages, oversees, and performs supervisory tasks to direct and control activities performed to effectively manage the end to end Ocean/Air Freight processes
* Work with our global teams and freight partners to ensure smooth hand-offs, standardization between regions and best practice alignment
* Build out origin handling processes for air and ocean shipments for our customers and build the team to execute them
* Serves as the escalation contact for our team and customer’s Ocean/Air Freight shipments; You're the SME! Educate our team and our customers on freight forwarding and more importantly - how Silq is bringing new value to an old industry!
* Responsible for cross-border air and ocean shipping and delivery of orders in the United States, including international freight arrangements, production of customs declaration documents, customs clearance coordination
* Pilot building Silq's in-house ocean consolidations program
* Communicate with overseas sales, operations and other functional departments to grasp the delivery situation as a whole, deal with various problems in the transportation process, deal with abnormal shipments, and update the shipping status in a timely manner
* Mastermind creative ways to deliver an exceptional client experience; ensure transparency and clear communication with clients enquiries on daily/weekly or needed basis.
* Establish, maintain, and deepen the cooperative relations with the shipping and forwarding companies
* Work with shipping partners to ensure timely booking and delivery of shipment
* Resolve complex client problems or disputes in a professional manner
* Keep records and documentation of client interactions for training purposes
* Work with Director of Operations to create monthly and quarterly departmental reports to determine whether KPIs are being met and where there is room for improvement
* Ability to manage the financial aspects of the department (purchasing, budget preparation and review, financial reporting and monitoring expenses).
* Responsible to train, develop and motivate employees to peak performance and growth in their knowledge and responsibilities

**Requirements:**

* 7+ years logistics operations management experience & freight forwarding. NVOCC experience is good to have.
* 2+ years of supervisory / leadership experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Ability to work autonomously in a fast pace, professional, team environment with minimal supervision
* Ability to prioritize tasks appropriately and in support of project schedules and other deadlines
* Strong analytical skills – use logical structuring to understand problems and to create sustainable solutions, don’t rely on others to tell you what to do.
* Super organized – never let anything slip through the cracks, time management is your forte.
* Able to identify, investigate and solve problems that arise in timely manner
* Effective verbal and written communication skills – communicate to be understood in a concise and clear manner, bring a point of view.
* Extreme attention to detail – you triple check all emails and deliverables and take pride in getting it right the first time.
* Proficient with MS office and/or Google Suite
* Adaptable and flexible – priorities change on a daily or hourly basis, you are able to pivot, adjust your schedule and assume responsibility to take the lead as needed

title: Duty Manager
description:

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Duty Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing the hotel’s daily operations, ensuring that all departments work together seamlessly to deliver outstanding guest service. A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

* Proven background in front office or hotel operations, ideally in a supervisory or managerial role.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Assistant Vice President - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Job Title:**
Assistant Vice President – Regulatory Transaction Reporting & Data Services
  
  
**Department:**
Asset Management – Investment Operations / Reporting
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
Asset Management Reporting and Data Services are responsible for the end-to-end integrity of the data lifecycle. This includes transforming validated investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data into accurate, timely, and compliant reports for clients, regulators, and internal stakeholders. The function ensures that regulatory transaction reporting (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC) is executed with precision while maintaining the robust data foundations required for institutional-grade reporting.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The Assistant Vice President (AVP) serves as a strategic leader and dual-function controller within the Regulatory Transaction Reporting (RTR) and Data Services ecosystem. The role is responsible for the governance, oversight, and continuous improvement of both the regulatory reporting framework and the underlying data management architecture.
  
  
The AVP is accountable for ensuring the "Golden Source" of data is maintained, managing the full data lineage from ingestion to regulatory submission, and driving the strategic roadmap for data quality and reporting automation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**

* Strategic Oversight: Lead the end-to-end delivery strategy for regulatory transaction reporting and the data services lifecycle, ensuring all global SLAs and multi-jurisdictional requirements are met.
* Data Governance & Integrity: Act as the primary authority for data quality; establish and enforce standards for data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency across all reporting streams.
* Regulatory Control Authority: Direct the oversight of both direct production (SFTR, MiFID II) and outsourced/delegated reporting (EMIR, ASIC), ensuring rigorous control over 3rd party Service Providers and Clearing Brokers.
* Critical Escalation & Incident Management: Serve as the senior point of contact for resolving complex regulatory discrepancies, systemic data breaks, and high-priority reporting failures.
* Quality Assurance Framework: Define and implement enhanced control standards for transaction pairing, matching, UTI management, and master data reconciliation.

**Contributing Responsibilities**

* Leadership & Talent Development: Provide strategic direction to Production Analysts and Data Processors; drive a culture of technical excellence, data literacy, and continuous professional development.
* Transformation & Data Engineering Oversight: Lead large-scale automation and digitalization projects; oversee the implementation of automated data validation rules and streamlined data ingestion workflows.
* Data Lineage & Traceability: Partner with IT and Data Engineering to ensure full end-to-end data lineage, enabling seamless audit trails from regulatory submission back to the original source system.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with senior leaders in Performance, Accounting, and Product teams to optimize upstream data flows and resolve systemic "root cause" issues.
* Audit & Regulatory Liaison: Lead the response to internal/external audits and regulatory inquiries, ensuring all data controls, governance documentation, and oversight evidence are robust.
* Change Management: Drive the implementation of new regulatory requirements (e.g., EMIR Refit) and system enhancements across the global reporting and data landscape.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**

* Advanced Regulatory Reporting Mastery: Deep expertise in the mechanics of EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, and ASIC, including submission lifecycles and exception handling.
* Data Management & Governance Expertise: Advanced understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), data sourcing, enrichment, and the management of investment data domains (Holdings, Pricing, Reference Data, Corporate Actions).
* Data Quality & Analytics: Ability to design data quality dashboards and use statistical methods to monitor data health and identify emerging trends/risks.
* Systems & Data Architecture: High-level understanding of the end-to-end data pipeline, including the connectivity between source systems, data warehouses, and regulatory interfaces (ARMs/APAs/TRs).
* Risk & Control Design: Advanced ability to design and implement complex control frameworks to mitigate operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic Leadership: Ability to lead diverse teams through complex regulatory shifts and inspire a culture of data-driven accountability.
* Influencing & Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and effectively challenge 3rd party service providers and brokers.
* Decisiveness under Pressure: Ability to make high-stakes, time-sensitive decisions regarding regulatory deadlines and data integrity.
* Problem-Solving & Innovation: A proactive approach to identifying systemic gaps in data/reporting logic and implementing long-term technological solutions.
* High Accountability: Absolute ownership of the function’s regulatory standing, data accuracy, and global delivery quality.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Education: Post Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (MBA/CFA preferred).
* Experience: Extensive experience (5+ years) in Regulatory Transaction Reporting or Financial Data Management within an Asset Management or Sell-side environment.
* Data Mastery: Proven track record in managing complex data flows, performing high-level reconciliations, and validating data lineage and traceability.
* Leadership Track Record: Experience in managing operational teams and overseeing outsourced service providers/vendors.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Expert-level understanding of the evolving global regulatory landscape (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Process Excellence: Demonstrated experience in leading process improvement, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.

**Skills Referential**
**Technical Skills:**

* Advanced Regulatory Frameworks (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Data Governance, Data Lineage, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Strategic Risk Management & Control Design.
* Expert proficiency in Data Analysis tools (Advanced Excel, SQL/Python knowledge preferred) and Reporting Platforms (e.g., Aladdin, DTCC, Tri-Optima).

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strategic Thinking & Vision.
* Executive Communication (Reporting KPIs and trends to senior management).
* Change Leadership & Transformation.
* Advanced Conflict Resolution & Negotiation.
* Risk-based Decision Making.

**Education Level:**
Post Graduate degree in Finance
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai

The role requires a leader with deep local market knowledge, strong relationships across government, GCC and enterprise clients, and a proven track record of growing IT services and technology business across India. Business Leadership & P&L Ownership

* Identify opportunities for cross-selling KPO, IT training, and software products into the existing client base.

Client & Stakeholder Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact and relationship owner for the company’s largest and most strategic India accounts.
* Represent Client of Pinnacle Group with regulators, industry associations, technology partners (e.g., global OEMs and software vendors), and at public/industry forums.
* Ensure compliance with India country statutory requirements, local labour laws, and other regulatory obligations.

Operations & Delivery Oversight

* Oversee delivery quality and client satisfaction across all engagements, working closely with delivery and consulting leads.
* Ensure robust governance, risk management, and commercial discipline across projects and contracts.

People Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and develop the India leadership team across sales and business development, and work in tandem with the company executive suite across delivery, operations, finance, and HR.
* Build a strong local talent pipeline, with particular attention to developing talent in line with country goals.
* Foster a high-performance, client-centric culture aligned with the company’s values.

Candidate Profile

Required Background

* Indian resident, with the vast majority of life and career based in India, and strong existing networks across government, GCCs and private-sector clients in the country.
* A significant portion of career spent with an IT Services / IT Consulting organization — ideally a global Tier-1 player with an established India presence, such as IBM, Accenture, Capgemini, or a top tier IOP service provider organization.

.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Description – Operations Manager (B2B Enterprise Business – Pan India)

**Job Title:**
Operations Manager – B2B Enterprise Business
  
**Department:**
Enterprise Business / Operations
  
**Location:**
Chennai, India (Responsible for Pan-India Operations)
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
**Industry:**
Transportation, Logistics & Supply Chain
  
**Experience:**
6–10 Years (Preferred)

1. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced, commercially driven and result-oriented Operations Manager to manage and grow GoGoX's B2B Enterprise Business across India.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete enterprise business lifecycle, starting from identifying business opportunities, receiving RFI (Request for Information) and RFQ (Request for Quotation), preparing and submitting commercial proposals, participating in tenders and bidding processes, winning enterprise contracts, and ensuring successful implementation and execution of transportation and logistics services.

The role will involve managing enterprise customer relationships, supporting business development and sales activities, handling key accounts, coordinating vehicle sourcing and allocation, overseeing Pan-India transportation operations, managing employees and logistics partners, and ensuring excellent service delivery.

The candidate will work closely with enterprise customers, internal sales and business teams, city operations teams, transport vendors, fleet owners, finance and senior management to achieve business growth, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction and profitability.

2. Key Job ResponsibilitiesA. B2B Enterprise Business Development & Sales

* Identify and develop new B2B enterprise business opportunities in the transportation and logistics industry.
* Identify potential corporate customers and build strong business relationships to generate new business.
* Drive enterprise business growth through customer acquisition, business expansion and strategic account development.
* Understand customer transportation and logistics requirements and propose suitable service solutions.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development teams to acquire new enterprise customers.
* Participate in client meetings, business presentations, commercial discussions and negotiations.
* Prepare business proposals, quotations, pricing structures and commercial offers in coordination with internal teams.
* Identify upselling, cross-selling and additional business opportunities within existing enterprise accounts.
* Develop long-term relationships with corporate customers to increase business volume and revenue.
* Track business opportunities, sales pipelines, customer conversions and revenue targets.

B. RFI, RFQ, Tender & Bid Management

* Receive and manage RFI (Request for Information) and RFQ (Request for Quotation) opportunities from existing and prospective enterprise customers.
* Identify and track tender opportunities and enterprise transportation requirements.
* Review customer requirements, including vehicle categories, vehicle quantities, transportation routes, service locations, deployment timelines and operational expectations.
* Analyse customer requirements and coordinate with internal operations, sales, finance and management teams to prepare competitive commercial proposals.
* Prepare and submit RFIs, RFQs, technical proposals, commercial quotations and tender documentation within the specified deadlines.
* Coordinate the preparation of pricing, transportation rates, cost estimates and commercial terms.
* Participate in customer tender processes, bidding activities, presentations, clarification meetings and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure timely follow-up with customers regarding submitted proposals, quotations and bids.
* Track bid status, submission deadlines, customer feedback, negotiations and final outcomes.
* Coordinate with management and relevant stakeholders to improve bid competitiveness and increase the chances of winning contracts.
* Maintain proper records of all RFIs, RFQs, quotations, tenders, bid submissions and customer communications.
* Manage the complete bidding lifecycle, from opportunity identification and RFI/RFQ receipt to proposal submission, negotiation and contract award.

C. Contract Award, Customer Onboarding & Implementation

* Coordinate with customers following successful bid submissions and contract awards.
* Ensure proper understanding of awarded contracts, agreed commercial terms, vehicle requirements and service delivery commitments.
* Coordinate the transition of new enterprise accounts from the business development and bidding stage to the operations team.
* Develop implementation plans for newly awarded enterprise transportation contracts.
* Ensure customer onboarding, operational documentation, service agreements and SOP implementation are completed.
* Prepare vehicle deployment and mobilisation plans based on customer requirements.
* Coordinate with regional operations teams and transport partners to ensure timely commencement of services.
* Ensure all contractual commitments, operational requirements and service-level agreements are communicated and implemented.
* Monitor initial service execution and resolve implementation-related challenges.

D. Enterprise Client & Key Account Management

* Manage and maintain relationships with existing B2B enterprise customers across India.
* Act as the primary point of contact for key enterprise accounts and customer escalations.
* Understand customer requirements, transportation volumes, service expectations and business priorities.
* Ensure smooth customer onboarding, account implementation and ongoing operational coordination.
* Develop customer-specific operating procedures (SOPs) and service delivery plans.
* Conduct regular customer review meetings and business performance discussions.
* Monitor customer satisfaction, service quality, retention and account profitability.
* Handle customer complaints, operational escalations and service-related issues within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.
* Identify opportunities to increase business volumes and expand existing customer accounts.
* Maintain strong relationships with decision-makers, procurement teams and key stakeholders of enterprise customers.

E. Pan-India Transportation & Logistics Operations

* Manage and oversee end-to-end B2B transportation and logistics operations across India.
* Ensure efficient execution of enterprise transportation requirements across multiple cities and regions.
* Coordinate vehicle sourcing, allocation, deployment, pickup, transportation and delivery operations.
* Monitor daily order volumes, vehicle availability, shipment movement and service execution.
* Coordinate with regional operations teams, city-level employees, transport partners and vendors.
* Ensure timely vehicle placement and fulfilment of customer transportation requirements.
* Establish standard operating procedures and ensure consistent operational processes across locations.
* Monitor service performance and ensure compliance with customer-specific SLAs.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency.
* Ensure proper coordination between central operations, regional teams and enterprise customers.
* Handle critical operational escalations and ensure business continuity.
* Monitor operational performance and take ownership of service delivery across India.

F. Vehicle Allocation, Fleet & Deployment Management

* Plan and manage vehicle allocation for enterprise customers based on their transportation requirements.
* Ensure the availability of appropriate vehicle categories, quantities and specifications as per customer contracts.
* Coordinate with fleet owners, transport vendors and regional operations teams for vehicle sourcing and deployment.
* Allocate vehicles across different cities and regions based on customer demand and business requirements.
* Ensure timely mobilisation and deployment of vehicles for newly awarded contracts and existing accounts.
* Monitor vehicle utilisation, availability, deployment status and operational performance.
* Ensure backup and replacement vehicles are arranged to avoid service disruptions.
* Coordinate vehicle allocation for additional customer requirements, new projects and business expansions.
* Ensure vehicle deployment is completed within agreed timelines and contractual commitments.
* Monitor vehicle-related costs and ensure commercially viable and efficient fleet utilisation.

G. Team & Employee Management

* Lead, manage and supervise enterprise operations employees and account management teams across different locations.
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure effective coordination among team members.
* Manage manpower planning based on customer requirements and business volumes.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, performance and overall team efficiency.
* Set individual and team performance targets and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Provide guidance, training and support to improve employee performance and operational capabilities.
* Ensure employees understand customer requirements, operational processes and service delivery expectations.
* Build a responsible, customer-focused and performance-driven team.
* Coordinate with HR for recruitment, employee onboarding, performance management and other employee-related matters.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination between central and regional teams.

H. Vendor & Transport Partner Management

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with transporters, fleet owners and logistics service providers across India.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard reliable transportation partners in different cities.
* Negotiate transportation rates and commercial terms to ensure cost-effective service delivery.
* Monitor vendor performance, vehicle availability and service quality.
* Ensure vendors meet customer-specific operational requirements and service-level commitments.
* Monitor vendor compliance with company policies and operational procedures.
* Resolve vendor-related operational issues and maintain a reliable transportation partner network.
* Identify opportunities to expand the vendor network to support new enterprise business requirements.

I. Revenue, Cost & Commercial Management

* Monitor enterprise account revenue, operational expenses and profitability.
* Ensure appropriate pricing and cost structures for transportation services.
* Coordinate with internal teams to prepare competitive and commercially viable quotations.
* Evaluate account-wise costs and margins before submitting commercial proposals.
* Identify opportunities to improve contribution margins and reduce operational expenses.
* Coordinate with Finance for customer billing, invoice reconciliation, payment follow-ups and outstanding receivables.
* Monitor customer credit exposure and coordinate the resolution of billing disputes.
* Track account-wise revenue, transportation costs and contribution margins.
* Ensure commercial commitments and approved pricing are followed during service execution.

J. MIS, Reporting & Performance Management

* Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly business and operational performance reports.
* Maintain MIS for enterprise customers, RFI/RFQ opportunities, tender submissions, bid status and contract wins.
* Track new business opportunities, bid conversion rates and enterprise revenue growth.
* Monitor vehicle allocation, deployment, utilisation and availability.
* Track customer order volumes, pickup and delivery performance and SLA compliance.
* Monitor employee productivity, vendor performance and operational efficiency.
* Prepare account-wise revenue, cost and profitability reports.
* Present business performance, operational challenges and improvement plans to senior management.
* Use operational data and reports to identify business opportunities and improve decision-making.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated based on the following performance parameters:

1. **Business Development:**
   New enterprise customer acquisition and business growth.
2. **RFI/RFQ Management:**
   Timely receipt, preparation and submission of proposals and quotations.
3. **Bid Management:**
   Number of bids submitted, bid conversion ratio and successful contract wins.
4. **Revenue Growth:**
   Achievement of enterprise business revenue targets.
5. **Client Management:**
   Customer satisfaction, account retention and business expansion.
6. **Contract Implementation:**
   Successful onboarding and commencement of newly awarded contracts.
7. **Vehicle Allocation:**
   Timely vehicle sourcing, allocation and deployment.
8. **Fleet Utilisation:**
   Vehicle availability, utilisation and cost efficiency.
9. **Operational Performance:**
   SLA compliance, on-time pickup and delivery performance.
10. **Team Management:**
    Employee productivity, performance and operational coordination.
11. **Vendor Management:**
    Vendor performance, service quality and cost optimisation.
12. **Profitability:**
    Account-wise revenue growth, cost control and contribution margins.
13. **Reporting:**
    Timely and accurate MIS and management reporting.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong understanding of B2B transportation, logistics and supply chain operations.
* Experience in enterprise business development and corporate sales.
* Hands-on experience in RFI, RFQ, tender preparation, bid management and commercial negotiations.
* Experience in winning and implementing enterprise transportation contracts.
* Strong enterprise client relationship and key account management skills.
* Experience managing Pan-India or multi-location operations.
* Knowledge of vehicle sourcing, fleet allocation and transportation partner management.
* Strong team leadership and employee management capabilities.
* Good commercial understanding, pricing and cost analysis skills.
* Ability to manage customer escalations and operational challenges.
* Strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS, CRM and ERP platforms.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Willingness to travel across India based on business requirements.

5. Educational Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Operations, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or Business Administration will be an added advantage.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in transportation, logistics, B2B enterprise business, operations management or business development.
* Previous experience handling corporate and enterprise customers is preferred.
* Experience in RFI/RFQ, tender management, commercial bidding and contract acquisition is highly desirable.
* Experience managing large-scale transportation operations, vehicle deployment and vendor networks across multiple cities will be an added advantage.
* Experience managing employees and teams across different locations is preferred.

6. Overall Role Expectation

The Operations Manager will take end-to-end ownership of GoGoX's B2B Enterprise Business across India, covering business development, RFI/RFQ management, tender participation, bid submissions, contract acquisition, enterprise client management, customer onboarding, vehicle allocation, transportation operations and team management.

The candidate must have the ability to combine business development with operational execution, ensuring that enterprise contracts are successfully secured, implemented and managed.

The ultimate objective is to grow GoGoX's enterprise transportation business, build strong corporate customer relationships, ensure reliable Pan-India service delivery, improve operational efficiency and achieve sustainable business profitability.

Fabrimech Engineers Pvt. Ltd. | Ambattur, Chennai

ABOUT FABRIMECH

Fabrimech Engineers Pvt. Ltd. is an established engineering and manufacturing company based in Chennai, with a legacy dating back to 1966. We specialize in precision fabrication, sheet metal manufacturing and pressure equipment, serving customers across railway, industrial and international markets.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Operations Manager to lead manufacturing operations across our two factories in Ambattur, Chennai. The role involves managing approximately 150 people across both units, overseeing production, PPC, quality, on-time delivery and maintenance, while driving higher productivity, better capacity utilization and operational excellence. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, the Operations Manager will be responsible for strengthening operational systems, implementing data-driven performance management and building a strong second line of leadership.

Manufacturing & Operations

• Lead day-to-day operations across both manufacturing units.

• Oversee production, PPC, quality, on-time delivery and maintenance.

• Improve production output, capacity utilization and resource efficiency.

• Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

• Ensure production targets and customer delivery commitments are achieved.

Production Planning & Control

• Strengthen production planning, scheduling and execution.

• Monitor work orders, production progress and pending activities.

• Improve coordination between departments to ensure smooth operations.

• Drive improvements in on-time delivery and manufacturing efficiency.

Systems & Digitalization

• Drive the implementation of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

• Establish live operational data tracking and daily MIS reporting.

• Strengthen ERP discipline and ensure timely and accurate data entry.

• Develop operational dashboards and performance monitoring systems.

• Establish and monitor KRAs and KPIs across departments.

• Build accountability and performance discipline within the organization.

• Develop department heads and supervisors.

• Build a strong second line of leadership.

• Report operational performance, challenges and improvement initiatives directly to the Managing Director.

Continuous Improvement

• Implement Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma practices.

• Reduce rejection, rework, scrap and production lead times.

• Improve machine utilization and reduce downtime.

• Standardize processes and drive continuous improvement across both factories.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Essential Qualifications & Experience

• B.E. in Mechanical Engineering.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, including experience running a manufacturing plant.

• Experience in fabrication, pressure vessels, sheet metal, welding or export-oriented manufacturing.

• Strong understanding of production planning, quality, maintenance and factory operations.

• Experience in managing teams and driving operational performance.

• Hands-on, data-driven and execution-oriented approach.

• Strong leadership, coordination and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills & Knowledge

• Experience with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 and EN 15085.

• Familiarity with ERP systems and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

• Experience in railway, pressure vessel or heavy fabrication industries.

• Experience managing multiple manufacturing units.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS

• Good communication skills in English, Tamil and Hindi.

WHAT WE OFFER

• An opportunity to lead operations across two manufacturing facilities.

• Direct interaction and reporting to the Managing Director.

• The opportunity to build systems and shape the future of a well-established manufacturing organization.

• Attractive compensation for the right candidate.

JOB DETAILS

Position: Operations Manager

Location: Ambattur Industrial Estate, Chennai

Experience: 10+ years

Qualification: B.E. Mechanical Engineering

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Arrangement: On-site

Reporting To: Managing Director

Joining Preference: Within 30 days

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their updated CV at fme@fabrimech.com.

title: Project Construction and Commissioning Manager
description:
**The opportunity**
The Project Construction & Commissioning Manager (PCCM) provides role-level leadership, coordination and control for the Construction & Commissioning scope across the project lifecycle. The PCCM supports tender handover, analyses the as-sold project basis, develops and maintains the Project Construction and Commissioning Management Plan, coordinates mobilization and resource planning, monitors schedule, cost, quality and HSE performance, represents Construction & Commissioning in relevant project forums, supports site take-over and demobilization activities, and ensures lessons learned are captured and shared for current and future projects. The role requires strong communicational skills, stakeholder management and interface leadership to align project management, engineering, procurement, site execution, installation, commissioning, customer representatives, subcontractors, the consortium partner and other external stakeholders. The PCCM is expected to build trust, maintain transparent communication, support timely decision-making and actively manage cross-functional interfaces to keep safety, quality, schedule and budget objectives aligned throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* The scope of the PCCM is to manage and coordinate Construction and Commissioning processes and activities related to project scope.
* The PCCM is office based supporting the accomplishment of the site execution and the management of the site which is performed by the site manager. The role require frequent travel to the sites, partners- and other Hitachi Energy- offices.
* Main Responsibility of the PCCM:
* Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Management: Drives and leads HSE by example, promotes HSE as our license to operate.
* Quality Management: Drives and leads Quality by example.
* Communication / Interface / Stakeholder Management: Leads and manages key Construction & Commissioning project interfaces to ensure alignment, effective communication and successful project execution throughout the project lifecycle. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with the Project Director, Project Engineering Manager, Lead Engineers, Project HSE Manager, Quality Manager, Supply Chain and other core project stakeholders.
* Leadership and Cultural Awareness: Demonstrates strong cultural awareness and adaptability leading projects executed in a global and multicultural environment.
* Subcontractor Management: Contributes to the development of the subcontracting strategy for the Construction & Commissioning scope based on tender assumptions, current project conditions, local market considerations and project delivery requirements.
* Documentation Management: Identifies Construction & Commissioning documents to be developed and delivered by the PCCM, including standard and project-specific deliverables. Develops the Project Construction and Commissioning Management Plan using the applicable template and based on tender handover, as-sold analysis, execution strategy, manning, subcontracting strategy and site infrastructure considerations. Coordinates the Construction and Commissioning Management plan with the relevant stakeholders. Revises the Plan when required through all project stages.
* Manpower Planning: Develops the initial mobilization plan based on tender assumptions, current project conditions, business priorities, staffing needs, budget and discipline input. Performs continuous resource planning for the Construction & Commissioning scope in coordination with relevant line managers and in line with the Project Construction and Commissioning Management Plan.
* Schedule Management: Leads the development of Construction & Commissioning schedule content and ensures relevant activities are included in project planning with feasible sequences, relationships and durations. Coordinates with project planning, site planning and relevant Construction & Commissioning disciplines to develop and maintain the project baseline for the PCCM scope.
* Cost Management: Takes responsibility for monitoring and reporting the Construction & Commissioning budget, forecast cost to complete and cost development within the PCCM scope.
* Constructability: Leads and drives the constructability process by ensuring Construction & Commissioning requirements are considered early in design, planning, procurement, logistics, safety, schedule and site execution preparation.
* Project Review: Leads preparation and coordination of the monthly Construction & Commissioning project review using the applicable digital project review, including Power BI based reporting where available.
* Coaching and Mentoring Tasks: Supports knowledge sharing, training and mentoring of fellow PCCMs and other Construction & Commissioning resources.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's Degree in electrical- or mechanical- engineering with at least 10 Years relevant work experience.
* Candidate must already have a work authorization that would permit to work for Hitachi Energy
* Ability to work under pressure and on own initiative; Ability to prioritize and work against deadlines.
* Project financial authorities according to Delegation of Authority; Calling-up and delegating staff via line organization responsible Manager
* Material procurement on site, Adjustment of the infrastructure, Conditions for delegation of personnel, Off-shore cost forecasting.
* Initiate or hold back payments to suppliers based on their fulfilment or non-fulfilment of the terms of the contract together with Subcontracting Site Manager
* Award contracts and orders for the project in accordance with directives of the line organization & within the delegation of authority of the company.
* Influence the selection of people assigned by Line Management.
* Challenge the SIM regarding evolution of Site Activities including but not limited to Budget aspects
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

The Front Desk Manager maintains accurate records, supports billing and payment processes, and ensures that front desk procedures are followed consistently. This role also involves training and guiding front desk team members, addressing patient concerns, and upholding clinic standards for customer service and confidentiality.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on Customer Satisfaction and professional handling of inquiries and concerns.
* Experience with Receptionist Duties, including greeting visitors, managing check-in/check-out, and maintaining a welcoming front desk environment.
* Excellent Communication skills, both verbal and written, to interact effectively with patients, visitors, and internal teams.
* Ability to manage Reservations and scheduling, including appointment coordination, calendar management, and follow-up confirmations.
* Prior experience in a clinic, hospital, spa, or hospitality front desk role is preferred.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in records and documentation.
* Comfort with basic computer systems and practice management or scheduling software.
* Ability to remain calm, courteous, and professional in a fast-paced environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional training or certification in administration, hospitality, or healthcare management is an advantage.

title: Infra Delivery Lead
description:
**Service Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery of L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations.
* Lead the Infra Command Center (L1.5) and the Hosting, Connectivity, DBA and Data Tribe pods.
* Act as single point of contact for the client infrastructure leadership.
* Run daily stand-ups and weekly service reviews with tower leads.
* Drive service improvement plans to closure.

**SLA, Reporting and Governance**

* Track response and resolution SLAs across all infra towers.
* Publish weekly and monthly SLA, KPI and backlog reports.
* Present service performance at monthly and quarterly governance reviews.
* Review monthly capacity, utilisation and performance reports for servers and databases.
* Maintain the RAID log for infrastructure services.
* Enforce ServiceNow ticket hygiene, CMDB accuracy and closure quality.

Incident, Escalation and MIM
  
  

* Attend MIM bridge calls for P1/P2 infrastructure and data platform incidents.
* Own client and internal escalations through to closure.
* Drive RCA, problem management and defect elimination plans.
* Coordinate with SecOps towers, OEM and hardware vendors, telecom carriers and client L3 teams.
* Drive repeat-incident reduction and alert tuning with the Command Center.

Change, Patching and Availability
  
  

* Govern change requests and maintenance windows across all infra towers.
* Track monthly OS, VMware, database and zero-day patch compliance.
* Oversee backup success, restore tests and DR / BCP drills.
* Oversee server, database and network builds and decommissions.
* Track platform software licences and expiry dates.

**Commercials and Contract**

* Own monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for infrastructure services.
* Track deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations.
* Raise and manage change requests for scope changes.
* Lead contractual reviews, including service credits and penalties.

**Resourcing and People**

* Plan capacity, shift rosters and 24x7 on-call coverage.
* Hire, onboard and retain engineers; manage backfills and leave cover.
* Maintain the skill matrix and cross-skilling plan across pods.
* Run performance reviews, coaching and career plans for the team.

Compliance and Continual Improvement
  
  

* Ensure adherence to client infrastructure standards and security policies.
* Track OS hardening, system agent and audit-log compliance.
* Support internal and external audits with evidence.
* Drive automation of routine tasks, patching and deployments.
* Keep SOPs, runbooks and knowledge-base articles current.
* Lead onboarding and transition of new infrastructure services.

**Tools/Technology - Knowhow**

* AWS (EC2, S3, ELB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM)
* Microsoft Azure
* Windows Server and Linux / Unix
* Cisco routers, switches and WLAN controllers
* Firewalls & load balancers
* Cisco Call Manager / PBX
* Databases (Oracle, MS SQL, Cloud databases)
* Datadog
* PagerDuty
* ServiceNow (ITSM, CMDB, reporting and dashboards)
* Tableau, Power BI / Excel for service reporting (good to have)
* Jira and Confluence (good to have)

**Processes and Frameworks**

* ITIL service management: incident, problem, change, request
* Disaster recovery and business continuity
* Automation and scripting: PowerShell, Bash, Python (good to have)
* Infrastructure as code: Terraform (good to have)

**Experience**

* 12+ years in IT infrastructure operations
* 5+ years as delivery lead in a managed services setup
* Led 24x7 multi-tower infrastructure operations for a global enterprise
* Managed onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, Windows, Linux, , Oracle, SQL Server and Datadog
* Oversight of data platform operations: Airflow, Talend, Snowflake, Tableau and Power BI
* SLA management, invoicing and contract reviews in an MSP model
* MIM participation and senior stakeholder escalation handling
* Service transition from an incumbent provider (good to have)
* Clear written and spoken English; confident with senior leadership

**Certifications – Good to have**

* ITIL 4 Foundation
* AWS Solutions Architect – Associate or Microsoft AZ-104 (good to have)

title: Technology Manager
description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We're looking for a Technology Manager to make sure our IT changes and tech ecosystem are safe and well-managed. You'll be working closely with our Operations and Product teams to keep projects on track.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Assessing initiatives that require IT changes
* Identifying dependencies, impact, and risks, and making sure they're properly analysed, tested, and managed
* Representing the Technology team in larger change and transformation programmes, and taking ownership of relevant tasks
* Building and optimising scalable processes to support our hyper-growth
* Leading and executing projects end to end
* Preparing reports and keeping directors and other stakeholders updated
* Resolving issues with management and stakeholders

**What You'll Need**

* 7+ years of experience in financial services or fintech, or at a leading technology or IT services provider
* Programme and project management qualifications, plus in-depth knowledge of their methods and principles
* A talent for breaking complex problems into smaller ones, and to enjoy working with data
* Risk awareness and an understanding of risk management frameworks, especially the three lines of defence model
* A solid grasp of technology within a financial services organisation, including modern tech stacks
* Knowledge of European financial services regulations, such as PSD2, GDPR, and the Digital Operational Resilience Act
* Experience partnering with executive teams and working closely with others to deliver results
* A background in retail banking and familiarity with Revolut's products and services
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills
* Sharp decision-making skills and the ability to analyse complex information, identify key issues, and drive resolutions

**Nice to have**

* Technology and change delivery experience at a leading global consultancy
* A track record of building or scaling the technology function of a financial services institution or fintech
* Relevant certifications, such as CCMP, ITIL, or PMP

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
  
  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

**We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.**
If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
  
  
By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

.

title: AVP-Risk (Credit & Cpty) and Performance Manager
description:
**Job Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Department: 2S Operations**
**About Business Line/Function**
**The Strategic Business Development and Transformation (SBDT) Team**
The SBDT team defines the regional go-to-market strategy and value proposition across all products and locations. The team manages the product portfolio, designs client solutions, and leads transformational initiatives across multiple product and solution domains. This function aligns the business with market, regulatory, and client requirements to drive optimal client satisfaction.
  
  
The SBDT team comprises several specialized units: Product and Solutions, Strategy and Business Management, Business Credit Advisors (BCA), Regulatory Watch.
  
  
To deliver strategic outcomes, the department collaborates closely with key internal stakeholders. Primary partners include the client coverage teams (Sales, Relationship Management, and Client Service) and the Service and IT delivery leadership (Client Delivery). Furthermore, the team maintains close working relationships with FIC, Global Markets, BNP Paribas Asset Management, and Wealth Management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
**As the Securities Services (2S) footprint expands across the APAC region, the division is increasingly recognized as an industry leader. To support the growing franchise, we are seeking talented professionals to support the following functions:**

* Risk management – Business credit analyst (BCA) CIB2S BCA team is a team of experts in credit risk in post trade services of CIB2S. As experts, the team provides risk assessments for these activities to CIB2S Business, Credit analysts and RISK credit delegation holders in the context of credit requests and annual credit reviews. The team members also contribute to raising risk awareness across CIB2S. The team collaborates with all CIB2S locations, engaging with various business lines and functions across the organization.
* Performance Management Framework - The team oversees the following areas:

**Business Management**
: Managing governance and P&L monitoring, while contributing to strategic product development initiatives for APAC Client Lines.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership:**
Driving strategic initiatives, including business, location, and regional strategies, alongside comprehensive market reviews for CIB2S.
  
  
**Policy Alignment:**
Collaborating with Head Office to implement 2S policies and procedures affecting APAC SBDT.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  
**Risk Management**

* Credit Assessment: Review credit requests prepared by Coverage and Front Office teams, providing critical challenge when proposed activity structures or risk mitigants deviate from BNP Paribas Credit Policies.
* Limit Calibration: Calibrate requested credit limits to ensure alignment with risk appetite.
* Risk Advisory: Provide formal risk opinions to Credit Analysts and Credit Officers regarding specific requests.
* Committee Representation: Represent the Business in credit committees, working in partnership with Client Development.
* Governance & Compliance: Manage post-committee follow-ups with relevant stakeholders to ensure all pending conditions are met.
* Due Diligence: Participate in client due diligence processes as required.
* Legal Risk Analysis: Analyze the credit risk implications of amendments to legal agreements and provide strategic recommendations to decision-makers.
* Strategic Projects: Contribute to projects concerning CIB2S credit risk topics and portfolio analysis.
* Market Intelligence: Maintain proactive awareness of evolving CIB2S activities, regulatory environments and credit risk methodologies, disseminating key insights to Management and business partners.
* Country Risk Monitoring: Utilize existing framework (e.g., country envelopes) and develop enhanced methodologies for the holistic monitoring of risk exposures in sensitive jurisdictions.
* Product Development: Advise CIB2S Product teams on potential risk impacts during the product development lifecycle.

**Performance Management**

* Governance Support: supporting APAC Client Lines Executive Committee (Exco) governance through the preparation of decision-making analyses across a broad range of strategic topics.
* Strategic Initiatives: supporting regional strategic initiatives, including business, location, and regional strategies, market reviews, and market share analyses.
* Financial Management: Supporting Client Lines' financial reporting, headcount planning, cost management, and the budgeting process, alongside reviewing allocation keys and producing regional newsletters and dashboards.
* Profitability Optimization: Supporting initiatives to improve profitability for key regional clients and proposing actionable plans to enhance client and product margins.
* Committee Management: Assisting senior management committees, including the Client Line Board, APAC Business Committees, and Client Line Steering Committees—by preparing strategic documentation and action plans.
* Product Development: Contributions towards various regional product development initiatives.
* Stakeholder Liaison: Liaising with Head Office on SBDT-related matters as required.
* Ad Hoc Projects: Executing ad hoc tasks within the performance management remit.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Proven expertise in credit or counterparty risk management within a financial institution or risk consultancy.
* Deep understanding of the Securities Services industry, its product suite, and the complexities of various financial instruments and their associated risks.
* Advanced analytical and presentation skills, with high proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to manipulate large, complex datasets with rigor.
* Ability in strategic planning and business management, underpinned by strong, independent problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information and formulate concise, high-impact messages for stakeholders.
* Ability to navigate complex organizational hierarchies and engage confidently with senior leadership
* Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work collaboratively within a team.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or above
  
  
**Specific Qualifications:**
CA or FRM or CFA qualification is highly desirable.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**




+ Credit & Cpty risk management and methodologies
+ Financial instruments and Risks
+ Proficiency in Power BI and familiarity with Design Thinking methodologies
+ Practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills
+ Ability to interact with senior management
+ Business storytelling
+ Project Management

**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.
