title: ST - Telco-Nokia Flow One-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager – Nokia FlowOne Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. description:
**Senior AI Lead / Director – AI Programs & Solutions | SRM Tech | Chennai - Hybrid**

**About SRM Tech**

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services.

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale.

As a Great Place to Work®-certified organization, we are committed to creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and thrive. We believe empowered individuals drive innovation, deliver value to customers, and play a meaningful role in shaping our collective success.

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

**Role Overview**

As a Senior AI Lead – AI Programs & Solutions, you will lead SRM Tech’s artificial intelligence programs, client engagements, and proprietary AI tool development initiatives. The role combines technical expertise with executive leadership, focusing on Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies, enterprise AI delivery, and positioning SRM Tech as a trusted partner in AI transformation.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage strategic client relationships, and drive the adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI workflows, and scalable AI/ML platforms. Experience in the Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical domain is a strong advantage.

**Work location**
: Chennai - Hybrid

**Preferred Experience**
: 15-20 years

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & GTM Execution**

* Define and execute Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies for AI offerings, accelerators, and solution frameworks.
* Lead client presentations and present technical solutions, translating business challenges into actionable AI roadmaps.
* Lead internal product and tool development initiatives to build reusable, scalable, and high-value AI assets and frameworks.

**Program Oversight & Delivery Excellence**

* Oversee end-to-end delivery of complex AI/ML programs, ensuring timely, high-quality execution aligned with business objectives.
* Manage cross-functional teams comprising data engineers, data scientists, ML engineers, and solution architects.
* Establish delivery governance, quality assurance, and best practices across AI programs.
* Serve as the primary AI subject matter expert in client discussions, discovery workshops, and steering committee meetings.

**Technical & Innovation Leadership**

* Drive the adoption of Generative AI architectures, including Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Vector Databases.
* Provide architectural oversight for scalable data pipelines and platforms, including Apache Spark, Kafka, and Databricks.
* Guide the development and implementation of classical ML and NLP models across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Mentor and develop AI engineering and data science teams, fostering technical excellence and innovation.

**Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical Domain**

* Apply Life Sciences domain knowledge across commercial operations, market access, clinical insights, and omnichannel analytics to develop industry-specific AI solutions and accelerate time-to-value for clients.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of overall experience in IT / Software Engineering.
* 6+ years in dedicated AI/ML leadership or architecture roles.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Proven experience in client management, executive presentations, and C-level stakeholder engagement.
* Experience in defining AI offerings, supporting pre-sales activities, and driving GTM expansion.
* Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and manage delivery teams across multiple projects.

**Technical Expertise**

**Generative AI & Modern AI Stack**

* Expertise in Generative AI platforms, Agentic AI architectures, RAG frameworks, LLMs, fine-tuning, and Vector Databases.

**Core AI/ML & Data Engineering**

* Strong foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and statistical modeling.
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.

**Data & Cloud Platforms**

* Experience with enterprise data platforms and technologies, including Databricks, Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native services across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

**AI Delivery & Governance**

* Experience in MLOps, CI/CD for AI, model monitoring, and automated deployment pipelines.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical domain experience, particularly in commercial AI use cases, field productivity tools, patient/HCP journey orchestration, and market access operations.

*SRM Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, without bias or discrimination, in line with applicable laws.*

title: Manager - Transfer Pricing
description:
**Job Summary**

* The Direct and Indirect Tax Change Champion exists to translate tax strategy, legislative developments and operational requirements into controlled, sustainable changes across direct and indirect tax processes. The role enables Tax teams to adopt new policies, processes, data capabilities and technologies while maintaining regulatory compliance, operational continuity and effective internal controls.
* The role is accountable for shaping and delivering tax transformation initiatives, coordinating impact assessments, strengthening process and data controls, and preparing affected stakeholders for implementation. This includes establishing clear transformation governance, managing dependencies and risks, and using process analysis and tax expertise to identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and improved reporting.
* Working across Country and Group Tax teams, Finance, Technology and relevant business functions, the role influences tax process owners and supports subject-matter experts in converting regulatory and business requirements into practical solutions. The role does not own underlying tax legislation, business strategy or technology development. It provides the change leadership, tax context and governance required to implement agreed changes effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Tax Transformation Strategy & Prioritisation**

* Translate tax strategy, regulatory developments and operational priorities into a structured transformation roadmap that addresses material direct and indirect tax requirements.
* Evaluate proposed changes against tax, business, data and technology needs to establish clear scope, outcomes, dependencies and implementation priorities.
* Shape business cases and delivery options for process, data and technology improvements that strengthen tax compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Provide tax transformation insight to process owners and governance forums, enabling informed decisions on investment, sequencing and implementation risk.

**Change Impact & Stakeholder Adoption**

* Assess the impact of tax policy, legislative, process and technology changes on affected teams, controls, data flows and operating procedures.
* Develop and execute change and communication approaches that build stakeholder understanding, readiness and adoption across Group and Country Tax teams.
* Identify adoption barriers and stakeholder concerns early, escalating material issues and coordinating practical mitigation actions with accountable owners.
* Engage Tax, Finance, Technology and business stakeholders to maintain alignment on intended outcomes, responsibilities and implementation requirements.

**Tax Process Optimisation**

* Analyse direct and indirect tax workflows to identify control gaps, duplication, manual intervention and opportunities for standardisation or automation.
* Design improved tax processes and operating practices that enhance accuracy, efficiency, traceability and consistency across relevant jurisdictions.
* Apply process mapping, data analysis and operational requirements analysis to define credible future-state workflows and measurable improvement outcomes.
* Embed continuous improvement mechanisms that use stakeholder feedback, performance information and operational learning to refine tax processes.

**Tax Technology & Data Enablement**

* Define tax business and operational requirements for tax engines, automation tools, data warehouses and reporting platforms in partnership with Technology teams.
* Coordinate tax input into solution design, testing, user acceptance and implementation readiness to confirm that agreed requirements and controls are addressed.
* Support the controlled deployment of tax technologies by coordinating user guidance, adoption support, issue resolution and post-implementation review.
* Monitor solution performance and data outcomes after implementation, directing identified defects, control concerns and enhancement opportunities to accountable owners.

**Transformation Governance, Risk & Controls**

* Establish proportionate governance for tax change initiatives, providing transparent oversight of scope, milestones, dependencies, decisions and delivery risks.
* Integrate tax compliance, internal control and conduct requirements into transformation design and implementation decisions.
* Maintain clear project documentation and performance reporting that enables timely escalation, governance review and accountable decision-making.

title: Supervisor, Accounts Receivable
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets.
* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.
* Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows.
* Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members.
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.
* Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.
* Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus.
* Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities.

title: General Manager/ Business Head
description:
**Job Description :**

**Company**
: KeminCBR Pvt.Ltd. (A fully owned subsidiary of Kemin South Asia Pvt Ltd)

**Role :**
General Manager /Business Head

**Location**
:Chennai

* Lead and transform our Ruminant Retail business (B2C) by driving 2X profitable growth, expanding customer and distribution reach, executing winning sales and marketing strategies, and building high-performing teams.
* Expected to be jointly responsible for providing business leadership, strategic directions and be accountable for the overall business KPIs of the company. Work closely as a team member, manage and lead the company towards achievement of the overall company’s shared goals
* Partner closely with Manufacturing, C&F, Finance, and Sales to unlock market opportunities, optimize business performance, and leverage technology, data, and AI to create sustainable growth.
* Work Environment: The position will be based at the head office in Chennai and will require traveling both regionally and internationally depends upon the needs of the regional and global requirements

Necessitates 16-18 days of business travel in a month

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Business Strategy and Leadership

* Develop and execute the annual operating plan and medium-term growth strategy for the ruminant retail business.
* Define business priorities, target markets, customer segments, geographic expansion plans, and channel strategy.
* Convert business objectives into clear functional plans, budgets, performance targets, and accountability for the team.
* Lead periodic business reviews and present performance, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions to senior leadership.
* Balance revenue expansion, profitability, customer value, and organizational capability when allocating resources.

2. Full P&L Ownership and Financial Performance

* Own the business P&L, including net sales, cost of goods sold, gross margin, operating expenditure, and operating profit against approved targets.
* Prepare and manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and financial performance reviews in partnership with Finance.
* Analyze product, customer, channel, and territory profitability and implement actions to improve the quality of earnings.
* Govern pricing, discounts, trade schemes, and promotional investments within delegated authority; obtain approvals for exceptions.
* Identify and address adverse variances in revenue, sales mix, margins, trade spending, and operating costs.
* Assess the commercial viability and financial return of new products, market expansion, headcount, and other business investments.
* Own business-level working capital outcomes in partnership with Finance and Supply Chain, including receivables, inventory, and cash conversion.

3. Sales and Retail Channel Development

* Lead delivery of sales targets through the sales team and distributor, dealer, and retail network.
* Develop territory coverage, distributor and retailer development plans, and channel productivity standards.
* Review primary and secondary sales, channel inventory, market reach, product availability, and repeat purchase trends.
* Lead strategic customer and channel partner relationships and support major negotiations and issue resolution.
* Ensure trade terms, incentives, and channel programs support profitable growth and comply with company policy.
* Conduct regular field reviews to assess execution quality, farmer demand, competitive activity, and channel effectiveness.

4. Product Portfolio and Marketing Direction

* Provide strategic direction to the Product Manager on portfolio priorities, positioning, pricing, launch plans, and marketing investments.
* Approve product and brand plans within delegated authority and ensure alignment with business growth and profitability objectives.
* Prioritize new product opportunities using customer needs, scientific differentiation, commercial potential, and financial feasibility.
* Review product lifecycle performance and decide on expansion, repositioning, rationalization, or discontinuation through the appropriate approval process.
* Oversee integrated marketing, farmer engagement, veterinary outreach, and channel activation programs.
* Ensure product claims, marketing communication, and promotional practices follow applicable requirements and internal review processes.

5. Forecasting, Supply Alignment, and Working Capital

* Own the commercial demand forecast and align Sales, Product Management, Finance, and Supply Chain on assumptions and priorities.
* Participate in demand and supply planning reviews to balance service levels, inventory investment, and business risk.
* Monitor stock availability, channel inventory, inventory aging, returns, and expiry exposure; drive timely corrective action.
* Ensure sales execution respects approved credit limits and terms, and drive collection accountability with Finance and Sales.
* Coordinate responses to supply constraints, product quality concerns, and customer service issues with the responsible functions.

6. Customer, Veterinary, and Farmer Engagement

* Build strategic relationships with distributors, retailers, veterinary professionals, dairy and livestock stakeholders, and key customers.
* Ensure farmer and customer insights inform business strategy, portfolio development, and field execution.
* Oversee technical and educational programs that support responsible product use and strengthen customer confidence.
* Establish clear processes for customer feedback, complaint escalation, technical support, and service recovery.
* Represent the business at relevant customer meetings, industry events, and strategic partnership discussions.

7. People Leadership and Organizational Capability

* Lead, coach, and develop the business team, including the Product Manager and sales leadership or sales team, as defined by the approved structure.
* Set measurable goals, review performance, and establish clear decision rights and cross-functional working practices.
* Build capability in commercial management, channel development, scientific selling, financial discipline, and customer engagement.
* Identify capability gaps and support recruitment, succession planning, talent development, and retention with HR.
* Create a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

8. Governance, Risk, and Continuous Improvement

* Ensure adherence to financial controls, approval limits, company policies, and applicable commercial and regulatory requirements.
* Identify and manage business risks, including customer concentration, credit exposure, channel conflict, supply disruption, and margin erosion.
* Work with Quality, Technical Services, and other responsible functions on product issues and business continuity responses.
* Improve reporting, business review processes, forecasting accuracy, and decision-making through reliable data.
* Maintain timely escalation of material risks, deviations, and investment requirements to senior leadership.

**Educational Qualification & Years of Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in
  **agriculture, Veterinary Science, Dairy Technology, Agribusiness**
  , or a related field (MBA is a strong plus) with
  **15–20 years of progressive experience in Sales,**
  Marketing, Business Development, or Commercial leadership and relevant experience in animal health, animal nutrition, livestock products, agricultural inputs, or a comparable retail-led business.
* At least
  **3–5 years in business leadership,**
  sales and marketing leadership, or a comparable role with demonstrable P&L responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience in distributor and retail channel management, team leadership, budgeting, pricing, and profitable business growth.
* Experience in the ruminant, dairy, or livestock sector is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional execution across product management, sales, marketing, technical services, and supply operations.

**Competencies - Skills required:**

Business and Financial

* P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Pricing, margin management, investment evaluation, and working capital discipline.
* Business strategy, market development, and resource allocation.

Commercial and Operational

* Sales leadership, distributor management, and retail channel development.
* Product portfolio strategy, marketing effectiveness, and customer relationship management.
* Demand planning, negotiation, execution management, and business risk assessment.

Leadership and Behavioral

* Strategic thinking, commercial judgment, and decisive problem-solving.
* People leadership, coaching, talent development, and accountability.
* Cross-functional influence, executive communication, ethical conduct, and change leadership.

Travel Requisite:

* Up to 50% of travel, domestically and internationally, as and when warranted

title: Fabric Sourcing Manager – Woven
description:
**Job Title: Fabric Sourcing Manager – Woven**

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Fabric Sourcing Manager – Woven**
to lead fabric sourcing, development, and vendor management for woven apparel categories.

This role will be responsible for ensuring the timely availability of high-quality woven fabrics while balancing
**cost, quality, lead time, and sustainability standards**
. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in woven fabrics, supplier management capabilities, and the ability to collaborate effectively across merchandising, design, production, and quality teams.

**Role Purpose**

The Fabric Sourcing Manager will drive the end-to-end woven fabric sourcing lifecycle — from development and approvals to bulk fabric execution — ensuring seamless alignment between buyer expectations, product requirements, and production timelines.

The role will play a critical part in strengthening vendor partnerships, improving sourcing efficiency, driving cost optimization, and ensuring consistent quality standards for international apparel manufacturing.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Fabric Sourcing & Development**

• Lead sourcing and development of woven fabrics, including cotton, linen, viscose, blends, sustainable materials, and specialty finishes.

• Coordinate fabric developments, lab dips, handlooms, strike-offs, and approvals in alignment with buyer and product requirements.

• Work closely with merchandising and product development teams to identify suitable fabric solutions for seasonal collections.

• Maintain and continuously update fabric libraries, shade cards, swatches, and development records.

• Ensure fabric innovations align with evolving UK, European, and global fashion trends.

**Vendor & Mill Management**

• Build and manage strong relationships with domestic and international fabric mills and suppliers.

• Evaluate supplier capabilities, quality standards, pricing competitiveness, and lead time reliability.

• Negotiate pricing, MOQ, payment terms, and delivery schedules to optimize sourcing efficiency.

• Monitor supplier performance and proactively resolve supply chain or quality-related challenges.

**Costing & Commercial Excellence**

• Drive cost optimization initiatives without compromising product quality and performance.

• Monitor trends in yarn pricing, dyeing, processing, and raw material costs.

• Support merchandising and costing teams with accurate fabric costing inputs and commercial feasibility.

title: Lead - Infrastructure and Security
description:
**Role Purpose**

Lead enterprise infrastructure and cybersecurity practices across Brakes India, with focus on secure, resilient and scalable technology foundations across plants and offices. The role will strengthen infrastructure reliability, cyber resilience, risk and compliance maturity, while building a strong understanding of 24x7 operations, facilities management services and multi-plant support so that broader operations responsibilities can be progressively transitioned over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy, Governance and Leadership**

* Define and execute the infrastructure and security strategy, roadmap, operating model and investment priorities aligned with business and IS objectives.
* Lead infrastructure, cybersecurity, risk, compliance and IAM teams with clear accountability and performance measures, while progressively building ownership of service operations and site support.
* Provide executive-level reporting on service reliability, cyber posture, material risks, audit status, resilience and improvement priorities.
* Develop team capability, succession plans and a culture of ownership, disciplined execution and continuous improvement.

**Enterprise Infrastructure and Operational Readiness**

* Own enterprise network and infrastructure services, including LAN, WAN, data centres, servers, cloud and hybrid platforms, storage, backup and end-user computing.
* Lead Microsoft 365 enterprise administration, including tenant administration, platform upkeep, collaboration services, licensing governance and administrative controls.
* Strengthen identity and access management as a critical capability, including Entra ID, access governance, privileged access, role-based access controls and periodic access reviews.
* Oversee endpoint administration, device governance and associated endpoint security management across plants and offices.
* Build operational readiness for facilities management services and 24x7 support, including monitoring, incident triage, escalation, site support and guidance to local IT coordinators.
* Drive lifecycle management, capacity planning, modernisation, standardisation, automation, cost optimisation and service management disciplines.

**Cybersecurity and Resilience**

* Define and execute the enterprise cybersecurity roadmap across IT, OT, endpoints, identity, networks, perimeter controls, cloud, applications, data and AI environments.
* Govern SOC operations, threat monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, patch governance, firewall and perimeter security controls, external attack-surface monitoring and remediation.
* Own cyber incident and crisis playbooks, disaster recovery strategy, backup and recovery controls, resilience drills and business continuity readiness.
* Embed security by design into technology architecture, digital programmes, manufacturing systems, cloud adoption and third-party services.
* Drive sustained maturity of security and infrastructure practices through continuous assessment, improvement roadmaps, control enhancement and adaptation to the evolving threat, compliance and technology landscape.

**Risk, Compliance and Assurance**

* Own the Information Security Management System (ISMS), enterprise technology risk register, control framework, policies, standards and evidence-based assurance.
* Maintain enterprise security, infrastructure and IT governance policies, standards and acceptable-use terms, ensuring timely review, approval, communication and formal sign-off.
* Lead TISAX readiness, assessments, closure of findings, label maintenance and ongoing alignment with automotive customer security expectations.
* Oversee ITGC, internal and external audits, statutory and customer assessments, non-conformity closure and sustained control effectiveness, ensuring we are always steadfast in internal and external security and compliance commitments.
* Govern third-party technology risk, security due diligence, contractual controls, licences, renewals and managed-service compliance.

**Application, OWASP and AI Security**

* Establish secure software development and application security practices aligned with OWASP principles, including threat modelling, secure design and code review, SAST/DAST, penetration testing and vulnerability remediation.
* Guide teams on OWASP Top 10, API security, authentication, session management, secrets management and protection of internet-facing applications.
* Define security practices for AI, Generative AI and agentic solutions, including data protection, identity and permissions, prompt-injection defence, model and supply-chain risk, logging, monitoring, human oversight and secure integration with enterprise systems.
* Assess AI vendors, models and solutions for security, privacy, data residency, access, auditability and operational resilience before deployment.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 20+ years of progressive experience across enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, IT operations, risk or compliance, including leadership of multi-disciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated experience in a multi-site manufacturing, automotive, engineering or similarly complex operational environment, with appreciation of plant-level IT support and local coordinator models.
* Hands-on strength in enterprise networks, hybrid cloud, Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID / identity and access management, endpoint administration, SOC operations, service management, disaster recovery, vendor governance and 24x7 support models.
* Experience with TISAX implementation, assessment and sustained compliance.
* Demonstrated strength in application security, OWASP practices and security assessment of modern web, API and cloud-native solutions.
* Practical experience leading or contributing to ISO/IEC 27001 certification is a bonus.
* Working knowledge of AI security and governance for Generative AI, enterprise copilots and agentic AI solutions.

**Qualifications and Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* Preferred certifications include CISSP or CISM; CISA, ITIL, CCSP, TOGAF, and relevant advanced cloud, network or infrastructure architecture certifications are advantageous.

**Leadership Attributes**

* Business-oriented technology leadership with strong judgement, structured problem solving and risk-based decision making.
* Ability to balance operational reliability, security, compliance, cost and transformation priorities.
* Clear executive communication, stakeholder influence and the ability to lead during incidents and periods of ambiguity.
* Strong ownership, integrity, customer focus, collaboration and people-development capability.

**Key Measures of Success**

* Availability, resilience and progressive maturity of critical infrastructure and security services; readiness to support broader operations transition over time.
* Timely detection, containment and remediation of cyber threats, incidents and high-risk vulnerabilities.
* Sustained TISAX, ITGC and customer-assessment readiness with timely closure of findings.
* Effective Microsoft 365 platform administration, IAM and privileged-access governance, endpoint administration, third-party risk governance and licence compliance.
* Delivery of modernisation and resilience priorities within approved budgets and measurable vendor SLAs.
* Growth in team capability, automation, operational discipline and stakeholder satisfaction.

**What the Role Offers**

An enterprise leadership role at the intersection of infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance and digital transformation, with the opportunity to build deep understanding of multi-location operational support and progressively take on broader technology operations responsibilities.

title: Cloud Services Manager (Container)
description:
Req ID: 142267
  
  
Remote Position: Hybrid
  
  
Region: Asia
  
  
Country: India
  
  
State/Province: Chennai
  
  
City: Guindy, Chennai
  
  
**Summary**
Seeking an execution-focused, technically proficient
**Manager of Cloud Services**
to lead the day-to-day engineering and operations of our multi-cloud ecosystem across
**AWS, Azure, and GCP**
. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cloud Architecture & Engineering, you will lead a dedicated squad of cloud, DevOps, and platform engineers tasked with translating high-level architecture designs into robust, production-grade deployments.
  
  
You will manage the implementation, maintenance, and reliability of our enterprise container platforms (GKE, AKS, OpenShift, and native Kubernetes), operationalize infrastructure for AI models and agentic workflows, and drive hands-on GitOps and IaC practices. This is an active, technical leadership role requiring direct participation in code reviews, pipeline automation, disaster recovery execution, and operational support.
  
  
Detailed Description
  
  
Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Blueprint Execution: Translate multi-cloud architectural frameworks into production-ready infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Container Environment Provisioning: Implement and standardize cluster topologies across Red Hat OpenShift, GKE, AKS, and upstream Kubernetes per architectural guidelines.
* AI Runtime Infrastructure: Deploy and support execution infrastructure for machine learning and agentic AI systems (e.g., configuring GPU/TPU nodes, model serving runtimes like vLLM/Triton, vector database clusters, and secure runtime sandboxes for agent execution).
* IaC Authoring & Review: Write, review, and maintain production Terraform modules, Helm charts, and raw Kubernetes/Kustomize manifests.
* GitOps Delivery: Manage and optimize automated GitOps pipelines using ArgoCD or Flux to ensure version-controlled, continuous deployments across staging and production clusters.
* Internal Platform Enablement: Maintain CI/CD pipelines, container registries, and self-service templates enabling software engineering and data science teams to deploy microservices smoothly.
* Cluster Lifecycle Execution: Coordinate and execute rolling cluster version upgrades, worker node pool patching, and OS maintenance across multi-cloud Kubernetes fleets with zero service disruption.
* Capacity & FinOps Tracking: Monitor resource consumption, configure cluster autoscalers (KEDA, Karpenter), implement pod resource quotas, and track daily compute costs across cloud providers.
* Vulnerability & Compliance Remediation: Enforce container base image hardening, automate CVE scanning (Trivy, Grype), and ensure runtime admission controllers (OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno) adhere to enterprise standards.
* Backup Automation: Implement, test, and manage automated backup routines for Kubernetes cluster states and persistent storage using tools such as Velero or Kasten.
* Model & Artifact Protection: Ensure secure, regular backups and snapshot validation for persistent AI datasets, model weights, and state stores.
* Incident Management & Escalations: Serve as an operational escalation point for L2/L3 production incidents, directing troubleshooting for container, network, and cloud outages.
* Telemetry Operations: Manage centralized logging, metrics, and tracing stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), configuring actionable alerting rules and dashboards.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Lead post-incident retrospectives, track action items to resolution, and implement self-healing automations to avoid recurrence.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  

* Multi-Cloud Administration: Hands-on operational experience with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (VPC/VNet configuration, IAM roles, cloud storage, security groups).
* AI & Agentic Workload Enablement: Practical experience deploying and managing infrastructure supporting AI/LLM workloads, containerized inference runtimes, or AI agent toolsets.
* Infrastructure as Code & Templating: Advanced proficiency writing and maintaining Terraform code, Helm charts, and native Kubernetes manifests.
* GitOps & Automation: Practical experience configuring and debugging GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux) and CI platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* Observability: Strong working knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry collectors, and centralized log aggregation tools.
* Leadership: Proven track record of managing technical teams and delivering enterprise cloud infrastructure services.

Physical Demands
  
  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Typical Experience
  
  

* 7 to 10 years of relevant IT experience that shows consistent progression, and at least 5 years hands-on technology and team leadership experience.

Typical Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational requirements may vary by geography.
* Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

+ Certifications:

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
- Associate or Professional Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect/SysOps, Azure Administrator, GCP Cloud Engineer)

Notes
  
  
This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**Procurement Manager**

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

**Company:**
IRISS, Inc.

**Department:**
Operations, Procurement and Supply Chain

Website: IRISS | YouTube: IRSS

**About the Role**

IRISS is seeking an experienced, results-driven Procurement Manager to lead procurement and supply chain planning for our manufacturing operations in Chennai, India.

This position is responsible for strategic sourcing, purchasing, supplier development, production scheduling, material requirements planning (MRP), capacity planning, and inventory management. The Procurement Manager will play a critical role in supporting manufacturing operations, ensuring material availability, controlling costs, and maintaining reliable production and customer delivery schedules.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in manufacturing procurement, supplier negotiations, production planning, and supply chain optimization. This individual will collaborate with Production, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Sales, and global IRISS teams to establish efficient procurement processes, develop supplier relationships, and support continued operational growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Sourcing and Procurement**

* Develop and implement sourcing strategies for raw materials, fabricated parts, purchased components, equipment, and manufacturing services.

* Identify, evaluate, and develop qualified local and international suppliers.

* Lead supplier negotiations, RFQs, competitive bidding, and purchasing agreements.

* Evaluate supplier pricing, lead times, quality, capacity, and overall commercial competitiveness.

* Develop local sourcing strategies to reduce costs, lead times, and supply chain risks.

* Support manufacturing expansion, new product introductions, and equipment procurement.

**Supplier Management and Cost Optimization**

* Establish supplier qualification, onboarding, and performance evaluation processes.

* Monitor supplier performance related to quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness.

* Develop supplier scorecards and implement corrective action plans.

* Identify cost reduction opportunities through negotiations, value engineering, and supplier development.

* Maintain strong supplier relationships while developing alternate sources for critical materials.

* Track procurement savings, cost improvements, and supplier performance metrics.

**Production Planning and Scheduling**

* Develop and maintain daily and weekly manufacturing production schedules.

* Coordinate production planning based on customer demand, available materials, equipment capacity, and staffing.

* Monitor production schedules, work orders, and manufacturing priorities.

* Identify production bottlenecks and develop recovery plans to minimize delays.

* Collaborate with Production and Sales to support achievable customer delivery commitments.

**Material Requirements and Inventory Management**

* Manage material requirements planning (MRP) to support manufacturing operations.

* Monitor inventory levels, material shortages, purchase orders, and supplier deliveries.

* Establish appropriate safety stock levels, reorder points, and purchasing parameters.

* Reduce excess inventory, obsolete materials, and unnecessary purchasing costs.

* Maintain accurate inventory and purchasing information within the ERP system.

* Coordinate with Logistics, Stores, and Finance to resolve material and purchasing discrepancies.

**Capacity Planning and Supply Chain Coordination**

* Develop short-term and long-term manufacturing capacity plans.

* Evaluate labor, equipment, supplier capacity, and material availability against production demand.

* Support Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) processes.

* Identify supply chain risks and develop contingency plans.

* Coordinate purchasing, production, and inventory planning to support manufacturing efficiency.

**Procurement Systems and Process Improvement**

* Establish standardized purchasing procedures, approval processes, and procurement controls.

* Maintain accurate supplier information, purchasing records, and ERP system data.

* Improve procurement workflows, reporting, and purchasing efficiency.

* Support ERP implementation, system improvements, and employee training.

* Ensure compliance with company purchasing policies, ethical sourcing practices, and applicable commercial requirements.

**Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead, develop, and support assigned buyers and production planners.

* Establish team priorities, performance expectations, and training requirements.

* Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and global IRISS teams.

* Provide procurement, inventory, and supply chain performance updates to plant leadership.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and supply chain operations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Supply Chain Management, Materials Management, Business, or a related discipline.

* 8–12 years of experience in manufacturing procurement and supply chain planning.

* Minimum 3 years of experience leading procurement, supply chain activities, or a team.

* Demonstrated experience developing suppliers and managing procurement and planning systems in India.

* Strong experience in strategic sourcing, supplier negotiations, purchasing, and supplier relationship management.

* Experience with material requirements planning (MRP), production scheduling, capacity planning, and inventory management.

* Proficiency in ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, and procurement reporting.

* Knowledge of Indian purchasing practices, import coordination, and commercial documentation.

* Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across departments.

* Ability to travel to supplier locations as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.

* Experience procuring fabricated parts, electrical products, polymers, or industrial components.

* Experience supporting new manufacturing facilities or manufacturing expansion projects.

* Experience with NetSuite ERP.

* CIPS or CPSM professional certification.

* Knowledge of supplier localization, cost reduction, and supply chain risk management.

* Experience supporting SIOP and manufacturing capacity planning.

* Tamil language proficiency.

**Why Join IRISS?**

IRISS is a global manufacturer of innovative electrical safety, reliability, and asset monitoring solutions.

As we continue developing our manufacturing operations in Chennai, this position offers the opportunity to establish procurement and supply chain processes, develop strategic supplier relationships, and contribute directly to the growth and success of our India operations.

We are seeking individuals who demonstrate strong leadership, accountability, analytical thinking, and a commitment to operational excellence.

**Compensation:**
Competitive and commensurate with experience.

title: MS-FDL-Senior Manager-Platform Engineering Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Senior Manager – Platform Engineering**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Platform Engineering to lead the strategy, engineering, and operations of a scalable enterprise platform supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines platform architecture, engineering execution, and people leadership, with accountability for secure, reliable, and cost-efficient shared capabilities. The ideal candidate will enable application and data engineering teams through self-service infrastructure, standardized delivery workflows, and a strong developer experience, supporting finance transformation solutions across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will own the platform engineering roadmap, delivery governance, and team development, partnering with product, architecture, security, and business leaders to improve engineering productivity and deliver measurable business outcomes across client engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Technology & Architecture Leadership**

* Own the platform engineering strategy and architecture roadmap, aligning cloud infrastructure, shared services, and modernization priorities with business and product goals.
* Lead the design and evolution of secure, resilient cloud-native platforms, including container orchestration, networking, identity, secrets management, and standardized environments.
* Establish engineering standards, reference architectures, infrastructure-as-code patterns, and automated guardrails for consistent provisioning and operation of platform services.
* Enable application, data, and AI/ML workloads through reusable platform capabilities, APIs, integration patterns, and scalable compute and storage services.
* Own CI/CD and release engineering capabilities, including automated testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment strategies, and rollback readiness.
* Provide technical leadership for critical incidents, architectural reviews, and complex engineering decisions; drive root-cause analysis and durable corrective actions.

**Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Lead delivery planning and governance across platform workstreams, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and commitments against agreed business outcomes.
* Embed agile, DevOps, and SRE practices, including service ownership, observability, on-call readiness, incident response, and tested disaster recovery.
* Define and track service-level indicators and objectives, agreed SLAs, and engineering delivery metrics to improve reliability, deployment performance, and recovery times.
* Drive capacity planning, performance optimization, and FinOps practices; manage platform budgets and vendors to improve cost efficiency without compromising reliability.
* Partner with security and governance teams to embed access controls, vulnerability remediation, auditability, data protection, and compliance requirements into platform operations.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale multidisciplinary platform engineering teams spanning cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, and automation; develop engineering managers and technical leads.
* Build a high-performance, inclusive engineering culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable outcomes.
* Own workforce planning, hiring, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with the platform roadmap.
* Coach managers and engineers on technical judgment, execution discipline, stakeholder engagement, and career growth; delegate effectively while maintaining accountability.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with product teams, enterprise architects, security leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, and clients to translate business needs into platform priorities.
* Balance platform investment, delivery capacity, risk, and business value; align stakeholders on trade-offs, service expectations, and measurable outcomes.
* Support solutioning, proposals, and client discussions with platform architecture, delivery estimates, operating models, and cost considerations.
* Communicate roadmap progress, investment needs, service health, delivery risks, and business impact clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Platform & Product Mindset**

* Manage the platform as an internal product, using developer feedback and adoption metrics to prioritize capabilities that reduce friction and accelerate delivery.
* Build self-service workflows, reusable infrastructure modules, service catalogs, and standardized delivery paths with clear documentation and onboarding.
* Measure platform value through adoption, developer satisfaction, onboarding time, delivery lead time, and reduced operational toil; enable secure analytics and AI use cases.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or SRE, including substantial architecture and delivery ownership.
* 5+ years of engineering people-management experience, with a demonstrated track record of leading multiple teams and developing engineering managers or technical leads.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity, security, resilience, and cloud operating models.
* Strong expertise in cloud-native architecture, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform), and automated environment provisioning.
* Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, observability, and automation using relevant tools and languages (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, OpenTelemetry, Python, or Go).
* Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and shared platform services; experience enabling data platforms and integration workloads.
* Experience with secure-by-design engineering, identity and access management, secrets management, software supply-chain security, and enterprise governance.

title: Assistant Manager /Deputy Manager Operations (Kochi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Kolkata)
description:
Matrimony.com Limited is India’s first pure-play consumer internet company to be publicly listed, known for its leadership in online matchmaking and marriage services. Its flagship brand, BharatMatrimony, is recognized as the largest and most trusted matrimony brand, complemented by EliteMatrimony and CommunityMatrimony. The company delivers services through websites, mobile sites, mobile apps, and over 130 company-owned retail outlets across India. Matrimony.com is certified as a Great Place to Work®, reflecting its focus on employee satisfaction and an inclusive workplace culture. Building on its strong matchmaking foundation, the company is expanding into the large, unorganized marriage services market with WeddingBazaar and Mandap.com, aiming to become a billion-dollar revenue organization.

About the Role

The Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager will oversee end-to-end Wedding Gift Box operations across the assigned state, covering lead allocation, telecalling, appointment scheduling, delivery execution, inventory management and MIS reporting.

The role is responsible for ensuring timely customer contact, improving appointment-to-delivery conversion, maintaining adequate stock and driving productivity across telecalling and field delivery teams.

Location-wise Requirements

Candidates should be willing to work from the respective state headquarters and travel within the assigned state as required.

* **Andhra Pradesh:**
  Proficiency in Telugu and English.
* **Telangana:**
  Proficiency in Telugu and English; knowledge of Hindi would be an advantage.
* **Karnataka:**
  Proficiency in Kannada and English.
* **Tamil Nadu:**
  Proficiency in Tamil and English.
* **Kerala:**
  Proficiency in Malayalam and English.
* **West Bengal:**
  Proficiency in Bengali and English; knowledge of Hindi would be an advantage.

Familiarity with local geography, delivery routes and experience managing teams across the respective state will be an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Management and Telecalling**

* Allocate daily leads to the telecalling team and ensure customers are contacted within defined timelines.
* Track lead statuses, including contacted, appointment fixed, follow-up, not interested and closed.
* Monitor appointments fixed by each telecaller and track appointment-to-delivery conversion.
* Review pending and uncontacted leads and ensure timely follow-up.
* Monitor calling quality and individual productivity, providing regular feedback and coaching.
* Ensure customer consent, delivery address, contact details and appointment preferences are captured accurately.

**2. Appointment and Delivery Management**

* Assign confirmed appointments to delivery executives based on location, route, workload and availability.
* Determine direct or courier delivery in line with approved serviceability and delivery guidelines.
* Coordinate packing, dispatch and courier handover with the relevant teams.
* Track assigned, completed, pending, rescheduled and unsuccessful deliveries.
* Coordinate with courier/3PL partners to resolve delays, failed delivery attempts and returns.
* Ensure proof of delivery and delivery statuses are updated accurately and promptly.
* Handle customer escalations and coordinate timely resolution.

**3. Field Team Supervision**

* Supervise field executives across locations within the assigned state.
* Track attendance, availability, appointments assigned and attended, successful deliveries, productivity and utilisation.
* Conduct daily reviews to communicate priorities, address operational challenges and clear pending cases.
* Ensure adherence to planned routes, appointment schedules and operating procedures.
* For Tamil Nadu operations, ensure Wedassist services are introduced to every WGB customer and customer requirements are recorded.

**4. Inventory and Stock Management**

* Maintain accurate stock records for Wedding Gift Boxes, brand vouchers, product samples and packing materials.
* Monitor brand-wise and location-wise stock receipts, consumption and balances.
* Initiate replenishment requests before inventory reaches critical levels.
* Coordinate with internal teams and designated brand contacts for replenishment and stock movement.
* Conduct periodic physical stock checks and reconcile discrepancies.
* Monitor voucher validity and product expiry, where applicable.

**5. MIS and Performance Reporting**

* Prepare daily reports on lead allocation, telecalling productivity and appointments.
* Maintain delivery reports covering completed, pending, rescheduled and unsuccessful cases.
* Track direct and courier deliveries separately.
* Prepare field executive performance and location-wise delivery reports.
* Maintain brand-wise inventory and replenishment reports.
* Submit monthly MIS highlighting performance, operational gaps and corrective actions.
* Analyse data to improve conversion, delivery efficiency and team productivity.

Experience and Skills

* Relevant experience in telecalling operations, field operations, logistics, delivery management or customer service operations.
* Prior experience supervising teams and coordinating operations across multiple locations.
* Strong planning, follow-up and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Working knowledge of inventory control, dispatch processes and courier operations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables and lookup formulas, and experience using CRM systems.
* Ability to analyse lead conversion, delivery performance and team productivity.
* Good communication skills in English and the relevant regional language.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage customer escalations.
* Ability to work towards defined targets and ensure timely execution.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Lead Contact Rate:**
  Percentage of allocated leads contacted within the defined timeline.
* **Appointment Fixing Rate:**
  Appointments fixed against leads contacted.
* **Appointment-to-Delivery Conversion:**
  Successful deliveries against confirmed appointments due during the reporting period.
* **Delivery Completion Rate:**
  Completed deliveries against assigned deliveries due during the reporting period.
* **On-Time Delivery Rate:**
  Percentage of deliveries completed within the committed timeline.
* **Telecaller Productivity:**
  Calls completed, appointments fixed and resulting deliveries per telecaller.
* **Field Executive Productivity:**
  Appointments attended and deliveries completed per executive.
* **Pending Deliveries:**
  Number and ageing of pending, rescheduled and unsuccessful deliveries.
* **Stock Availability:**
  Availability of required gift boxes, brand vouchers, products and packing materials.
* **Inventory Accuracy:**
  Accuracy of physical stock against recorded stock balances.
* **Stock Replenishment:**
  Timely replenishment to prevent stock-outs and delivery interruptions.
* **Reporting Adherence:**
  Accuracy and timely submission of daily and monthly reports.
* **Wedassist Pitch Coverage – Tamil Nadu Only:**
  Percentage of WGB customers introduced to Wedassist, with customer requirements recorded.

title: Store Manager
description:
**KAG Tiles, an established Indian tile brand headquartered in Chennai, is opening a chain of beauty and wellness showrooms in the city.**

We are looking for Store Managers to run them from the first day. A new showroom, a new team, and a group behind you that has been in business a long time.

**Reports to Head of Operations · one showroom in Chennai · 4 to 8 years**

Run one showroom completely. The team, the stock, the equipment, the numbers, and the standard of care every user receives.

**The work**

• Open and close the showroom. Cash, banking, daily reconciliation and the daily report

• Lead the beauty advisors. Roster, attendance, coaching on the floor, and their development

• Own the targets for footfall, conversion, basket and repeat visits

• Stock. Counts, indents, shelf availability, expiry control and shrinkage

• Look after the analysis equipment. Cleaning, calibration schedule, service calls, custody

• Handle complaints yourself, and keep the showroom clean, lit and presentable at every open hour

**• Hold the advice-first standard.**

No pressure selling, nothing recommended that a user does not need. A condition of the job, not a preference

**What we are looking for**

• 4 to 8 years in retail, at least 2 running a showroom or as a senior supervisor

• Beauty, cosmetics, pharmacy, eyewear, apparel or similar organised retail

• Has handled a team of four or more, and can say what happened to them afterwards

• Comfortable with a tablet, a billing system and a user record system. We work on screens, not registers

• Fluent Tamil, working English, and patience with people who ask a lot of questions

• Six-day week, retail hours, weekends and festival days worked

**What we offer**

• Fixed salary with an incentive on showroom and team results. We do not pay product-wise commission

• Full training on the equipment and the consultation process, with certification, and first claim on senior roles as the chain grows

team.

This is for a role as Application Support Manager within India CoE BNP Leasing solution APS.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly motivated and skilled candidate to join a very dynamic company and work in an exciting environment.

The team’s scope will be expanded in the future beyond the first set of activities described depending on business applications needs and the overall BNP Paribas IT organization.

· Manage a team of 18+ resources with the help of N-1’s

· Enhance & manage existing scripts/process as per BPLS APS Standards.

· Support for the various BPLS IT teams regarding BAU issues.

· Documentations, process definition, stakeholder management

· Hands on manager with 50% on Production and 50% on management to start with

· Help build team spirit and integrate into BNP Paribas culture.

· Strong Knowledge of ITIL

· Linux

· Familiarity with database technology is required: Oracle and SQL Server

· Good written and spoken English.

· Measure and identify areas for improving Quality and overall Delivery.

· Able to communicate efficiently.

**Behavioral Skills:**

o Excellent Communications

Graduate & Above

**Location:**
Mumbai (TN)

**About BNP Paribas Group:**

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center.
