title: FSRC-R and CT-RCT-PYTHON-AML-KYC-FRAUD-MANAGER
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Manager – Data, Cloud & AI Engineering**
**Manager – Technology Consulting**
**Experience: Strictly 8+ years**
**Mandatory eligibility:**
Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes.
* Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments.
* Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components.
* Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps.
* Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations.
* Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization.
* Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations.
* Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities.

**Deliverable ownership**

* Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support.
* Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting.
* Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions.
* Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders.
* Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries.

**Team management and leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists.
* Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support.
* Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication.
* Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.
* Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support.
* AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring.
* Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms.

**Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls.

**AI leadership expectations**

* Identify and prioritize AI use cases for alert triage, investigation support, entity resolution, anomaly detection, document analysis, quality assurance, and engineering productivity.
* Ensure human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias assessment, auditability, model-risk alignment, and appropriate use of regulated data.
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and monitoring for accuracy, grounding, latency, reliability, operational risk, and business value.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code, testing, documentation, and analysis while maintaining review and security controls.

**Good to have**

* Actimize: Experience delivering, enhancing, integrating, or supporting NICE Actimize solutions for Transaction Monitoring, AML, sanctions, fraud, alerting, or case management.
* SAS: Experience with SAS programming, SAS AML, SAS Fraud Management, analytics workflows, data preparation, or migration and modernization initiatives.
* Exposure to Spark, Databricks, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent modern data and DevOps tooling.
* Experience supporting proposals, commercial estimates, statements of work, delivery financials, and senior client presentations.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 8+ years of relevant professional experience in technology delivery, software or data engineering, cloud, AI, analytics, or Financial Crime Technology.
* Leadership: Demonstrated ownership of complex deliverables and experience managing multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholders.
* Mandatory combination: Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and practical experience across the Financial Crime Compliance domain are required.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Predictable delivery with clear ownership, transparent governance, controlled risk, strong quality, and timely stakeholder decisions.
* Scalable Python, SQL, cloud, and AI solutions aligned to Financial Crime controls and operational needs.
* A high-performing team with clear accountability, stronger capability, and sustainable delivery practices.
* Client confidence built through technical credibility, concise communication, proactive escalation, and measurable outcomes.

**What Working At EY Offers**
You will lead meaningful Financial Crime Technology assignments in an interdisciplinary environment that values quality, practical learning, collaboration, responsible innovation, and knowledge exchange. The role provides opportunities to shape client outcomes while growing teams and capability across data engineering, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance.
  
  
Apply only if you meet the 8+ years requirement and all mandatory technical, leadership, and domain criteria.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Technology & Innovation Leader
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Sr. Technology & Innovation Leader**

**Role-**
Sr: Technology & Innovation Leader

**Practice:**
Travel, Transportation & Hospitality (TTH)

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Experience:**
20+ years in TTH domain with at least 10+ years in leadership, solution and Sales

**About the Role**

Leads the technology engine of TTH Unit — turns the growth agenda into working solutions, reference architectures and accelerators. The technical authority in the room and behind the offer: the engine room to the growth front of house.

Work with Geo, Account and Growth leaders towards strategic account growth, new-logo acquisition, industry solutions, executive relationships and AI-led transformation opportunities.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the technical solution and architecture on strategic pursuits — make each solution credible, feasible and genuinely differentiated.
* Bring deep AI and modernization expertise (agentic, GenAI, legacy-to-modern) into client-ready constructs.
* Build the reusable accelerators, prototypes and products — show and tell, not slideware.
* Leverage the zero-friction enterprise platforms and the Data & AI horizontal; own the technical IP and accelerator roadmap.

* Provide architecture assurance and technical credibility through to close; set the technical foundation for a clean delivery hand-off.
* Recruit, mentor, coach, and develop account leaders, sales executives, consultants, solution architects, and delivery leaders.
* Establish clear accountability, growth goals, and client-centric execution standards.
* Represent Hexaware at major industry events

**What You Bring**

**Must have**

* 20+ years of Technology leadership experience across Travel, Transportation, Hospitality domain for Technology Services.
* Deep industry expertise across airlines, airports, logistics, transportation, hospitality, travel technology platforms, loyalty businesses, or related sectors.
* Experience leading large, complex digital transformation and managed services engagements.
* Strong understanding of AI, cloud, data, analytics, digital engineering, cybersecurity, and modernization services.
* Executive-level communication and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite stakeholders.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed teams.
* Experience scaling an industry vertical within a technology services or consulting organization.
* Existing relationships with major TTH industry executives.
* Strong analyst, advisor, and partner ecosystem relationships.
* Experience leading AI and data transformation initiatives from strategy through value realization.
* Own the technical solution and architecture on strategic pursuits — make each solution credible, feasible and genuinely differentiated.
* Bring deep AI and modernization expertise (agentic, GenAI, legacy-to-modern) into client-ready constructs.
* Build the reusable accelerators, prototypes and products — show and tell, not slideware.
* Leverage the zero-friction enterprise platforms and the Data & AI horizontal; own the technical IP and accelerator roadmap.
* Supply the technical POVs and working proofs that create demand; co-author the technical half of the “why Hexaware” narrative.
* Provide architecture assurance and technical credibility through to close; set the technical foundation for a clean delivery hand-off.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA strongly preferred.

**Who You Are**

* **Self-driven.**
  You do not wait to be told what to do. You see what a pursuit needs and go get it done.
* **A fast learner.**
  You can pick up a new plan, a new solution area, or a new technology quickly and speak to it with confidence.
* **A problem solver.**
  You enjoy untangling messy client problems and finding practical answers.
* **A practitioner.**
  Clients trust you because you have lived their problems, not just read about them and also, you understand how airlines, logistics providers, hospitality brands, and transportation organizations operate.
* **Commercial Builder.**
  You love creating growth, building pipelines, winning deals, and scaling businesses.
* **A team player.**
  You bring together sales, consulting, technology, delivery, and partner teams to achieve common goals.
* **Trusted Advisor.**
  Clients rely on your judgment because you understand both business and technology outcomes.
* **Strategic Thinker.**
  You can connect long-term industry trends with practical client solutions.
* **Talent Magnet.**
  You attract, develop, and retain exceptional leaders.

**What Success Looks Like in the First Year**

* Development of a stronger industry leadership bench and go-to-market capability.
* A growing accelerator / IP library and its reuse across pursuits.
* Technical contribution to win-rate; solution feasibility and differentiation.
* Time-to-prototype; strength of the show-and-tell in front of customers.
* Significant growth in TTH bookings, revenue, and qualified pipeline.
* Expansion of key strategic accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
* Acquisition of new enterprise logos.
* Increased adoption of AI-led and digital transformation services.
* Strong executive relationships across priority clients.
* Improved client satisfaction and executive sponsorship scores.
* Increased analyst and market visibility for Hexaware's TTH practice.

**Why Hexaware**

Hexaware is a global technology and business services company focused on AI-first transformation. Across Travel, Transportation & Hospitality, we help organizations modernize customer experiences, optimize operations, unlock the value of data, and accelerate innovation through cloud, AI, engineering, and digital solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to lead one of Hexaware's most strategic growth sectors, influence industry transformation at scale, and build a high-impact business backed by a global delivery and innovation ecosystem.

title: TC - CS - IAM - CyberArk - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM-**
**PAM Senior**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects and support practice build
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 5-7 years of experience in installing and implementing PAM solutions like CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Thycotic, Conjur/Hashicorp Vault
* Experience using Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and knowledge of Application container tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Image Registries
* Experience in integration of Conjur/Hashicorp Vault with enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, and DevOps application (Jenkins, Ansible etc) will be an added advantage
* Experience in managing Windows/Linux environments and Database (PostgreSQL ideal)
* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**

* Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
* Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Manager-Quality

Hydraulic Power Packs, Hydraulic Piston Accumulators, Hydraulic Cylinders

Ensure that the Quality Management system processes are established, implemented, and maintained.

Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track Quality performance and identify areas for improvement.

Take active role in supplier development activities.

Bachelors degree in mechanical engineering

Strong leadership and team management skills

Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities

title: Assistant Manager - IT Operations & Infrastructure
description:

Senior Server Engineer – IT Operations & Infrastructure

Provide L3 support and technical ownership for servers (Windows & Linux), SAN/storage (HPE), virtualization (VMware/KVM) and cloud (AWS) platforms. Lead project upgrades, migrations and technology refreshes.

* Administer Windows Server & Linux environments at enterprise scale.
* VMware ESXi/vSphere administration including all cluster/HA/DR features; KVM administration for Linux virtualization.

* Plan & execute infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh initiatives.
* Author documentation: HLD/LLD, SOP, runbooks; assist audit & compliance (SOX, PCI, ISO 27001 as applicable).

* 4–8 years in enterprise server & storage environments, VMware VCP 6.x/7.x, AWS (Associate level experience), strong scripting (PowerShell/Shell).
* Deep knowledge of SAN/LUN management on HPE systems, VMware cluster design, Windows/Linux patching.
* Experience in backup software and cloud security domains.
* Troubleshooting / RCA skills for complex multi-tier applications.

**Preferred Certifications & Qualifications**

* VMware VCP or VCAP
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator (Associate)
* RHCSA/RHCE or Microsoft MCSA/MCSE
* ITIL Foundation

**Competencies**

* Strong analytical & problem-solving skills
* Leadership & mentoring ability
* Effective communication across teams
* Ownership-driven attitude

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to Server Team Lead; provides technical guidance to Server Engineers.

***Global Precision Manufacturing Technology Partner***
*.*

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking an experienced Cost & Estimation Manager**
to lead customer RFQ evaluations, product costing, quotation management, and cost optimization for aerospace precision-machined components. The role will drive estimation accuracy, pricing competitiveness, margin protection, and continuous improvement through strong collaboration with Sales, Engineering, Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Finance teams.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. RFQ & Quotation Management**

* Lead end-to-end RFQ evaluation, cost estimation, and timely submission of competitive customer quotations.
* Ensure accurate costing based on technical drawings, specifications, material requirements, machining cycles, and special processes.
* Maintain pricing consistency, cost traceability, and adherence to approval procedures.

**2. Costing & Pricing Strategy**

* Develop and maintain robust cost models covering raw materials, machining, tooling, subcontracting, overheads, and other manufacturing costs.
* Establish and periodically review machine-hour rates, overhead absorption, and pricing assumptions with Finance.
* Ensure quotations align with manufacturing capabilities, market conditions, and target profit margins.

**3. Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with Sourcing/Purchase to validate supplier quotations, subcontracting costs, and material pricing.
* Collaborate with Sales and Engineering to assess RFQs, evaluate commercial risks, and improve quote-to-order conversion.
* Work closely with Manufacturing to validate cycle times, capacity assumptions, and process costs.

**4. Cost Performance & Margin Improvement**

* Monitor estimated versus actual costs for awarded parts and programs, identify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Review manufacturing cost trends, highlight inefficiencies, and recommend actions to protect and improve margins.
* Analyze quotation wins and losses to strengthen pricing accuracy and competitiveness.

**5. Continuous Improvement & Cost Reduction**

* Support Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven cost analysis.
* Identify opportunities to optimize material utilization, machining cycles, processes, and supplier costs.
* Track and validate cost savings and their impact on profitability.

**6. Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the costing team to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent RFQ execution.
* Standardize costing methodologies, estimation practices, and ERP discipline.
* Build strong cross-functional collaboration and a culture of cost ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Desired Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline; relevant cost accounting or finance qualifications are an advantage.
* Proven experience in cost estimation, product costing, and RFQ management within aerospace, precision machining, or high-precision manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of engineering drawings, machining processes, cycle-time estimation, raw materials, tooling, and special processes.
* Experience in cost modelling, pricing strategy, supplier cost analysis, and margin management.
* Proficiency in ERP systems, Excel-based costing models, and data analysis.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, communication, and team leadership skills.
* Exposure to AS9100 quality systems and aerospace customer requirements is preferred.
* Existing industry relationships in aerospace, aviation, or medical components would be an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* Opportunities to work with global customers and advanced precision manufacturing technologies.
* Professional development and career growth opportunities.
* A collaborative, performance-driven work environment.

**Ready to make an impact?**

Join TASE and play a pivotal role in strengthening pricing competitiveness, driving cost excellence, and supporting profitable growth in the global aerospace and precision manufacturing industry.

Category Manager - Global Professional Services Sourcing
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Category Manager - Global Professional Services Sourcing is accountable for developing and executing the global sourcing strategy for external professional services. The role partners with business, technology and functional stakeholders to shape demand, run competitive sourcing processes, negotiate strong commercial outcomes, establish fit-for-purpose contracts and statements of work, and improve supplier performance.
  
  
Category Scope
  
  
Consulting and advisory services; technology and engineering professional services; project-based services; implementation services; specialist services; staff augmentation for the indirect sourcing category where in scope; and related managed or outcome-based engagements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Category Strategy and Planning
  
  

* Develop, maintain and execute a global category strategy aligned with business priorities, technology roadmaps and financial objectives.
* Analyse spend, demand, supplier concentration, market dynamics, rate structures and regional delivery models to identify opportunities and risks.
* Build and manage a multi-year sourcing pipeline, including renewals, new requirements, consolidation initiatives and supplier transitions.
* Design preferred-supplier, panel and governance models that improve buying channels, transparency and control.

Strategic Sourcing and Negotiation
  
  

* Lead end-to-end RFIs, RFPs, RFQs and competitive negotiations for complex professional-services requirements.
* Partner with stakeholders to convert business needs into clear scopes, deliverables, evaluation criteria and commercial models.
* Develop supplier evaluation frameworks covering capability, delivery, commercials, risk, sustainability and cultural fit.
* Negotiate competitive rate cards, discounts, volume tiers, productivity commitments, payment terms, indexation, travel and expense rules, and other commercial protections.
* Recommend sourcing decisions using fact-based analyses, total-cost considerations and clearly documented trade-offs.

Contract and Statement of Work Governance
  
  

* Lead the commercial development and review of master agreements, statements of work, amendments and change requests in partnership with Legal and relevant control functions.
* Ensure each engagement has clear scope, deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, service levels, pricing, resource assumptions, governance and change-control provisions.
* Promote the appropriate use of fixed-price, milestone-based, time-and-materials, capacity, managed-service and outcome-based models.
* Identify and prevent scope ambiguity, uncontrolled change, rate leakage, weak acceptance provisions and inappropriate dependency on named resources.

Supplier and Performance Management
  
  

* Own commercial relationships with strategic professional-services suppliers and maintain effective executive-level engagement.
* Establish supplier scorecards, business reviews and improvement plans covering cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, innovation and contractual compliance.
* Lead or support resolution of supplier performance issues, commercial disputes and escalations.
* Drive supplier rationalisation, capability development and continuous improvement while maintaining appropriate competition and resilience.

Governance, Risk and Reporting
  
  

* Distinguish appropriately between professional services, staff augmentation, contingent labour, managed services and outsourced services, escalating classification or compliance concerns when required.
* Ensure sourcing activity follows company policies, delegated authority, competition requirements, data protection, information security and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain accurate reporting on spend under management, sourcing pipeline, contract and SOW expirations, savings, cost avoidance, risks, decisions and supplier issues.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement or category management, with substantial ownership of professional-services spend in a global or complex organisation.
* Demonstrated success leading complex RFx processes and negotiating high-value professional-services agreements and statements of work.
* Strong understanding of consulting, technology, engineering or other knowledge-based service delivery models, including onshore, nearshore and offshore structures.
* Proven ability to interpret rate cards, resource pyramids, utilisation assumptions, project economics and total cost of ownership.
* Experience managing strategic suppliers, performance reviews, improvement plans and commercial escalations.
* Strong contract and commercial acumen, with practical knowledge of scope, acceptance, service levels, change control, intellectual property, confidentiality, liability and termination concepts.
* Strong analytical capability and proficiency with spend, pipeline, savings and supplier-performance data.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, supply chain, technology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and work effectively with diverse stakeholders across functions, cultures, geographies and levels of seniority, adapting communication and influencing styles to achieve alignment and drive decisions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in technology, engineering, telecommunications, media, manufacturing or another multinational environment.
* Experience establishing preferred-supplier programmes, global rate cards, offshore delivery models or outcome-based services.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, contract lifecycle management, spend analytics and supplier-management platforms.
* Experience working across cultures, regions and time zones.
* MBA in related fields.

title: E-commerce Manager (Marketplaces) – Brand Growth
description:
About Thrise

Thrise is a full-stack Amazon growth agency and an Amazon Ads Verified Partner, based in Chennai. Since 2021 we have helped 30+ brands grow on Amazon India, US, UK and UAE — across kitchenware, paints, nutraceuticals, baby care, apparel and FMCG.

Our founders bring 13+ years of eCommerce experience, including 4 years inside Amazon India. Every account runs on our 3A Framework:
**Analysis, Assist, Accelerate**
. We work on a retainer-plus-revenue-share model, so we only win when our brands grow.

About the role

You will own the growth of 4–6 brand accounts on Amazon — their revenue, profitability and account health. This is not a back-office listing role. You are the brand's growth lead: you read the numbers, decide what to change, get it done with our ads and catalog team, and explain the results to the client.

If you have run Seller Central accounts end-to-end and want to own outcomes rather than tasks, this role is for you.

Key responsibilities

**Account growth and P&L**

* Own monthly sales, TACOS and contribution-margin targets for each assigned brand.
* Build and run a 90-day growth plan per account, reviewed monthly with the client.
* Plan sale events (Prime Day, Great Indian Festival, BAU deals), coupons and promotions.

**Advertising (with the PPC team)**

* Set ad strategy and budgets across Sponsored Products, Brands and Display.
* Review campaign performance weekly — ACOS, ROAS, search term harvesting, negatives, bids.
* Hand clear briefs to the PPC Manager and check that changes land.

**Catalog, pricing and account health**

* Keep listings conversion-ready: titles, bullets, A+ content, images, keywords, variations.
* Maintain the per-SKU price tracker (MRP, selling price, deal price, coupons, No Cost EMI) and check every price against profitability.
* Monitor account health, inventory and FBA stock levels; resolve cases, suppressions and policy issues through Seller Central and Seller Support.

**Client management**

* Be the main point of contact for your brands — weekly updates, monthly business reviews.
* Turn data into plain recommendations the client can act on.
* Spot upsell opportunities: new marketplaces (US, UK, UAE), Flipkart, quick commerce, creative services.

Must-have requirements

* 3–5 years hands-on with Amazon Seller Central (India) — listings, inventory, promotions, account health, cases.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Ads: campaign structure, match types, ACOS vs TACOS, bid and budget decisions.
* Proven growth story on at least one account — you can show the before and after numbers.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets: pivots, lookups, business reports, unit economics.
* Clear written and spoken English for client communication; Tamil is a plus.
* Comfortable owning a number and being accountable for it.

Good to have

* Agency experience managing multiple brands at once.
* Exposure to Amazon US, UK or UAE (Global Selling).
* Flipkart Seller Hub or quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) experience.
* Familiarity with ad tools such as AdLabs, Helium 10 or Jungle Scout.
* Category experience in nutraceuticals, home, beauty, baby care or FMCG.

description:

**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Data Operations & Technical Oversight**

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
* Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
* Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
* Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
* Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
* Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
* Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
* Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
* Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
* Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

As the Manager of Air Freight Export/Import Operations, your role involves overseeing and improving operational activities related to Air Freight Export/Import. Your primary focus will be aligning with the business strategy, which includes developing and implementing strategic plans to optimize export/import operations. **Preferred:**

title: Manager - Administration Facilities
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on and experienced Administration, Facilities & Business Operations Manager who can independently manage the complete administration and infrastructure function across multiple locations. This role will have end-to-end responsibility for office administration, facility management, IT asset lifecycle, vendor management, procurement, infrastructure development, office setup and new business hub setup. The person will work closely with the Founders, Functional Heads, Finance, HR, IT and Hub Managers to understand business requirements, plan resources, manage costs and ensure that every location has the infrastructure and support required to operate efficiently.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership from planning to execution — whether it is setting up a new office, opening a business hub, procuring equipment, negotiating with vendors, managing existing facilities or resolving an urgent operational issue.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Administration & Overall Office Management**

\* Take complete ownership of administrative operations across all company offices and business locations.

\* Manage day-to-day office requirements including housekeeping, security, pantry, office supplies, maintenance, transport and general workplace services.

\* Establish standard administrative processes, SOPs, checklists and service standards across all locations.

\* Ensure offices are well-maintained, organised, functional and equipped to meet business requirements.

\* Manage office seating, space allocation, meeting rooms, visitor management, access arrangements and general workplace infrastructure.

\* Oversee office expenses, petty cash, administrative purchases, maintenance requirements and service requests.

\* Ensure timely resolution of employee and business-related administrative requirements.

\* Maintain proper documentation of administrative activities, expenses, contracts, assets and service records.

**2. Multi-Location Administration & Hub Management**

\* Manage and monitor administrative and facilities operations across multiple locations.

\* Work closely with Hub Managers and location representatives to understand and fulfil administrative and infrastructure requirements.

\* Establish uniform administrative standards and operating procedures across all offices and hubs.

\* Conduct periodic reviews of each location to assess infrastructure, maintenance, housekeeping, security, assets and operational readiness.

\* Monitor location-wise expenses, vendor performance, asset utilisation and pending administrative requirements.

\* Ensure each hub operates within approved budgets and follows company policies.

\* Take ownership of resolving location-specific infrastructure and administrative challenges.

\* Develop centralised reporting mechanisms to track all locations and provide visibility to management.

\* Coordinate inter-location asset movement, transfers, replacements and procurement requirements.

**3. New Office Setup & Business Hub Expansion**

\* Take complete ownership of setting up new offices, business hubs, warehouses and operational facilities.

\* Understand business requirements and prepare infrastructure plans, resource requirements and setup budgets.

\* Identify suitable locations and coordinate with brokers, landlords, building management and relevant stakeholders.

\* Manage lease documentation, rental agreements, deposits, negotiations and handover coordination with Finance and management.

\* Plan office layouts, seating capacity, workstations, meeting rooms, storage areas, electrical requirements, internet connectivity and other infrastructure.

\* Coordinate civil work, interiors, electrical installations, networking, furniture, air conditioning, security systems and other setup activities.

\* Ensure all required equipment, furniture, internet, utilities and facilities are ready before business operations begin.

\* Coordinate procurement, installation, testing and commissioning of required infrastructure.

\* Manage office shifting, relocation, expansion and renovation projects.

\* Prepare project timelines, track execution and ensure setup is completed within approved budgets and timelines.

\* Conduct final readiness checks before handing over the facility to the respective business or Hub Manager.

**4. Facilities & Infrastructure Management**

\* Manage the complete upkeep and maintenance of office infrastructure across all locations.

\* Oversee electrical systems, air conditioning, UPS, DG backup, plumbing, internet connectivity, fire safety systems and other utilities.

\* Ensure preventive maintenance schedules are followed and breakdowns are addressed without affecting business operations.

\* Manage housekeeping, hygiene, pest control, drinking water, pantry services and workplace cleanliness.

\* Coordinate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), repairs, servicing and equipment replacement.

\* Monitor infrastructure utilisation and identify requirements for upgrades or expansion.

\* Coordinate with landlords, building management and external service providers for infrastructure-related issues.

\* Ensure uninterrupted availability of essential workplace facilities.

\* Identify potential infrastructure risks and resolve them proactively.

**5. IT Asset & Infrastructure Management**

\* Take ownership of the complete lifecycle of company IT assets including laptops, desktops, monitors, printers, networking equipment and accessories.

\* Plan IT asset requirements based on hiring, replacement, expansion and business needs.

\* Coordinate with the Technology team for laptop configurations, technical specifications, procurement and deployment.

\* Ensure assets are tagged, recorded and allocated to employees and respective locations.

\* Maintain a centralised IT asset register with purchase details, serial numbers, warranty, assigned employee, location and asset status.

\* Manage asset allocation, handover, recovery, repair, replacement, transfer and disposal.

\* Ensure laptops and other IT equipment are available before employee onboarding.

\* Coordinate asset recovery during employee exits and ensure proper handover documentation.

\* Track warranty periods, AMC renewals, repairs and replacements.

\* Coordinate with internal IT teams and external service providers for hardware, network, Wi-Fi, printers, CCTV, biometric systems and conferencing equipment.

\* Maintain records of software subscriptions, licences and renewals in coordination with the Technology team.

\* Conduct periodic physical asset audits and resolve discrepancies.

\* Ensure proper utilisation and accountability of company-owned IT assets.

**6. Procurement & Purchase Management**

\* Manage end-to-end procurement for office administration, facilities, IT assets and business infrastructure requirements.

\* Consolidate purchase requirements from functional heads, Hub Managers and business teams.

\* Understand actual business requirements before initiating purchases and ensure procurement aligns with approved budgets.

\* Identify suitable vendors, obtain quotations, compare pricing, evaluate quality and negotiate commercial terms.

\* Prepare purchase recommendations and coordinate management approvals.

\* Manage procurement of laptops, desktops, office furniture, appliances, electrical equipment, networking equipment, stationery, office supplies and other business requirements.

\* Coordinate business-related purchases for new hubs, office expansions and operational requirements.

\* Ensure timely delivery, installation and commissioning of purchased equipment.

\* Verify quality and quantity of materials received against approved purchase orders.

\* Maintain proper purchase records, quotations, approvals, invoices, delivery challans and warranty documents.

\* Coordinate with Finance for invoice verification, payment processing and vendor reconciliation.

\* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality or business requirements.

\* Avoid unnecessary purchases, duplicate procurement and underutilisation of company assets.

**7. Vendor Management & Commercial Negotiations**

\* Identify, evaluate, onboard and manage vendors across all locations.

\* Manage vendors for housekeeping, security, maintenance, IT hardware, internet, transport, pantry, office supplies, furniture, civil work and other business requirements.

\* Negotiate pricing, service scope, payment terms, delivery timelines and commercial conditions.

\* Ensure proper agreements, Statements of Work (SOWs), quotations and supporting documents are maintained.

\* Monitor vendor performance, service quality, delivery commitments and response timelines.

\* Conduct periodic vendor reviews and address service-related gaps.

\* Maintain a centralised vendor database with contact details, commercial terms, agreements and renewal dates.

\* Track AMC renewals, rental agreements, service contracts and other recurring commitments.

\* Verify vendor invoices against approved quotations, purchase orders and actual services delivered.

\* Build reliable vendor relationships across different cities to support business expansion.

\* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation and improved commercial terms.

**8. Budgeting, Cost Control & Financial Discipline**

\* Prepare annual budgets for administration, facilities, IT assets, infrastructure, maintenance and procurement.

\* Prepare location-wise budgets for existing and upcoming business hubs.

\* Track monthly expenses against approved budgets and report significant variances.

\* Evaluate purchase requirements based on business necessity, cost, quality and long-term utilisation.

\* Negotiate with vendors to achieve competitive pricing and better service terms.

\* Monitor recurring expenses such as rentals, electricity, internet, housekeeping, security, maintenance and AMCs.

\* Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs through better planning, asset reuse and vendor management.

\* Ensure purchases and administrative expenses follow the company’s approval process.

\* Prepare monthly MIS reports covering expenses, procurement, assets, vendor performance and infrastructure requirements.

**9. Workplace Safety, Security & Compliance**

\* Ensure all company offices and facilities maintain appropriate safety, hygiene and security standards.

\* Coordinate fire safety systems, emergency preparedness, evacuation drills and safety inspections.

\* Maintain relevant facility licences, certificates, inspection records and renewal documentation.

\* Coordinate with building management, landlords and external agencies for safety and infrastructure requirements.

\* Ensure security personnel follow established visitor management, access control and incident-reporting procedures.

\* Monitor housekeeping and workplace hygiene standards across locations.

\* Maintain records of incidents, inspections and corrective actions.

\* Escalate safety, security and compliance concerns to management without delay.

**10. Employee Workplace Experience & Business Support**

\* Ensure employees have a clean, safe, comfortable and functional working environment.

\* Address employee concerns related to facilities, seating, equipment, housekeeping and workplace services.

\* Coordinate infrastructure and administrative requirements for new joiners and employee movements.

\* Support HR and functional teams with office arrangements for leadership visits, manager meetings, training programmes and employee events.

\* Ensure meeting rooms, workstations and common areas are ready for use.

\* Gather feedback from employees and Hub Managers and take corrective action.

\* Ensure administrative support is responsive and business teams are not held up due to avoidable infrastructure or facility-related issues.

**11. Team Management, Process & MIS**

\* Manage and guide administrative staff, housekeeping teams, security personnel and location-level administrative representatives.

\* Define responsibilities, service expectations and performance standards for administrative teams and outsourced service providers.

\* Train Hub Managers and administrative representatives on company SOPs, asset management, vendor coordination and expense controls.

\* Develop centralised trackers for assets, procurement, vendors, expenses, facility issues and contract renewals.

\* Prepare periodic MIS reports for management.

\* Track pending requests, issue-resolution timelines, recurring problems and corrective actions.

\* Ensure proper documentation and accountability across all locations.

\* Provide management with timely updates on infrastructure risks, expansion requirements, cost optimisation and operational readiness.

**What We Expect From You:**

\*
**10+ years of experience in Administration, Facilities Management, IT Asset Management and multi-location operations.**

\* Experience managing multiple offices, hubs, warehouses or business locations.

\* Strong hands-on experience in setting up new offices, operational hubs and business facilities from scratch.

\* Experience in procurement, vendor identification, commercial negotiations and contract management.

\* Good understanding of IT assets, hardware procurement, inventory management and asset lifecycle.

\* Experience managing administrative and infrastructure budgets across multiple locations.

\* Ability to coordinate with Founders, Functional Heads, Finance, HR, Technology and Hub Managers.

\* Strong understanding of office infrastructure, facilities maintenance, safety and workplace management.

\* Experience in start-ups, healthcare, e-commerce, logistics or other fast-growing organisations will be preferred.

\* Good knowledge of Excel, MIS reporting, ERP, procurement and asset management systems.

\* Strong communication, negotiation, planning and problem-solving skills.

\* Willingness to travel to different company locations as required.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role:**

\* All company offices and hubs are operationally ready and well-maintained.

\* New office and hub setups are completed within approved budgets and timelines.

\* Employees receive timely administrative and infrastructure support.

\* IT and non-IT assets are properly tracked, utilised and accounted for.

\* Vendor services meet agreed quality and cost expectations.

\* Procurement is planned, transparent and cost-effective.

\* Administrative processes are standardised across all locations.

\* Infrastructure issues are resolved proactively without disrupting business operations.

\* Management has clear visibility of administrative costs, assets, vendors and infrastructure requirements.

title: NPD - Service Manager (Kitchen Appliances)
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Service Manager - Appliances to manage after-sales service, product defect verification, warranty claims, replacements, and vendor coordination for our appliance category. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in home or kitchen appliances and be capable of identifying product defects, validating customer complaints, coordinating with vendors for repair or replacement, and ensuring timely closure of service issues. The role will work closely with Customer Care, Quality, New Product Development, Warehouse, Supply Chain, and appliance vendors to improve service quality and reduce recurring product issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Defect Identification & Verification:**
  Review and validate appliance-related customer complaints to identify whether the issue is a product defect, usage-related concern, transit damage, or service requirement.
* **Warranty Management:**
  Verify warranty eligibility based on purchase details, product condition, warranty terms, and complaint nature before approving repair, replacement, or further action.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate with appliance manufacturers, OEMs, and service vendors for warranty claims, repair support, spare parts, replacement approvals, and defective product resolution.
* **Defective Product Replacement:**
  Ensure defective appliances are repaired or replaced within agreed timelines in coordination with vendors, Customer Care, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.
* **Product Inspection:**
  Conduct or coordinate inspection of returned or defective appliances to validate the issue before processing vendor claims or replacements.
* **Root Cause Analysis:**
  Analyze recurring defects, service complaints, warranty claims, and return patterns to identify root causes and drive corrective actions with vendors and internal teams.
* **Service Escalation Management:**
  Handle critical and escalated appliance service cases and ensure timely resolution with proper communication to relevant stakeholders.
* **Vendor Claim Tracking:**
  Maintain records of defective units, warranty claims, replacements, credit notes, pending cases, and vendor closures.
* **Spare Parts Coordination:**
  Work with vendors to ensure availability of critical spare parts required for appliance repairs and service support.
* **Service TAT Monitoring:**
  Track turnaround time for inspection, repair, replacement, and claim closure and ensure service cases are resolved within defined timelines.
* **Customer Complaint Analysis:**
  Review complaint trends, customer feedback, ratings, and service-related concerns to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.
* **Quality Feedback:**
  Share structured defect and service feedback with Quality and NPD teams to improve future product quality, design, specifications, and vendor performance.
* **Return & Replacement Control:**
  Work with Customer Care and Operations teams to ensure only validated defective cases are processed for replacement or warranty claims.
* **Vendor Performance Monitoring:**
  Track vendor performance based on defect rates, service responsiveness, warranty closure time, spare availability, and replacement support.
* **Documentation & MIS:**
  Maintain accurate records and periodic reports on service complaints, defect categories, warranty claims, replacements, vendor recoveries, and pending cases.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Develop and improve SOPs for appliance service, warranty verification, defect handling, replacement approval, and vendor claim management.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**
  Collaborate with Customer Care, QA, NPD, Warehouse, Ecommerce, Supply Chain, Finance, and vendors for effective service case closure.

**Mandatory Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5-8 years of experience in after-sales service, service operations, warranty management, or appliance service management.
* Mandatory hands-on experience in Home / Kitchen Appliances.
* Experience handling products such as mixer grinders, blenders, choppers, induction cooktops, electric kettles, air fryers, rice cookers, OTGs, or similar appliances.
* Strong experience in defect identification, warranty verification, vendor coordination, repair, and replacement handling.
* Good understanding of electrical and functional appliance issues, common failure modes, and service requirements.
* Experience working with OEMs, manufacturers, service centres, or appliance vendors.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, and escalation-management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to maintain service records, MIS, claim trackers, and vendor follow-ups.

**Preferred Exposure**

* Experience with consumer durable, D2C, ecommerce, or home appliance brands.
* Exposure to service centre operations and technician coordination.
* Experience in warranty cost control and vendor claim recovery.
* Knowledge of spare parts planning and defective stock handling.
* Experience using customer complaint data and service trends to drive product quality improvements.

**About The Indus Valley**

The Indus Valley is a Chennai-based direct-to-consumer cookware and kitchen brand focused on health, safety, quality, and innovation. We are committed to developing products that improve everyday cooking experiences while maintaining strong standards of reliability, functionality, customer satisfaction, and responsible product development.

title: Production Manager
description:
Impaqt Robotics is at the forefront of industrial automation, developing intelligent robotic systems and modular automation solutions for manufacturing and logistics. Our mission is to simplify robotic deployment through robust software, smart hardware design, and production-ready systems. As we expand our robotics platform, we are building core capabilities in motion planning, manipulation, and intelligent automation.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Production Manager to lead shop-floor operations and production planning and control (PPC). You will manage two assembly technicians and one QC inspector, taking ownership of production planning, assembly, quality control and shipment readiness.

You will translate customer orders into achievable build plans, coordinate material availability, maintain a safe and organised production floor, and ensure finished systems are tested and ready for dispatch. This role requires close collaboration with engineering, procurement and logistics teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Team leadership:**
  Lead, schedule and develop two assembly technicians and one QC inspector. Set daily priorities, train the team on standard operating procedures (SOPs) and review performance.
* **Production planning:**
  Develop and execute weekly production and service plans. Track capacity, material availability and delivery commitments.
* **Shop-floor management:**
  Manage production layout, 5S, housekeeping, tools, materials and safety compliance. Conduct regular audits to maintain shop-floor discipline.
* **Engineering-to-production handover:**
  Interpret engineering bills of materials (BOMs) and CAD assemblies, validate BOM completeness and buildability, upload BOMs into Odoo ERP, and translate engineering requirements into clear SOPs and work instructions.
* **Assembly and testing:**
  Own assembly from kitting through final testing. Work with engineering to develop and maintain jigs and fixtures, and ensure their consistent use to achieve repeatable, right-first-time assembly.
* **Quality control:**
  Own incoming, semi-finished and finished-goods quality control, including inspection standards, checklists and acceptance criteria.
* **Vendor development and coordination:**
  Support purchasing in assessing new vendors’ technical capabilities and approving samples and first articles. Follow up on component delivery and quality.
* **Shipment readiness:**
  Coordinate with logistics to ensure finished systems are ready for shipment in line with agreed delivery dates.
* **Process documentation:**
  Develop and maintain SOPs for production planning, assembly, inspection and dispatch.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.E., B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Production or Industrial Engineering.
* 6–10 years of shop-floor experience in manufacturing.
* At least 2 years of direct supervisory experience managing technicians or inspectors.
* Strong manufacturing fundamentals, including machining processes, fits and tolerances, assembly practices and engineering drawing interpretation.
* Ability to interpret engineering BOMs and CAD assemblies and translate them into practical build instructions.
* Demonstrated experience implementing 5S and maintaining shop-floor discipline, developing or qualifying vendors, and building or specifying assembly fixtures.
* Hands-on ERP experience covering BOMs, manufacturing orders, purchasing and inventory. Odoo experience is preferred; experience with SAP, Tally Prime or a comparable system is also suitable.
* Hands-on experience with CNC machining or metal fabrication is required.

**Why Join Us?**

* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Take responsibility for the complete production cycle, from BOM validation and material planning to assembly, testing and shipment readiness.
* **Build automation products for global markets:**
  Contribute to cobot-based products sold through distributors and system integrators in more than 38 countries.
* **Shape how we manufacture:**
  Develop practical SOPs, quality standards and assembly fixtures that improve consistency and make the production floor more effective.
* **Lead a hands-on team:**
  Develop a focused team of technicians and a QC inspector, with a direct impact on build quality and delivery performance.
* **Work across disciplines:**
  Collaborate closely with engineering, procurement and logistics, combining shop-floor problem-solving with production planning and ERP execution.

We welcome applications from motivated candidates with strong fundamentals and a passion for robotics, even if they do not meet every qualification listed.

Apply now to join Impaqt Robotics and help build the next generation of intelligent automation solutions.

The role will need to initiate and develop good communication and interpersonal relationship with business operations teams and IT and to maintain the high level of service that is currently being provided to all the clients.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
This is a varied operational and managerial position with a senior level of responsibility within the Transaction Management team, within Middle Office Services. This Transaction Management Assistant Vice President acts as a Primary contact point for all internal/external clients. The team is responsible for trade confirmation, trade process, trade settlement, and reporting of trade instructions from clients. The team is also responsible for processing directed lending instructions, wire transfers, and trade exceptions. The candidate should be a hands-on manager who is required to ensure the teams under their responsibility undertake delivery to both internal and external clients, ensure timely response to client-initiated queries, and escalation of any unresolve matters to manager for best resolution solution.

* Drive transformation initiatives, including automation and process improvements
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and manage associated risks.
* Responsible for service delivery and client sentiment, including direct client contact
* Support a strong risk management and control environment
* Broad and in-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations.
* Identify, recommend and drive process improvement initiatives
* Conduct high-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work-processing issues, make suggestions to streamline operations and implement.
* Liaise with colleagues in region or divisions globally where required for client issue resolution
* Perform work independently within scope of established guidelines and according to specific procedures.

* Provide guidance, support and development opportunities to the members of your team

****What We Value****
