title: Senior Manager WOP
description:
Who are Inchcape
  
  
At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.
  
  
We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.
  
  
Main Purpose of Job :
  
  

* Lead the World of Ports (WOP) marine data and operational delivery function, acting as the senior maritime subject-matter expert between global Inchcape teams, product, technology and customers.
* Own delivery against KPIs for collection, verification, validation and publication of port, terminal, berth, vessel and marine-operational datasets and APIs, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and operational relevance.
* Translate practical seagoing and port-operational expertise into product requirements, customer use cases and continuous improvements that support safe, efficient and commercially sound maritime decision-making.

Key Accountabilities :
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the WOP marine/data operations team, setting clear standards for performance, quality and professional growth.
* Act as the senior marine subject-matter expert for port, terminal, berth, vessel and cargo operations across WOP products and services.
* Own marine-data governance, validation standards and quality controls to ensure data is operationally credible, consistent and fit for customer use.
* Engage directly with shipowners, operators, charterers, terminals, ports and other customers to understand operational needs and convert feedback into actionable requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across the Inchcape global network to improve source coverage, verification discipline and timeliness of marine information.
* Partner with Product, Technology and Data teams to define specifications, acceptance criteria and priorities for maritime data and digital solutions.
* Provide marine-operational oversight for new datasets, APIs and product features, ensuring outputs reflect real-world shipping and port workflows.
* Use data and domain insight to identify gaps, trends and opportunities, providing clear recommendations that support the WOP product roadmap.
* Manage multiple workstreams and improvement initiatives, balancing operational delivery, customer priorities, risk and strategic objectives.
* Establish and maintain SOPs, controls, documentation and audit trails that strengthen operational resilience and data quality.
* Represent WOP in customer and stakeholder forums, communicate progress to senior management, and support sprint/release readiness from a marine-business perspective.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Demonstrable senior-level maritime experience with strong practical knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo operations and port agency workflows.
* Strong marine assurance and operational risk mindset, with the ability to assess the reliability and operational relevance of maritime information.
* Consistently high data quality, verification and service performance against agreed KPIs and customer expectations.
* Successful conversion of marine-domain knowledge and customer feedback into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Effective leadership of a geographically dispersed team, with measurable improvements in capability, accountability, quality and productivity.
* Trusted engagement with senior internal stakeholders and external maritime customers, supported by clear, credible and concise communication.
* Successful delivery of marine-data, API and digital initiatives in partnership with Product, Technology and Data teams.
* Well-governed processes, SOPs and controls that support traceability, continuous improvement and operational resilience.
* Proactive identification of data gaps, customer pain points and maritime-market opportunities that inform the WOP roadmap and priorities.

Skills and Experience required :
  
  

* Marine Operations Expertise: In-depth knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo handling, port agency processes and ship/shore interfaces.
* Seagoing / Marine Background: Senior officer-level seagoing or equivalent shore-based marine operations experience, with strong practical understanding of shipboard and port operations.
* Marine Assurance & Risk: Sound knowledge of marine assurance, operational risk, HSSE principles and safe operating practices relevant to vessels and terminals.
* Data Governance: Ability to define verification rules, quality controls and governance standards for critical maritime operational data.
* Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Credible communication with shipowners, operators, charterers, ports, terminals, agents and senior internal stakeholders.
* Product & Business Translation: Ability to convert marine workflows, operational pain points and customer needs into product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Digital Maritime Transformation: Strong understanding of maritime digitalisation, data platforms, APIs, vessel/port intelligence and technology-enabled operational decision support.
* Team Leadership: Proven ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams while setting clear performance standards.
* Project & Delivery Management: Ability to manage concurrent workstreams, priorities, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones in a fast-paced environment.
* Commercial Awareness: Understanding of how reliable port and vessel intelligence supports voyage planning, chartering, operations, demurrage, risk and customer value.
* Analytical Capability: Ability to interpret complex maritime datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate practical insights to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Change & Continuous Improvement: Ability to improve processes, introduce new standards and guide teams through operational and technology change.
* Communication & Reporting: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including senior-management reporting and customer-facing presentations.
* Problem Solving & Judgement: Sound operational judgement with a structured approach to resolving data, process, customer and delivery issues.

Experience :
  
  

* Maritime Experience: Typically 10+ years in shipping, marine operations, ports, terminals, vessel operations or closely related maritime roles.
* Senior Marine Responsibility: Experience at senior officer level at sea (preferably Master Mariner / Chief Engineer / Chief Officer / Second Engineer) or equivalent senior shore-based marine responsibility.
* Port & Terminal Operations: Hands-on exposure to port calls, berth/terminal operations, cargo operations, marine services and ship/shore coordination.
* Marine Assurance: Experience applying marine assurance, HSSE, operational risk or compliance principles in vessel, port or terminal environments.
* Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading teams, setting standards, managing performance and developing capability.
* Maritime Data / Digital Solutions: Experience using or delivering maritime data, port intelligence, vessel-tracking, API, analytics or other digital shipping solutions.
* Customer Relations: Experience engaging maritime customers and stakeholders, gathering requirements and resolving operational or service issues.
* Product / Project Delivery: Experience contributing to or leading product, data or technology initiatives from requirement definition through implementation.
* Data Quality & Governance: Experience establishing validation processes, quality controls, SOPs and traceable governance for operational information.
* Cross-functional Working: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across marine operations, commercial, product, technology and data teams.
* Global / Distributed Operations: Experience working across different geographies, cultures and time zones in a global maritime environment.
* Change Management: Track record of implementing process or technology change while maintaining operational delivery.
* Executive Communication: Experience providing concise progress, risk and recommendation updates to senior management and external stakeholders.
* Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated record of improving operational quality, efficiency, customer outcomes or data reliability

Education and Professional Qualification :
  
  
Essential: Recognised marine qualification and substantial maritime operating experience.
  
  
Preferred: Master Mariner (STCW II/2), Chief Engineer (STCW III/2), or equivalent senior deck/engine certification. Alternatively, a degree in Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies or Marine Operations supported by significant vessel, port or terminal experience. A relevant management, project-management or digital/data qualification is advantageous.
  
  
Why Inchcape Shipping Services?
  
  
We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.
  
  
Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these:
  
  
Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture.
  
  
The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.
  
  
Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.
  
  
In return, we will offer you:
  
  
A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive:
  
  

* A retirement savings plan
* Holiday
* Competitive salary
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Career development and progression opportunities
* Values Award celebration events

Plus, much more!
  
  
If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!
  
  
#ISSthebiggerpicture
  
  
Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location.
  
  
Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity.

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**RAMCO CONGLOMERATE**

Ramco Systems is part of the
**$1 billion+ diversified Ramco Group**

**AI/ML-based**
,
**bot-enabled**
, and
**cloud-native**
solutions.

Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high-growth enterprises alike.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications
**Ramco is the place to be.**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The
**Manager / Senior Manager – Payroll Bureau**
oversees payroll compliance across a region or multiple countries, leading a team to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality statutory compliance within the payroll product.

The role is pivotal in strengthening compliance governance, driving statutory development cycles, and enabling scalable, standardised processes across countries.

The individual is the primary owner of compliance delivery for assigned regions — representing the compliance function to internal and external stakeholders, holding service quality, and building a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Regional Compliance Ownership & Governance**

* Lead compliance operations across the assigned region and ensure full statutory coverage in the payroll product.
* Ensure end-to-end statutory updates —
  **monitoring, interpretation, communication, development, testing, release**
  — are executed with precision and timeliness.
* Act as the escalation point for complex compliance interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes.
* Own relationships with authorities, consultants, and regulatory bodies for assigned geographies.
* Build compliance governance frameworks, SOPs, and audit-ready documentation standards.

**Regulatory Interpretation & Technical Oversight**

* Review product requirements, interpretation notes, change impact assessments, and compliance documentation prepared by the team.
* Guide the team on complex multi-country regulatory analysis and accurate statutory interpretation.
* Evaluate regulatory changes for business impact, system updates, and operational feasibility.
* Provide clear guidance on ambiguous legal scenarios and edge cases.

**Leadership, Team Management & Capability Building**

* Lead the team with effective workload allocation, quality checks, and timely delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and upskill team members through structured training, feedback, and development plans.
* Drive a culture of accuracy, ownership, accountability, and excellence in interpretation and documentation.
* Conduct performance evaluations, workforce planning, and capability development initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Confidence**

* Partner with Product Engineering and other cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of regulatory requirements in the product.
* Lead end-to-end review of existing statutory setups for critical countries and implement product enhancements.
* Ensure timely, clear communication of regulatory changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee responses to complex customer compliance queries, ensuring accuracy, logical reasoning, and consistency.
* Represent Payroll Bureau in customer meetings and compliance deep-dives, building credible relationships with clients, consultants, and internal partners.

**Strategic Initiatives & Innovation**

* Lead initiatives to scale compliance operations through automation, templates, frameworks, and standardised processes.
* Partner with technology teams on AI-driven compliance research tools, dashboards, analytics, and automation projects.
* Build compliance assets including whitepapers, statutory summaries, and marketing and thought-leadership content.
* Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement, standardisation, and future-readiness.

**Training & Knowledge Enablement**

* Drive internal and external training programmes on payroll compliance, regulatory frameworks, and statutory updates.
* Strengthen organisation-wide compliance capability through structured enablement sessions.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Full statutory coverage for the region, delivered ahead of regulatory effective dates.
* Complex interpretations and disputes resolved at this level rather than escalated upward.
* A team whose documentation needs progressively less correction.
* Customers and consultants who trust the Bureau’s statutory position without needing to verify it.
* Compliance operations that scale through standardisation rather than added headcount.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head – Payroll Bureau and reviewed on the cadence noted.*

* **Statutory coverage and release timeliness**
  — statutory updates for the region delivered into the product ahead of their effective dates, with full coverage maintained.
  *(Per release)*
* **Compliance accuracy**
  — statutory defects reaching production for the region, and defects traced to an interpretation error.
  *(Per release)*
* **Governance and escalation**
  — frameworks, SOPs, and documentation standards current and audit-ready; complex interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes resolved within the agreed timeline.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Technical review quality**
  — team documentation reviewed and signed off, and rework arising after sign-off.
  *(Monthly)*
* **Team capability and performance**
  — performance evaluations and development plans completed, and capability gaps closed against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*
* **Customer and stakeholder confidence**
  — complex compliance queries resolved accurately within the agreed window, and customer deep-dives supported to a satisfactory outcome.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Scale and enablement**
  — automation, template, or framework initiatives delivered, and training programmes and compliance assets published against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* Qualified
  **Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Lawyer**
  with 7 to 10 years of relevant payroll compliance experience, or another qualification with 10+ years in multi-country payroll or statutory compliance roles.
* Experience in team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and managing multi-country compliance.
* Strong analytical, logical, and interpretation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex regulations into clear, implementable guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* High integrity, professionalism, and ownership, with pride in the quality of work and curiosity to keep learning.
* Builds strong working relationships within and across teams, and coaches team members to succeed through guidance and clarity.
* Adapts quickly to changing demands and shifting priorities, and takes ownership to deliver solutions.
* Builds trust with internal teams, customers, and external partners, and gives them confidence through clear communication of statutory coverage in the product.
* Brings structure and strategic thinking to compliance operations, and continuously improves processes.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of Ramco tools is an added advantage.
* Experience owning authority and regulator relationships in more than one jurisdiction.
* Exposure to compliance automation, analytics dashboards, or AI-assisted regulatory research tooling.

**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS**

* Own payroll compliance for a full region on a platform used across 35+ countries.
* Direct influence on how regulation is built into the product.
* Lead a compliance team and represent the function to clients and regulators.
* Be part of a fast-evolving, innovation-led enterprise software company.

Job Title: Engineering Manager – HV Substations (EPC)
  
  
Job Location:
**Chennai, India**
**Join Us!**
We combine AtkinsRéalis project management expertise and Hitachi Energy's deep technological knowledge to create a company dedicated to substations – we are Linxon!
  
  
The Engineering Manager leads the multidisciplinary engineering team assigned to one major project, or to several projects in parallel, within the High Voltage (HV) substation EPC business. The role owns technical delivery end-to-end — from design coordination through to as-built handover — while acting as the primary technical interface toward vendors, subcontractors, and internal/external stakeholders. This is a senior, hands-on leadership position requiring both deep electrical engineering credibility and strong people-management skills.
  
  
**What will you do?**
**Team Leadership**

* Manage, coordinate, and develop the project engineering team, covering primary (substation layout, electrical calculations, studies), secondary (protection, control, automation, SCADA), BIM/3D modelling, and civil/structural engineering disciplines.
* Allocate engineering resources and Distribute workload across the allocated resources of the project team based on project phase, milestones, and priorities; scale the team up or down as projects move through ECI, detailed engineering, and site support phases.
* Set individual and team objectives, mentor engineers, and support technical skill development within the discipline groups.
* When responsible for multiple projects simultaneously, arbitrate priorities and resource allocation across projects in line with overall business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of contact for Principal Design Engineer in UK and guarantee the delivery of the design by GETS as per project plan.
* Attend weekly internal design review and monthly project plan review meetings.

**Engineering Delivery & Technical Ownership**

* Own the overall technical quality, consistency, and interdisciplinary coordination of the engineering deliverables (single line diagrams, layouts, protection & control schemes, civil/structural drawings, 3D BIM models, technical specifications).
* Ensure engineering outputs comply with applicable codes, standards, client technical specifications, and internal engineering standards.
* Resolve interdisciplinary technical conflicts (e.g., primary/civil layout clashes, secondary/primary interface issues) and ensure design freeze milestones are met.
* Review and approve Guarantee the review and the approval of the key technical documents and design packages before issue to client or procurement according to project delivery plan.

**Vendor & Supplier Interface**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact toward equipment vendors and subcontractors.
* Support technical clarification meetings, technical bid evaluations, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and design review meetings with suppliers.
* Ensure vendor technical documentation (drawings, datasheets, calculations) is reviewed, commented, and approved in line with project schedule.

**Internal Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with the wider project engineering organization (project management, procurement, construction, commissioning, QA/QC) to align engineering priorities with overall project schedule and deliverables.
* Represent the engineering function in internal project review meetings, steering committees, and client-facing technical discussions.
* Communicate risks, technical constraints, and schedule impacts clearly and proactively to project leadership and internal stakeholders.
* Act as a credible, senior technical voice able to defend engineering positions and priorities in front of internal stakeholders and management.

**Experience, Education And Other Required**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor'S or Master's level).
* Minimum 18+ years of experience required, with a solid background in the HV EPC substation business (design, engineering, and/or execution of AIS/GIS substations, HV equipment, protection & control systems).

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About The Team**
CloudBees builds CloudBees Unify, a governed software delivery platform spanning CI/CD, release orchestration, and feature management. Feature Management is the capability that lets teams ship code with a feature turned off, roll it out gradually, and kill it instantly if something breaks, no redeploy needed.
  
  
This team is moving into a new org, and that's where you come in.
  
  
You'd inherit a team spread across three continents and about ten time zones, and likely pick up one or two additional small teams alongside it. The team includes engineers who do not need you to tell them how to write code. What they need is someone who clears the path between them and shipping and treats "I don't know, let me find out" as a perfectly good answer in a 1:1.
  
  
This is the role today. If you do it well, there's room to take on more.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own delivery and team health for Feature Management
* Steer decisions with questions, then let your engineers own the architecture. If you're the one drawing the boxes, something's gone wrong
* Give feedback in the moment, not in a surprise essay once a year
* Hire, grow, and have the hard conversations when someone isn't where they need to be
* Cut process that exists because someone was once scared
* Use AI agents to run your own job faster: pull together who's on PTO next week, the lead time of your team's PRs, what ticket needs attention, what shipped and what it broke, instead of digging through five tools by hand

Not write code. Not approve every PR. Not sit in on every incident call because you don't trust the on-call rotation.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Must have**

* A track record of improving automation and developer tooling, not just using what's handed to you
* At least 5 years as a software developer before moving into management, so the technical instincts below are earned, not borrowed (ideally, you have developed in Go)
* 5+ years as an actual engineering manager, with 5 or more direct reports at once. Not a tech lead with 3 reports and half a week of coding
* Genuinely technical: enough hands-on background in CI/CD, feature flagging, or platform engineering to ask a sharp question in a design review, plus real experience managing engineers who are better coders than you, and you're comfortable with that
* A track record of running distributed, multi-timezone teams: clear owners, clear deadlines, decisions that don't wait on a meeting that nine time zones won't allow
* You take the heat for your team and hand them the credit
* The instinct to measure what shipped and what it did for customers, not green dots in Slack. You know deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore, and you use them to start conversations, not to rank people
* A real appetite for AI: recent, hands-on use of at least one coding agent (Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, Kiro, or similar) to run your own work, not necessarily to ship product code. You push your team to try these tools too, and have opinions about where they help and where they don't, not secondhand takes from a keynote you watched once
* Experience taking over a team mid-transition

**Nice to have**

* A sense of humor. You'll need one some days, and it'll help on the good ones too
* Prior exposure to release orchestration
* Java development experience

**Who This Is For**
You'd rather ask what's actually blocking someone than "why isn't this done yet." And when the unpopular call is needed, you make it, even when the timing is inconvenient.
  
  
You're fine with ambiguity that has a shape, not ambiguity that's just chaos with a Jira board. Sharp and a little irreverent beats technically flawless but rigid, as long as you still ship.

Serving as the local team lead for the Procurement team within the Finance division, this role is integral to the procurement lifecycle at athenahealth. You will support backend procurement operations for a U.S.-based procurement team, including requisition compliance, purchase order creation, supplier registration, maintenance of records within enterprise resource planning/procure-to-pay (ERP/P2P) tools, supplier due diligence, annual supplier monitoring, contract coordination, internal and external communications, reporting, and related operational work.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to help ensure procurement activities are completed accurately, consistently, and on time. The position requires strong organization, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured environment. You should be comfortable working across teams, reviewing data for accuracy and trends, and identifying practical solutions to operational challenges. Experience supporting a team and helping improve operational results will be valuable in this role.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* People Leadership & Operational Management
* Lead, coach, and develop direct reports supporting PO administration, supplier onboarding and offboarding, and Oracle supplier profile maintenance across U.S. and India operations.
* Establish individual objectives, service expectations, quality standards, development plans, and measurable accountability for results.
* Allocate workloads, monitor capacity and coverage, conduct regular one-on-ones, provide timely performance feedback, and address execution or capability gaps.
* Build cross-training and succession coverage for critical PO and supplier processes, including planned and unplanned absences.
* Create an accountable, service-oriented culture focused on accuracy, responsiveness, control adherence, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement.
* Purchase Order Administration & Fulfillment
* Oversee end-to-end PO administration, including validation of approved requisitions, contract and budget alignment, PO creation, dispatch, acknowledgement, change orders, issue resolution, receipt coordination, and closure.
* Ensure POs contain accurate supplier, entity, currency, payment term, accounting, tax, line-item, period-of-performance, and supporting-document information before release.
* Monitor PO fulfillment status and coordinate with requestors, budget owners, suppliers, Sourcing, Accounts Payable, and Finance to resolve missing receipts, invoice mismatches, exhausted balances, blocked invoices, overdue commitments, and other transaction exceptions.
* Maintain clear controls for non-PO spend, after-the-fact requests, emergency purchases, one-time suppliers, blanket POs, contract renewals, and other approved exception pathways.
* Coordinate timely PO amendments for approved scope, quantity, price, term, accounting, or supplier changes while preserving approval evidence and audit history.
* Lead periodic PO close reviews to identify completed, expired, inactive, duplicate, or no-longer-needed POs and confirm closure with the appropriate business and Finance stakeholders.
* Ensure PO records and supporting documentation are complete, accurate, accessible, and audit-ready throughout the PO lifecycle.
* Promote appropriate use of P-Cards, purchase orders, catalogues and other purchasing channels based on established buying and payment policies.
* Monitor P-Card transaction compliance, aging items, missing documentation, recurring exceptions, and other control issues; escalate and drive corrective actions where required.
* Maintain operational reporting and audit-ready supporting documentation for P-Card activity and associated controls.
* Supplier Onboarding & Offboarding
* Lead supplier onboarding from validated intake through activation, including required forms, tax and banking documentation, business ownership, approvals, sanctions and compliance checkpoints, risk-review status, and supplier communication.
* Confirm that supplier onboarding requests are complete and appropriately approved before Oracle supplier-profile creation or activation; return incomplete requests with clear remediation requirements.
* Support controls associated with supplier tax classification and U.S. information-reporting requirements, including collection and maintenance of appropriate supplier tax documentation used in 1099 reporting.
* Coordinate with Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, Finance, Accounts Payable, Tax, and business owners to ensure required reviews are completed and documented before the supplier becomes transaction-ready.
* Oversee supplier offboarding, including validation of termination or inactivity, review of open POs and invoices, closure of remaining commitments, deactivation of purchasing use, profile-status updates, and retention of supporting evidence.
* Maintain controls for one-time suppliers, reactivation requests, supplier legal-name changes, mergers or acquisitions, address changes, and payment-information changes, including required out-of-band verification where applicable.
* Prevent duplicate or fragmented supplier records by applying standardized search, matching, naming, and documentation requirements before creating or reactivating a supplier.
* Oracle Supplier Profile Maintenance & Support
* Own operational governance for Oracle supplier-profile creation, maintenance, activation, inactivation, and user support in accordance with approved access and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Ensure supplier master data is accurate and complete, including legal name, tax identifiers, addresses, contacts, business classifications, payment terms, purchasing sites, entities, currencies, and supporting documentation.
* Oversee controlled updates to supplier profiles, including name, address, contact, tax, banking, payment, and site changes, with appropriate approvals and verification evidence.
* Monitor duplicate records, incomplete profiles, inactive suppliers, expired documentation, conflicting data, and other master-data quality issues; assign remediation actions and track them through completion.
* Triage Oracle supplier and PO transaction issues, document root causes and resolutions, coordinate system support with IT and Finance, and communicate status to affected stakeholders.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, procedure updates, training, and adoption for approved Oracle/P2P process or system changes affecting supplier or PO operations.
* Service Levels, Controls & Operational Metrics
* Define and manage service-level targets for PO creation, PO changes, supplier onboarding, supplier offboarding, supplier-profile updates, issue resolution, and PO closure.
* Maintain dashboards and weekly operating reviews covering queue volume, completed transactions, aging, cycle time, first-pass accuracy, rework, exceptions, backlog, and control compliance.
* Measure PO fulfillment and close performance, including open-PO aging, past-due POs, completed POs awaiting closure, closure cycle time, dormant POs, remaining commitment value, and percentage closed within target.
* Track supplier operations metrics, including onboarding cycle time, first-pass completeness, profile-update cycle time, duplicate-prevention findings, offboarding completion, and aged requests.
* Analyze recurring defects and bottlenecks, identify root causes, assign corrective actions, and verify that improvements reduce cycle time, rework, and control failures.
* Escalate material service, control, data-quality, or capacity risks with a clear statement of impact, owner, corrective action, and expected resolution date.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence, support internal and external audit requests, and track remediation actions through verified closure.
* Process Documentation, Training & Stakeholder Support
* Maintain current SOPs, process maps, RACIs, control narratives, job aids, templates, intake requirements, and exception procedures for PO and supplier operations.
* Develop and deliver training for Procurement team members, requestors, approvers, and business stakeholders on PO administration, supplier onboarding and offboarding, Oracle supplier requirements, receipt responsibilities, and PO closure.
* Publish clear operating guidance through approved Procurement repositories and communication channels; archive obsolete materials and maintain version control.
* Facilitate operational reviews, document decisions and actions, and drive routine follow-up without unnecessary escalation to senior Procurement leadership.

**Expected Education & Experience**

* Undergraduate degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Business, Operations, or a related discipline preferred.
* Approximately 7–10 years of experience in procurement operations, procure-to-pay, purchasing operations, supplier master data, Accounts Payable operations, or a related function.
* Working knowledge of U.S. and India tax requirements relevant to procurement, supplier onboarding, invoicing, and supplier master-data operations.
* Experience supporting U.S. 1099 reporting processes, including supplier tax-document collection, supplier classification/data validation, exception resolution, and coordination with Tax and Accounts Payable.
* Experience managing or supporting P-Card programs, including transaction controls, cardholder support, exception management, documentation, and compliance monitoring.
* Experience managing catalog purchasing and other guided-buying channels, including operational support, transaction troubleshooting, and stakeholder coordination.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders and Accounts Payable to resolve PO/invoice/receipt mismatches and other procure-to-pay exception
* Demonstrated experience leading direct reports, including goal setting, coaching, performance feedback, workload management, capacity planning, and employee development.
* Hands-on leadership experience with end-to-end PO administration, including requisition validation, PO creation, changes, fulfillment support, receipt and invoice issue resolution, and PO closure.
* Demonstrated experience leading supplier onboarding and offboarding processes, including documentation, approvals, compliance checkpoints, stakeholder coordination, activation, inactivation, and exception handling.
* Demonstrated experience administering Oracle supplier profiles or comparable ERP supplier-master records, including data quality, duplicate prevention, profile updates, controls, and user support.
* Experience defining and managing operational service levels, transaction queues, aging, cycle-time reporting, first-pass accuracy, rework, backlog, and close-performance metrics.
* Working knowledge of procure-to-pay controls, segregation of duties, supplier master-data governance, three-way match concepts, invoice and receipt exceptions, and audit evidence requirements.
* Experience collaborating with Finance, Accounts Payable, Tax, Legal, IT, InfoSec, Compliance, Sourcing, Contracts, and business stakeholders.
* Experience with Oracle/P2P, ServiceNow or comparable intake tools, SharePoint, Teams, and reporting or dashboard tools is preferred.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* People leadership, coaching, performance management, delegation, workload prioritization, capacity planning, and team development.
* Purchase order administration, fulfillment support, change management, commitment cleanup, and PO closure.
* Supplier onboarding and offboarding, supplier master-data governance, documentation validation, and duplicate prevention.
* Oracle supplier-profile creation, maintenance, troubleshooting, data quality, access controls, and segregation of duties.
* Operational service management, including queue management, service levels, aging analysis, cycle time, first-pass accuracy, rework, backlog, and escalation.
* Procure-to-pay controls, audit readiness, exception management, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
* Strong stakeholder service, written communication, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.
* Process mapping, SOP development, training, change management, continuous improvement, and AI-enabled operational opportunities.
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to operate independently during U.S. business hours.
* P-Card program management, purchasing controls, transaction review, exception management, and cardholder support.
* Catalog purchasing operations and purchasing-channel management.
* Working knowledge of U.S. and India tax considerations affecting procurement, suppliers, and procure-to-pay transactions.
* U.S. 1099 reporting support, supplier tax documentation, tax-data validation, and cross-functional coordination with Tax and Accounts Payable.
* PO, invoice, and receipt mismatch resolution, including effective coordination among business requestors, suppliers, Accounts Payable, Procurement, and Finance.

**Success Measures**

* Direct reports have clear objectives, balanced workloads, regular coaching, documented development plans, and measurable accountability for results.
* POs are created and changed accurately within established service levels, with complete approvals and supporting documentation.
* Open-PO aging, overdue commitments, completed POs awaiting closure, and dormant POs are actively managed and reduced against established targets.
* PO closure reviews occur on schedule, closure decisions are documented, and completed or no-longer-needed commitments are closed promptly and accurately.
* Supplier onboarding and offboarding requests are completed within service levels, with required approvals, risk checkpoints, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Oracle supplier profiles remain complete, current, properly supported, and compliant with duplicate-prevention, access, approval, and segregation-of-duties controls.
* P-Card operations are administered within established controls, with timely documentation, transaction review, exception resolution, and corrective action for recurring issues.
* Catalog purchases are processed through appropriate purchasing channels, with operational issues and exceptions resolved promptly.
* PO, receipt, and invoice mismatches are proactively identified and resolved through effective coordination with business stakeholders, Accounts Payable, suppliers, and Finance.
* Supplier tax documentation and master data required to support applicable U.S. 1099 reporting are complete, accurate, current, and available to Tax and Accounts Payable within established timelines.
* Procurement operations appropriately support U.S. and India tax requirements while tax determinations and specialized interpretations are escalated to the appropriate Tax stakeholders.
* Operational dashboards provide reliable visibility into volume, cycle time, aging, backlog, first-pass accuracy, rework, exceptions, and close performance.
* Recurring defects and bottlenecks have documented root causes, owners, corrective actions, and measurable improvements.
* Procedures, controls, job aids, and training materials remain current, approved, accessible, and audit-ready.

title: Program Director
description:
**Job Summary**
The Program Director will oversee large scale strategic programs with a strong focus on budget management resource optimization and disciplined planning and execution. The role manages complex client facing initiatives ensuring profitable delivery high quality outcomes and alignment with customer experience goals in a hybrid work model with day shifts and no travel requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive integrated program planning activities to align scope timelines and financial targets while ensuring clear visibility of milestones for all stakeholders
* Manage program budgets by tracking costs forecasting financials and optimizing spend to achieve profit objectives and sustainable margins for the organization
* Oversee end to end program execution by coordinating cross functional teams resolving delivery risks and maintaining adherence to schedule and quality expectations
* Coordinate resource management activities by balancing workload optimizing staffing levels and ensuring critical roles are filled to support program commitments
* Monitor key performance indicators across scope schedule cost and quality to provide timely status updates and actionable insights to senior stakeholders
* Engage with client teams to understand business objectives capture evolving expectations and translate customer experience needs into pragmatic delivery roadmaps
* Implement governance routines including steering forums risk reviews and issue tracking to maintain transparency accountability and timely decision making across the program
* Drive continuous improvement by analyzing delivery data identifying patterns in delays or defects and implementing corrective actions to enhance program efficiency
* Support change management by assessing impact on teams and systems planning adoption activities and ensuring that changes are introduced with minimal disruption to operations
* Collaborate with technology and business partners to ensure that program outcomes are aligned with enterprise strategies and generate measurable value for end customers
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory guidelines by embedding required controls and documentation practices into daily program operations
* Foster a culture of collaboration and accountability within the program environment to encourage open communication timely risk escalation and a strong focus on customer value
* Utilize wealth management domain knowledge where applicable to interpret client requirements align solutions with advisory processes and improve outcomes for end investors
* Drive hybrid work practices by defining clear ceremonies communication channels and work agreements that support distributed teams operating in a day shift environment

**Qualifications**

* Require extensive experience in managing large programs with responsibility for cost control profit realization and financial performance within complex environments
* Require proven expertise in resource planning capacity management and workforce optimization to ensure that critical skills are available at the right time for program delivery
* Require strong capability in program planning and scheduling including creation of integrated roadmaps dependency maps and realistic release plans for multi team initiatives
* Require hands on experience in program execution with accountability for meeting client commitments managing scope changes and maintaining high levels of delivery quality
* Require demonstrated success as a customer experience focused program manager who can balance user needs operational constraints and business outcomes in each release
* Nice to have experience in wealth management or related financial services domains to better understand client journeys regulatory considerations and product operating models
* Require strong communication and stakeholder management skills to interact with senior executives cross functional teams and client representatives in a clear and structured manner
* Require familiarity with hybrid work models and collaboration tooling to effectively coordinate distributed teams ensure clarity of responsibilities and maintain productivity
* Require a track record of mentoring and supporting team members to build program management capabilities encourage accountability and promote continuous improvement across engagements

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Project Management Professional PMP or Program Management certification such as MSP or PgMP relevant to large scale program delivery

title: Im saree manufacturer Bhagalpuri silk
description:
**Company Description**
N Fabrics is a growing textile company specializing in Bhagalpuri silk sarees and other high-quality traditional fabrics. Based in Chennai, the organization focuses on blending classic weaving techniques with contemporary designs to serve both domestic and international markets. The company values craftsmanship, reliability, and long-term partnerships with artisans and suppliers. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that improve product quality, production efficiency, and customer satisfaction. N Fabrics offers a collaborative work environment where employees can develop skills in textile manufacturing and design.

**Role Description**
The Im saree manufacturer Bhagalpuri silk role at N Fabrics is a full-time, on-site position located in Chennai. The role involves overseeing the end-to-end manufacturing of Bhagalpuri silk sarees, including coordinating with weavers and dyers, monitoring fabric quality, and ensuring designs are produced accurately. Daily tasks include supervising production schedules, checking color consistency and fabric finishing, inspecting sarees for defects, and maintaining records of batches and inventory. The role also includes collaborating with the design and sales teams to align production with client requirements and market trends, and implementing basic quality control and safety practices on the production floor. The position may require occasional visits to suppliers and production units to ensure timely delivery of materials and adherence to quality standards.

**Qualifications**

* Knowledge of silk textiles, especially Bhagalpuri silk, and understanding of saree manufacturing processes such as weaving, dyeing, and finishing.
* Experience in production supervision or factory floor management within the textile or garment industry.
* Basic skills in quality control, including inspecting fabrics, identifying defects, and maintaining product standards.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders, including artisans, suppliers, designers, and sales teams.
* Strong organizational and record-keeping skills for tracking batches, inventory, and production timelines.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a diverse team environment.
* Attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn new techniques and processes.
* Preferred: Diploma or degree in Textile Technology, Fashion Design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in saree or silk manufacturing.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Join athenahealth as a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a newly formed engineering team advancing our Integration Platform. You will build and develop the team, guide technical direction, and own the delivery of scalable, reliable integration solutions.
  
  
Working closely with engineering, product, architecture, and operational stakeholders, you will help simplify healthcare data exchange and improve the experience of developers, customers, and integration partners. A key focus will be advancing automation, self-service capabilities, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve engineering productivity.
  
  
**Team Summary**
The Integration Platform is part of the athenahealth Data and Ecosystem Platform subdivision. It supports internal data exchanges and connections between athenahealth and laboratories, imaging providers, registries, health information exchanges (HIEs), payers, other electronic health record (EHR) systems, faxing services, and third-party vendors serving healthcare practices.
  
  
A core component is our proprietary HL7 engine, which supports more than 15,000 contexts, approximately 20,000 connections, and millions of subscriptions. These connections use protocols and connectivity methods such as SFTP, HTTPS, APIs, and VPN sockets, making scalability, performance, and reliability central to the team’s work.
  
  
The platform supports inbound and outbound HL7 connections, alongside custom integrations for specific customer needs. Self-service tools and a dedicated advisory team support the onboarding, development, and validation of new integrations.
  
  
The Chennai team will expand these capabilities through platform improvements, process automation, and AI-powered tools that simplify integration development, testing, and onboarding.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices across planning, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance, with appropriate engineering review and quality controls.
* Identify and deliver opportunities for automation, self-service, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve developer and customer experiences.
* Establish and track meaningful measures of delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, engineering productivity, and integration turnaround time.
* Lead the evolution of existing systems while supporting new functionality and maintaining operational continuity.
* Foster agile / AIDLC development practices and use delivery outcomes and team feedback to improve how the team works.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Coach and mentor engineers through regular feedback, career development, and opportunities to strengthen technical and leadership skills.
* Own engineering planning and delivery for integration and faxing solutions, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Partner with product, architecture, and engineering leaders to translate business objectives into a technical roadmap and achievable delivery plans.
* Guide architectural decisions and engineering practices that improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the long-term architecture and modernization strategy for the Integration Platform.
* Lead recruiting, onboarding, and talent development to build the capabilities needed for the team’s roadmap.
* Partner with operational and advisory teams to identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.
* Maintain productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and vendors.
* Support production readiness, incident resolution, and follow-up improvements that strengthen platform reliability.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI development tools through focused experiments with measurable outcomes.
* Share technical knowledge and effective engineering practices across teams.

**Expected Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* At least 12 years of experience across software development and engineering leadership, including experience managing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop teams, manage performance, and deliver complex software initiatives.
* Strong technical background in Java and experience designing, developing, or operating scalable enterprise software.
* Experience guiding architectural decisions, managing technical trade-offs, and improving software quality and operational reliability.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and continuous improvement practices.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and opportunities to apply AI and automation to engineering workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical audiences

* Govern the improvement project portfolio, track benefits realization, and communicate progress to senior leadership

* Leadership experience in solving complex quality issues & managing an improvement project portfolio
* Leadership experience in overseeing strategic initiatives, change management, business process improvement, and deployment
* Change management and stakeholder management

* Experience in leading and facilitating global teams in RCA and sustaining improvements
* Sustainable implementation of standardized best practices globally

**Competencies**

title: Downstream Process Excellence Lead
description:
**Where you fit in**
If you like transforming and impacting the business and the process, with a passion for accounting, reporting and analysis and innovation, this could be your chance to make your mark in the energy industry. You will grow in a supportive team that champions process custodianship, improvement and transformation, projects and portfolio management and product ownership, in support of R&A’s aspiration of becoming an Accounting and Insights Powerhouse.
  
  

* The Downstream Reporting & Analysis (R&A) Organisation is a team of >900 colleagues providing accurate, timely and insightful finance and accounting and analysis to deliver more and cleaner energy solutions.
* Within the Downstream Reporting & Analysis is the Process Excellence Team which is responsible for leading and guarding the process, covering Planning and Appraisal (PAR), Finance Accounting and Controlling (FAC), and Period End (PE), for different Classes of Business (COB) (namely Mobility, Lubricants, Low Carbon Solution, Products and Chemicals).
* This role will report to the global Downstream Process Excellence Manager and is directly responsible for projects delivery, working closely through cross-horizontal collaboration and integration with the R&A Downstream Operations Teams – Controllers and PAR, Process Owners Team, MI Centre of Excellence (COE), Finance in the Business (FitB), Process Digital Interface and other teams within Shell.

**What’s the role?**

* The DS Process Excellence Lead is responsible for leading the delivery of Efficiency, Effectiveness, Finance Digital Core, and/or Governance portfolio of projects, leading various Operations Teams towards realizing efficiency opportunities and/or strengthening process effectiveness and governance.
* Manage initiatives, covering from ideation and opportunity building, demand management, design and build, implementation/delivery, go-live, to hyper-care:
* Specific projects and initiatives may fall and/or overlap within the functions of planning and appraisal, financial accounting and controlling, financial closing/period-end activities.
* Specific projects and initiatives may be standalone projects directly local to Downstream, or as part of a portfolio/program mandated by Group due to data, systems, and/or business changes (as in the case of growth investments and divestments).
* Specific projects and initiatives may lead and managed as part of the direct scope of Process Excellence, and/or as a portfolio/program managed in collaboration with R&A Operations Teams, MI COE, Finance in the Business, other PE teams within and beyond R&A, etc.
* Lead the change management, readiness (people, process, and/or systems, as applicable) and delivery reporting requirements of the projects and initiatives, to ensure optimal visibility, timely senior sponsorship and support, sufficient insights at decision review boards (DRB) as required, as well as appropriate resourcing and capabilities, among others, from ideation to hyper-care and stabilization.
* Lead the project requirements profiling, business and process impact assessments, and risk management assessments, and subsequently communicate such to proper levels of sponsorships and stakeholders.
* Identify and execute pivotal projects that enhance effectiveness and efficiency through collaborative efforts with PAR, and Solution (MI COE, IT, etc.) teams.
* Serve as the custodian of existing processes, seeking opportunities to optimize them with streamlined interfaces and structures while mitigating risks.
* Conduct comprehensive impact assessments of changes affecting the process, align with key stakeholders on potential impacts, and meticulously document the outcomes.
* Adhere to the Demand Management model in the acceptance and prioritization of new demands.
* Understand the implications of system transitions (CFIN, S4, NUCLEUS, etc.) on the R&A DS process, engage with Operations and Implementation teams at appropriate intervals, and ensure proper traction on key risks through collaborative efforts with all relevant stakeholders.
* Assess the prospective alterations to the PAR processes resulting from corporate reorganization, mergers, divestments, and integrations.
* Ensure the compliance to standard project management model in the execution and implementation of the key projects and initiatives.
* Exemplify leadership in driving transformative changes by leveraging robust Processes, People, and Systems.
* Augment the PE reputation by adhering to standardized procedures and ensuring effective communication with broader teams.
* Shall serve as pathfinder in data and knowledge management building specifically for value stream mappings, process documentation and socialization, among other knowledge management requirements.

**What we need from you?**

* You will inspire people to make changes that will have a direct impact on our success. Furthermore, you will have:
* Master’s degree or Professional Qualification, in Business/Accounting/Finance with exceptional numeracy skills and experience.
* Excellent project or program management skills and experience to Create Value.
* Change management expertise and experience in a multi-project or portfolio level.
* Excellent oral and written presentation skills.
* Appreciation and understanding of Downstream Financial and Management Information Systems and Data Flows, as well as a passion for leveraging technology and automation.
* Passion for the Downstream Business, the Energy Transition, Powering Progress, and a curiosity for how the business delivers value.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**An Inclusive & Progressive Place to Work**

* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.

**Shell in India**
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
  
  
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
  
  
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
  
  
Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
  
  
Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
  
  
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

title: Senior Manager - Customer Service Transformation and AI
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
