At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Lead end-to-end CCaaS and Customer Service AI transformation programs that align with client vision and business objectives—enhancing contact center capabilities with cloud-native platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE, Five9), conversational AI, CX insights, and operating model redesign. Serve as both growth driver and delivery anchor, working with C‑suite stakeholders, platform partners, and internal teams to deliver measurable impact.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Growth**

* Advise C-suite stakeholders on customer service transformation strategies, including AI adoption, digital channels, and experience-led service design.
* Define target operating models, business cases, and transformation roadmaps aligned to enterprise priorities.
* Identify value levers across cost reduction, experience improvement, and automation.
* Lead pursuits: RFP responses, solution proposals, pricing, and executive stakeholder engagements.
* Build practice offerings in collaboration with CCaaS and AI platform partners to differentiate service capabilities.

**End-to-End Delivery**

* Drive full lifecycle delivery for global, multi-stream of customer service, CCaaS and AI transformation programs: discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
* Implement Agile project management with on‑shore/off‑shore delivery teams and robust governance.

**Technology & Innovation Enablement**

* Guide clients on CCaaS platform selection, architecture, and implementation (Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE, Five9).
* Drive adoption of conversational AI, automation, and advanced analytics to enhance service quality and efficiency.
* Bridge business and technology teams to ensure solutions are scalable and outcome-driven.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build and maintain senior-level client relationships, acting as a strategic partner and trusted advisor.
* Communicate complex transformation initiatives clearly to executive audiences.
* Identify and cultivate follow-on opportunities within existing accounts.

**Market & Technology Insight**

* Monitor emerging CCaaS, conversational AI, and CX trends to inform strategy and innovation.
* Team Leadership
* Build, mentor, and lead cross-functional consulting teams and delivery teams.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Agile delivery and on‑shore/off‑shore team coordination.
* Strong stakeholder management across client and vendor teams.
* Conversational AI experience (bots, IVA, NLP) and platform migration expertise.
* Data compliance knowledge (PCI/PII, GDPR) tied to CCaaS and compliance platforms.
* Win and deliver multiple CCaaS transformation programs, meeting scope, budget, and timeline goals.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in customer service KPIs: AHT, FCR, CSAT/NPS.
* Expand practice pipeline through partner GTM initiatives and follow-on client engagements.
* Build a high‑performing team and enhance practice capabilities via PoVs, thought leadership, and accelerators.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Demonstrate expertise in customer contact center technologies through certifications from leading CCaaS providers, including AWS, Genesys, NICE, and Five9.
* Have experience designing or implementing integrations between contact center platforms and enterprise CRM solutions such as Salesforce Service Cloud and Microsoft Dynamics 365.

**What We Look For**

* 8–12+ years in customer service and contact center transformation or consulting, with at least 5 years in CCaaS or cloud contact center delivery.
* Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale CCaaS transformations across discovery, migration, and managed operations.
* Experience in proposal writing, executive presentations, and business development within service operations or contact center technology.
* Hands-on knowledge of CCaaS platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone, Five9) and integrations with CRM systems.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: HSE Manager
description:
Rotork is a market-leading global provider of mission-critical flow control and instrumentation solutions. Customers rely on Rotork for innovative, high quality and dependable solutions for managing the flow of liquids, gases and powders. Rotork helps customers around the world to improve efficiency, reduce emissions, minimise their environmental impact and assure safety.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Purpose of the Job:**

* To be the driving force in implementing a zero-accident safety culture and continuous improvement.
* Drive a strong safety culture, regulatory compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement.
* To maintain 3rd party accreditation to ISO45001
* To fully satisfy customer requirements through the establishment of robust processes and procedures within the ISO45001 H&S management system.

**Key Responsibilities and Outcomes:**

* Develop and implement HSE strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Lead safety culture transformation and behavioural safety programs.
* Act as the HSE subject matter expert for all India operations.
* Provide regular HSE performance updates to senior leadership
* Responsible for Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) compliance and performance across 3 manufacturing sites in India.
* Provide HSE support and governance for field service activities across India.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable Indian regulations, including:
* Factories Act
* State Factory Rules
* Environmental regulations
* Fire and Safety requirements
* Hazardous Waste Management Rules
* Contractor Safety Regulations

Liaise with government authorities and regulatory agencies. Lead internal and external compliance audits.
  
  
**Risk Management**

* Conduct site risk assessments and hazard identification programs.
* Drive implementation of risk mitigation actions.
* Ensure safe systems of work, permit-to-work, LOTO, confined space, working at height, and contractor safety programs are effective

Incident Management
  
  

* Lead investigation of incidents, near misses, and environmental events.
* Conduct root cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Monitor incident trends and establish preventive measures.

Environmental & Sustainability Management
  
  

* Ensure environmental compliance and permit adherence.
* Drive waste reduction, energy conservation, and sustainability initiatives.
* Monitor environmental KPIs and compliance reporting.

Service Operations Safety
  
  

* Develop and implement HSE requirements for service engineers operating across India.
* Ensure travel, customer-site, and field service risks are assessed and controlled.
* Support customer audits and service-related safety requirements.

Training & Competency Development
  
  

* Develop HSE training matrix for employees and contractors.
* Deliver leadership safety training and awareness programs.
* Ensure competency assessments and certification requirements are maintained.

Emergency Preparedness
  
  

* Establish and maintain emergency response plans for all sites.
* Conduct emergency drills and business continuity exercises.
* Coordinate with local emergency services and authorities.

Management Systems
  
  

* Maintain and improve ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems (IMS).
* Lead certification audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure KPI tracking, reporting, and corrective action closure.

Contractor Management

title: Office & Community Manager
description:
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
  
  
Share
  
  
**About Zuora**
At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.
  
  
We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
The Office & Community Manager will own the day-to-day workplace experience for Zuora’s Chennai office, creating a safe, efficient, welcoming, and well-maintained environment where employees and visitors can do their best work. Reporting to the APAC Workplace Manager, this role will connect facilities operations, vendors, budgets, employee programs, and community-building initiatives into one reliable workplace experience.
  
  
In the first 12–18 months, you will establish strong operating rhythms for the Chennai office, strengthen vendor and financial controls, improve workplace services, and help build an engaging office community aligned with regional workplace standards and business priorities.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Workplace Experience & Operations
  
  

* Own daily workplace operations and ensure the office is safe, clean, functional, and ready for employees and visitors.
* Oversee housekeeping, pantry, reception, security, maintenance, access control, transport, and related workplace services.
* Conduct regular workplace inspections and coordinate timely resolution of facilities issues, maintenance requirements, and employee concerns.
* Partner with the landlord, building management, service providers, and internal teams to maintain uninterrupted office operations.
* Establish and maintain workplace procedures, service standards, records, checklists, and operating routines.

Vendor & Financial Management
  
  

* Manage workplace vendors across sourcing support, quotations, negotiations, contracts, SLAs, AMCs, service reviews, and performance improvement.
* Monitor service quality, vendor compliance, invoices, purchase orders, and timely payments in partnership with Finance and Procurement.
* Support annual budgeting, expense tracking, forecasting, reporting, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and operational efficiency while protecting the employee experience.
* Maintain accurate records for contracts, assets, invoices, purchase orders, and workplace expenditure.

Employee Experience & Community Engagement
  
  

* Plan and deliver employee engagement activities, celebrations, wellness initiatives, and community-building programs.
* Create inclusive programs that encourage connection, collaboration, and a positive office culture.
* Gather employee feedback and translate insights into improvements to workplace services and the office experience.
* Manage workplace communications related to events, facilities updates, office guidelines, and employee initiatives.
* Support initiatives that encourage meaningful office connection, collaboration, and a strong sense of community.

Events, Hospitality & Leadership Support
  
  

* Coordinate workplace logistics for leadership visits, town halls, business meetings, team events, and external visitors.
* Manage event planning across budgets, venues, catering, vendors, employee communications, and on-site execution.
* Ensure meeting rooms, visitor areas, and office facilities are prepared to the required standard.
* Deliver a professional, inclusive, and welcoming hospitality experience for employees, leaders, and guests.

Health, Safety & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure compliance with applicable workplace, building, fire safety, environmental, and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate workplace risk assessments, safety inspections, emergency drills, corrective actions, and follow-up activities.
* Maintain emergency response procedures, incident records, safety documentation, and business continuity plans.
* Work with building management, security, vendors, and internal teams to address workplace risks promptly.
* Promote a culture of safety, inclusion, accessibility, and responsible workplace practices.

Space, Assets & Workplace Projects
  
  

* Maintain accurate records of office assets, equipment, inventory, seating, and space utilization.
* Coordinate workplace requirements for employee onboarding and offboarding, including access, seating, assets, and relevant handovers.
* Support office moves, seating changes, maintenance projects, renovations, and workplace improvement initiatives.
* Monitor office utilization and identify opportunities to improve space planning and resource allocation.
* Partner with IT and other teams to ensure workplace readiness for new employees and changing business needs.

Sustainability & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support initiatives related to energy efficiency, waste reduction, responsible purchasing, and sustainable workplace operations.
* Monitor workplace feedback, service levels, vendor performance, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare periodic reports on workplace expenditure, vendor performance, employee engagement, and operational issues.
* Share updates, risks, and recommendations with the APAC Workplace Manager and escalate issues requiring regional support.

**About You**
You may be a great fit if you:
  
  

* Bring typically 6–8 years of experience in workplace operations, facilities management, corporate office administration, hospitality, or employee experience.
* Have experience managing office services, vendors, budgets, events, workplace projects, and compliance requirements.
* Can take ownership of local workplace operations, prioritize competing needs, and respond thoughtfully to time-sensitive issues.
* Build trusted relationships with employees, leaders, vendors, landlords, and cross-functional partners.
* Use sound judgment, organized processes, and practical problem-solving to improve service delivery.
* Understand financial operations such as invoice validation, purchase orders, expense tracking, budget monitoring, and vendor cost control.
* Communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different stakeholders and situations.
* Are comfortable working independently while staying connected to regional standards, priorities, and support networks.
* Use Microsoft Office or Google Workspace confidently and can learn procurement, ticketing, or facilities management systems.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in a technology, SaaS, or multinational corporate environment.
* Experience supporting office moves, renovations, space planning, or workplace improvement projects.
* Familiarity with sustainability, environmental health and safety, business continuity, or accessibility programs.
* Experience creating employee engagement or community-building programs.

**About The Team**
The Chennai Office & Community Manager is part of Zuora’s APAC Workplace team and reports to the APAC Workplace Manager. The team is responsible for creating safe, effective, and engaging workplaces that support employees, leaders, and business operations across the region.
  
  
You will work closely with HR, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security, business leaders, landlords, building management, and workplace service providers. This is a hands-on role with meaningful local ownership, regional collaboration, and opportunities to expand your scope through workplace projects, employee programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:
  
  

* Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
* Medical Insurance
* Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
* Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
* Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
* Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
* Mental wellbeing resources and support
* Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process

#ZEOLife at Zuora
  
  
ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:
  
  

* Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
* Learn constantly and iterate often
* Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you.

description:

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.
  
  
The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.
  
  
The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation
  
  

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications

title: Commercial Manager, Life of Mine Solutions
description:
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future?
  
  
We believe we can develop the technology and gain the know-how to make a difference. It’s a big responsibility, and we are committed to making an impactful positive change. We need your skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials and technology needed for a better future.
  
  
**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring**

* Outcome-based models: Build and price lifecycle agreements cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, performance bonus and penalty structures, availability and throughput commitments.
* Indexing & term: Set multi-year index mechanics and term structures that protect FLS margin without. Define what good looks like before we commit externally.
* Consignment & ownership: Structure equipment ownership, consignment parts, and inventory models that the customer and FLS can both stand behind.
* Go/no-go discipline: Apply a clear deal evaluation framework. To advise whether we walk away from deals we cannot deliver or cannot price with confidence.

**Bid, Negotiation & Contract**

* Commercial offers: Lead the build of commercial proposals and pricing. Make sure pricing transparency, KPI definitions, and wear thresholds are defined and defensible, not left open.
* Negotiation: Run commercial negotiation with the customer, holding the line on the points that carry real risk and conceding where it does not.
* Contract integrity: Work with legal to close performance language gaps, per-KPI cap contradictions, and definition risk before signature, not after a dispute.
* One FLS: Make sure product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution are aligned on the commitment before it goes to the customer.

**Execution Readiness & Delivery Alignment**

* Operational truth: Logically test every commercial model against operational reality. A model that ignores site conditions is a future loss.
* Handover: Hand agreements to the delivery teams with the commercial logic, obligations, and risk points named clearly. Nothing implied.
* Performance tracking: Define how each agreement's performance should be measured and reported, so bonus / penalty mechanics for example are based on agreed data, not argument.

**Pipeline, Reporting & Governance**

* Support and maintain a structured commercial pipeline from opportunity through to signed agreement, with clear ownership at each stage for the sales regions you are working with
* Report deal status, margin, and commercial risk to leadership with the call a action and owner named, not just an observation.
* Maintain commercial templates and pricing tools so the team works from a consistent, disciplined base.

**Commercial Tools, Estimating & Standards**

* Commercial tooling: Support the development and ongoing improvement of the commercial tools the team relies on pricing models, offer templates, deal evaluation and go / no-go frameworks. Keep them practical and used, not shelfware.
* Estimating tools: Support the build and maintenance of estimating tools and cost models, Maintenance reference documents so estimators price lifecycle scope from a consistent, defensible base and the assumptions behind a number are clear.
* Commercial & legal guidelines: Work with legal to develop and maintain commercial and legal guidelines for long-term agreements: term and indexation mechanics, KPI and wear-threshold definitions, liability and cap structures, bonus / penalty language. Give the team a clear standard to work from before negotiation, not after a dispute.
* Equipment-specific packages: Develop repeatable, equipment-specific commercial packages for the core FLS product lines, so a lifecycle offer for a given asset starts from a proven template rather than a blank page.
* Version control & ownership: Own version control on tools, templates, and guidelines so the team works from one current source, with changes named and dated.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships**

* Socialize deals, strategic or commercial approach with regional leadership, sales teams, product ownership
* Engage mining operators, internal product, and regional operations to identify and qualify lifecycle opportunities worth pursuing.
* Represent FLS in commercial discussions, performance reviews, and customer planning sessions over the life of the agreement.
* Run competitive intelligence on rival lifecycle and performance-based offers to keep FLS's commercial position sharp.

**Team Support & Mentorship**

* Coach estimators GBC and commercial team members on deal structuring, pricing discipline, and the go/no-go framework.
* Build commercial capability across the team so quality does not depend on a single person.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Win rate on lifecycle deals: Percentage of qualified opportunities converted to signed agreements.
* Margin integrity: Delivered margin against committed margin across the active agreement portfolio.
* Cycle time: Average time from qualified opportunity to signed agreement.
* Execution alignment: Percentage of signed deals delivered without commercial dispute or unplanned concession.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Deep understanding of outcome-based commercial models in mining - cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, consignment, bonus/penalty mechanics.
* Strong grasp of fixed plant and lifecycle equipment economics: availability, throughput, wear life, repair and renewal.
* Commercial negotiation and contract construction, including working with legal on performance language and risk.
* Ability to connect commercial structure to operational delivery - commercial models built on operational truth, not optimism.
* Clear, direct written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leaders and customers and holding a position under challenge.
* Strong commercial judgment and the discipline to walk away from a deal that does not hold up.
* Comfort working across product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution to deliver one FLS to the customer.

**Education & Experience**

* Work experience: Minimum 10 years in mining, industrial services, or capital equipment, with a strong record in commercial deal structuring and negotiation.
* Demonstrated experience building and closing multi-year, outcome-based or performance contracts with measurable commercial results.
* Experience leading and developing commercial team members, including geographically dispersed teams.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Special Requirements**

* Ability to travel approximately 30 percent of the time, including internationally to mine sites and customer locations.
* Valid driver's license and passport.

**Core Competencies**

* Business acumen: Clear grasp of mining industry trends, risk, and market dynamics that drive FLS's lifecycle business internationally.
* Drive for results: Takes accountability for the commercial outcome and success of the deals owned.
* Influence and persuade: Convinces customers and internal stakeholders to align on a course of action; holds a position when challenged.
* Decision making: Takes personal responsibility for commercial decisions and their impact, including when data is incomplete.
* Critical thinking: Structured analysis of commercial and operational risk to reach a defensible position.
* Continuous improvement: Challenges current commercial process to sharpen FLS's lifecycle position.
* Mentor and coach: Build commercial capability in others through direct, supportive feedback.
* Think strategically: Connects individual deals to the broader shift from product selling to lifecycle accountability.

title: Multi-Store Manager – QSR Operations
description:
**Multi-Store Manager – Retail Operations**
**Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream**

***Chennai / Bangalore***

***Running one store well is a skill. Running several — without losing your grip on any of them — is something else entirely. That's the person we're looking for.***

**About Us**

Amadora Gourmet Ice Cream has been one of South India's most loved artisanal ice cream brands since 2011. We operate across Chennai and Bangalore, with an active expansion underway. As we scale, we need a sharp, grounded operations leader who can hold our stores to a high standard — and build the systems that make that standard self-sustaining.

**The Role**

As Multi-Store Manager, you will have end-to-end accountability for a cluster of Amadora stores. This is not a desk job.
***You'll be on the floor, in the numbers, and in the conversation — every day.***

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

**Operations & Standards**

* Own daily operations across your cluster of stores — opening/closing compliance, staffing, service flow, and cleanliness
* Conduct structured store visits with written observations and follow-through
* Ensure product quality and presentation standards are consistent across every outlet
* Identify and fix operational breakdowns before they become habits

**People & Performance**

* Hire, onboard, coach, and where necessary, exit store-level staff
* Build a culture of accountability — shift leads and store managers should run their stores, not wait for you to run it for them
* Conduct regular performance reviews and create development plans for high-potential team members
* Reduce attrition by building teams that actually want to stay

**Commercial & Financial Accountability**

* Track daily sales, waste, and cost metrics across your cluster
* Flag variances and drive corrective action with urgency
* Manage petty cash, vendor coordination, and inventory discipline at the store level
* Own your cluster's P&L contribution — you'll know your numbers cold

**Customer Experience & Brand**

* Monitor customer feedback across Google Reviews, Swiggy, Zomato, and in-store
* Ensure complaints are resolved quickly and learnings are fed back into operations
* Maintain Amadora's reputation as a premium, detail-obsessed brand at every touchpoint

**Reporting & Communication**

* Report daily to senior leadership with structured updates — not just "all okay"
* Surface issues early, propose solutions, and follow through on commitments
* Be the connective tissue between the ground and the leadership team

**What We're Looking For**

* 5–8 years in F&B, QSR, or specialty retail operations — with at least 2–3 years managing multiple locations
* A natural operator: you notice what's off before anyone tells you
* Strong people instincts — firm when needed, fair always
* Comfortable with numbers: sales, waste, cost per unit, variance — this should be your language
* Excellent communicator — clear in writing, direct in person
* Chennai or Bangalore based; willingness to travel between cities as needed
* Experience with delivery platforms (Swiggy/Zomato) and basic POS systems is a plus

**Why Amadora?**

We're not a cookie-cutter QSR chain. Every scoop we serve is made from scratch using real ingredients — no shortcuts, no compromise. That means the person leading our stores needs to genuinely care about quality, not just throughput.

***This role has real influence***
.

You'll shape how dozens of people show up to work, how thousands of customers experience our brand, and how we grow into new markets.

***If you want a role where your fingerprints are on the operation — this is it.***

International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
The role provides essential operational control across third-party management, stock and order administration, vendor financial management, product-change testing, and day-to-day embossing support. Without a backfill, these responsibilities would need to be redistributed across existing team members, increasing operational risk, reducing capacity, and potentially affecting service quality and control effectiveness.
  
  
The role acts as the key coordination point between HSBC stakeholders and the external vendor, supporting the continued delivery of card-related operations and daily operational support for embossing related activities.
  
  
The position also supports Third Party Engagement Manager (TPEM) activities and manages actions within Archer for third-party management activities.
  
  
**Key Activities Managed**
**Third-party and vendor governance**

* Manage TPEM and vendor governance activities.
* Maintain and update activities within Archer, including taking appropriate action against assigned controls.
* Track governance requirements, actions, risks, issues and evidence.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and the vendor to ensure obligations are completed on time.

**Stakeholder and vendor coordination**

* Act as the single point of contact between HSBC stakeholders and the vendor.
* Coordinate business requirements, operational changes, and service requests.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely communication across relevant teams.
* Facilitate effective collaboration between business, operations, technology, procurement, and vendor contacts.

**Plastics and collateral order management**

* Manage orders for card plastics and collateral.
* Track stock levels, movements, consumption, and replenishment requirements.
* Identify potential shortages, excess stock, or supply issues and take preventative action.
* Maintain accurate records and provide status updates to stakeholders.

**Forecasting and vendor cost management**

* Monitor vendor costs against agreed requirements and forecasts.
* Track vendor invoices and payouts.
* Investigate discrepancies and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders.

**Testing and product-change support**

* Provide ad hoc testing support for changes to card plastics and collateral.
* Coordinate with Idemia on revisions, new developments and product changes relating to credit and debit cards.
* Support test planning, execution, defect follow-up, and sign-off activities.
* Ensure operational impacts are understood before changes are introduced.

**Embossing operations and team management**

* Manage a team responsible for embossing-related activities.
* Oversee daily file processing and ensure queries are addressed promptly.
* Manage complaints, escalations, and exceptions through to resolution.
* Monitor team workload, service quality, and operational performance.
* Periodic review of procedures, controls and service expectations are consistently followed.

**Criticality of the Role**
**Required**
The role supports activities that directly affect the availability, accuracy and timely delivery of card products and related collateral. Effective management is required to:
  
  

* Maintain continuity of daily embossing and card-processing activities.
* Prevent stock shortages that could disrupt card issuance or replacement processes.
* Ensure vendor controls and governance obligations are completed.
* Protect financial accuracy through effective cost and payout tracking.
* Support timely implementation of card-product changes.
* Ensure queries, complaints and operational escalations are resolved within expected timescales.
* Maintain clear accountability between HSBC and the vendor.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate or above in any discipline with 10-12 years’ experience
* Person having experience and comprehensive knowledge on credit card operations is preferred.
* Strong analytical ability, logical thinking, and risk awareness.
* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* Have a strong team spirit and ability to work under pressure.

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable .
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: CMS Manager
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
  
  
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
The CMS Manager oversees day-to-day content operations across assigned business areas, ensuring digital content is implemented accurately, efficiently, and in line with business priorities. The role manages operational delivery across cross-functional partners and translates requirements into clear plans that balance deadlines, available capacity, technical requirements, and quality standards. A key part of the role is providing clear ownership and direction for CMS operations, particularly those delivered through WordPress.
  
  
The role combines team leadership with strong working knowledge of content management systems, especially WordPress, alongside operational workflows, quality assurance, and continuous improvement. The CMS Manager is expected to identify risks early, support the resolution of complex implementation issues, develop team capability, and improve the processes and tools used to manage content at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Operational Planning & Delivery****

* Oversee delivery across assigned business areas, including CMS and WordPress activity, aligning execution with business priorities, deadlines, and quality expectations.
* Assess incoming demand against available capacity, prioritize work, and identify risks or dependencies that could affect delivery.
* Coordinate complex updates, launches, migrations, and recurring operational workflows within WordPress and other relevant systems, ensuring work progresses through the appropriate review and approval stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for partners across Editorial, SEO, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Compliance, Product, and Engineering, as relevant to assigned areas.

****CMS/Wordpress Expertise****

* Maintain strong practical knowledge of WordPress and related content management tools, templates, plugins, components, and workflows, providing guidance to the team where required.
* Oversee the effective use of WordPress across assigned business areas, ensuring agreed approaches, standards, and publishing practices are followed consistently.
* Support the team in troubleshooting complex CMS and WordPress implementation issues, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with relevant technical partners.
* Identify recurring defects, manual tasks, and operational risks within CMS workflows, and recommend scalable improvements to tools, processes, and controls.

****Team Leadership & Development****

* Lead and support team members responsible for CMS operations, providing clear direction, coaching, feedback, and performance guidance.
* Develop team skills in CMS and WordPress usage, quality assurance, troubleshooting, operational judgement, and independent problem solving.
* Conduct regular check-ins and performance discussions, set clear expectations, and support individual development.

****Syndication Management****

* Own the CMS implementation and publishing workflow for syndicated content across external platforms.
* Ensure syndicated content meets platform specific formatting, building, and quality guidelines.
* Coordinate with the Operations team to maintain content continuity and manage daily and weekly content calendars.
* Monitor syndication quality and resolve publishing issues to ensure accurate and timely delivery.

****Quality Assurance & Standards****

* Ensure content and page implementations in WordPress and other relevant systems meet agreed standards for accuracy, structure, configuration, SEO requirements, monetisation elements, and applicable editorial and compliance guidelines.
* Maintain effective quality checks, analyze error patterns, and implement corrective actions to reduce defects and rework.

****Reporting & Continuous Improvement****

* Maintain operational reporting for assigned areas, including throughput, turnaround times, revisions, quality, and capacity.
* Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve delivery.
* Share concise updates on progress, risks, and improvement opportunities with relevant leaders.

**Skills & Experience**

* 8 – 10 years of full-time experience
* 2-3 years of experience in leading and managing a team
* Experience managing a team, including workload planning, coaching, performance feedback, and accountability for delivery and quality.
* Experience managing CMS operations, digital content implementation, content production, or digital operations in a high-volume environment, with responsibility for delivery through WordPress or a comparable platform.
* Strong practical knowledge of WordPress, including page components, templates, plugins, workflows, and configuration. Experience with AEM or another comparable content management system is beneficial.
* Ability to plan multiple workstreams, manage dependencies, and adjust priorities as business needs change.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements and constructively address infeasible requests.
* Demonstrated ability to lead the resolution of operational, WordPress, or wider CMS issues and identify practical, repeatable solutions.
* High attention to detail, sound organizational skills, and the ability to balance quality, timeliness, and changing priorities.

**Perks**

* Day off on the 3rd Friday of every month (one long weekend each month)
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Program to promote health well-being
* Monthly Office Commutation Reimbursement Program
* Paid paternity and maternity leaves

title: Coach Manager - Online Chess Learning
description:
**Company Description**
Chennai Chess Club is India’s fastest-growing chess community, dedicated to delivering high-quality chess education to learners around the world. The club offers structured online and in-person programs, complemented by engaging meetups and events across Chennai. With over 2000 students globally, Chennai Chess Club provides a vibrant environment for both aspiring and experienced players. The organization is focused on building a strong, inclusive chess culture and creating opportunities for continuous learning and competition.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Coach Manager to oversee the end-to-end lifecycle, performance, and operational excellence of our global Chess Coach network.

Sitting at the intersection of Talent Operations, Instructional Quality, and Community Building, you will scale our chess coaching ecosystem. You will be responsible for upholding high pedagogical standards, driving coach engagement and retention, optimizing coach capacity across batches, and ensuring exceptional learning outcomes for our students.

This role requires a deep background in chess instruction—whether as a player, certified coach, or academy operator—combined with strong operational discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Coach Lifecycle & Talent Development**

* Lead recruitment and technical evaluation processes to source high-caliber chess coaches (FIDE-rated / titled players preferred).
* Design and execute structured onboarding and induction programs covering our platform, curriculum, and teaching methodology.
* Drive continuous upskilling initiatives on chess pedagogy, interactive tool usage, and student engagement strategies.
* Build sustainable talent pipelines and retention initiatives for top-performing coaches.

**2. Performance Management & Quality Assurance**

* Establish clear delivery standards and evaluate coaching performance through regular session audits.
* Monitor key quality metrics (student retention, session ratings, student progress) and implement targeted improvement plans (PIPs) where needed.
* Refine matching criteria to align student rating tiers, learning goals, and age groups with the right coach expertise.

**3. Academic Quality & Instructional Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for complex chess domain questions, curriculum clarification, and delivery challenges.
* Collect frontline feedback from coaches to collaborate with Curriculum and Student Operations teams on improving learning materials and class tools.
* Track student rating progressions and batch health metrics to ensure strong academic results.

**4. Operations & Workforce Planning**

* Manage student-coach allocation, schedule adjustments, and batch health across international time zones.
* Forecast coach capacity requirements to support new cohort launches and category expansions.
* Oversee operational delivery to ensure seamless class scheduling and zero coverage gaps.

**5. Compensation & Financial Operations**

* Oversee wage administration, payout tracking, and dispute resolution in partnership with Finance.
* Manage performance-linked bonus programs, incentive structures, and career growth levels for coaches.
* Optimize coach capacity and payout structures to balance network growth with unit economics.

**6. Coach Experience & Engagement**

* Cultivate an active community culture among chess coaches through webinars, peer analysis sessions, and recognition programs.
* Act as an advocate for coaches, managing grievances and maintaining high morale across a distributed network.
* Track engagement metrics (eNPS) to build a collaborative, high-retention environment.

**Role Requirements**

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* Chess Experience: Proven background as an active/former chess coach, titled player (e.g., CM, FM, IM, GM), or certified FIDE Instructor / Trainer.
* Network Operations: Experience managing chess coaches or running/operating a chess academy, club, or EdTech vertical.

**Key Competencies**

* 3–6 years of experience in Coach Operations, Academic Management, or Community Operations.
* Strong grasp of chess training methodologies across beginner, intermediate, and advanced student levels.
* Data-driven approach to tracking operational metrics (retention, utilization, student feedback).
* Excellent communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder alignment skills.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.
* Leadership opportunity to shape the future of digital chess education.
* Dynamic, remote-friendly workplace culture driven by a passion for chess.

title: Support Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Pulse Telesystems is a leading telecom solution provider in India, delivering personalized telecom services that support evolving business needs. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Chennai, the company has expanded into multiple major metropolitan cities, serving over 4,000 clients across diverse industries. Its offerings include Internet Leased Lines, VoIP Solutions, Cloud Telephony, Virtual Numbers, SIP Internet Calling, custom CRM integrations, and advanced spam monitoring and CNAM services. Pulse Telesystems is a trusted telecom partner for top enterprises such as Zoho, MGM Healthcare, Larsen & Toubro, CEAT, India Cements Ltd., and PVR Cinemas, helping them improve performance and reliability. Team members join a growing organization focused on innovation, service quality, and long-term client relationships.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, disciplined and accountable Support Shift Lead to own day-to-day support operations during an assigned shift. The person will actively monitor tickets and incidents from logging through resolution, enforce response and resolution SLAs, coordinate the team, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. This role requires a hands-on leader who follows up relentlessly, escalates risks early, maintains accurate updates, and holds the team to agreed processes and commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.  Support Ticket & Incident Ownership

●      Monitor the support queue continuously and ensure every issue has a clear owner, priority, next action and target time.

●      Track tickets end-to-end—from acknowledgement and triage to troubleshooting, resolution, validation and closure.

●      Review ageing, overdue, stalled, reopened and high-priority tickets; drive action plans to prevent avoidable delays.

●      Enforce response, update and resolution SLAs; escalate potential breaches before they occur.

●      Coordinate major incidents, ensure timely technical escalation, and maintain an accurate incident timeline and handover notes.

2.  Team Leadership & Performance

●      Allocate and rebalance work based on severity, skills, workload and urgency; confirm ownership of every active issue.

●      Run shift kick-offs, periodic queue reviews and end-of-shift handovers.

●      Set clear expectations, monitor productivity and quality, and address missed commitments promptly and fairly.

●      Coach team members on troubleshooting, ticket hygiene, customer handling and escalation discipline.

●      Identify repeated performance gaps, document facts, and raise persistent issues to the Support Manager.

3.  Proactive Communication & Stakeholder Management

●      Provide timely, concise and factual updates to customers, internal teams, management and relevant stakeholders.

●      Communicate impact, current status, actions underway, blockers, ownership and the next update time—without waiting to be chased.

●      Alert stakeholders early when an issue risks breaching SLA or affecting business operations.

●      Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, vendors and other teams until dependencies are resolved.

●      Ensure no critical issue goes silent and no shift ends without a documented handover of open risks.

4.  Process, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

●      Maintain accurate ticket records, incident notes, escalation details, workaround steps and resolution summaries.

●      Prepare shift reports covering ticket volumes, SLA performance, open/overdue incidents, major risks and follow-up owners.

●      Identify recurring incidents and recommend problem-management actions, knowledge-base updates and process improvements.

●      Follow support procedures, access controls, customer communication standards and incident-management policies.

●      Use ticketing and monitoring tools consistently; keep dashboards and operational trackers current.

Required Skills & Competencies

●      Strong ownership, urgency, discipline and follow-through; comfortable enforcing standards and holding people accountable.

●      Excellent written and verbal communication; able to provide clear updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

●      Sound incident triage, prioritisation, escalation and problem-solving skills.

●      Experience coordinating a support/helpdesk/service desk/NOC/application support team.

●      Strong organisation skills, attention to detail and confidence handling competing priorities.

●      Ability to remain calm, firm and professional during high-severity incidents or customer escalations.

●      Working knowledge of SLAs, ticket lifecycle, incident management, shift handovers and operational reporting.

Experience & Qualifications

●      Typically 3–6 years of experience in technical support, IT operations, service desk, application support or a related environment.

●      At least 1–2 years in a team-lead, shift-lead, senior support or incident-coordination capacity preferred.

●      Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.

●      Exposure to monitoring dashboards, SLA reports, escalation matrices and knowledge-base processes.

●      ITIL Foundation or equivalent incident/service-management training is an advantage.

Success Measures (KPIs)

●      SLA compliance for first response, stakeholder updates and resolution.

●      Reduction in overdue, ageing and unassigned tickets.

●      Quality and timeliness of incident communications and shift handovers.

●      Ticket documentation completeness and resolution quality.

●      Escalation timeliness, repeat-incident trends and customer/stakeholder feedback.

●      Team adherence to process, ownership and agreed action deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is firm but fair, highly visible in the support queue, and proactive by default. They do not wait for reminders, allow issues to drift, or accept vague status updates. They establish clear owners and deadlines, communicate risks early, verify that actions are completed, and maintain professional accountability without resorting to disrespectful or aggressive behaviour.

Application Note

* Applicants should highlight examples where they improved SLA performance, managed critical incidents, coordinated a support team, prevented escalations through proactive communication, or reduced ticket backlog.
* Please share the resume to hr@pulse.in/ samuel@pulse.in

title: Business Manager – Electric Motor Scrap
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Business Manager to lead the procurement and trading of electric motor scrap and associated non-ferrous metals. The ideal candidate will have a strong existing supplier network among motor recyclers, e-waste processors, and industrial scrap generators, along with a deep understanding of metal recovery economics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Sourcing & Procurement: Identify, develop, and manage a robust supply chain for electric motor scrap, including dismantled motors, armatures, and copper-bearing scrap from motor recyclers, electronics, and industrial units .
* Supplier Network Expansion: Build and strengthen relationships with scrap aggregators, motor manufacturers, and e-waste processors to ensure a consistent volume of high-grade feedstock .
* Commercial Negotiation: Evaluate scrap quality, recovery potential, and assay reports to negotiate competitive pricing and favorable payment terms .
* Market Intelligence: Monitor daily market trends, scrap pricing movements (Copper, Aluminium, Steel), and supply-demand dynamics to optimize procurement strategies .
* Logistics & Compliance: Coordinate inbound logistics and ensure all purchases comply with environmental, safety, and e-waste regulatory requirements .

**Candidate Profile:**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Metallurgy, Commerce, or Supply Chain.
* Experience: Proven track record (3–10+ years) in metal scrap procurement, specifically with electric motors, ferrous/non-ferrous trading.
* Skills: Strong negotiation skills, existing supplier connections in the scrap ecosystem, and proficiency in Excel for reporting .

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to build and lead a vertical within a growing recycling business.

title: AGM / Associate expert , Chapter lead Field Engineering
description:
KONE is a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, making people’s journeys safe, convenient, and reliable with smart and sustainable People Flow®. In a world where cities are constantly evolving and more and more people choose to live in them, we at KONE stand with one clear aim: to shape the future of cities. We make urban life more vibrant and livable. And we do it by enabling safe, sustainable, and effortless people flow for all. We help cities leave a positive mark on the planet - for the next century and beyond. We shape the future of cities.
  
  
**KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI)**
is where the magic happens at KONE. It's where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.
  
  
**KONE R&D**
brings together top talent from different disciplines into an industry-leading product and technology organization. We thrive in solving complex customer challenges, connecting legacy with the latest technologies across hardware and software engineering. In fact, roughly half of our R&D roles are in software. Agile ways of working mean that we are better able to meet our customers’ rapidly evolving needs for speed and innovation, in a global environment.
  
  
R&D unit in KTI is responsible for developing digital services at KONE. It’s the development engine for our Digital Services such as KONE 24/7 Connected Services, Office Flow and Partnership Ecosystem. Our common goal at KONE is to keep the end users safe and people flow uninterrupted. KONE moves 2 billion people every day and that means our services can really make cities better places to live.
  
  
We are now looking for
  
  
**Head of Domain, Field engineering for Maintenance, Repair and Installation development**
to lead KONE India R&D field engineering team for maintenance and repair method development, both on-site and off-site (remote) inspections and interventions. The role will focus on transforming traditional maintenance operations from visit based conventional approach to data driven digitally enabled service delivery including inspections and repairs.
  
  
Work will require leadership experience and knowledge in Preventive Maintenance and Repairs, digitalization, maintenance strategy development and reliability analyses. You will work together with several R&D, IT and innovation units with close collaboration with business lines and country companies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop the Preventive Maintenance to deliver high-quality solutions and operational excellence.
* Act as Technical Lead in key projects, like maintenance visits content & methods optimization, driving digital maintenance process development and alignment across teams.
* Serve as Innovation Champion for the Field Engineering domain, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and piloting new technologies and practices.
* Conduct and support reliability centered maintenance based on data analyses and RAMs simulation (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability). Optimization is bringing insights for operational efficiency and way how to implement service delivery processes.
* Ensure compliance with maintenance-related codes & standards, regulations, contracts and company policies.
* Collaboration and co-creation within R&D, global business lines and KONE country companies.
* Monitor performance metrics (Field productivity, COR, Uptime) and drive actions to meet or exceed targets.
* Define and follow internal KPIs to measure domain productivity

**To be successful in this role, the preferred candidate will have**

* MSc or BSc in relevant field.
* Proven experience in maintenance management or repairs related to long-term service agreements to maintain customer assets at large scale.
* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Expertise in RAM methodologies and DATA analyses concepts.
* Rule based ML models and generative AI implementation to development and methods.
* Familiarity with maintenance processes, systems and development.

Strategy & Thought Leadership

* Leads coordination of the production of product performance reports and updates for senior management including scenario analysis, sensitivity testing, and forward-looking risk mitigations.

title: Market Risk Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
FR&Gs mission is to provide effective and efficient identification, measurement, monitoring and control of market, liquidity & Stress Testing related to the clearing and settlement processes for DTCC, its members and the markets. In addition, FR&G provides critical governance and quality assurance capabilities for key risk functions that are designed to meet rigorous organizational and regulatory standards. FR&G works under delegated authority from the Board and senior management to manage these risks within defined risk tolerances, as approved by the Board and senior management. FR&G collaborates closely with Quantitative Risk Management and the Counterparty Credit Risk teams to maintain an integrated and comprehensive approach to financial risk management at DTCC to support an effective second line of defense. FR&Gs prime directive for DTCC's applicable clearing agencies and joint ventures consists of the following:
  
  

* Maintain sufficient collateral to cover any losses associated with the liquidation of any defaulting member or family portfolio under extreme but plausible scenarios;
* Ensure that sufficient liquidity resources are available so that each entity is able to settle all transactions as contracted in the event of a failure by the single largest member or family under extreme but plausible circumstances;
* Exercise continuous improvement of policies, procedures and processes that support robust, ongoing member surveillance and effective but appropriate response to distress events; and
* Manage FR&G to maintain a deep and broad product knowledge and risk framework to effectively measure and manage market, liquidity and credit risks. Market Risk for Fixed Income Clearing Corporation (FICC) and National Securities Clearing Corporation (NSCC) is responsible for the monitoring of daily margin calculation and managing market and liquidity risk exposures arising from trade execution and settlement activities in the clearing corporations and the depository. Responsibilities also include driving new business initiatives, overseeing risk systems design and continuous enhancements, compliance with Risk Management policies and procedures. Responsible for understanding of margining methodologies, keen understanding of financial markets and client profiles, and effectively collaborate with other DTCC teams to identify, analyze, and mitigate potential risks and safeguard financial market in which DTCC plays a pivotal role.

**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
As a Director, you will provide senior leadership across Financial Risk & Governance (FR&G), supporting DTCC’s clearing agencies and critical market infrastructure. You will be accountable for the identification, measurement, monitoring, and control of market and liquidity risk exposures, operating within Board‑approved risk tolerances and regulatory expectations.
  
  
You will serve as a senior leader for the FR&G organization in Chennai, combining direct people management responsibilities with a broader leadership presence across the local Market and Liquidity Risk teams. This is a key role which strengthens DTCC’s global risk operating model, developing talent, and ensuring consistent execution and risk culture across regions.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide senior oversight of daily market and liquidity risk activities, including market risk, stress testing, liquidity sufficiency, and member exposure monitoring across DTCC clearing entities as we move toward 24x7 clearing.
* Ensure risk management practices adhere to DTCC policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations, exercising sound [LL1] judgment and timely escalation where required.
* Partner closely with Quantitative Risk Management, Counterparty Credit Risk, and Clearing & Settlement stakeholders to support a cohesive and integrated financial risk framework.
* Drive continuous improvement of risk methodologies, processes, and controls to strengthen resilience under extreme but plausible market stress scenarios.
* Support enhancements to market, liquidity, and stress testing risk systems, tools, and reporting infrastructure through collaboration with technology and other stakeholders.
* Support risk assessments related to new initiatives, products, or material changes as required, consistent with established risk frameworks and governance.
* Lead, develop, and manage Market and Liquidity Risk professionals across the regional offices, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Serve as a senior leadership presence for the FR&G regional offices, fostering engagement, coordination, and collaboration across teams, regardless of reporting alignment.
* Operate effectively in a matrixed environment, influencing stakeholders and driving outcomes across functions and regions, including in the absence of direct management authority.
* Establish strong cross-functional relationships to promote alignment, resolve competing priorities, and deliver consistent execution of risk objectives
* Provide senior leadership and serve as a central point of communication across stakeholders, providing clear, transparent, and timely updates on risk exposure, emerging issues, and strategic initiatives.
* Support responses and inquiries from internal audits, regulatory examinations, and governance reviews, including issue remediation and appropriate escalation to senior management.
* Contribute to global risk governance forums, leadership discussions, and cross‑functional initiatives to support DTCC’s broader risk management strategy and objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 10 years of related experience
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (Master’s, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Significant experience in market risk, liquidity risk, stress testing, or financial risk management within a clearing organization, exchange, bank, or financial market infrastructure environment.
* Proven people leadership experience, including direct line management of managers and/or senior professionals.
* Demonstrated ability to provide leadership influence and coordination across teams without direct reporting relationships, particularly in regional or multi‑location environments.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, margining methodologies, liquidity risk frameworks, and regulatory expectations applicable to clearing agencies.
* Strong communication, judgment, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to operate effectively at senior leadership levels.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. description:

This role serves as the senior technology leader within Lexitas India, responsible for managing day-to-day IT Operations and Information Security functions while ensuring alignment with the global technology strategy established by the CIO/CISO.

The Director will lead a team of approximately 10 resources split between IT Infrastructure Operations and Information Security. This position plays a critical role in maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable technology services that support a rapidly growing, compliance-driven business environment.

* Participate in security investigations and incident management activities.
* Promote security awareness and security-first thinking throughout the organization.

**Governance, Risk, & Compliance**

* Support and maintain compliance programs including:
* SOC 2
* HIPAA
* Customer security assessments and RFPs
* Internal control audits
* Coordinate audit activities, evidence collection, remediation planning, and control management.

**COMPETENCIES, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Lexitas expects employees to model and conduct themselves according to the Lexitas Core Values. Employees are expected to deliver Service Excellence with a spirit of Positivity and Integrity. We embrace Innovation and an Entrepreneurial mindset to keep improving, while always treating others with Respect. We thrive on Teamwork, while celebrating Diversity and the unique strengths each person brings. These values shape our culture and fuel our commitment to exceptional service.

  strong knowledge and practical experience with:
* Information Security frameworks and best practices

  experience with:
* AWS cloud infrastructure (preferred)
* Azure cloud infrastructure (acceptable)
* Cloud security principles

  strong familiarity with:

**Summary**
**Position Summary**

**Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - SAP MM/FICO/SD integration with Direct or Indirect Tax experience**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting practice is seeking a Manager, Tax Services professional to help clients modernize and improve their tax operations. In this role, you will lead SAP tax transformation and application managed services efforts, guide teams through complex delivery requirements, and help translate tax and business needs into technology-enabled solutions. As a Manager, Tax Services professional on the Tax Transformation Consulting team, you will be responsible for...
