**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients' tax departments move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients' objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients' global strategies with the options that exist to turn strategy into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC's Enterprise Tax Transformation (ETT) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented, or are considering implementing, an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function's unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology, and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.

And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.
  
  
Deloitte’s culture
  
  
Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centred, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
  
  
Corporate citizenship
  
  
Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Mumbai/Pune/Gurugram/Chennai/Kolkata

Required:
  
  

* 8 to 15+ years of total experience
* 5+ years of implementation experience in SAP ECC 6.0 & S/4HANA with a focus on Tax integration across SAP FICO/MM/SD, including Direct or Indirect Tax experience
* Experience with tax technology applications such as ONESOURCE/Global Next Integration, Vertex Accelerator and Chainflow Accelerator Integration, Avalara, and Sovos

title: IT Sourcing Manager
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Sourcing Manager
  
  
**Department**
: ISPL Cardif IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40.5 billion in 2025.
  
  
BNP Paribas Cardif IT is a global organization with about 3000 IT staff across Europe, Latin America and Asia. Its mission is to drive and support our business strategy across all regions by leading digital transformation and delivering secure, resilient, and scalable industrial technology solutions. It is committed to enabling innovation, strengthening cyber resilience, and fostering collaboration and diversity across markets and teams to create exceptional value for our customers and partners, and ensure sustainable growth for BNP Paribas Cardif at the global scale.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The IT Sourcing Manager is responsible for the commercial and contractual architecture of the India sourcing project. This role acts as the vital link between Onshore Beneficiaries (Business & IT Managers) and the External Vendor Market. Your mission is to translate the technical and operational needs of our onshore stakeholders into high-quality sourcing strategies, ensuring that the vendors selected provide the exact expertise, cost-efficiency, and compliance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Onshore Stakeholder Engagement & Requirement Translation
* Beneficiary Alignment: Act as the primary commercial interface for Onshore IT Managers and Business Beneficiaries to understand their technical roadmaps and resource needs.
* Requirement Synthesis: Collaborate with onshore technical leads to translate complex functional and technical requirements into clear, commercially viable Sourcing Specifications.
* Sourcing Advisory: Advise onshore beneficiaries on market trends, pricing benchmarks, and the pros/cons of different delivery models (e.g., Managed Services vs. Staff Augmentation) to ensure their needs are met effectively.
* Strategic Sourcing & Vendor Selection
* Market Intelligence: Conduct continuous research into the Indian IT landscape to identify high-caliber service providers that align with BNP Paribas Cardif’s technical standards.
* RFP & Tender Management: Lead the end-to-end Request for Proposal (RFP) process, ensuring that all technical criteria defined by onshore beneficiaries are rigorously evaluated during vendor selection.
* Sourcing Strategy: Execute sourcing decisions that balance technical excellence, cost-optimization, and long-term scalability.
* Negotiation & Contract Management
* Commercial Negotiation: Lead negotiations on pricing structures, volume discounts, and contract terms to maximize value for the Group.
* SLA & Contractual Governance: Ensure that all vendor contracts include robust Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that directly reflect the service quality expected by onshore beneficiaries.
* Contractual Compliance: Ensure all agreements strictly adhere to BNP Paribas Group procurement policies and global cybersecurity/risk standards.
* Vendor Relationship & Financial Oversight
* Vendor Lifecycle Management: Manage the formal onboarding of new partners and the strategic exit/transition of legacy providers.
* Commercial Escalation: Act as the first point of escalation for any commercial discrepancies, contract breaches, or cost-related deviations impacting the project budget.
* Cost Optimization: Partner with FinOps and Finance to monitor vendor spend and ensure the outsourcing model delivers the expected economic efficiency.

**Contributing Responsibilities**
**Recruitment & Onboarding Execution**

* Demand Translation: Convert onshore technical requirements into detailed hiring plans (profile, timing, and priority).
* Talent Coordination: Orchestrate the end-to-end recruitment workflow within ISPL (screening, interviews, and offers) to ensure a seamless talent pipeline.
* Onboarding Management: Support the rapid onboarding of resources to meet project ramp-up needs and ensure "day-one" readiness.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic Sourcing & Procurement: Mastery of the end-to-end sourcing lifecycle (RFP, RFI, RFQ) within a complex IT environment.
* Contract Management: Deep understanding of commercial contract law, specifically regarding IT services, intellectual property, and data privacy.
* Vendor Risk Management (VRM): Ability to assess and mitigate third-party risks in alignment with IT Risk Management and Cybersecurity frameworks.
* Financial Acumen: Proficiency in cost-benefit analysis, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) modeling, and managing complex pricing structures.
* IT Domain Awareness: Foundational understanding of IT infrastructure, application development, and cloud services to communicate effectively with technical beneficiaries.

**Specific Qualifications**

* Stakeholder Influence & Negotiation: Exceptional ability to manage expectations and negotiate effectively with both internal onshore beneficiaries and external vendor executives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work seamlessly across IT, HR, Finance, and Procurement functions to achieve project goals.
* Analytical Thinking: Capability to synthesize complex technical requirements and market data into clear strategic recommendations.
* Communication Excellence: High proficiency in articulating commercial and strategic concepts to diverse audiences, ensuring alignment between onshore needs and offshore delivery.
* Integrity & Professionalism: Unwavering commitment to ethical sourcing practices and compliance with Group standards.

**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**

* Strategic Sourcing/Procurement expertise
* Contract Law fundamentals
* Vendor Risk Management (VRM)
* Financial Modeling/Cost Analysis
* Familiarity with IT Service Management

**Behavioral Skills**

* Advanced Negotiation skills
* Strong Commercial Acumen
* Ethical Integrity
* Stakeholder Management
* Strategic ThinkingSkill

**Education Level:**
Master’s Degree
  
  
**Experience:**
8+ years of experience
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

title: IT Strategist
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Strategist
  
  
**Department**
: ISPL Cardif IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
BNP Paribas Cardif is a world leader in bancassurance partnerships, providing its customers with products and services that let them realise their goals while protecting themselves from unforeseen events. BNP Paribas Cardif is committed to having a positive impact on society and to making insurance more accessible. A subsidiary of BNP Paribas, the insurer has a unique business model anchored in partnerships. It creates solutions for more than 500 partner distributors in a variety of sectors – including banks and financial institutions, automotive sector companies, retailers and telecommunications companies – as well as for financial advisors and brokers who market the products to their customers. With a presence in 30 countries and strong positions in Europe, Asia and Latin America, BNP Paribas Cardif is a global specialist in personal insurance, the world leader in creditor insurance and a major contributor to financing for the real economy. With 9,000 employees worldwide, BNP Paribas Cardif had gross written premiums of €40.5 billion in 2025.
  
  
BNP Paribas Cardif IT is a global organization with about 3000 IT staff across Europe, Latin America and Asia. Its mission is to drive and support our business strategy across all regions by leading digital transformation and delivering secure, resilient, and scalable industrial technology solutions. It is committed to enabling innovation, strengthening cyber resilience, and fostering collaboration and diversity across markets and teams to create exceptional value for our customers and partners, and ensure sustainable growth for BNP Paribas Cardif at the global scale.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
The
**IT Strategist**
is the strategic architect and operational orchestrator for the IT leadership team. This role is responsible for defining the department's strategic direction and ensuring its successful execution through rigorous governance, transformation management, and high-level communication. You will act as the bridge between strategic intent (CTO/CIO vision) and operational reality (Production/Delivery), ensuring that the organization’s transformation—specifically the India sourcing initiative—is seamless, data-driven, and delivers maximum value to our business beneficiaries.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Definition & Roadmap Orchestration
* Strategy Formulation: Actively contribute to the definition and promotion of the IT industrialization and production strategy, ensuring alignment with the BNP Paribas Group’s global technological policy.
* Transformation Roadmap: Design and manage the multi-year transformation roadmap, translating long-term vision into actionable milestones for the India transition and other strategic shifts.
* Decision Support: Provide the COO/Head of IT with high-level synthesis, risk opinions, and "decision-ready" intelligence to facilitate complex strategic choices.
* Executive Communication & Visual Storytelling
* Strategic Narrative Design: Lead the creation of sophisticated, executive-level presentations (PowerPoint) for Steering Committees, Board reviews, and Group-level reporting.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Develop and execute communication plans that translate technical and operational complexities into clear, compelling business value for Onshore Beneficiaries and Group leadership.
* Transparency & Reporting: Establish a culture of transparency by designing high-level reporting frameworks that provide a consolidated view of strategy, budget, and transformation progress.
* Governance, Performance & Business Alignment
* Governance Frameworks: Implement and lead governance bodies to facilitate decision-making processes, trajectory monitoring, and stakeholder alignment.
* KPI & Performance Architecture: Define and oversee the deployment of relevant performance indicators (KPIs/SLOs) to monitor the quality, stability, and ROI of the new operational setup.
* Business Relationship Liaison: Act as the ultimate escalation point for "business irritants," ensuring that the interests of Onshore Beneficiaries are represented in the design and implementation of new IT solutions.
* Operational & Financial Oversight
* Transformation Monitoring: Oversee the "Build, Run, Improve" cycle of the transformation, ensuring that the transition to India delivers expected efficiency and cost-control targets.
* Budget & Cost Governance: Monitor the departmental strategic budget, ensuring that investments in transformation and production are based on a clear business rationale (ROI/Efficiency).
* Risk & Continuity Oversight: Ensure that the transformation strategy integrates IT Risk, Cybersecurity, and Business Continuity (BCP) requirements from the design phase.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategy & Transformation: Proven ability to define, promote, and implement large-scale organizational change and IT industrialization strategies.
* Business / IT Relationship Management: Expertise in managing complex stakeholder ecosystems and aligning IT capabilities with business needs.
* Financial & Budget Steering: Ability to manage strategic budgets, monitor cost evolution, and ensure the financial viability of the transformation roadmap.
* Risk & Governance: Deep understanding of IT Risk, Cybersecurity governance, and the ability to provide informed "Risk Opinions" on strategic decisions.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**
**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Visual Storytelling: Mastery of PowerPoint to create high-impact, executive-level visual narratives.
* Analytical Ability: Superior ability to synthesize vast amounts of data into actionable strategic insights.
* Project/Program Management: Advanced knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and ITIL methodologies to oversee complex, multi-threaded programs.
* Change Management: Ability to understand, explain, and support large-scale organizational change.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Impact & Influence: Exceptional ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive commitment toward a shared strategic vision.
* Decision Making: Ability to make high-pressure decisions based on incomplete or complex information.
* Resilience: High capacity to maintain focus and leadership stability in a fast-paced, transformative, and often ambiguous environment.
* Creativity & Problem Solving: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks in the transformation and designing innovative solutions.
* Communication Excellence: Mastery of both oral and written communication in English, tailored for executive audiences.

**Education Level:**
Master’s Degree
  
  
**Experience:**
10–15+ years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. description:
**People Manager & Business Activity Owner (BAO) - Center of Excellence**
**Introduction**
We are establishing a new Business Activity Owner (BAO) Center of Excellence (CoE) and are seeking a strong, strategic leader to build and guide one of its core teams. This is a "dual-hat" People Manager role responsible for leading, developing, and inspiring a team of BAO professionals while also managing a portfolio of Technology & Business Enablement’s (T&BE) third-party relationships.
  
  
This role requires an experienced leader with a strategic mindset, strong business acumen, and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, constantly evolving environment. Success in this position depends on sound judgment, accountability, effective decision-making, and a commitment to developing talent. The role also requires balancing operational excellence with people leadership, fostering both high performance and a culture that supports professional growth and healthy work-life integration.
  
  
**Leadership & Management Responsibilities**
As a People Manager within the CoE, your primary responsibility is to your team. We have high expectations for our leaders, and you will be accountable for:
  
  

* Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of BAO professionals. Foster a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
* Strategic Vision: Develop and execute a strategic vision for your team, proactively identifying opportunities for optimization and aligning with the ever-changing technology and vendor strategy.
* Financial Oversight: Manage financial tasks and budgets related to your team and vendor portfolio.
* Resilience & Adaptability: Handle pressure with composure and guide your team through a dynamic and ever-changing environment.
* Empathetic Leadership: Be present and attentive to your team's success, actively promoting a healthy work-life balance and ensuring their well-being.
* Ownership & Accountability: Demonstrate strong professional intelligence and the ability to think independently. You will be expected to make decisive calls and own the outcomes, learning and iterating from both successes and failures.

**Business Activity Owner (BAO) Responsibilities**
In addition to your leadership duties, you will act as the designated BAO for a select portfolio of vendor relationships. You will be hands-on in executing the end-to-end responsibilities for these critical suppliers.
  
  
**Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Define Business Needs: Collaborate with internal teams to clearly define business requirements for engaging a third-party.
* Risk Assessment: Initiate and complete the Inherent Risk Questionnaire (IRQ) to determine the risk profile of the relationship.
* Engage Sourcing: Partner with Sourcing to conduct sourcing events and select the appropriate third-party.
* Coordinate Due Diligence: Manage the comprehensive due diligence process with various control assessment groups.
* Contracting: Oversee the contracting process, securing approvals and ensuring correct setup.

**Ongoing Monitoring & Management**

* Performance Management: Continuously monitor and report on third-party performance against Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Risk & Control Assessments: Perform Ongoing Monitoring (OGM) control assessments and address any identified gaps.
* Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for the third-party and manage escalations.
* Process Improvement: Proactively identify trends, drive supplier optimization, and make recommendations to improve ways of working.
* Compliance: Stay current on industry regulations and ensure the third-party relationship remains compliant, including managing renewals and amendments.

**Offboarding**

* Termination: Manage the decision and execution of the termination process, ensuring a smooth transition.

**Qualifications**
**Leadership Qualifications**

* Management Experience: Proven experience in leading, mentoring, and developing teams is required. This is ideally demonstrated by 2+ years of a formal people management role, however significant experience acting as a team lead, project lead, or senior mentor for a group of colleagues will be strongly considered.
* Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to think strategically, look forward, and align team execution with broader business and technology strategy.
* Decisiveness & Accountability: Demonstrated history of making independent decisions and taking full ownership of the results.
* Emotional Intelligence: Strong ability to lead with empathy, manage team dynamics, and remain composed under pressure.

**BAO & Professional Qualifications**

* Experience: 2+ years of experience in a supplier/third-party management, vendor management, project management, or risk management role.
* Project Management: Excellent project management, planning, and organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to manage and track multiple complex tasks simultaneously.
* Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal, collaboration, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present complex and sensitive issues clearly to senior management.
* Problem Solving: A proactive and analytical mindset with the ability to handle ad-hoc requests, remediate issues, and drive resolutions.
* Adaptability: A desire to learn, tackle new challenges, and thrive in an evolving role.

title: Books Head/Account Manager – Publishing Services
description:

**Role Overview**

The role requires a strong understanding of end-to-end book production, excellent client communication skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with internal production, editorial, composition, quality, and technology teams.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with a publishing house or a publishing services company, understand the complete book production lifecycle, and be capable of managing customer expectations, delivery schedules, quality standards, and operational performance.

* Manuscript assessment, pre-editing, and content preparation.

* Artwork, tables, figures, permissions, and reference management.
* Author queries, corrections, and review cycles.

* Indexing, where applicable, and preparation of print-ready PDFs and eBook outputs.

**2.     Production Coordination & Delivery**

* Coordinate with production managers, editors, typesetters, proofreaders, quality teams, and other stakeholders.
* Track multiple titles and projects simultaneously, ensuring visibility into milestones, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Monitor production volumes, turnaround times (TAT), quality metrics, and pending activities.
* Ensure that project teams have clear briefs, specifications, and priorities.
* Escalate risks in advance and drive timely resolution of production issues.
* Ensure compliance with publishing standards, customer specifications, and internal quality processes.

**3. Quality & Process Improvement**

* Maintain high standards of editorial, compositional, and final-delivery quality.
* Analyse recurring errors, customer feedback, rework, and production delays to identify root causes.
* Work with internal teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve productivity, and reduce production costs without compromising quality.
* Support the adoption of workflow automation, digital publishing solutions, and AI-enabled tools wherever relevant.
* Monitor account-level performance against agreed SLAs, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Support workload planning, resource coordination, and production forecasting.
* Track relevant operational metrics, including productivity, turnaround time, error rates, rework, and customer satisfaction.
* Support estimates, production planning, scope discussions, and change requests in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
* Identify potential opportunities to expand the scope of services offered to existing customers.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

·        5–7 years of relevant experience in book publishing, book production, or publishing services.

·        Candidates from publishing houses, academic publishers, STM publishers, trade publishers, or publishing services companies are preferred.

·        Strong practical knowledge of book production stages, workflows, terminology, and deliverables.

·        Postgraduate qualification preferred.

·        Strong academic background, preferably from a reputed institution, with English-medium education.

·        Excellent spoken and written English

·        Strong email-writing, meeting-management, presentation, and reporting skills.

·        Ability to explain production issues, risks, and corrective actions clearly and professionally.

Chennai (Work from Office)

title: Director - Tech Operations
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
Joining Amex Tech means helping build and operate technology that supports critical business capabilities at enterprise scale. We are seeking an experienced
**Director of Engineering**
to lead a portfolio within the Operations Data and Analytics organization spanning
**ServiceNow and IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategy platform engineering, and observability and operational analytics for the Customer Journey availability program**
.
  
  
A significant area of focus will be the continued development and modernization of
**Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and the Configuration Management Database (CMDB)**
capabilities that support these processes. This leader will help ensure these capabilities operate as integrated enterprise technology products, with strong engineering practices, reliable data, appropriate governance, and roadmaps aligned to the needs of the broader technology organization.
  
  
This leader will be responsible for bringing together platforms, engineering practices, operational processes, and data to improve availability, resiliency, efficiency, and measurable business outcomes across mission-critical technology services.
  
  
The role requires an experienced engineering leader who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels—setting direction and developing technical talent while maintaining sufficient depth to challenge architecture, engineering, reliability, platform, and service-management decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**How You Will Make an Impact**
**Engineering & Platform Leadership**

* Lead engineering and platform capabilities supporting ServiceNow/ITSM, Strategy, and Customer Journeys.
* Establish and execute multi-year platform and engineering strategies aligned with organizational priorities.
* Drive modernization of platform architecture, engineering practices, automation, integrations, and data capabilities.
* Establish standards for software quality, testing, deployment, security, scalability, resilience, and maintainability.
* Ensure critical platforms meet expectations for availability, performance, scalability, security, and regulatory compliance.
* Develop strong technical talent and create organizational depth while establishing clear accountability and ownership.

**ServiceNow, ITSM & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and engineering leadership for ServiceNow and associated enterprise ITSM capabilities, with particular emphasis on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and CMDB development as it relates to those areas.
* Establish and evolve a technology roadmap for these capabilities that aligns ServiceNow development with enterprise operational, reliability, risk, product owners, and business priorities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of industry standards, established practices, and emerging trends across ITIL-based Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management and use that knowledge to inform platform strategy and engineering priorities.
* Ensure CMDB capabilities supporting Incident, Problem, and Change processes provide accurate, useful, and sustainable configuration and relationship data.
* Drive integration across Incident, Problem, Change, and CMDB capabilities so that configuration data strengthens impact analysis, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, operational decision-making, and automation.
* Partner with ITSM process owners and technology stakeholders to translate process strategy into scalable ServiceNow capabilities.
* Participate in and influence the ServiceNow roadmap through established governance, prioritization, and planning forums, representing the needs and priorities of SRE, Application Support, Operations Engineering, and other technology stakeholders.
* Build alignment across process owners, platform teams, engineering organizations, and senior leaders on ServiceNow priorities, investments, sequencing, and technical direction.
* Challenge unnecessary process or platform complexity while ensuring appropriate controls, governance, and auditability.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows, eliminate process gaps, improve data quality, and reduce operational toil.
* Ensure ServiceNow capabilities evolve as engineered products rather than simply administrative workflows.
* Establish metrics demonstrating the effectiveness of ITSM capabilities and their impact on availability, reliability, engineering productivity, and operational outcomes.

**Observability, SRE & Availability**

* Define and evolve observability capabilities using technologies such as Dynatrace, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, and related enterprise tooling.
* Improve telemetry, monitoring, alerting, event correlation, and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
* Drive adoption of engineering practices that move teams from reactive monitoring toward proactive observability and reliability management.
* Partner with SRE and application teams to establish meaningful SLIs, SLOs, availability measures, and service-health standards.
* Use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns and prioritize engineering investments.
* Connect observability, CMDB, Incident, and Problem data to improve identification and resolution of reliability issues.
* Expand the footprint of our Customer Journeys and align them to critical business services.

**Strategy & Data Platforms**

* Lead application development and production support for Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), including delivery execution and the long-term platform roadmap.
* Ensure availability, scalability, and performance of BI and analytics capabilities supporting critical business and operational decisions.
* Drive modernization of data architecture, tooling, and engineering practices.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to develop advanced analytics and data-driven operational insights.
* Create integrations with other operational solutions including agentic solutions.

**Customer Journey Availability**

* Provide leadership across modern data ecosystems and workflow/orchestration technologies such as Apache Airflow.
* Lead and expand capabilities for measuring end-to-end availability across critical customer journeys.
* Establish visibility and accountability across application, infrastructure, platform, and business teams.
* Support 99.99% availability objectives for designated critical journeys through standardized measurement, governance, and engineering practices.
* Establish controls and processes supporting reliability, risk management, auditability, and consistent delivery of business outcomes.
* Use observability and operational data to proactively identify risks affecting customer experiences.

**Financial & Organizational Leadership**

* Build, attract, retain, and develop high-performing engineering talent.
* Lead effectively across globally distributed teams and stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Significant experience leading enterprise engineering, platform engineering, SRE, production management, data, or technology operations organizations.
* Demonstrated experience providing leadership to senior engineers and technical leaders.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow and enterprise ITSM/ITIL processes, particularly Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
* Strong understanding of industry standards and established ITIL practices associated with Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Configuration Management.
* Experience developing or overseeing CMDB capabilities that directly support Incident, Problem, and Change processes.
* Demonstrated experience participating in and influencing ServiceNow platform roadmaps through established governance, planning, and prioritization forums in a complex enterprise environment.
* Ability to influence platform direction across organizations where roadmap ownership, process ownership, engineering execution, and business priorities may reside with different teams.
* Experience with enterprise observability platforms such as Dynatrace and Splunk, including modern telemetry and monitoring practices.
* Strong background in application development, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and production engineering.
* Experience defining and executing large-scale technology and platform strategies.
* Experience operating business-critical systems in highly available and regulated environments.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud, automation, and reliability engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to influence peers and leaders and align teams across complex global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) or comparable enterprise BI platforms.
* Experience with Apache Airflow or comparable data orchestration technologies.
* Experience with Site Reliability and Operations Engineering in a large-scale application support organization.
* Experience establishing enterprise observability strategies.

**Leadership Qualities**
Successful Directors in this role will demonstrate the ability to:
  
  

* Set a clear technology vision and convert strategy into executable roadmaps.
* Develop senior engineers and technical leaders.
* Create clear ownership and accountability while empowering individuals to make decisions.
* Balance delivery speed with reliability, security, technical debt, regulatory requirements, and long-term maintainability.
* Communicate complex technical issues and tradeoffs effectively with both engineers and executives.
* Influence enterprise platform and process direction when decision-making is distributed across multiple organizations.
* Build consensus through established governance while being willing to constructively challenge priorities and approaches.
* Make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Create an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, automation, continuous improvement, and learning.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge teams without becoming the team's de facto principal engineer.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll India is part of Ramboll Group owned by the Ramboll Foundation, with strong corporate values and long-term thinking. In India we have major offices in Gurugram, Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai and Mumbai. Here, you can apply your professional passion for high quality and delivering innovative solutions within Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future, working in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture.
  
  
We invite you to bring your passion, curiosity, positive energy, and technical expertise to develop sustainable solutions for industry projects worldwide. To succeed in this role, you must possess a strong technical background in industry engineering (Process, Chemical, Petrochemical, etc.), extensive experience as a Piping and Layout specialist, and the ability to lead project teams across Ramboll’s offices and geographies within the Plant Design discipline.
  
  
**You will join our High-Rise Buildings**
**Department**
As our new
**Senior Technical Lead BIM - High Rise Structure**
, you will be part of our global High-Rise department, Ramboll’s dedicated team of Highrise experts which have designed over 150 tall building projects globally, including some of the most technically challenging. You would be responsible to coordinate with project managers and/or engineers for Analysis and Design work in the Highrise department in Chennai to support the global department which also has offices in Copenhagen, UK, Middle East, and Singapore.
  
  
**The BIM Lead owns day-to-day resourcing and quality performance of the BIM function, which sits entirely within REC. The role gives the BIM function a single point of accountability for resource allocation, output quality and staff development.**
**Job Description**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Allocate BIM staff across active projects in line with project delivery plans and the Department's resourcing methodology.
* Identify resourcing gaps or conflicts early and raise them to the Head of Department and the relevant Project Lead before they affect delivery, in line with the Project Delivery and Governance Guideline.
* Own overall BIM output quality and drawing presentation standards across REC.
* Set and monitor productivity and quality standards for the BIM team, distinct from the project-level quality checks performed by the BIM Quality Lead and Senior BIM Coordinator(s).
* Escalate any resourcing decision beyond the Department's established methodology, and any matter that cannot be resolved through coordination with the Quality function or the relevant Project Lead, to the Head of Department.
* Maintain visibility of BIM team capacity and utilisation across REC.

**Secondary Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver a structured training scheme for the BIM team, covering software proficiency, modelling standards and productivity.
* Assign team members to the training scheme and track completion and resulting quality/productivity improvement.
* Identify individual skill gaps and provide or arrange targeted training as needed.
* Coordinate with Project Leads and Project BIM Leads on project-specific BIM resourcing and delivery needs.
* Report resourcing status, training progress and quality trends to the Head of Department on a regular basis.

**Ideal Character Type**

* Hands-on and detail-focused: comfortable reviewing models and drawings directly, not managing purely at a distance.
* Owns resourcing and quality outcomes; escalates early rather than explaining late.
* Calm and structured under multiple concurrent project deadlines.
* Coaching mindset: builds capability in the team through training rather than working around gaps.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Degree or diploma in a relevant BIM, architectural technology or engineering discipline.
* Minimum 25 years of relevant BIM experience, including substantial experience in a managerial or lead capacity with direct responsibility for team and resource management, ideally within a multi-disciplinary structural or MEP design environment.
* Proven track record with top-tier engineering consultancies in the region.
* Relevant professional accreditations required.
* Demonstrated experience designing or delivering structured training programmes for technical teams.
* Strong working knowledge of BIM standards, modelling software (e.g. Revit) and quality/productivity benchmarking.

**Why This Role May Interest You**

* Genuine ownership of the BIM function's resourcing, quality standards and training programme.
* A newly defined role with a direct hand in shaping how BIM is structured across REC.
* Group backing for the tools and training the function needs.

**Additional Information**

title: Cinema Advertisement Operations - Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
The Cinema Advertisement Operations Manager is responsible for the end-to-end execution, monitoring, and delivery of cinema advertising campaigns across a network of theatres. The role ensures seamless campaign scheduling, content deployment, playback monitoring, compliance with client requirements, billing support, and operational excellence. The position serves as a critical link between Sales, Clients, Theatre Partners, Technology, and Finance teams to ensure successful campaign delivery and revenue realization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Operations & Execution**

* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of cinema advertising campaigns
* Coordinate campaign scheduling, deployment, monitoring, and closure activities
* Ensure advertisements are delivered as per approved schedules and contracts
* Monitor campaign start and end dates to ensure uninterrupted execution
* Coordinate with theatre partners for campaign implementation and troubleshooting

**Advertisement Content Management**

* Validate advertisement content received from clients and agencies
* Ensure content complies with technical specifications and regulatory requirements
* Coordinate content ingestion, transcoding, distribution, and deployment
* Maintain advertisement content repositories and version controls

**Playback Monitoring & Compliance**

* Track campaign playback through monitoring systems and playback logs
* Investigate and resolve missed, delayed, or incomplete advertisement deliveries
* Ensure contractual spot commitments are met across theatre networks
* Generate proof-of-performance reports for clients and internal stakeholders

**Billing & Revenue Assurance**

* Validate playback reports and campaign logs for invoicing purposes
* Ensure accurate calculation of delivered spots and campaign performance metrics
* Support revenue reconciliation and audit requirements
* Minimize revenue leakage through operational controls and validations

**MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly campaign execution reports
* Develop operational dashboards and performance scorecards
* Monitor campaign KPIs and identify areas for improvement
* Provide management with insights on inventory utilization and operational efficiency

**Client & Sales Support**

* Partner with Sales teams during campaign planning and execution
* Support clients with execution updates, campaign reports, and issue resolution
* Participate in pre-campaign feasibility assessments
* Ensure service-level agreements (SLAs) are consistently achieved

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies and automation
* Develop SOPs and operational best practices
* Collaborate with technology teams for system enhancements
* Lead initiatives to improve campaign visibility, reporting accuracy, and operational productivity

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Media Management, Information Systems, Marketing, or a related field
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification preferred

**Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in Advertisement Operations, Media Operations, Cinema Advertising, Broadcast Operations, or Digital Media Operations
* Experience managing multi-location campaign execution and reporting
* Experience working with theatre networks, media agencies, and advertisers is preferred

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel
* Power BI
* SQL and Data Analysis
* Campaign Scheduling Systems
* ERP and CRM Platforms
* MIS Reporting and Dashboard Development
* Process Automation Tools

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong Operational Management Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Customer Focus
* Communication & Coordination
* Time Management
* Decision Making
* Team Leadership

title: Marine Superintendent
description:
**Company Description**
Executive Ship Management (ESM), part of the Executive Group of Companies headquartered in Singapore, is a trusted partner to leading global ship owners and major industry players who demand high standards, quality, and professionalism. The company operates a world-class maritime institute in India, the Samundra Institute of Maritime Studies (SIMS), to ensure that its vessels are managed by specially trained officers and crew. ESM maintains a robust, in-house recruitment, training, and vetting process, building a strong pool of skilled seafarers for advanced and specialized vessels. With resource centers across India and support offices in Houston, Rotterdam, and Tokyo, ESM leverages advanced information technology and innovative ship management solutions to enhance performance at sea and on shore. Guided by a strong quality culture, ESM is committed to safety, security, and the holistic development of its people, assets, and long-term partnerships.
  
**Role Description**
The Marine Superintendent is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, responsible for overseeing the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of assigned vessels. This role involves monitoring day-to-day vessel performance, guiding shipboard teams on marine operations, and ensuring adherence to company policies, international regulations, and industry best practices. The Marine Superintendent will coordinate with ship management and technical teams on voyage planning, incident prevention, audits, and inspections, including vetting and port state control requirements. The role includes reviewing operational reports, conducting ship visits, supporting crew in the implementation of safety management systems, and driving continuous improvement in vessel operations. The Marine Superintendent will also collaborate with stakeholders, including owners and charterers, to maintain high standards of professionalism and operational reliability.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong expertise in Marine Operations and Vessel Operations, including navigation, cargo handling, and safety procedures.
* Candidates should possess solid experience in Ship Management, covering compliance, maintenance oversight, and coordination with technical and crewing teams.
* Candidates should possess proven Supervisory Skills to guide shipboard personnel, conduct performance reviews, and support training and development.
* Candidates should possess hands-on knowledge of Vetting processes, audits, inspections, and alignment with oil major and industry requirements.
* Candidates should ideally have a Class 1 or Class 2 certificate of competency (deck or engine) with relevant sea-going experience.
* Candidates should possess strong understanding of international maritime regulations (ISM, ISPS, MARPOL, SOLAS) and quality, health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Candidates should possess effective communication, report-writing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work in a multicultural environment.
* Candidates should possess good analytical and problem-solving abilities, familiarity with fleet management or maritime software, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: Programme Manager - Enterprise AI
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
WPP is accelerating the adoption of AI across the enterprise, investing in a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to transform how work gets done across our global business.
  
  
Within Enterprise Technology, we're enabling this transformation by building the platforms, capabilities and operating models that will power the next generation of work. From Microsoft Copilot and intelligent automation to emerging AI technologies and agentic workflows, we're embedding AI into the fabric of how WPP operates globally.
  
  
We're looking for a Programme Manager (Value & Delivery) to help us understand, measure and evidence the impact of AI across the organisation.
  
  
This role sits at the centre of WPP's Enterprise AI adoption and measurement capability. You'll own the data, reporting and analytics that enable senior leaders to understand how AI is being adopted, where value is being created and what actions are needed to accelerate impact.
  
  
We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical and data modelling expertise with a delivery mindset. You'll be responsible for building trusted executive reporting, integrating data from multiple sources and ensuring adoption, usage and value metrics stand up to scrutiny. If you enjoy turning complex datasets into actionable insight and want to play a key role in one of WPP's most important transformation programmes, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Manage the recurring cadence of adoption, utilisation and value reporting, ensuring weekly and monthly reporting cycles are delivered accurately and on schedule.
* Track licence utilisation and adoption across the Enterprise AI estate, helping identify optimisation opportunities and supporting investment decisions.
* Maintain benefits and ROI tracking against agreed business cases, ensuring evidence, assumptions and outcomes are clearly documented.
* Coordinate activity across the Enterprise AI opportunity pipeline, tracking progress, dependencies, actions and risks to ensure initiatives keep moving forward.
* Support use-case intake and assessment processes, helping prioritise opportunities and ensuring requests are routed effectively through governance and delivery pathways.
* Oversee the configuration and maintenance of adoption and measurement reporting, including Viva Insights and related analytics platforms.
* Maintain programme governance artefacts, including RAID logs, action trackers, status reports and delivery plans.
* Prepare clear, concise reporting and updates for stakeholders, providing visibility of progress, risks, issues and outcomes.
* Work closely with programme, delivery, governance and business teams to ensure activities remain aligned and focused on measurable value.
* Help identify process improvements and opportunities to strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of the Enterprise AI operating model.

**What We're Looking For**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365 adoption programmes or digital transformation initiatives.
* Working familiarity with Viva Insights, Power BI and workforce analytics platforms.
* Experience in programme management, programme delivery, business analysis or benefits tracking within a complex organisational environment.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail and delivery discipline.
* Comfort working with data, metrics and reporting, with the ability to validate, explain and challenge information rather than simply present it.
* Strong organisational skills, with experience maintaining reporting cycles, governance artefacts and programme documentation.
* Analytical curiosity and a desire to understand the drivers behind performance, adoption and business outcomes.
* Experience working with reporting and analysis tools such as Excel, Power BI or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to tailor information for both operational and senior stakeholder audiences.
* A proactive, self-directed approach with the confidence to drive actions, follow through on deliverables and keep programmes moving.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, professional status reporting and programme updates.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of benefits tracking, value realisation or programme performance measurement.
* Microsoft AZ-900, DP-900, PMP, PRINCE2 or similar qualifications.
* Experience working within a global organisation and coordinating distributed teams across multiple regions.

we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

title: Editorial Manager – Books
description:
**Company:**
Thomson Digital

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Experience:**
5–7 Years

**Role Overview:**

Thomson Digital is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Editorial Manager – Books**
to manage editorial activities for book publishing projects. The candidate will be responsible for overseeing editorial quality, coordinating with internal production teams, managing schedules, and ensuring that editorial deliverables meet the required quality standards and deadlines.

The candidate should have a strong academic background, excellent command of written and spoken English, a sound understanding of book editorial workflows, and the ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of projects.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Editorial Operations & Workflow Management**

* Manage editorial activities across book publishing projects, ensuring adherence to established workflows, schedules, and quality standards.
* Oversee editorial processes, including manuscript assessment, copyediting, language editing, proofreading, reference checking, and author query management, as applicable to project scope.
* Ensure consistency in language, grammar, style, formatting, and adherence to client-specific style guides.
* Review editorial deliverables and ensure that they meet customer specifications and publishing standards.
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks, and take corrective action to ensure timely completion.

**2. Team Management & Coordination**

* Coordinate with editors, proofreaders, editorial coordinators, project managers, and book production teams.
* Allocate and prioritise editorial work based on project requirements, deadlines, and available resources.
* Guide team members on editorial standards, style requirements, and quality expectations.
* Monitor team performance, productivity, and turnaround time.

**3. Quality Assurance**

* Ensure high standards of editorial accuracy, consistency, readability, and language quality.
* Conduct quality reviews and audits to identify errors, inconsistencies, and deviations from client requirements.
* Analyse recurring errors and implement corrective and preventive measures.

**5. Project Planning & Delivery**

* Plan and monitor editorial schedules to ensure timely completion of assigned titles and projects.
* Track milestones, pending activities, author queries, and dependencies.
* Prepare and maintain project status reports, quality reports, and productivity trackers.

**6. Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve editorial workflows, productivity, and quality.
* Support the implementation of standard operating procedures and best practices.
* Stay updated on developments in book publishing, editorial tools, digital publishing, and AI-assisted editorial workflows.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in book publishing, editorial services, publishing production, or a publishing services organisation.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in English, Literature, Journalism, Publishing, Mass Communication, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Strong academic record, preferably from a reputed college or university.
* English-medium educational background preferred.
* Strong understanding of book editorial workflows and publishing standards.

Work from Office (6 days a week)

title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
description:
**Senior Manufacturing & Production Quality Lead – LifeBand**

**Location:**
India – predominantly on-site in Chennai

**Engagement:**
Contract, Full Time

**Reporting to:**
Equivital UK Product & Operations Leadership

**Product:**
Equivital LifeBand – first high-volume production run of 2,000 units

**Role purpose**

Equivital is seeking experienced electronics manufacturing professional to provide hands-on leadership and oversight of the first high-volume production run of approximately 2,000 LifeBand devices at our manufacturing partner in India.

This is a critical production-launch role. The successful candidate will act as Equivital's senior on-site manufacturing representative and will be responsible for ensuring that the production process is properly controlled, technically robust and capable of delivering a consistently high-quality product at the required yield.

The individual will work closely with the manufacturing company in Chennai and quality teams, Equivital's UK engineering and product teams, and other technical stakeholders.

The role requires someone who is comfortable working directly on the factory floor, identifying problems, challenging poor processes, implementing corrective actions and communicating clearly with both factory personnel and senior technical teams in the UK.

**Key objectives**

The successful candidate will be accountable for:

* Excellent build quality across the 2,000-unit production run.
* High first-pass yield and minimal rework/scrap.
* Successful integration of the new ATE into the production process.
* Implementation and control of the new final DFT testing process.
* Robust control and verification of the LifeBand welding process.
* Ensuring welded assemblies meet the required mechanical and electrical specifications, particularly those affecting pogo-pin performance.
* Accurate material, component and finished-goods traceability.
* Improved stock control and production material management at Manufacturing plant.
* Rapid identification, containment and resolution of production issues.
* Accurate production reporting to the UK team.
* Establishment of a repeatable production process that Manufacturing company can continue to operate after the launch phase.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Production launch and daily manufacturing oversight**

* Be Equivital's principal technical and operational representative on-site during the production run.
* Work closely with Manufacturing company production, engineering and quality personnel.
* Review and approve production readiness before volume manufacturing begins.
* Establish clear daily production targets and monitor actual performance.
* Monitor production flow from incoming components through assembly, welding, programming, testing, final inspection and packing.
* Identify bottlenecks, recurring defects and process weaknesses.
* Challenge processes that are not producing the required quality or yield.
* Have authority to recommend or initiate a production stop where there is a significant quality or product-risk issue.

**2. ATE implementation**

The successful candidate will:

* Work with Equivital engineering and manufacturing company to embed the ATE into the production process.
* Ensure operators understand the correct test procedure.
* Verify that the ATE is correctly configured and being used consistently.
* Establish appropriate test records and traceability.
* Monitor ATE failure rates and identified abnormal trends.
* Distinguish genuine product failures from test-equipment/operator/process failures.
* Ensure failed units are correctly quarantined and investigated.
* Ensure that production does not bypass required ATE testing.
* Work with engineering to refine the ATE process where necessary.

**3. Final DFT implementation**

Final Design-for-Test / DFT testing is a new element of the LifeBand production process.

The role will be responsible for:

* Implementing the final DFT test process on the production line.
* Ensuring appropriate test fixtures, equipment and procedures are available.
* Training and supervising operators.
* Ensuring 100% of required devices receive the defined final testing.
* Ensuring test results are recorded and traceable to individual units.
* Monitoring DFT failure modes and trends.
* Working with Equivital engineering to investigate recurring failures.
* Preventing units from progressing to final packing without completing the required tests.

**4. Welding process control**

A particularly important responsibility will be oversight of the LifeBand welding process.

The successful candidate must have practical experience of manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies and understand the failure modes associated with welding/joining processes.

They will:

* Establish and document the required welding process parameters.
* Verify that the welding equipment is correctly set up and maintained.
* Ensure operators are trained and following the approved process.
* Establish appropriate first-off and periodic inspection requirements.
* Monitor weld quality throughout production.
* Identify potential weld defects before they become downstream failures.
* Ensure appropriate mechanical/electrical verification of the weld.
* Investigate weld-related failures and implement corrective actions.
* Pay particular attention to the impact of the welding process on the alignment, positioning and reliability of the LifeBand pogo-pin interface.
* Ensure the finished assembly meets the required mechanical tolerances and electrical performance requirements.

Experience with welding or joining of small electronic assemblies, plastics, metals, flexes, contacts or similar precision components would be highly desirable.

**5. Quality and yield management**

Establish and maintain a clear production-quality dashboard covering, at minimum:

* First-pass yield (FPY)
* Overall yield
* Scrap
* Rework
* ATE failures
* DFT failures
* Welding defects
* Pogo-pin/contact failures
* Functional test failures
* Component/assembly defects
* Repeat failure modes
* Units quarantined
* Units released
* Production throughput

The successful candidate will identify trends rather than simply report numbers.

Where yield deteriorates, they will determine the likely root cause and drive corrective action.

**6. Factory process discipline and stock control**

Manufacturing company currently requires improved production discipline and material control.

The role will therefore include:

* Verification of component availability before production starts.
* Physical verification of critical stock where required.
* Improving accuracy between recorded and actual stock.
* Ensuring components are correctly identified and traceable.
* Preventing uncontrolled substitution of components.
* Ensuring rejected/failed components are segregated.
* Establishing appropriate quarantine and disposition processes.
* Identifying shortages before they stop production.
* Ensuring finished and semi-finished units can be reconciled against production records.

**7. Non-conformance and root-cause analysis**

The individual will lead or coordinate investigation of manufacturing defects.

They should be comfortable using appropriate techniques including:

* CAPA
* Non-Conformance
* Process capability analysis where appropriate

The objective is not simply to repair defective units but to prevent recurrence.

**8. Communication with the UK team**

Provide a concise daily/weekly production report to Equivital UK covering:

**Production**

* Units planned, completed, passed, failed, yield, Rework/scrap

**Quality**

* Top defects, ATE failures, DFT failures, Welding defects, Contact/pogo-pin issues, Open NCRs

**Operations**

* Stock/component issues
* Production constraints
* Staffing/process issues
* Risks to schedule

**Actions**

* Corrective actions completed
* Actions in progress
* Decisions required from the UK team

Significant quality issues should be escalated immediately rather than waiting for the weekly report.

**Authority**

The individual must have sufficient authority to:

* Stop or pause production where a significant quality issue is identified.
* Quarantine suspect product.
* Require re-testing or additional inspection.
* Challenge production processes that do not meet the agreed specification.
* Escalate unresolved issues directly to Equivital UK leadership.

The role is not intended to be a passive inspection position.

**Required experience**

**Essential**

* Significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* Experience managing or overseeing production of electronic devices/products.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality systems.
* Hands-on experience with production testing and test equipment.
* Experience implementing or managing ATE or automated production testing.
* Experience with DFT/functional testing.
* Experience with precision manufacturing processes involving small components.
* Practical experience with welding, joining or equivalent manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies.
* Strong understanding of process control, yield and defect analysis.
* Strong communication skills in English.
* Ability to work directly with factory operators, engineers and management.
* Comfortable working on the factory floor rather than purely in an office environment.

**Highly desirable**

* Experience with wearables, medical devices, IoT devices, consumer electronics, industrial electronics or similar products.
* Experience with high-volume electronics manufacturing.
* Experience with SMT/PCBA and final assembly.
* Experience with pogo pins, spring contacts, connectors or similar electrical interfaces.
* Experience establishing production test fixtures and traceability systems.
* Experience working with international companies or overseas engineering teams within regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience with ISO 9001, ISO 13485 or similar quality systems.
* Engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or a related discipline.

**Personal characteristics**

The successful candidate will be:

* Technically credible.
* Hands-on and practical.
* Highly organised.
* Detail-oriented without losing sight of production objectives.
* Comfortable challenging poor processes.
* Calm under production pressure.
* Commercially aware.
* Strong enough to represent Equivital's interests with the manufacturing partner.
* Excellent at communicating technical issues simply and clearly to UK-based colleagues.

Oragadam
