title: Director - Functional Systems & Technology
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Comcast’s Residential Billing Strategy & Operations team is taking the next step in expanding its leadership structure by hiring a Director 1 to lead our full India offshore team. All current India based people managers and professionals supporting Comcast Residential Billing Strategy & Operations will report to this role. This role is accountable for CIEC operational performance, talent management, controls, delivery quality, and execution outcomes, while also being the on-the-ground leader responsible for US based counterparts who own functional strategy and product/process decisions. As the Director of Residential Billing Strategy & Operations, this role will lead teams accountable for the performance, reliability, and operations of Comcast’s end-to-end billing ecosystem. This environment processes tens of billions in annual revenue, supports millions of customers, and underpins financial integrity, digital experiences, and the company’s ability to compete and grow. This leader will be accountable to manage teams ensuring enterprise pricing, promotional, and go-to-market (GTM) strategies are accurately delivered, highly governed, and operationally scaled across every billing platform and customer segment. This role will oversee biller related data flows, operational processes, and configuration quality, that translate enterprise decisions into accurate, trusted customer bills, while advancing automation, data intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that improve precision, speed, and adaptability. As the senior people leader in the CIEC this role will also be responsible for talent management and strategy inclusive of succession planning, eNPS scores, employee engagement, and hiring processes. The CIEC director will be a senior leader of the Billing Operations team reporting directly to the SVP of the Residential Billing Strategy & Operations team alongside other US based senior leaders. This leader will be expected to own the end to end activities of the team inclusive of capabilities, risks, capacity, talent and execution performance at the enterprise level and be able to own both operations and the transformational change across the org. The ideal candidate is a strong people and operations leader with experience in a global or matrixed environment, ideally within billing, revenue, or other large-scale operational environments. The candidate will be expected to collaborate on a global scale with leaders in the both the US and CIEC.
  
  
**Job Description**
People Leadership & CIEC Operations
  
  

* Lead the full CIEC (India offshore) team supporting Residential Billing Strategy & Operations.
* Collaborate with US based leaders to oversee billing operations teams inclusive of configuration management, pricing and GTM enablement, testing and validation, data governance, analytics and reporting, and operational controls.
* Champion CIEC related continuous improvement efforts inclusive of automation, data intelligence, and AI-enablement initiatives to reduce manual effort, prevent defects, and improve precision, speed, and resiliency across billing processes and revenue-critical systems.
* Develop staff through ongoing training in billing, configuration, revenue assurance, and automation capabilities, as well as operational procedures, policies, communication, and technical skills.
* Create a positive, collaborative, cross-functional atmosphere and process across the CIEC team and with U.S. counterparts.

Billing Operations, Configuration & Execution Quality
  
  

* Ensure CIEC teams deliver accurate, high-quality billing setup, configuration, eligibility logic, rating, taxes, fees, and financial settings.
* Support disciplined execution of rate events, pricing and promotional changes, GTM changes, product launches, migrations, and platform releases.
* Lead CIEC testing, validation, and release-readiness activities to support high-quality, stable, error-free deployments.
* Ensure eligibility rules, offer structures, compatibility logic, and customer pathways are configured and tested to perform as intended for all market-facing offers.
* Work with supervisors and managers to ensure all deliverables meet preset deadlines, specifications, and budgets to achieve financial and business objectives.

Automation, Data Quality & Analytics
  
  

* Improve the efficiency and effectiveness of CIEC operations by establishing and tracking performance metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that inform operational and financial decisions.
* Lead CIEC automation work as an extension of the broader Billing Operations Continuous Improvement team -- identifying, building, and scaling automation, data intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions that simplify work and improve resiliency across the billing lifecycle.
* Drive continuous improvement of operational workflows, execution consistency, and cost performance through simplification and automation.

Stakeholder Partnership, Delivery & Change Leadership
  
  

* Translate U.S. priorities and enterprise strategies into local operational plans and requirements with measurable outcomes.
* Support prioritization, risk mitigation, and integrated execution of the billing, configuration, pricing-enablement, data, and operational initiatives assigned to CIEC.
* Oversee local planning, communication, readiness, and change adoption for new capabilities and releases of new technology.
* Communicate department strategies and objectives effectively within CIEC and across the broader organization.
* Exercise independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Maintain regular, consistent, and punctual attendance, and performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees At All Levels Are Expected To**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first.
* Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users, and advocates of our game-changing technology, products, and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System, a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making callbacks, and helping elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Respect and promote inclusion - do what’s right for each other, our customers, investors, and our communities.

Comcast Competencies: Director Level 1
  
  

* Shapes the Future - Embracing Innovation & Change - Drives innovation by encouraging and respecting new ideas and championing change.
* Forward Thinking - Shapes and/or aligns efforts with Comcast’s direction, applying a long-term perspective and external awareness.
* Customer Focus - Delivers on commitments to internal and external customers.
* Personal & Team Leadership - Drives oneself and others, contributing to the performance of a strong, diverse team.
* Selecting & Developing Talent - Attracts, develops, and retains critical talent, helping to get the right talent in place for the organization; strong mentoring skills.
* Building Collaborative Relationships - Operates with a OneComcast mindset, building strong and valued working relationships across the company.
* Embodies Our Values - Demonstrates the courage to take a stand when needed.
* Inspiring Trust - Earns the trust of others through authenticity, humility, respect, and credibility.
* Agility & Adaptability - Adapts to changing conditions and challenges, seeking opportunities to continue learning.
* Execution Excellence - Achieves goals through operational excellence, defining a clear path to accomplish objectives.
* Solution Focus - Effectively analyzes issues, making sound, timely decisions and recommendations.
* Financial & Business Acumen - Applies job knowledge, business experience, and financial understanding to make effective decisions.
* Excellent organizational, collaboration, and negotiation skills.
* Highly self-motivated, self-directed, and attentive to detail, with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

title: Sr Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team within the Fleet Intelligence & Reliability organization. The team is responsible for identifying systemic fleet risks, determining the physical and systemic causes of complex failures, and ensuring that corrective and preventive actions deliver measurable and sustainable reliability improvement across the global Solar and Storage installed fleet.
  
  
This role owns the technical governance of Root Cause Analyses for complex, high-impact, recurring, and fleet-wide issues. The manager will ensure that investigations are evidence-based, technically rigorous, and completed with clear accountability from initial containment through corrective-action validation and fleet-risk closure.
  
  
The leader will manage engineers across relevant disciplines, which may include power electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, embedded software, plant controls, and systems engineering. The position requires close partnership with Fleet Performance & Analytics, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Project Engineering, Field Operations, and commercial teams to convert fleet experience into product and operational improvement.
  
  
**Job Description**
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for fleet reliability, failure investigation, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Own and continuously improve the RCA governance process, including issue prioritization, ownership assignment, technical reviews, milestones, escalation, corrective-action tracking, validation, and closure criteria.
* Lead investigations of complex, high-impact, systemic, and recurring failures affecting solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, plant controls, power conversion equipment, and associated interfaces.
* Ensure investigations are grounded in verified evidence, operating data, event logs, inspection results, failure reproduction, laboratory analysis, engineering calculations, and appropriate structured problem-solving methods.
* Differentiate failure symptoms, direct physical causes, contributing factors, systemic causes, and organizational causes, ensuring that conclusions are supported by evidence.
* Drive immediate containment, short-term mitigation, and permanent corrective and preventive actions with the relevant engineering and operational owners.
* Prioritize investigations using safety exposure, customer impact, availability loss, recurrence, fleet population, warranty exposure, and financial consequence.
* Maintain a fleet-level view of failure modes and systemic risk across products, projects, regions, configurations, software versions, suppliers, and operating environments.
* Partner with Fleet Performance & Analytics to use fleet data, trends, event signatures, and risk models to detect emerging issues, quantify exposure, and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Translate field and fleet learning into recommendations for product requirements, design changes, validation plans, software releases, manufacturing processes, supplier controls, maintenance strategies, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical leadership during critical fleet events, customer escalations, and executive-level issue reviews.
* Ensure customer-facing and internal RCA reports are accurate, evidence-based, clear, and delivered in accordance with committed milestones.
* Develop and maintain reusable engineering knowledge, including RCA standards, failure libraries, lessons learned, troubleshooting guides, technical advisories, and investigation templates.
* Support the definition and deployment of Change, Modification, and Upgrade actions resulting from fleet reliability findings.
* Establish and monitor meaningful metrics such as RCA cycle time, milestone adherence, recurrence rate, corrective-action closure, investigation backlog, and quantified fleet-risk reduction.
* Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related technical field.
* Demonstratable experience in engineering, reliability, failure analysis, product engineering, installed-base engineering, or a related technical function.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations or RCAs involving multidisciplinary systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, technical teams, or significant cross-functional engineering programs.
* Experience with power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, power conversion, industrial automation, or comparable complex industrial equipment.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

Desired Characteristics
  
  

* Advanced degree in engineering, reliability, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
* Previous people-leadership experience within a global engineering or technical organization.
* Strong knowledge of solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, power electronics, plant controls, electrical protection, thermal management, and industrial communication networks.
* Experience applying structured investigation methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, 5 Whys, Ishikawa analysis, 8D, Kepner-Tregoe, or Failure Mode and Effects Analysis.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, failure mechanisms, accelerated testing, design validation, reliability growth, and corrective-action effectiveness assessment.
* Experience analyzing operational data, waveforms, alarms, event logs, failed components, inspection evidence, and intervention history.
* Strong systems thinking, technical judgment, and ability to make risk-based decisions with incomplete or evolving information.
* Proven ability to influence Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Operations, and commercial teams in a matrixed environment.
* Strong customer-facing skills and the ability to communicate sensitive technical findings with clarity, credibility, and appropriate transparency.
* Ability to manage multiple high-priority investigations across a global fleet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self-starting attitude with the ability to establish structure, set priorities, develop people, and drive issues through sustainable closure.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Vulnerability and Patch Manager
description:
Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
  
  
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
  
  
As
**Vulnerability and Patch Manager**
, you will lead the vulnerability intelligence, prioritisation and patch advisory service across the client's server, end-user, network and security device estate, coordinating remediation through the client's operational teams and suppliers.
  
  
**This is a design, review and advisory role.**
You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

**Essential Skills**

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Desired Skills**

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

**What Do I Need Before I Apply**

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening (equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard) and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

**Benefits**

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits [India HR to confirm the benefits package].
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”
  
  
If you are an experienced vulnerability management professional who can turn vulnerability data into clear, prioritised action, we encourage you to apply today.

title: Sourcing Business Partner - Crushing
description:

* Experience working within a global, cross-functional organisation.

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Manager - ST&S Delivery

JOB DESCRIPTION

Manager/Associate Director - ST&S Delivery

Settlements | iData | Contracts & Confirmations | Accounting, Reporting & Controls

Role Purpose

The Manager, ST&S Delivery will own end-to-end service delivery across assigned Oil & Gas Supply, Trading & Shipping operations covering Settlements, iData, Contracts & Confirmations, and Accounting, Reporting & Control, the role will lead operational teams, manage client governance, maintain service performance and controls, resolve material escalations, and execute the agreed transformation roadmap. The Manager will translate the Delivery Head’s strategic direction into operational plans and ensure accurate, timely and controlled delivery across high-value and time-sensitive processes.

Key Responsibilities

•

Own delivery performance across assigned ST&S processes, ensuring achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, close-calendar commitments and control requirements.

•

Lead operational delivery across settlements, reference and master data, contracts and confirmations, and accounting, reporting and controls.

•

Establish effective workload management, capacity planning, staffing, prioritization and resource-deployment practices across delivery teams.

•

Monitor volumes, work queues, ageing, exceptions, reconciliations, productivity, quality and operational risks; intervene early where performance is at risk.

•

Lead resolution of material settlement breaks, confirmation mismatches, contract exceptions, data defects, reconciliation differences, accounting issues and control failures.

•

Act as the primary operational contact for assigned client stakeholders and lead service reviews covering delivery, risks, controls, improvement actions and transformation progress.

•

Build effective relationships across trading operations, finance, treasury, legal, tax, credit, risk, compliance, technology and data teams.

•

Ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, four-eye reviews, delegated authorities, segregation of duties, approval protocols, records retention and audit-trail requirements.

•

Oversee operational-risk events, control incidents, audit findings, business-continuity requirements and remediation actions.

•

Prepare and present governance packs covering service levels, quality, ageing, productivity, risk, controls, financial performance and improvement outcomes.

•

Convert the transformation roadmap into executable initiatives, milestones, resource plans, readiness criteria and measurable benefits.

•

Lead process diagnostics and standardization; sponsor workflow, digitization, analytics and automation opportunities after stabilizing performance and addressing source-data causes.

•

Ensure SME participation across design, validation, testing, UAT, knowledge transfer, hypercare and post-implementation reviews.

•

Retain appropriate human review and approval for material commercial, legal, regulatory, accounting and payment decisions.

•

Lead Deputy Managers, Team Leads and operational teams; set objectives, coach leaders, build cross-skilling, maintain succession coverage and strengthen accountability.

Manager - ST&S Delivery

Core Domain & Functional Skills

•

Strong understanding of the Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading lifecycle across crude, products, gas, LNG and/or power.

•

Settlements: AR/AP invoicing, pricing validation, payment preparation, netting, cash allocation, collections, disputes, intercompany, ancillary/brokerage settlements and reconciliations.

•

iData: counterparty and bank-account records, payment data, standard settlement instructions, settlement and netting reference data, governance and data-quality remediation.

•

Contracts & Confirmations: contract administration, trade-term validation, physical and derivative confirmations, electronic matching, discrepancy management and counterparty engagement.

•

Accounting, Reporting & Controls: journals, derivative and balance-sheet accounting, P&L and working-capital reconciliations, financial close, controls, audit and reporting support.

•

Ability to manage service performance, capacity, productivity, operational risk, governance and benefits realization in a multi-stakeholder environment.

•

Working exposure to ETRM/CTRM platforms, ERP or finance systems, reconciliation tools, workflow/case-management platforms, automation and reporting dashboards.

Experience & Qualifications

•

11-14 years of relevant experience in Oil & Gas, energy or commodity-trading operations, including at least 7 years in service delivery, operations management or people leadership.

•

Demonstrated experience managing multi-process or multi-team operations in an SLA-driven and control-oriented environment.

•

Strong experience in at least two scope areas, with end-to-end awareness across the wider ST&S lifecycle.

•

Proven ability to manage client stakeholders, service reviews, operational escalations and cross-functional dependencies.

•

Experience in transition, process standardization, workflow implementation, automation, digitization or operating-model transformation.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Commerce, Engineering, Technology, Energy Management or a related discipline. Relevant accounting, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, transformation or change certification is desirable.

•

Fluent business English, with flexibility to support business and market timelines.

Leadership & Behavioural Expectations

•

Strong ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes, controls and stakeholder commitments.

•

Ability to balance service, risk, commercial, people and transformation priorities.

•

Sound judgement, structured problem solving and confidence in managing senior stakeholders and difficult escalations.

•

Clear written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to work across cultures, commodities, regions and systems.

•

A coaching mindset that develops people, protects critical knowledge and promotes continuous improvement.

Measures of Success SLA and KPI achievement | accurate and timely delivery | fewer aged exceptions and recurring breaks | stronger controls | effective client governance | improved productivity and visibility | sustained transformation benefits | capable and engaged teams

title: Manager - Customer Service Transformation And AI

**Consulting –**
**Manager- Customer Service Transformation and AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. **The Opportunity**
The
**Manager – Customer Service Transformation and AI**
will drive AI-led service transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining service strategy, AI solution design, process improvement, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in reimagining service journeys, contact centre operations, field service, and knowledge-enabled support models through responsible use of AI, automation, analytics, and workflow orchestration. You will work with senior stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities, shape practical roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, service productivity, resolution quality, and operating efficiency.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Development & Market Leadership**

* Support the development of AI-led service transformation opportunities across advisory and implementation engagements, contributing to pipeline growth and client relationship expansion.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution narratives, and executive presentations focused on service modernization, AI adoption, and customer operations improvement.
* Support GTM development for AI-enabled service offerings across sectors, including contact center transformation, intelligent case management, field service optimization, and digital self-service.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and points of view on AI-led service transformation, customer operations, and service experience modernization.
* Stay current on emerging service models, AI adoption patterns, automation trends, and customer expectations that may influence client service transformation priorities.

**Client Engagement & Delivery**

* Lead workstreams within service transformation programs from current-state assessment through roadmap design, implementation planning, and adoption support.
* Assess service processes, customer journeys, operating models, channel mix, agent workflows, knowledge management practices, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Design AI-enabled service operating models, service blueprints, automation use cases, governance structures, and adoption roadmaps aligned to client business outcomes.
* Support implementation of AI use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, sentiment insights, knowledge search, predictive service, and workflow automation.
* Partner with technology, data, and business teams to translate service pain points into business requirements, solution concepts, process maps, and delivery-ready backlogs.
* Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify productivity gains, containment improvement, average handle time reduction, service quality improvement, and cost-to-serve impact.
* Ensure delivery quality across assigned workstreams, including scope management, stakeholder coordination, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and executive reporting.
* Support change management and adoption activities to improve stakeholder readiness, responsible AI usage, and operational sustainability.

**Technology & Innovation**

* Enable teams to leverage AI, automation, analytics, CRM, contact center platforms, knowledge management systems, and workflow tools to improve service outcomes.
* Work with cross-functional teams to define data, integration, and governance considerations required for AI-enabled service transformation.
* Identify opportunities to build accelerators, prototypes, and reusable methods for AI-enabled service discovery, solution design, and benefits tracking.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Manage small to mid-sized project teams or workstreams, ensuring high-quality deliverables, structured problem solving, and timely execution.
* Coach consultants and analysts on service transformation methods, requirements structuring, stakeholder engagement, and AI-led operating model design.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Experience with AI-enabled service use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, and predictive service insights.
* Exposure to service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service, ServiceNow CSM, Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, or similar technologies.
* Industry experience across B2B, professional services, technology, manufacturing, consumer, healthcare, utilities, or financial services sectors.

**What We Look For**

* 8+ years of experience in service transformation, customer operations, contact center transformation, field service transformation, digital service, or AI-enabled operations improvement.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading service transformation initiatives from assessment through implementation planning and adoption.
* Strong understanding of service journeys, contact center operations, case management, knowledge management, service KPIs, and customer experience improvement levers.
* Hands-on experience with AI, automation, analytics, CRM, service platforms, or digital workflow tools in customer service environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and project delivery skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We are looking for an accomplished Senior Delivery Manager with 15+ years of experience to lead complex Insurance technology engagements for global clients. The role requires broad functional and technical understanding of Guidewire InsuranceSuite, surrounding digital and integration platforms, and a strong command of service management and ITIL principles. The successful candidate will own client outcomes, delivery performance, financial health, service quality, people leadership and continuous improvement across a large engagement or a portfolio of engagements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, complex or multiple Insurance engagements across implementation, transformation, application maintenance and support, enhancements, integration, testing, release and production operations.
* Provide executive governance across scope, schedule, quality, SLAs, risks, dependencies and benefits, with clear accountability for committed client outcomes.
* Lead geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams across onshore, nearshore and offshore locations, including service managers, architects, functional consultants, engineering, testing, DevOps and service management teams.
* Build trusted relationships with client executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders, product owners and third-party partners, and act as the senior escalation point for delivery and service matters.
* Establish and run governance forums, steering committees, service reviews and executive reporting with fact-based insights, decisions and actions.
* Drive predictable delivery through integrated planning, demand and capacity management, dependency management, release readiness, quality gates and disciplined change control.
* Own performance against contractual service levels and experience measures; lead recovery plans where performance is at risk and ensure transparent reporting of trends and corrective actions.
* Oversee major incident response, problem management, root-cause analysis, change and release management, service transition, knowledge management and operational resilience.
* Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned processes, client controls, security requirements, regulatory obligations, audit expectations and delivery standards.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation, shift-left, observability, engineering excellence and AI-enabled operations to improve reliability, responsiveness and cost efficiency.
* Support solutioning, estimation, proposal development, transition planning and mobilization for new opportunities and scope expansion.
* Develop leadership capability and succession across the account; coach managers and senior team members, manage performance, improve retention and build a strong delivery culture.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Guidewire and platform leadership**

* Broad knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, including configuration, integration, data, digital channels, rating, batch processing, rules, workflows and reporting.
* Understanding of Guidewire Cloud delivery and operations, cloud migration considerations, platform upgrades, environment strategy, deployment pipelines and production support models.
* Ability to oversee Guidewire integrations with policy, claims, billing, document, payment, finance, customer relationship management, data, analytics, identity and other enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of modern architecture and engineering practices involving APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, middleware, cloud services, secure DevOps, automated delivery pipelines, test automation and observability.
* Working knowledge of adjacent Insurance platforms and technologies such as digital portals, data and analytics platforms, document and content management, rating solutions, enterprise integration and cloud infrastructure.

**Service management and operational excellence**

* Practical application of ITIL principles across incident, major incident, problem, change, release, request, configuration, knowledge, availability, capacity and service-level management.
* Experience establishing operating models, service governance, escalation paths, responsibility structures, support coverage, on-call models and service improvement plans.
* Ability to use operational data to identify recurring failure patterns, service risks, demand drivers and improvement opportunities, and convert insights into measurable actions.

**Leadership and delivery attributes**

* Strong Insurance domain understanding, preferably Property and Casualty, across policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims and related business processes.
* Proven success delivering large-scale or multi-account technology engagements for global clients, with accountability for distributed teams and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate confidently across executive governance, commercial management, delivery detail and technical risk while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
* Strong leadership presence, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution and stakeholder management skills.
* Commercial acumen covering estimation, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, productivity, contract interpretation and change control.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, scaled delivery and traditional delivery methods, with the judgment to apply fit-for-purpose governance.
* Working familiarity with service and engineering tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, monitoring platforms, knowledge repositories and automated delivery toolchains.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of overall experience in technology delivery, including substantial leadership experience in Insurance engagements.
* Proven experience as a Senior Delivery Manager, Program Manager, Account Delivery Lead or equivalent, managing a large engagement or multiple concurrent teams across global clients.
* Demonstrable delivery knowledge across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter, plus associated digital, integration, data and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading implementation and/or managed services engagements with responsibility for service performance, client governance, financials, people and risk.
* Strong understanding of ITIL and service management principles, including practical experience across incident, problem, change, release and service-level management.
* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Program or project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or an Agile certification.
* Experience with Guidewire Cloud, cloud transformation, complex platform modernization or large-scale service transition.

title: Sr. Manager Supplier Engineering
description:
**Company Description**
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
  
  
As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
  
  
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
  
  
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
  
  
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function of the Position:**
The successful candidate will lead a team of Supplier Engineers, to develop a portfolio of suppliers that deliver components, parts, and sub-assemblies at lowest landed cost for Intuitive’s robotic systems. By building technical expertise and business acumen in the Robotics space including its primary commodities of Motion control (electric motors, gearboxes, brakes, sensors, and other actuators), Electronics (PCBAs, PCBs, and electrical harness assemblies), Metals (CNC machining, Castings), and Plastics (injection molding, thermoforming, reaction injection molding), Supplier Engineering leads the technical evaluation during supplier selection, works with suppliers to develop manufacturing processes for components, and qualifies these processes to ensure suppliers can deliver the quality, capability, capacity, and cost necessary to meet Intuitive’s needs.
  
  
You will be responsible for the engineering relationship with many suppliers and the corresponding spend required to establish production, as well as for the discovery and development of new suppliers. You will strive to deliver the best-in-class performance score from your suppliers which is derived from several KPIs of Capacity, On-time Delivery, Cost reduction, Risk Mitigation, Product Quality and Service levels.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**
Lead a team of supplier engineers who are delivering value to the business through the following activities.
  
  

* Supply-chain Strategy: Develop and execute Global Supply-chain strategy and roadmap for long term, sustainable and resilient supply-chain to support Intuitive’s Product strategy and roadmap.
* Supplier Selection: Conduct market research to identify trends in the field of [plastics, Metal] manufacturing and accordingly select and evaluate suppliers to enable Agility and innovation during New Product Introduction, and to enable production scale globally for products that reach broad commercial launch. Establish a strong partnership with the commodity sourcing team to incorporate commercial viability in supplier selection process.
* Supplier Development and collaboration: Drive and adopt new technologies and automation in supply-chain to achieve high efficiency and production scale. Champion best practices like DFX, Lean, SPC, Six-sigma, Project management, into supply-chain. Establish clear communication channels with suppliers and manage both technical and business relationships
* Supplier Performance and Monitoring: Partner closely with suppliers to select optimal mfg process and process controls to achieve high quality and cost performance. Develop effective KPIs to monitor supplier performance (delivery, capacity, cost, quality). Execute projects towards continuous improvements of KPIs.
* Supplier Compliance: Partner with Supplier Quality org to drive audit finding resolution with suppliers through processes like CAPA and SCARs to maintain compliance with QMS requirements
* Supplier Risk management: Partner with Global supply-chain team to identify various risks within supply-chain and implement mitigation measures.
* Supplier Change management: For commercially launched products, execute Intuitive’s change management processes like major/moderate change (MCF), Supplier Change Request (SCR) and Change Order (CO) to support large scale projects towards capacity scaling, cost reduction, product quality improvement and supply-chain risk mitigation.
* Stakeholder Influence: Aligning/Negotiating on project ownership and hand-off points with various peer Supplier engineering groups (like New Product Introduction, Mfg Plant support, Tooling development). Influencing decisions with key partners in Global Ops (planning, sourcing, purchasing), Engineering (Design, Process, Quality) and Project Management Org.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Proven ability to lead teams to solve complex technical and process problems
* Proven ability to hire highly capable staff, and grow and mentor staff
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presentations to executives
* Demonstrated Project Management skills and ability to influence and negotiate with stakeholders.
* Domain Knowledge expertise in the [Plastic, Metal] commodity. Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes and measurement techniques. Deep understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, schedule and capacity
* Outstanding analytical skills along with good judgment
* Proficiency in Six Sigma and Lean Manufacturing techniques; certification preferred
* Knowledge of document management systems and ERP Systems, preferably Agile and SAP
* Knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485 preferred
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus
* Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis – domestic and international (25%)

**Required Education And Training**

* BS degree in engineering, advanced degree preferred
* 8+ years related experience in Manufacturing, Operations, Supplier Quality, Supplier Development, or related field with significant medical or medical device experience preferred
* 3+ years of experience leading supplier engineering, supplier quality or supplier development teams, or leadership of equivalent areas.

title: Director - Cloud Platform Operations, Reliability & Security
description:
**Location**
Chennai, India; relocation can be discussed

**Experience 15**
+ years in technology, including substantial executive leadership

**Reporting**
Senior technology leadership

**The mandate**

An established enterprise software organization is strengthening the way it builds, protects, and operates its cloud services. It is looking for an executive who can bring platform engineering, production resilience, and security outcomes under clear leadership, while working closely with product and engineering teams.

The successful leader will set direction and build a capable organization that delivers dependable services, reduces security exposure, and automates routine operational work. This is a leadership appointment with real technical accountability: the executive will challenge design decisions, examine service and security evidence, and personally engage in critical events when needed.

**What you will own**

An integrated operating model for cloud platforms, service operations, SRE, secure software delivery, and security engineering.

Organization design, leadership development, and measurable accountability across managers and specialist teams.

The executive view of service health, operational risk, security posture, major incidents, and investment priorities.

A close partnership with engineering leaders so reliability and security are built into architecture, development, release, and support.

**Areas of impact**

**Service resilience and operational leadership**

Define how critical services are measured and operated, including SLOs, error budgets, availability, performance, capacity, and release risk.

Lead high-severity incident response and 24x7 escalation. Set expectations for command, communications, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective work.

Use telemetry, service reviews, readiness practices, and resilience exercises to identify weak signals and prevent customer-impacting failures.

Build repeatable operating practices for change management, on-call readiness, escalation, and continual service improvement.

**Cloud platform and financial stewardship**

Guide the architecture and operating model for OCI or an equivalent major provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Oversee Kubernetes and virtualized environments, microservices foundations, cloud networking, databases, provisioning, and platform lifecycle.

Expand infrastructure as code and policy as code to make environments consistent, reviewable, and controlled.

Ensure backups and disaster recovery are routinely tested against agreed recovery objectives; improve resilience based on exercise results.

Introduce sound cloud financial management through cost allocation, forecasting, capacity choices, rightsizing, and accountable spend.

**Security engineering and threat response**

Own identity and privileged-access practices, secrets handling, and least-privilege design across cloud and engineering environments.

Ensure application and API authorization testing addresses tenant boundaries, isolation, and access-control failures in multi-tenant services.

Operate a risk-based vulnerability program that assigns owners, sets remediation targets, verifies fixes, and escalates overdue exposure.

Maintain cloud security posture management, continuous monitoring, security incident response, and disciplined penetration-test follow-through.

**Secure delivery, assurance, and AI operations**

Work with software engineering to embed automated checks in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container scanning, and IaC scanning.

Agree practical remediation SLAs and risk exceptions with engineering teams, keeping controls effective and delivery workflows usable.

Maintain operating evidence for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2; lead customer security assessments and responses.

Apply automation and AIOps to detection, triage, response, and toil reduction. For AI agents, establish identity controls, authorized tool access, isolated execution, complete audit trails, and human approvals for sensitive actions.

**Experience and leadership profile**

At least 20 years of technology experience, with a track record of senior ownership in cloud platforms, production operations, reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or security engineering.

Executive leadership across multiple functions, including managing managers, setting direction, building leadership capability, and delivering outcomes through sizeable teams.

Accountability for business-critical production services; product SaaS or other cloud-native, multi-tenant environments are especially relevant.

Practical depth in a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, observability, IaC, and recovery planning.

Credible record of leading significant production incidents and converting lessons into lasting changes to architecture, process, or operational readiness.

Applied security engineering experience spanning IAM/PAM, secrets, application and API authorization, vulnerability remediation, cloud posture, monitoring, and response.

Experience introducing automated CI/CD security checks and achieving sustained remediation without relying on manual review as the main control.

Experience leading ISO 27001-family and SOC 2 assurance, including evidence quality and customer-facing security reviews.

Ability to communicate technical risks, trade-offs, service performance, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Additional strengths**

Production experience with OCI; equivalent leadership depth with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is applicable.

Background in enterprise SaaS or a regulated, security-conscious technology environment.

Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or audit credentials, such as cloud architecture/security certifications, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.

Demonstrated use of AIOps or AI agents in operational settings with clear boundaries, oversight, and auditability.

description:
**Company**

: 8–12 years in LT, control and automation panel manufacturing, including at least 3 years leading a team

**Qualification**
: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in EEE, EIE or ECE

**Role Summary**

You will lead day-to-day production, testing and quality of MCC, PCC, VFD, APFC and PLC/automation panels. You make sure every panel leaves the shop floor on time, built to drawing, fully tested and documented. You will work as the link between Design, Stores/Logistics, Sales and the customer so production runs without rework or delays.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Management**

- Plan and run panel production schedules against order priorities and delivery commitments

- Lead and supervise wiremen, fitters and testing technicians, including allocating manpower and tracking productivity

- Make sure builds follow approved GA/schematic drawings, BOM and wiring standards

- Find bottlenecks, cut rework and improve cycle time and workmanship

- Enforce shop-floor safety, 5S and housekeeping

**VFD Testing, Troubleshooting & Commissioning**

- Carry out hands-on parameterisation, testing and troubleshooting of VFDs (Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Control Techniques, Danfoss, Delta, Mitsubishi or similar)

- Run motor-coupled and no-load testing, and check I/O, communication and protection functions

- Support site commissioning and resolve field issues when needed

**PLC Panel FAT & Testing**

- Prepare and run FAT procedures: I/O checks, network/communication tests (PROFINET, Modbus, Ethernet/IP), interlock and sequence simulation

- Lead customer and consultant FAT witness visits, and record and close punch points

- Carry out routine tests such as IR, HV and continuity, plus functional and power-on tests

**QC & Documentation**

- Prepare and maintain QC dossiers: inspection checklists, test reports, FAT protocols and reports, IR/HV records, calibration records and as-built markups

- Make sure panels comply with IEC 61439 / IS 8623, IEC 60204-1 and customer specifications

- Maintain NCR/CAPA records and support ISO quality system requirements

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

- Design: clarify drawings, feed back on manufacturability and control revisions

- Purchase/Stores/Logistics: track material readiness, shortages, dispatch planning, packing and documents

- Sales: confirm delivery dates, technical deviations and change orders

- Customer: handle progress updates, inspection scheduling, query resolution and handover

**Other**

- Any other responsibilities assigned by management in line with business needs

**Skills & Competencies**

- Strong hands-on knowledge of VFDs, PLCs (Siemens S7-1200/1500 preferred), HMIs and switchgear

- Able to read and interpret electrical schematics, GA drawings and BOMs

- Sound knowledge of panel testing practice and relevant standards

- Proven ability to lead a shop-floor team and meet deadlines

- Good communication skills in English and Tamil, with confidence dealing with customers and consultants

- Working knowledge of MS Excel/Office; exposure to EPLAN or AutoCAD Electrical is a plus

**Preferred**

- Experience with OEM or system-integrator panel shops serving pharma, F&B, water/wastewater or oil & gas

- Exposure to customer FATs witnessed by third-party inspectors

**Compensation**
: Competitive, based on experience

title: Chief Cloud Infrastructure & Security Officer
description:
Job Description

**Senior Director / Vice President, Cloud Operations & Security Engineering**

**Location:**
Chennai DLF

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
20+ years

**Role Summary**

Talentgigs is seeking an experienced technology leader to own and advance Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevSecOps, and Security Engineering.

This leader will bring deep technical judgment and a strong record of leading cloud-native production environments. They will build a capable, accountable organization that protects and operates critical services through reliable engineering, proactive security, automation, continuous monitoring, and disciplined incident management.

The role extends beyond traditional infrastructure management and information security management system (ISMS) compliance. The successful candidate will embed security and reliability in engineering and operational practices, reduce risk before it becomes an incident, and use automation and AI-driven operations to improve service health and response.

**Key Responsibilities**

Production Operations and Reliability

* Own the reliability, availability, performance, and operational readiness of production services.
* Establish clear service ownership, operational accountability, escalation paths, and on-call practices.
* Lead incident response, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on corrective actions.
* Define and improve service-level objectives, service-level indicators, error budgets, and operational health measures.
* Strengthen change, release, capacity, resilience, backup, and disaster-recovery practices.
* Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil through engineering-led improvements.

**Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering**

* Set the direction for secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-aware cloud infrastructure.
* Lead the design and operation of cloud-native platforms, environments, networks, identity controls, and shared services.
* Promote infrastructure as code, standard platform patterns, self-service capabilities, and repeatable environment provisioning.
* Ensure platform design supports availability, recovery, observability, performance, and secure delivery.
* Guide capacity planning, cloud cost visibility, and optimization without compromising reliability or security.

**SRE and Operational Excellence**

* Build and mature SRE practices that make reliability measurable and part of day-to-day engineering.
* Develop observability across services using actionable metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and service health views.
* Improve deployment safety through progressive delivery, automated checks, rollback readiness, and resilient release practices.
* Use incident trends, operational data, and post-incident reviews to guide prioritized improvements.
* Create a culture of learning and accountability in which incidents lead to durable fixes.

**DevSecOps and Security Engineering**

* Embed security into software delivery, infrastructure management, and operational workflows.
* Lead practical security engineering across identity and access, secrets, configuration, network controls, workload protection, and data safeguards.
* Build automated security checks into build, test, deployment, and infrastructure pipelines.
* Establish continuous monitoring and threat detection with clear triage, escalation, and response ownership.
* Drive vulnerability prevention and remediation through asset visibility, risk-based prioritization, patching, secure configuration, and dependency controls.
* Strengthen cloud security posture and address risks across applications, platforms, identities, and operational processes.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to resolve security issues early and sustainably.
* Ensure audits and ISMS obligations are supported by effective technical controls and evidence, while keeping operational security and risk reduction at the center.

**Automation and AI-Driven Operations**

* Set an automation strategy that reduces manual work, improves consistency, and speeds up safe delivery and recovery.
* Apply AI and advanced analytics to suitable operational use cases, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage, capacity forecasting, and knowledge retrieval.
* Establish appropriate safeguards, human oversight, validation, and access controls for AI-supported operational workflows.
* Measure automation outcomes through reduced toil, faster response, fewer repeat incidents, and improved service health.

**Organization and Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain strong teams across production operations, cloud infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, and security engineering.
* Define organizational structure, role clarity, decision rights, service ownership, and measurable accountability.
* Develop senior technical leaders and create growth paths for engineering and operations talent.
* Work closely with product, application engineering, architecture, risk, and business leaders to align technology priorities with business outcomes.
* Communicate operational risk, service health, security posture, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Lead through technical credibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and consistent follow-through.

Required Technical Qualifications

* 20+ years of progressive experience in technology, infrastructure, production operations, cloud engineering, reliability, or security, including substantial leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership in cloud-native production environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, networking, identity, compute, storage, and platform operations.
* Experience designing and operating containerized and orchestrated workloads, such as Kubernetes or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, configuration management, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation.
* Deep working understanding of SRE principles, observability, service-level objectives, incident management, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Experience implementing security controls in cloud and software delivery environments, including identity management, secrets, vulnerability management, secure configuration, and threat detection.
* Experience establishing continuous monitoring, alerting, incident response, and security operations practices.
* Ability to assess architecture and operational risk, make trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical decisions.
* Familiarity with cloud cost management and capacity planning in production environments.

**Required Leadership Qualifications**

* Experience leading multiple technical functions and managing managers or senior technical leaders.
* Track record of building technically strong teams with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to stay close to technical decisions while setting direction and enabling teams to execute.
* Proven leadership in major incidents, security events, operational change, or complex service transformations.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and investment priorities to executive and non-technical audiences.
* A practical, engineering-led approach to governance, risk management, and compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust and work across organizational boundaries.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience leading operations and security in a high-scale, high-availability, or business-critical environment.
* Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure and operational models into cloud-native platforms and practices.
* Familiarity with zero-trust principles, security architecture, threat modeling, and secure software supply chains.
* Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, game days, and recovery exercises.
* Experience using AI or machine learning to improve operational monitoring, incident workflows, or engineering productivity.
* Familiarity with security and service-management frameworks or standards relevant to the organization.
* Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or leadership certifications.

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be assessed through sustained improvements in:

* Production service availability, reliability, performance, and recovery readiness.
* Incident frequency, severity, time to detect, time to restore, and recurrence rates.
* Adoption and quality of service-level objectives, observability, and service ownership.
* Vulnerability exposure, remediation timelines, secure configuration, and cloud security posture.
* Security monitoring coverage, alert quality, response readiness, and closure of corrective actions.
* Automation coverage, reduction in manual toil, and safe deployment frequency.
* Resilience, backup, disaster-recovery, and continuity test outcomes.
* Cloud cost visibility and efficiency while meeting reliability and security requirements.
* Team capability, role clarity, leadership depth, and accountability across the functions.
* The ability of engineering teams to adopt secure and reliable practices as part of normal delivery.

description:

* Experience supporting executive leadership teams and enterprise-wide initiatives.
* MBA or other relevant advanced degree.
* Experience in consulting, strategy, PMO, governance, or transformation functions.
* Ability to influence without authority and coordinate across complex global stakeholder groups.

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, the work model will be determined in accordance with business needs and hiring location. title: Manager - Procurement
description:
The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading procurement activities for both inter-company and external supplier purchases, ensuring cost-effective sourcing, uninterrupted material availability, efficient logistics management, and supplier relationship development. The role requires expertise in procurement strategy, commercial negotiations, SAP systems, logistics coordination, and supply chain management within the process automation industry.
  
  
Procurement & Sourcing
  
  

* Manage end-to-end procurement activities for inter-group and external suppliers.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Ensure timely procurement of materials, components, and services to support business operations.
* Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes, cost optimization, and supplier performance.

Supplier Management
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop suppliers to support business requirements.
* Build strategic partnerships with key suppliers and internal group companies.
* Monitor supplier performance through KPIs such as delivery, quality, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness.
* Conduct periodic supplier reviews and corrective action follow-ups.

Commercial Negotiation
  
  

* Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, payment terms, contracts, and service agreements.
* Deliver year-on-year cost savings through strategic sourcing initiatives.
* Manage contract renewals and ensure favorable commercial terms.

SAP & Procurement Operations
  
  

* Oversee purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, and supplier master data within SAP.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies and approval workflows.
* Drive accuracy and efficiency of procurement transactions and reporting.

Logistics & Supply Chain Coordination
  
  

* Coordinate closely with logistics providers, production planning, warehouses, and suppliers to ensure on-time deliveries.
* Manage import/export processes, shipment tracking, and customs-related activities.
* Support inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with Planning, Manufacturing, Engineering, Finance, Quality, and Customer Service teams.
* Support business growth through proactive procurement planning and risk mitigation.
* Act as the key escalation point for supply disruptions and delivery challenges.

Process Improvement
  
  

* Drive digital transformation and process automation initiatives within procurement operations.
* Implement best practices in sourcing, supplier management, and logistics.
* Participate in continuous improvement and operational excellence projects.
* Graduate degree in Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration, or related discipline.
