title: Global Billing Operations - Manager
description:
**Background**
 State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Controllership, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. Billing Organization owns aspects of business\-as\-usual activities within billing areas and also drives process improvements and automation.
   

  

**Basic Purpose Of Job**
 The Invoice Review Lead will be responsible for all aspects of the invoice billing process including invoice raising, OOPS (Out of Pocket Expenses) invoicing, and invoice review across State Street global businesses spread across countries \& regions.
   

  

 The Invoice Review Lead will manage a large team with a complex engagement model on a day\-to\-day basis. The individual will be directly responsible for daily management of accurate, consistent, and timely invoice deliverables. This individual will provide subject matter expertise in invoice preparation and review including receivables analytics. The Invoice Review Lead will also be responsible for managing State Street Global Advisors’ invoice production and review.
   

  

 In addition to Business As Usual (BAU) responsibilities as described above, this role will also be involved in process re\-engineering, standardization, and automation efforts.
   

  

 Responsibilities:\-
   

  

**Business As Usual (BAU) Activities**
* General responsibility for all operational invoicing activities
* End\-to\-end responsibility for a major group of the billing process: Invoice preparation and review
* Oversee and manage the invoice review team to achieve global consistency and effectiveness in controls; accurate, quality work; and transparency into activities and results. Maintain a robust control environment: process controls, process oversight and process governance responsibility
* Develop the team to adopt “owner’s mind set”, work independently, and effectively manage timelines
* Manage resources to assist with ad\-hoc invoice projects
* Measure progress toward goals; and evaluate productivity and team efficiency. Review and assess regularly with team members and with management
* May serve as a subject matter expert on particular invoice related issues
* Coaches the team and gathers feedback for performance appraisals


**Process Re\-Engineering, Standardization, And Automation**
* Assist with the process Re\-Engineering, Standardization, and Automation efforts for invoicing
* Responsible for ongoing process improvements


**Expectations**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree in Finance, CPA Qualified with an experience minimum of 10 to 12 years working with invoices in a global billing function at a large financial services institution.
* Knowledge of various services and industry trends of billing methods for those services like Custody services, Sub custodian, trust services and out pocket expense billing, asset management etc.
* Experience of building and maintaining strong control environment (risk excellence, experience with SOX, RCSA controls, etc.), establishing policies, procedures and strong internal controls.
* Demonstrated leadership in improving/building\-out the invoice function for multiple geographies and business areas
* Experience assisting with re\-engineering processes and driving similar centralization of the end\-to\-end activities for the major financial institutions


**Skills Required**
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, Visio), advance levels of Excel (pivot tables, formulas, excel workbook maintenance best practices)
* Knowledge of billing systems
* Conceptual understanding of company\-wide financial architecture (GL, sub\-GL technology, specialized tools) applicable to the above process groups of processes
* First level management expertise required
* Independent decision\-making capabilities, demonstrated thought leadership
* Pride of ownership with the ability to deliver high quality results timely
* Self\-motivated, self\-assured, and self\-managed
* Strong analytical and ability to analyze and summarize complex financial transactions
* Strong attention to details
* Problem solving skill
* Highly organized with ability to multi\-task and work under high pressure deadlines
* Must be able to work in a fast paced environment


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 5\+ years of team management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

**Job Summary**
* Lead and accelerate process transformation across CIB, WRB and Functions by deploying Process Excellence capabilities to improve client outcomes, operational effectiveness, efficiency, and risk \& control.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to identify, prioritise and deliver enterprise\-wide transformation opportunities aligned to the Bank's ambition to standardise, simplify and digitise.
* Build and scale Process Excellence capabilities, embedding a culture of continuous improvement and delivering measurable business outcomes


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the delivery of enterprise\-wide process transformation by leveraging Process Excellence capabilities to drive efficiency, effectiveness, client and colleague experience, and sustainable business value.
* Define and execute process transformation roadmaps with Business and Function leaders.
* Lead the deployment of Process Excellence capabilities including Process Universe, Process Reviews, Process Mining and Delivery services.
* Drive process redesign, optimisation, automation and simplification opportunities across strategic initiatives.
* Influence senior stakeholders to align on transformation priorities, desired outcomes and delivery plans.
* Manage programme governance, risks, dependencies, resources, budgets and delivery performance.
* Build team capability, develop talent and foster a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure adherence to governance, methodologies and project delivery standards while delivering measurable benefits.


**People and Talent**
* Set direction and drive high performance by translating strategy into clear direction, aligning individual goals to team outcomes and providing regular, constructive feedback.
* Develop talent and capability through coaching and career conversations that build critical skills, stretch potential and prepare individuals for future opportunities.
* Lead by example by role\-modelling the Bank’s valued behaviours, upholding strong risk and conduct standards, exercising sound judgment, and creating an inclusive team culture that supports wellbeing, values diverse perspectives, and drives accountability.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must\-have Skills**
* Strategic Thinking
* Stakeholder Management
* Process Excellence Methodologies (eg. Lean, Six Sigma)
* Project \& Programme Management
* Transformation \& Delivery
* Operating Model \& Organisational Change


**Other Skills**
* Cost / Business Efficiency
* Strategy \& Measurement
* Management Consulting


**Our Ideal Candidate**
**Key Experiences**
* Minimum 15 years in the project / programme / portfolio management space, supporting or delivering mid\-large size, complex initiatives across CIB, WRB and Functions
* Domain knowledge applied and gained through significant transformation initiatives across CIB, WRB and Functions key processes, resulting in significant benefits streamlining processes
* Knowledge of the Bank, in terms of key processes, stakeholder groups
* Strategic thinking, ability to identify opportunities and translate this into roadmap and actionable plan
* Knowledge of SCB ways of working
* Knowledge of Process Excellence methodologies (lean, six sigma, zero base design) and proven execution track record
* Strong influencing and communication skills – oral, written and presentation. Proven success in communicating technical information in a simple way.
* A can\-do attitude committed to doing what it takes to deliver. Diligent and detail orientated
* Growth mindset. Appetite, ambition and ability to experiment and learn quickly
* Excellent stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills. Establishes effective working relationships across the organisation – from senior management to individual teams
* A team player; multi\-culturally aware with a proven ability to work in a global service delivery model, with onshore and offshore resources
* Confident and courageous to raise/escalate issues in a pro\-active, professional, and timely manner
* Demonstrate understanding of and commitment to the Group’s core values


**Languages**
* Business Communication


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.


**Recruitment Assessments**
 Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.
   

  

 Visit our careers website www.sc.com/careers

title: Infrastructure Architect
description:
* In this role, you will manage contract governance and commercial controls for Cross Functional Services across infrastructure managed services engagements.
* Ensure alignment of delivery obligations with contractual commitments, service levels, KPIs, penalties, deliverables, governance forums, reporting obligations, and client expectations.
* Act as the central point of coordination for contractual interpretation, obligation tracking, commercial risk assessment, contract change control, and compliance reporting.
* Work closely with service delivery managers, finance, PMO, legal, procurement, transition, tower leads, client governance teams, and partner/vendor teams to ensure commercial and contractual discipline.
* Drive proactive identification of contractual risks, open obligations, SLA/KPI exposure, change impacts, commercial deviations, and governance actions across the service lifecycle.


 A day in the life of an Infoscion
   

  

* As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to lead the engagement effort of providing high\-quality and value\-adding consulting solutions to customers at different stages\- from problem definition to diagnosis to solution design, development and deployment.
* You will review the proposals prepared by consultants, provide guidance, and analyze the solutions defined for the client business problems to identify any potential risks and issues.
* You will identify change Management requirements and propose a structured approach to client for managing the change using multiple communication mechanisms.
* You will also coach and create a vision for the team, provide subject matter training for your focus areas, motivate and inspire team members through effective and timely feedback and recognition for high performance.
* You would be a key contributor in unit\-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high\-quality, value\-adding consulting solutions to customers adhering to the guidelines and processes of the organization. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
* Experience in contract governance for infrastructure managed services, Cross Functional Services, SIAM, service management, or multi\-vendor operating models.
* Ability to interpret contract schedules, statements of work, service descriptions, RACIs, governance frameworks, performance obligations, commercial clauses, and change control procedures.
* Hands\-on experience in tracking contractual deliverables, obligations, service levels, KPIs, penalties, credits, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, risks, and open actions.
* Strong knowledge of contract change management including change request assessment, impact analysis, pricing coordination, approval tracking, documentation, and implementation governance.
* Experience in commercial management including billing validation, invoice support, effort/cost tracking, forecast alignment, consumption reporting, chargeability tracking, and financial governance.
* Ability to coordinate with legal, finance, procurement, delivery, PMO, transition, service management, tower teams, and client stakeholders for contract\-related decisions and escalations.
* Experience in preparing compliance dashboards, contract obligation trackers, governance reports, commercial risk logs, SLA/KPI exposure reports, and leadership updates.
* Strong understanding of ITIL\-based delivery operations, incident/change/problem/service request processes, service reporting, operational governance, and continuous service improvement.
* Ability to manage contractual escalations, dispute coordination, audit support, evidence management, and closure of non\-compliance observations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, analytical, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and executive reporting skills.

title: Head of Physiotherapy (Clinical Lead)
description:
ABOUT VECURA
   

 VeCura is a doctor\-led wellness and metabolic health clinic chain with 30\+ branches across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, and more coming. We treat 35,000\+ clients a year through structured programmes combining lifestyle, diet, device and physiotherapy. Muscle health and mobility are becoming central to how we care for clients, and we're building that function from the ground up.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

 You will own physiotherapy across the VeCura network. You'll design and standardise our Physio module and train every branch physiotherapist to deliver both consistently. You'll also be the public face of physiotherapy at VeCura, explaining movement, strength and healthy ageing on camera to a large social media audience.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO
   

 Clinical leadership
   

 • Own the Physio module in every VeCura programme: assessment battery, session protocols, progression rules and outcome measures
   

 • Co\-develop programmes with our medical team
   

 • Define contraindications, red flags and escalation pathways with the medical team, and keep protocols evidence\-based and clinically defensible
   

 • Audit protocol adherence and outcomes across branches, then fix the gaps
   

 Training and team building
   

 • Build the physio training curriculum: onboarding, module certification and periodic refreshers
   

 • Train and mentor branch physiotherapists, in person and virtually
   

 • Set quality standards and documentation norms, and run case reviews
   

 Content and communication
   

 • Appear regularly on VeCura's social media channels (reels, explainers, Q\&A, live sessions)
   

 • Work with the marketing team to plan, script and shoot content on mobility, strength, posture and healthy ageing
   

 • Keep all public messaging accurate, responsible and free of exaggerated claims
   

 • Support client education material and occasional workshops or corporate talks
   

  

 WHAT YOU BRING (MUST\-HAVE)
   

 • BPT required; MPT (Musculoskeletal, Neuro, Sports or Geriatrics) strongly preferred
   

 • 7\+ years of clinical experience, including at least 2 years leading or training a team of physiotherapists
   

 • Proven on\-camera experience: social media content, YouTube, TV, webinars or brand videos. Please share links.
   

 • Hands\-on experience with strength and balance rehab in older adults or musculoskeletal populations
   

 • Strong written and verbal communication in English and Tamil
   

 • Ability to turn clinical protocols into simple, repeatable SOPs that others can follow
   

  

 GOOD TO HAVE
   

 • Certification or training in fall\-prevention programmes (e.g., Otago), sarcopenia assessment or geriatric rehab
   

 • Familiarity with EMS, body composition analysis (InBody) or strength testing
   

 • Experience in a multi\-branch clinic chain or a structured training role
   

 • Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam knowledge is a plus
   

 • An existing personal following as a health educator
   

  

 WHAT WE OFFER
   

 • A leadership role building a network\-wide function from scratch
   

 • Direct access to corporate leadership and the medical team
   

 • A platform to build your public profile as a trusted physiotherapy voice
   

 • Competitive compensation

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
**Job Description**
 Cost Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain project cost budgets in accordance with the Project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and the Basis of Estimate
* Liaise with procurement, finance, and time\-capture functions to ensure accurate and timely capture of all cost elements — procurement, materials, subcontracts, and labour
* Monitor and review cost commitments and expenditure through all phases of project lifecycle
* Liaise with project management and planning to ensure accuracy of cost phasing and forecasting
* Review and evaluate project cost performance reports and forecast updates
* Review and analyse cost impact of manpower forecasts
* Review and issue project change orders and variations in accordance with change notifications
* Assess and communicate cost and schedule impact of change notifications
* Monitor overall project cost performance and contingency drawdown
* Lead the project cost close\-out process
* Act as Cost Focal Point for all assigned project scopes


 Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure project budgets, costs, and reports are documented, auditable, and issued in a controlled manner
* Review and evaluate project cost performance reports in accordance with project reporting requirements
* Attend project and client periodic meetings and present cost performance status as required
* Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and issued in accordance with the contract reporting calendar
* Ensure original and current budgets correspond to approved estimates and scope changes throughout the project lifecycle
* Participate in contract and corporate risk analysis sessions and audits


 PMBS \& Efficiency
   

  

* Support the achievement of the contract PMBS efficiency target (target: PMBS below 50% of Engineering cost)
* Actively contribute to simplification of cost reporting structures and reduction of unnecessary reporting overhead
* Contribute to the development of fit\-for\-purpose cost controls for the Fast Track delivery model


 Team \& Capability Development
   

  

* Supervise, guide, and manage the Cost team — delegating work, reviewing outputs, and supporting development
* Play a key role in mentoring and career development of cost personnel within the GEC
* Lead and participate in Project Controls compliance and continuous improvement reviews
* Contribute to the recruiting and retention of project controls talent within the GEC Hub


**Contract\-specific Requirements**
 Location \& Mobility
   

  

* Based at the Wood GEC office in Chennai, India — this is the primary place of work
* Willingness and ability to undertake periodic overseas travel, primarily to the UK (Aberdeen), for project governance, knowledge transfer, customer engagement, and team alignment purposes
* Estimated overseas travel: low frequency (approximately 2–4 trips per year depending on project phase)


 International \& Multicultural Experience
   

  

* Demonstrated experience working in multicultural environments — experience working or collaborating with teams in Europe (particularly the UK) is strongly preferred
* Proven ability to operate effectively across cultural, organizational, and time\-zone boundaries
* Experience of UK North Sea or comparable European offshore oil and gas operations is advantageous


 Brownfield Experience
   

  

* Preference for candidates with previous brownfield offshore modification or brownfield EPC project experience
* Familiarity with the particular challenges of brownfield scope definition, execution in operating environments, and interface management with asset operations teams


 Transition \& Uncertainty Leadership
   

  

* Demonstrable ability to lead teams through periods of significant change, transition, and operating model evolution
* Comfortable operating with managed uncertainty — able to keep teams focused, motivated, and delivering during periods when processes, structures, or accountabilities are still maturing
* Experience of operating model transitions, onboarding programmes, or significant organizational change is advantageous


 Workload Flexibility
   

  

* Ability to manage varied and changing workloads across multiple concurrent scopes of differing scale and complexity
* Comfortable moving between strategic planning, hands\-on delivery support, and team leadership as the situation requires


 Networking \& Talent Development
   

  

* Strong professional networking capability — able to identify, attract, and retain talent within the GEC and the wider Wood organization
* Active approach to building an internal talent pipeline, mentoring junior team members, and contributing to the development of the GEC as a center of excellence
* Contribution to the wider recruiting effort for the GEC Hub build\-out is expected


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business discipline (or equivalent through relevant vocational training and industry experience)


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Minimum 8 years of relevant cost control experience
* Excellent knowledge of cost software, budgeting, forecasting, and cash\-flow management
* Advanced knowledge of Project Execution Procedures for Cost Management including Change Management
* Excellent understanding of WBS and CBS structures, earned value application, and cost/schedule variance analysis
* Prior experience in a senior cost role, with team management experience
* Experience of offshore oil and gas project delivery — brownfield experience strongly preferred


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Analytically rigorous with strong attention to accuracy and auditability
* Proactive communicator — raises issues early and clearly
* Able to work autonomously and within a team across multiple time zones
* Committed to continuous improvement and process simplification
* Strong organizational and planning skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent scopes


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy \& Materials pillar of Sidara \- a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com
   

  

**Diversity Statement**
 We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non\-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

title: Manager – Financial Operations
description:
Management Level
   

  

 F
   

  

 EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer\-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Manager – Financial Operations**
 The Manager, Financial Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of all finance activities processed through the organisation's Workday/ERP platform. The role acts as the global process owner for Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and direct oversight of UK Payroll processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing, timely financial reporting, strong controls, and optimal use of Workday/ERP capabilities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a strong people leader with the ability to develop high\-performing teams, build organisational capability, and drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
   

  

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Process Ownership**
* Lead the delivery of finance operations across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and Payroll processes.
* Own operational performance, ensuring delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Ensure standardised, efficient, and well\-controlled end\-to\-end finance processes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues and process exceptions.


**People Management**
* Lead, develop, and motivate a high\-performing Finance Operations team.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and career development opportunities to enhance capability and engagement.
* Drive talent management, succession planning, and skills development to ensure long\-term organisational resilience.


**Accounts Payable Operations**
* Oversee invoice processing, payment execution, employee expenses, and supplier account management.
* Ensure timely supplier payments and effective resolution of payment\-related issues.
* Maintain strong AP controls, compliance, and governance standards.
* Act as the functional owner for Workday Accounts Payable processes and enhancements.


**Record\-to\-Report Operations**
* Ensure timely and accurate journal processing and financial accounting activities.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalisation, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
* Manage balance sheet reconciliations, bank reconciliations, and prepayment accounting.
* Support statutory, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvements across RTR processes to improve efficiency, control, and reporting quality.


**Procurement Operations**
* Manage Purchase Order (PO) support processes.
* Oversee supplier onboarding activities and vendor master governance.
* Support procurement compliance and policy adherence.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive efficient purchasing processes.
* Support supplier negotiations and process optimisation initiatives.


**Payroll Operations (UK)**
* Oversee UK payroll processing, validation, reconciliations, and payroll accounting activities.
* Ensure payroll operations are delivered accurately, compliantly, and on time.
* Review payroll journals, controls, and exception management processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of payroll queries and exceptions.
* Partner with HR and external providers to maintain a high\-quality payroll service.


**Workday/ERP Governance \& Optimisation**
* Act as the Finance SME for Workday/ERP processes and functionality.
* Drive maximum utilisation of system capabilities through automation and process standardisation.
* Partner with Technology and Business teams on system enhancements and process changes.


**Performance Management \& Reporting**
* Develop and maintain KPI dashboards and operational reporting.
* Monitor productivity, service levels, quality, and control metrics.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide regular management information to Finance leadership.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Simplify workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support Finance transformation and change initiatives.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
* Strong experience across Finance Operations, Shared Services, or Financial Accounting environments.
* End\-to\-end knowledge of Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Fixed Assets, and UK Payroll processes.
* Experience of operating and optimising ERP platforms, preferably Workday.
* Strong understanding of Month\-End and year\-end financial close processes.
* Experience delivering operational excellence, automation, and process transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple functions and levels.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to lead change and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**
* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA) or equivalent


**SKILLS:**
* Fluent English: written and spoken.
* Proven Leadership abilities and team working
* Excellent organizational, communication and planning skills
* Professional, credible individual with an ability to influence peers, superiors and subordinates
* Adaptable with an ability to change direction and priorities if required
* Achievement orientation: Driven by goals and deadlines
* Ability to work well with people across the organisation.
* Ability to understand the detail behind processes.


 We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. Please note any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory pre\-employment screening checks.

title: Asset Manager
description:

In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.

* Review and manage credit and legal documentation to support smooth execution of lending transactions.

* Analyse legal drafts and ensure alignment with business, regulatory, and operational requirements.
* Identify risks, escalate issues appropriately, and ensure all processes are completed within agreed timelines.

**Desirable Skills Set**
* Strong experience in credit documentation and lending operations.

* Assertive personality with strong negotiation and problem\-solving abilities..

 This role is based out of Chennai.

 To support Wholesale Lending with day\-to\-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.
   

  

**Accountabilities**

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. * Proven experience as a delivery lead, preferably with MetricStream or similar GRC platforms.

* Knowledge of MetricStream features and technology (BAPI journeys, PL\-SQL, JAVA and MetricStream reporting tools, Power BI etc.)
* Knowledge of data governance and the integration of Risk, Audit, and HSEC processes.


**Key strengths include:**
* A solutions\-focused individual who can work with teams through complex challenges while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification is a plus.
* Familiarity with compliance, risk management, and audit processes.
* Awareness of natural resources sector compliance challenges and emerging GRC \& ERM trends, is a plus.


**Benefits**
* We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.
* We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.
* We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.


**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
   

  

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa\+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient \- increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
   

  

 We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India\-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high\-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI\-first engineering organization operates \- where large language models, agents, and AI\-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day\-to\-day engineering.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi\-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
* As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
* Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India\-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on\-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
* Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM\-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI\-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
* Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 8\+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
* Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
* Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
* Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in computer science or related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user\-facing technologies.
* Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
* Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production\-ready solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* AI Leadership Competencies \-We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
* AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine\-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
* AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost\-per\-interaction, trust).
* Driving AI\-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI\-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
* Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
* Talent and culture for an AI\-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI\-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.

title: Deputy Manager- Execution
description:
**Job Description**
**Your Responsibilities:**
 We are looking for a dynamic Trade Execution \& Port Operations professional to manage end\-to\-end execution of edible oil imports and domestic trade operations. The role will be responsible for execution of import and local purchase contracts, vessel operations, customs coordination, terminal operations, inventory management, customer deliveries, documentation, cost control, and stakeholder management across multiple ports including JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and Haldia.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in handling imported edible oils such as Crude Palm Oil (CPO), Degummed Soybean Oil (DSO), Sunflower Oil, RBD and other bulk liquid commodities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Trade Execution
   

  

* Manage complete execution of purchase and sales contracts from contract confirmation until final settlement.
* Ensure timely execution of import shipments with minimal operational and financial risk.
* Coordinate contract nominations, shipment schedules, delivery plans, and execution timelines.
* Monitor contractual obligations and ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms.
* Maintain accurate trade position and execution status.


 Port \& Terminal Operations
   

  

* Independently manage day\-to\-day operations at JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and other assigned ports.
* Coordinate vessel discharge operations with shipping agents, tank terminals, surveyors, customs brokers, and transporters.
* Monitor vessel berthing, discharge progress, storage utilization, and cargo evacuation.
* Ensure timely completion of discharge operations while minimizing demurrage, detention, and operational delays.
* Coordinate local purchase unloading and customer loading operations.


 Customs \& Documentation
   

  

* Track Bill of Entry (BOE) filing and customs clearance.
* Coordinate with Customs House Agents (CHA), shipping lines, and regulatory authorities.
* Monitor duty payments and customs\-related compliance.
* Ensure timely availability of import documents for cargo clearance.


 Customer \& Supplier Coordination
   

  

* Act as the primary execution contact for buyers, suppliers, shipping companies, tank terminals, surveyors, inspectors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate delivery orders, cargo lifting schedules, sampling, inspections, and documentation.
* Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Perform margin calculations, revised pricing, duty variance calculations, and commercial settlements.
* Process Debit Notes (DN), Credit Notes (CN), and trade settlements.
* Verify invoices before processing


 Inventory \& Quality Management
   

  

* Monitor stock positions across terminals.
* Coordinate quality inspections, sampling, and survey reports.
* Ensure accurate inventory reconciliation.
* Coordinate quality and weight settlements with suppliers and buyers while minimizing commercial exposure.
* Monitor execution costs and identify opportunities for operational savings.
* Review port, terminal, survey, transport, and warehouse costs.
* Support vendor invoice verification and non\-raw material vendor payments.


 Reporting \& MIS, Process Improvement \& Compliance
   

  

* Maintain execution records and operational documentation.
* Prepare Daily Discharge Reports (DDR), vessel status reports, stock reports, and execution MIS.
* Update SharePoint and ERP systems with execution data.
* Prepare month\-end operational reports and support financial closing activities.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, trade compliance, food safety, and statutory requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining complete documentation.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Trading, Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Logistics, Customs, and Legal teams.
* Build effective relationships with customers, suppliers, terminals, surveyors, transporters, shipping agents, and government authorities.
* Maintain accurate execution records.
* Support ERP implementation and digital initiatives.
* Perform additional execution\-related responsibilities assigned by management.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Timely execution of purchase and sales contracts.
* Zero operational disruptions due to execution lapses.
* Minimized demurrage, detention, and avoidable logistics costs.
* Accurate BOE tracking and customs clearance.
* Timely customer deliveries and cargo lifting.
* Inventory accuracy and stock reconciliation.
* Timely completion of commercial settlements (DN/CN).
* Accuracy of MIS and operational reporting.
* Strong compliance with SOPs and audit requirements.
* Continuous improvement through cost\-saving and process optimization initiatives.


**Your Profile**
 Preferred Experience
   

  

* 5–10 years of experience in Trade Execution, Import Operations, Port Operations, or Supply Chain.
* Experience in edible oil imports is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience managing bulk liquid cargo operations.
* Experience handling multiple ports simultaneously.


**Preferred Commodity Experience**
* Crude Palm Oil (CPO) /Crude Deggumed Soybean Oil /Refined Oils /Crude Sunflower Oil /Other edible oil commodities

As a Product Strategy and Operations Manager, you will work closely with the Product Strategy and Operations Manager and the Product leadership team, partnering across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Finance. This is an ideal first role for a fresh MBA graduate who wants exposure to how a fast\-scaling product organisation actually runs — you'll learn by doing, with real ownership from day one.
 



 You will:
 


* Support the P\&E rhythm of business — helping coordinate roadmap reviews, sprint planning, launch readiness, post\-launch retrospectives, and QBRs — and help build the operating cadence that keeps the product organisation structured and predictable.
* Help track the product metrics that matter: activation, adoption, retention, expansion, and their leading indicators. Assist in building out the "product landing" framework — a structured post\-launch process that ensures new features are actually adopted and generate learnings for the next iteration.
* Support the product\-level analysis of pricing and packaging — how capabilities are bundled, how value is communicated at each tier, and how new AI modules affect the overall commercial model.
* Assist Finance and Sales on pricing changes — building models of customer impact and helping structure the internal and external communication around pricing evolution.
* Help develop ROI frameworks and value metrics for each product area, which Marketing and Sales can use in positioning and commercial conversations.
* Support the sales enablement process — working with Sales and Marketing to help set targets, build plans, and track tactics that drive pipeline generation, CSAT, and adoption.
* Help build and maintain competitive intelligence systems that give product leaders an up\-to\-date view of the market landscape.



**What We're Looking For**

 .

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Trackon Couriers Private Limited is a customer\-centric logistics partner focused on providing on\-time deliveries at competitive rates. The company leverages cutting\-edge technology to streamline shipping operations and offer reliable, efficient logistics solutions. Trackon is committed to service excellence, combining innovation with personalized support to meet diverse customer needs. Team members benefit from working in a performance\-driven environment that values accountability, operational quality, and continuous improvement.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Branch Manager role based in Chennai. The Branch Manager oversees day\-to\-day branch operations, including managing dispatch and deliveries, supervising staff, and ensuring adherence to service standards and timelines. The role involves monitoring branch performance, handling customer escalations, and implementing operational improvements to enhance efficiency and profitability. The Branch Manager is responsible for coordinating with regional and head office teams, managing budgets, maintaining compliance with company policies, and preparing regular reports on branch activities. **Qualifications**
  

* Demonstrated experience in branch management, operations management, or logistics supervision, preferably in courier or transportation services.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, guide, and develop on\-site teams to meet performance and service targets.
* Proficiency in using logistics or dispatch software, basic MS Office tools, and technology\-driven tracking systems.
* Excellent customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills for handling client queries and resolving escalations.
* Solid analytical and problem\-solving abilities, including capacity to interpret data, track KPIs, and implement process improvements.
* Proven ability to manage budgets, control operational costs, and support revenue growth at the branch level.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Ability to work on\-site in Chennai, handle multiple priorities, and maintain high standards of reliability, integrity, and professionalism.

title: Plant Manager / Production Manager
description:
For our Client:
 



  





 Chemical Blending Facility – Speciality Chemicals
 



  





 Position Overview
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager / Production Manager to lead the setup, commissioning, and ongoing operations of a chemical blending facility for the manufacture of detergents, surfactants, and dicing fluids. The role will be responsible for safe, efficient, quality\-driven, and compliant plant operations, including production planning, batch manufacturing, raw material handling, packaging, maintenance coordination, manpower management, and continuous improvement.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will bring strong hands\-on experience in chemical blending, specialty chemicals, surfactants, detergents, lubricants, process chemicals, personal care chemicals, or related formulation\-based manufacturing environments, along with proven leadership of plant teams and adherence to safety, quality, and statutory requirements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead day\-to\-day production operations for chemical blending, mixing, filtration, filling, packaging, storage, and dispatch activities.
 



 Manage plant setup activities including layout readiness, equipment installation support, utilities coordination, trial batches, commissioning, and operational handover.
 



 Ensure all batches are manufactured strictly as per approved formulations, batch sheets, SOPs, work instructions, and quality specifications.
 



 Plan production schedules based on customer requirements, raw material availability, manpower, equipment capacity, and delivery commitments.
 



 Supervise handling, storage, charging, transfer, and use of chemicals including surfactants, solvents, additives, builders, preservatives, pH adjusters, fragrances, and specialty performance additives.
 



 Maintain strong control over batch yields, rework, wastage, spillage, process losses, and product consistency.
 



 Coordinate closely with Quality Control / Quality Assurance for raw material release, in\-process checks, finished product testing, non\-conformance handling, and corrective actions.
 



 Implement and enforce EHS practices related to chemical handling, PPE, MSDS/SDS compliance, spill response, fire safety, hazardous storage, effluent control, and emergency preparedness.
 



 Maintain compliance with applicable factory, labour, environmental, statutory, ISO, customer, and internal audit requirements.
 



 Lead, train, schedule, and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, helpers, and contract employees across shifts.
 



 Coordinate with maintenance and engineering teams to ensure preventive maintenance, breakdown response, calibration, utility reliability, and equipment uptime.
 



 Monitor production performance using KPIs such as output, batch cycle time, right\-first\-time quality, OEE, downtime, yield, cost, rejection rate, and on\-time delivery.
 



 Maintain accurate plant documentation, including batch records, production reports, stock records, shift logs, equipment cleaning records, EHS records, and audit trails.
 



 Drive continuous improvement initiatives in productivity, safety, housekeeping, process standardization, material usage, energy efficiency, and cost reduction.
 



 Support procurement, stores, warehouse, logistics, R\&D, technical service, and commercial teams to ensure smooth end\-to\-end operations.
 



 Required Qualifications and Experience
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, Chemistry, Polymer Science, Production Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 



 Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in chemical manufacturing, preferably in chemical blending, detergents, surfactants, specialty chemicals, metalworking fluids, dicing fluids, lubricants, process chemicals, home care, personal care, coatings, adhesives, or similar formulation\-based industries.
 



 At least 3–5 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial production role with responsibility for teams, shifts, production targets, safety, and quality outcomes.
 



 Experience in plant startup, commissioning, scale\-up, process stabilization, or greenfield / brownfield expansion projects will be highly preferred.
 



 Strong working knowledge of batch processing, blending vessels, agitators, pumps, transfer lines, filtration systems, filling lines, storage tanks, weighing systems, utilities, and packaging operations.
 



 Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, 5S, lean manufacturing, and statutory compliance requirements applicable to chemical plants.
 



 Technical Competencies
 



 Understanding of surfactant chemistry, detergent formulations, emulsions, pH control, viscosity control, foam behaviour, compatibility, and stability requirements.
 



 Knowledge of chemical blending methods, batch sequencing, raw material compatibility, and contamination prevention.
 



 Ability to read and implement formulations, batch manufacturing records, process parameters, SOPs, SDS/MSDS documents, and quality specifications.
 



 Strong awareness of safe storage and handling of acids, alkalis, solvents, surfactants, preservatives, additives, and other industrial chemicals.
 



 Working knowledge of effluent, waste, spill, and emissions management practices relevant to chemical blending facilities.
 



 Ability to troubleshoot production issues such as off\-spec batches, phase separation, foaming, viscosity deviation, contamination, colour / odour variation, filling losses, and equipment downtime.
 



 Leadership and Behavioural Competencies
 



 Strong leadership, ownership, discipline, and hands\-on plant\-floor orientation.
 



 Ability to build and lead teams in a startup or scale\-up manufacturing environment.
 



 High commitment to safety, quality, compliance, housekeeping, and operational reliability.
 



 Good communication skills for coordination with senior management, technical teams, vendors, auditors, customers, and shop\-floor employees.
 



 Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical, data\-driven, and cost\-conscious approach.
 



 Ability to create systems, enforce SOPs, train teams, and sustain operational discipline.
 



 Key Performance Indicators
 



 Achievement of monthly and weekly production plans.
 



 Right\-first\-time batch quality and reduction in non\-conformances.
 



 Improvement in yield, productivity, batch cycle time, and equipment uptime.
 



 Reduction in wastage, rework, spills, downtime, and customer complaints.
 



 Compliance with EHS, statutory, audit, and documentation requirements.
 



 Manpower productivity, training completion, retention, and discipline.
 



 On\-time availability of finished goods for dispatch.
 



 Reporting and Interfaces
 



 Reports to: Business Head
 



 Preferred Candidate Profile
 



 The preferred candidate will be a practical, technically strong, safety\-conscious production leader who has grown through plant operations and understands both formulation accuracy and shop\-floor execution. The person should be comfortable working in a hands\-on environment, setting up systems from scratch, leading teams across shifts, and ensuring that the facility operates with high standards of quality, discipline, compliance, and cost control.
 



  





 Location \- Chennai
 



  





 Budget \- Open

title: Security Operations Centre (SOC) Manager
description:
**Job Purpose** 




 The SOC Manager leads the daily operations of the Security Operations Centre, overseeing on\-premises and hosted security technologies, directing incident response, and leading the SOC team. The role ensures the continued maturity of the organization's security controls and the protection of its data, infrastructure, and customers against evolving cyber threats.
 



  





**Job Dimensions** 



* **Reports to:** 
 Cybersecurity Manager
* **Direct reports:** 
 6
* **Indirect reports:** 
 0
* **Function:** 
 Cybersecurity / Security Operations



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**SOC Monitoring \& Management** 



* Oversee the daily monitoring and review of security event activity and the cyber\-threat landscape, ensuring the ongoing maturity of the organisation's security controls.
* Manage the resolution of cybersecurity incidents and coordinate engineering support for security systems.
* Identify and diagnose potential threats — including root\-cause analysis and after\-action reviews — to ensure security controls (firewalls, IPS, etc.) defend the enterprise against malicious network attacks.
* Manage customer relationships against SLAs, expectations, and contractual terms.
* Drive the creation and implementation of custom alerting rules, searches, and dashboards for review and investigation.
* Oversee support\-ticket analysis to identify and implement improvements, and report findings, data, and KPIs to leadership.
* Own the design and engineering of key security tools, including the automation of tasks and processes through scripting and programming.
* Collaborate with internal teams to embed security, logging, auditing, and support needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Align internal SOC processes to improve analyst efficiency.



**Governance** 



* Implement the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Ensure security teams' adherence to security controls and policies.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and responsibilities.



**Reporting \& Documentation** 



* Develop and streamline processes and procedures for efficient SOC operations.
* Conduct weekly and monthly service\-review meetings with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure the organization's data and infrastructure are protected through appropriate security controls.
* Perform routine security audits of the infrastructure and present findings.



**Training \& Development** 



* Ensure all certifications required for the role are met within 6 months of joining and kept valid thereafter.
* Maintain knowledge across all relevant areas of security administration and expand specialist knowledge as required.
* Stay current with the field through continuous learning and participation in technical events.



  





**Span of Communication** 



* **Internal:** 
 FutureX internal teams
* **External:** 
 Customers



  





**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills** 




  





**Required Qualifications \& Certifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in a related field
* CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional
* CISM – Certified Information Security Manager
* GPEN – GIAC Penetration Tester
* GREM – GIAC Reverse Engineering Malware
* GCFE – GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner
* ITIL Foundation



*(Certifications must be held or obtained within 6 months of joining.)* 




**Required Experience** 



* 8–12 years of relevant cybersecurity / security operations experience



**Required Skills** 



* Complex problem\-solving
* Fluent spoken and written English
* Ability to deliver clear, engaging, and concise presentations to customers



  





**Job\-Specific Skills \& Competencies** 




**Technical Competencies** 



* SIEM, DLP, Active Directory, Email Security, Endpoint Security, IDS/IPS, and related tooling
* Vulnerability assessments

title: Warehouse Executive
description:
**About The Company**
 We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate career. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle.
   

  

 "The spending youth, especially the millennials \& Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value conscious. Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say.
   

  

 RentoMojo caters to the needs of the working professionals which is unmet due to nonavailability of furnished rental flats by offering furniture and appliances on rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and appliances.
   

  

 Currently, we have 100,000\+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 12\-14 months. The current market size (as per a recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4\.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025\.
   

  

 With 700\+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only made a new market of lease which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer rental industry. title: Associate / Assistant manager - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Position Overview"** 




  




* **Job Title:** 
 Associate / Assistant manager \- Transaction Reporting
* **Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations
* **Location:** 
 Chennai
* **Business Line / Function:** 
 Reporting Production Analyst – Regulatory Transaction Reporting (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite)



  





**Position Purpose:** 




  





 Execute day‑to‑day regulatory transaction reporting across EU and UK jurisdictions (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II) and ASIC Rewrite. Serve as the first‑line defence to ensure accurate, complete and timely submission to Trade Repositories or Approved Reporting Mechanisms, while overseeing outsourced reporting providers and delegated broker reports.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




  





 1\. Oversight \& Monitoring of Outsourced Reporting (EMIR EU/UK, ASIC)
 


* Monitor daily production and submission status of the 3rd‑party service provider (SP).
* Validate SP controls, reconcile internal trades against SP reports, and track escalations or SLA breaches.
* Maintain audit evidence and act as the primary SP point‑of‑contact.



 2\. Daily Trade \& Transaction Reporting (SFTR \& MiFID II – EU/UK)
 


* Produce and submit all reportable trades within regulatory deadlines.
* Monitor platforms and intraday flows, validate post‑submission content, and ensure final acceptance by the Trade Repository or ARM/APA.



 3\. Rejections \& Exceptions Remediation
 


* Investigate NACKs and other exceptions; identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing).
* Amend and resubmit corrected reports within the required jurisdictional timeframes.
* Keep a detailed audit trail of all remediation actions.



 4\. Daily \& Monthly Reconciliation
 


* Perform daily reconciliation for SFTR and MiFID II (EU/UK) and reconcile internal data against SP output for EMIR and ASIC.
* Conduct monthly reconciliations to confirm consistency between source data and submitted data.
* Document results and escalate any unresolved breaks with a clear resolution plan.



 5\. Oversight of Delegated EMIR Reporting on ETD (Clearing Brokers)
 


* Validate the completeness and timeliness of broker‑submitted reports.
* Engage brokers to correct discrepancies, track issues and retain audit evidence.



 6\. Pairing \& Matching
 


* Resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions; manage UTI processing in line with internal procedures.
* Monitor pairing and matching rates as a key quality indicator.



 7\. Reporting to RTR Team
 


* Produce daily dashboards covering volumes, pairing/matching rates, acceptance, rejections and remediation.
* Highlight emerging issues, trends and risks in a structured manner.



**8\. Continuous Improvement \& Knowledge Sharing** 



* Identify and escalate recurring issues; keep procedures, run‑books and knowledge base up‑to‑date.
* Cross‑train team members to maintain full interchangeability.
* Stay current with regulatory changes and contribute to impact assessments.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience (must have):** 




  




* **Regulatory Reporting Experience:** 
 Minimum
 **(Associate \- 3\-6 years)**
* **( Assistant Manager 7\- 11 years)** 
 in regulatory transaction reporting within financial services (asset‑management or sell‑side).
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** 
 Solid understanding of reporting mechanics (submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI, pairing‑matching, lifecycle events) and proficiency in at least one regime (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite) with a willingness to master all four.
* **Outsourced‑Provider Oversight:** 
 Proven ability to monitor, challenge and review controls and SLAs of an external reporting provider.
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Advanced Excel (pivot tables, look‑ups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting.
* **Analytical \& Investigative Skills:** 
 Strong root‑cause analysis of data‑quality issues.
* **Communication:** 
 Ability to translate technical issues into clear messages for the RTR team and senior management; capable of producing presentations and KPI reports.
* **Team Interchangeability:** 
 Support colleagues through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
* **Behavioral Skills:** 
 Active listening, adaptability, knowledge sharing and meticulous attention to details



  





**Preferred Education, Skills \& Experience :** 




  




* **Regulatory Regimes:** 
 Working knowledge of two or more of the following – EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite.
* **Reporting Platforms:** 
 Hands‑on experience with Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri‑Optima, DTCC or IHS Markit.
* **Additional Technical Tools:** 
 Familiarity with automated reconciliation or data‑quality tools (e.g., Python‑based scripting, SQL) – advantageous but not mandatory.



  





**About BNP Paribas India Solutions:** 




  





 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group.
